This article is, hopefully, the first of 
many articles; | hope to write on this Subject: 

Before starting, | salute the Late Prof 
K.S .Krishnamutri, the founder of the KP System , 
fondly known as Guruji. | congratulate Shri 
Kanak Bosmia, for having started this e- 


magazine, especially devoted to KP. 


This introductory write up is to convince 
the readers, that the method is based entirely 
on principles enunciated by Guruji. Guru 
propounded the KP system after a lot of 
research, and he encouraged students to carry 
out further research. Dr Kar’s Sub-sub theory 
is a result of such further research. In 
Maharastra, Mr. Husbe, and later Mr. S.G. 
Gondhalekar of Thana, carried out research 
and have propounded what Is called the 4 Step 
Theory, as 4 steps are involved in finding the 
houses signified by the planets. Shri 


Gondhalekar is running a monthly magazine, 


q 


“Nakshatra Dena” in Marathi, and also a 
correspondence course, in Marathi, on this 4 
step Theory. | have gone thru this course, and 
my notes are based on what | have learned from 


this course. 


The Fundamental Principle of KP is that a 
Planet gives the results indicated by its Star 
Lord. The Sub Lord indicates whether such a 
result will be positive or negative, by its 
placement, and houses owned by it. The planet 
also 
Gives the results indicated by its Placement, and 


thru the houses it owns. 


Inthe 4 step theory, this KP principle is 
carried forward, and it is stated, that the Sub- 
Lord will give the results indicated by the Star- 
Lord of the Sub-lord. This is the 4'" step. 


Inthe 4 Step Method, instead of finding 
the significators of the Houses, and then 
tabulating the Houses signified by the Planets, 
the Houses influenced by the planets are found 
directly. A planet is assumed to give results of 
the House Where it is situated in the chart, and 
the house/ houses owned by it. Thus each planet 
will influence 2 or 3 houses, in the Normal 
Course. However, inthe 4step theory, it will also 
influence the houses influenced by its star-lord, 
its sub-lord and the star lord of the sub-lord. 


These houses are found in 4 steps as under 


Step 1: The house of residence 
of the Planet then 1 or 2 houses owned by the 


Planet: 


Step 2: The house of residence of the 

Star Lord of the planet and lor 2 houses owned 
Step 3: The house of residence 

of the Sub Lord of the Planet and 1 or 2 houses 


owned by it. 


Step 4: The house of residence 
of the Star-Lord of the sub-lord 


And lor 2 houses owned by this planet. 


All the houses indicated in the 4 steps are held 


to be influenced or signified by the Planet. 


Prof KSK has indicated that one should 


consider the Star Lord of the Sub Lord as well. 


That sub-lord can influence certain 
results is dealt with in “Cusps and Subs”. “I f the 
Sub-lord of the Ascendant Is significator of....... 
“, certain results are indicated.. This shows that 
the Sub-lord can indicate direct results. In 
Reader 4 page 86 “TO FIND OUT THE 
PHYS|CAL FEATURES OF .......”, it Is stated “ 
If the sub-lord of the seventh cusp is SUN and 
it is deposited in: or the lord of the 
constellation is Sun in which the sub- lord of 7 
is in :” 
|n other words, if the 7'° sub-lord is SUN or the 
star-lord of the 7‘" sub-lord is SUN, and this in 


This clearly points out that KSK_ had 


visualized the use of the Star Lord of the Sub- 
Lord. 

Inthe next article, | will attempt to show how 
these 4 steps are computed.

WHAT ARE THE RULING PLANETS? These are 
not mere Planets but they are the 

that will take the KP followers out of 
the labyrinth dark tunnel of KP principles where 
several precious stones, jewels and what not, 
are strewn all over but cannot be seen by them 
due to the thick darkness. Therefore one should 
be very careful before trying to use these 
GREAT LIGHTS for their use. Then what is the 
procedure. Let me _ explain below, which is 
backed by my experience as a practicing KP 
Astrologer for the past more than half a 
century (55 years) after learning this Great 


Divine Science directly by sitting under the 
lotus feet of our beloved GURUJ 1 himself. 


Before attempting to verify, correct and 
predict on a Birth Chart or from a Horary 
Chart, first close your eyes, concentrate deeply 
and beg for the GRACE of your Parents, 
(FATHER AND MOTHER) whether they are alive 
or not, since they are the persons who gave you 
this body and mind through which your intellect 
works on any subject and produce results. 


Then beg for the GRACE of GURU)! to guide 
you properly and correctly. This is a must, since 
without a Guru or Teacher you~ cannot 
understand anything in life. 


Next, pray to your I shta Devta, 
(WORSHIPPING DEITY) it may be anything 
like, Christ, Allah, Ram, Krishan, Shiv, 
Jegadambha etc., etc., This is necessary 
because the Planets are placed in the firmament 
by THEM to give results based on their position 
in the Chart. Here a question may be asked 
viz., “| DON’T BELIEVE IN THE EXISTANCE 
OF ANY GOD “, what am I to do?. O.K. At 
least you Know and believe that you are brought 
into this world by your Father and Mother. For 
such persons, their Father and Mother only are 
the Gods or I shta Devta. 


Check your own Natal/ Birth Chart and find out 
whether the period Lords, viz., Dasa, Bukthi, 
Anthar and Sookshma, Moon and the Ascendant, 
are Transiting in a favorable position for you on 
the day you are working out the chart. Here 
give more importance to the Ascendant which 
indicates the time at which you are taking up 
the Chart for working. Please note here that | 
have not taken into account J upiter and Sun. 
The reason is very simple. J upiter indicates the 
year and all of us know that it is a very slow 
moving Planet and you cannot wait for another 
Year to come before taking up the Chart for 
working. Similarly Sun which denotes the Month 
also moves only a degree per day and we cannot 
wait for one month, for taking up _ the 
examination of the Chart. 


After satisfying all the above pre- requisites, 
you should work out the RULING PLANETS with 
respect for them in your heart since they are 


going to guide you to success. Here also first 
you should take only the 5 RULING PLANETS 
followed by our GREAT GURUJI, VIZ.,. 
Ascendant Star Lord, Ascendant Sign Lord, 
Moon's Star Lord, Moon’s Sign Lord and finally 
the Day Lord, (Here, if you follow the Indian 
System of Day, it should be from Sun Rise to 
Sun Rise. Otherwise, it should be from Midnight 
to Midnight) for the time up to the Seconds, at 
the place you are examining the Chart. Since 
correct time is the essence in this exercise you 
Should give greatest importance for the 
correctness of the time up to the Micro 
Seconds which you can obtain from= any 
Scientific Laboratory which uses the Atomic 
Clock for their work e.g., National Physical 
Laboratory branches in your place or any nearby 
city. You can get it from the local telegraph 
office also since they correct their time every 
day at 4 P.M. 


These first set of 5 Planets should be kept and 
used as PRIMARY RULING PLANETS. Then, 
take those Planets that have not figured 
directly as RPs i.e., Primary RPs, but they are 
in the Star and / Sub of RPs., those Planets 
within 3 degrees of a RP, those Planets which 
are occupying the Ascendant Sign in the RP, 
those Planets that are being strongly aspected 
by the Primary RPs. These should be kept 
separately as SECONDARY RULING PLANETS. 
So far as Nodes are concerned, if they are 
conjoined with either the Primary or Secondary 
RPs they should be taken as RPs in their 
respective set i.e., Primary or Secondary and 
similarly if they occupy the Signs of the RPs., 
Primary and Secondary. In this process you will 
mostly get all the 9 Planets are RPs. 


After the above process is over, you can begin 
your work, first by the positioning the 
PRIMARY RPs to the required places depending 
on the type of question etc., In case you are 
not getting the correct result, go to the 
SECONDARY RPs to see if they fit in for the 
purpose for which you have invoked the RPs. 


In the case of Horary Charts, the usual 
elimination process (i) removing the tempting RPs 
(ii) RPs that are occupying the negative houses 
from the houses required for getting the result 
(iii) RPs that are in the Stars/Subs of Planets 


occupying the negative houses (iv) RPs in the 
Star and or Sub of a Retrograde Planet (v) RPs 
that are occupying the houses 6, 8 and 12 to 
the houses of judgement, should be followed.

1) F-1 
PLANET A 1S IN THE START OF B. 
2) F-2 
PLANET A IN THE STAR OF B, AND BIS IN THE STAR OF C 
3) F-3 
PLANET A IN THE SUB OR SUB SUB OF B, BIN THE STAR OF C. 
4) F-4 
PLANET A IS IN THE SUB OR SUB SUB OF B, BIS IN THE STAR OF C, CIS IN THE STAR 
OF D. 


Of the above from F-1 and F-3 are popular used, and as per Dr. Kar he like this two. 

For F-1 Position B, For F-2 Position c ,also for F-3 Position c and F-4 Position D is to be well 
scrutinized .l.e B or C or D Must be inthe favorable bhava. We require to judge or thay shall be the 
cuspl sign,star or sub sublord. When we require or consider the cusps (for marriage 2,/,11) 

Next planet once found as positive and again in other way found as negative, the positive one should 
be taken because we are proceeding in search of a good result.

Our Gurujt late J hothisha Marthand Shri K.S. 
Krishnamurthy after his unceasing labour and research 
for over 40 to 50 years derived this marvelous system 
popularly known as (K.P. System) krishamurthy Padhdhati, 


a system of scientific predictive stellar astrology. 


In this system, the Ruling planets serve as a 


master key in timing due events. 


Unlike old Traditional system a planet tenanting 
the Constellation emits the matter | of the house 
occupied by the constellation Lord and the houses owned 


by them. 


Such matters are indicated by the tenant 
PLANET which ts Known as the Significator will come to 
pass depending on the sub portion of the constellation 


occupied by the tenant planet 


What is SIGNIFICATORS. 
a) The Planet inthe constellation of the occupant of 


the bhava (House) 


b) The Occupant of the house, if there are to plants 
in its three stars. 

c) Planet in the constellation of the lord of House 
provided the houses owned by the lord of the 
constellation are un-occupied. 

d) Lord of the House, of there are no planets in any 
of its three stars and the houses owned are 


vacant 


W hat is a Sub? 


a) You know that the arc or the extent of a star Is 13-20 
(800 mts) and is divided into a un equal proportion of the 
Dasa years allotted to each Planet inthe VIMSHOTTARI 
DASA SYSTEM of 120 years, each such part is known as 
sub contracted from Sub-Division. 

|[n other words if the constellation is a kin to 
DASA, the bukthi is akin to SUB and Authse is akin to 
SUB-SUB 


J ust as a Planet 1s controlled by sub and thus its 
powers are modified interms of its constellation Lord, So 
also the 12 CUSPS inthe Birth chart or Horary chart are 
ruled by subs and the lord of the same sub is being 
controlled by the constellation lord and effects of the 
matters signified by the cusp and house get modified in 
terms of signification attained by the sub lord of these 
cusps. Table of subs ( 1 to 249) can be had in almost all 


the K.P. Readers and Ephemeris. 


In K.P. System the cusp sub lord is the deciding 
factor in all cases. This is the sheet - Anchor of the K.P. 
System and is universally applied with out exception to all 
queries whether judged from birth charts or in Horary 
Maps. For assessing a particular question and in terms of 
the matter cited in the query, one shall look into the sub 


lord of the cusp of house which represents such matters. 


The cusp and the sub lord of that house is the 
deciding factor. An Examination of the cuspal Sub-Lord 
will enable to decide finally and clearly, if the matter 


denoted by that house in question will fructif y or not 


House division in K.P. 

Shri K.S.K. had advised the PLACIDIUS system 
to be used and this system divided the 12 signs into 
unequal but correct divisions. In this system, a house is 
SO considered to commerce from a point ina sign, so that 
the space between the cusp of the | st house and that of 
the || nd House is the extant of the Lagna bhara, the 
space between the 2™ CUSP and that of the 3™ CUSP is 


called as 2" bhava 


This radically differ from the old Indian 
Traditional system, where the cusp of a house Is taken as 
the mid point of a house, which K.P. Students need not 
consider at all Sothe entire SUB LORDS of 12 cusps, will 
reveal the status of a horoscope. This is the essence of 


Guruji’s K.P. system. 


So the students of K.P. system should bear in 
mind the necessarily of assessing the strength of each 
cusp before predicting the effects of dasa and also 


particular event as desired by the querants. 


The cuspal sub lords is also comes as strong 
Significator of the particular CUSP, in the absence of the 
planets in its there stars. This was tested is so many 


cases and found to get good results. 


For example If you want to predict a query 
regarding the sale of house, ie Disposal of housing or 


landed property, the sub lords of the CUSP of 3, 5, 10 


are to be judged for selling and 3 & 12 for giving 


possession. 


4'" house represents immovable property (Land, 
Building etc.) The purchaser is represented by the 7'" 
CUSP of the chart and his acquisition of property is 
denoted by 4°" from 7" ic 10'" cusp. Whether any party 
would purchase the querants property (ie whether the 
querant will be able to sell the property (1.e. whether the 
querrant will be able to sell the property) is therefore to 
be judged from the 10°" CUSP of the chart and its SUB 


lord. 


The Querrant is property is denoted by the 4" 
CUSP and his parting with it by 3°° CUSP (which is 12 
from 4'"), Thus some party would purchase only if the 
SUB Lord of 10'" CUSP is a significator of houses 
(Bhavas) 3, and 10°". The 5'" CUSP is also relevant to the 
matter as it is the 11'° house from 7‘” (Fulfillment of his 
desire) representation of the purchaser. |f the sub lord 
of 4°" CUSP signifies 4,11 and 12 one will construct a 
house and MARS also should come into picture for 
immovable properties and Building as SAT for 
construction (Civil Engineering) 11th for fulfillment of 


desire and 12'" for investment of money.

ADVANCED SYSTEM OF STELLAR ASTROLOGY

System. | am one of HIS fortunate students who 
had heard him in person teaching HIS System. He 
also. occupied the Chair in Astrology’ in 
BARATHIYA VIDYA BHAVAN. For the benefit of 
all Astrologers in general and _ Astrologers 
practicing KP in particular, | venture to write about 
THIS unique system of HIS with HIS blessings from 
above. 


1, CASTING A HORARY CHART:- For casting a 
Horary Chart take the commencing position of the 
Sub of the Horary number as the NIRAYANA 
ASCENDANT. This Cuspal position of the Ascendant 
remains the same irrespective of the year or the 
locality where the CHART is cast. 


2. For ascertaining the Cusps of other houses, 
take the LATITUDE where the Astrologer judges 
the chart irrespective of the place from which the 
Query has been raised, either by phone, letter, 


Email, telegram etc., and the Chart is to be 
prepared as per THE PLACIDIUS SYSTEM OF 
HOUSE DIVISION as advised by our GURUJ! LATE 
SRI K.S.KRISHNAMURTHI) I with the help of 
UNIVERSAL TABLE OF HOUSES OR K.P.TABLE 
OF HOUSES AND MAHABALA EPHEMERIS and 
other Tables required for erecting the Chart 
correctly as advised by him. This is for those who 
prepare the Chart manually. Those who have 
computers can prepare the Chart with the help of 
Software prepared by Sri A.R.Raichur of Bombay or 
Sri Rangarajan of Man Machine Systems, Chennai. 


3. If the HORARY CHAT is likely to be judged 
immediately after casting then the_ position of 
Planets is to be worked out for the time when the 
Chart is taken for casting, In all other cases the 
position of Planets should be worked out only for 
the time when the Astrologer commences analyzing 
the chart. | would like to make one point clear in 
respect of those Astrologers who have KP Charts 
computer package. In their cases they should 
remember that unless they are in a position to 
analyze the Chart immediately after getting a print 
out of the Chart with all details of the 
Significators, Aspects, Dasas etc., they should 
not cast the Chart and keep it and attend to some 
other job thinking that the Chart has been prepared 
for the correct time as desired by them and 
therefore they can take time to leisurely judge 
them. In their case also the same rule that applies 
to others who cast Charts manually applies i.e., 
unless they are in a position to analyze the chart 
immediately don't feed the data in the computer 
and get the print out of the Chart with other data 
mentioned above. 


4. The query may be for the Querist himself or 
for some relative or friend. If the query is for 
himself make all calculations from Lagna. If it is for 
younger Brother or Sister, take the 3rd _ house 
counted from the Lagna in the Horary Chart as 
Ascendant and work out. If it relates to Mother, 
take the 4th as Ascendant. For the Sons and 
Daughters of the Querist take 5‘ for Wife or 
Partner in business take 7th, for Father take 9th, 
for elder Brother or Sister, for Friend etc., take 
11° and for any unknown persons take 9°" as 
Ascendant and work out. 


5. After the chart is cast, the first job is 
to check whether the chart reflects the mind of 
the Querist. For this check what MOON the Planet 
that controls the thought process and_ mind, 


represents by virtue of houses owned and occupied by 
it, whether its star and Sub Lords are connected 
with the houses relevant to the query raised. 
Experience confirms that a connection by Sub Lordship 
is very important. 


6 ASCENDANT also reflects the Mind of the 
Querist, since it stands for both the Querist 
himself and also the query put by him. Whatever 
matters the Ascendant Sub Lord signifies, that is 
what the Querist would like to know. So ascertain 
which houses are signified by the Ascendant Sub 
lord and what relevancy they have to the question 
raised. 


7. WHETHER THE MATTER IS PROMISSED:- 
The main purpose of HORARY is to get a direct 
answer to the query raised and therefore unless the 
matter is promised there is no point in proceeding 
further. Therefore only when the query is properly 
reflected by the disposition of MOON and/or 
ASCENDANT SUB-LORD, the case is to _ be 
examined whether the matter is promised or not. In 
this connection | would like the readers to keep in mind 
PUNARPOO DOSHA before coming to any conclusion 
on this matter. While examining a Horary Chart 
this will be discussed in detail, if necessary. 


8. For finding out whether the matter 
queried will materialize or not, consider the 11°" Cusp 
and find out whether the 11°" Cusp Sub Lord is 
either RETROGRADE or deposited in_ the 
Constellation whose Lord is RETROGRADE. If the Sub 
Lord himself is retrograde then the event will 
materialize with delay. But if it is posited in the 
Constellation of a Planet that is retrograde then the 
event will not materialize at all. On the other 
hand if the Sub- Lord and Lord of the Constellation 
in which this Sub Lord is posited are in direct motion 
and if the same Sub Lord is also a significator of 
either 11th or at least any one of the concerned 
houses relevant to the query in question then the 
event is promised. FULFILMENT OF ALL THESE 
THREE CONDITIONS i.e., i) Sub Lord should not be 
retrograde ii) Sub Lord should not be in the 
Constellation of a Planet in retrograde and iii) the 
Sub- Lord should signify 11th or any one of the 
houses relevant to the Query, 1S A MUST to give 
an affirmative answer to the query raised. If ANY 
ONE Of THEM IS NOT FULFILLED, THEN THE 
EVENT WILL NOT HAPPEN. 


9. Another method to ascertain whether an 
event will materialize or not is to check whether the 


CUSPAL SUB LORD of the main house is_ the 
significator of the main or any of the Subsidiary 
house(s) or the 11th house. For example for 
foreign travel Sub Lord of the 12th Cusp (Main 
house) must be a significator of either 9 (long 
journey) or III (Change or movement from 
residence) or 12th - change of environment itself. 
For marriage the 7‘ Cusp Sub Lord should signify 
either 2, 7 or 11 etc., 


10.WHETHER CHANGE IS BENEFICIAL OR 
NOT? Very often the consultants ask whether the 
change is going to be beneficial or not. For this 
ascertain whether the 11" Cusp Sub Lord signifies 
the concerned houses. For example, if the XI Cusp 
Sub Lord signifies 2nd house (finance) the change will 
be good financially (increase in family members i.e., 
birth of children, beneficial to all the other relatives 
of the Querist since 2™ indicates all relatives 
irrespective of any particular relationship such as, 
Wife, Children, Father, Mother, Sisters etc., etc., 
But if it signifies 12th to 2nd i.e. Ascendant or lst 
house, it will indicate negation or worsening of the 
financial position, negating birth of children etc., if 
other considerations also agree i.e., if 5th or 11th 
Cusp Sub Lord gives similar indications. Some K.P. 
Astrologers have opined that the Ascendant will not 
negate financial matters. But from my _ personal 
Opinion and experience | have found that the 
Ascendant does affect the financial matters. The rest 
| leave it to the readers. 


11.The Sub Lord of a Planet denotes whether 


that Planet is auspicious for the progress of the 


Bhava or inauspicious for the Bhava signified by the 
Planet. If the Sub Lord is not in a favourable 


position then the Querist meets with obstacles, faces 
disappointment or negation of the matter. 


12. For ascertaining the Bhadhakasthana 
while judging Longevity or health remember that if 
the Ascendant is in a movable Sign, (MESHA, 
KATAKA, THULAM AND MAKARA) the 11" house is 
the Bhadakasthan, if it (Ascendant) is in a 
FIXED SIGN (RISHABHA, SIMHA, VRISCHIKA 
AND KUMBA) 9th house is the Bhadakasthan and 
finally if the Ascendant is in a COMMON SIGN 
(MITHUNA, KANYA, DHANUS AND’ MEENA) 
7th house is’ the Bhadhakasthana. 


13. HOW TO J] UDGE A CHART? The first 


step in this direction is to identify correctly the 
houses which have a bearing on the fructification of 


a query, e.g., MARRIAGE 2,7,11- BUILDING A 
HOUSE 4, 11, 12 - EMPLOYMENT 2, 6, 10 and 11 
etc., etc., and the Significators of these houses. The 
Significators are to be graded as lst. 2nd, 3rd, 4th 
and 5th strictly according to K.P. Method. How this 
grading is done will be explained when | take up a 
Chart for analyzation. 


14. RAHU AND KETHU_ should _ be_ included 
as Significators if they are conjoined 
with/ aspected by the Significators or tenanted in the 
house of Significators. 


15. For identifying the Lordship of a house, it

1S THE OWNER OF THE SIGN WHERE THE 
CUSP FALLS. THIS IS VERY IMPORTANT TO 
UNDERSTAND IN K.P.

In such cases the beneficial Significators amongst

THIS is really a very difficult task even for a very

methods of — selecting fruitful oor _ beneficial 
Significators are explained below.

L ASCENDANT OR_- LAGNA

29. TIMING OF EVENT: 


THIS is the greatest hurdle that even the

be mastered only by experience over a long period of 
time. However a few useful tips are given below. 


30.An event will materialise during the

Planets. 


31.W hen the event is expected in: 


a) Few hours from the time of judgement 
of the Horary Chart, move the 
Ascendant i.e., Lagna to the sensitive 
Zone of the Significators. 

b) In a few days time move Moon to the 

sensitive zone of the Significators. 

c) In a few months time, move Sun to 

the sensitive ZONES of the 

Significators 
d) lf after a year or more then move 
) UPITER to the sensitive ZONE of the 
Significators. 


In case the event is likely to happen within a few 
hours from the time of judgement of the Horary 
Chart, find the Lagna i.e., Ascendant that is rising 
at the time of judgement. Then which is next to rise 
and so on. Then that wing of ZONE that is governed

that one has to find out when the third signif icator 
becomes the Sub- Lord. When this position in that

32. But in case the event is expected to

33. IN HORARY CHARTS, Planets in retrograde

POSSIBILITY OF STAYING 
TOGETHER: 
A KP APPRAISAL 








By: Vijay Kumar 
Senior Manager, C-DOT 
Electronic City, Phase-1,Hosur Road 
Bangalore - 560 100 
080-25119580 (Off), 26587463 (Res)0-9845039153 
v_kumar@cdotb.ernet.in 





Author: The author hails from the Electronics and 
Communication engineering background, presently heading 
a Senior Managerial position at The Centre for 
Development of Telematics (C-DOT), Bangalore. Besides 
teaching Parasharic and J aimini astrology at |CAS, 
Bangalore and contributing to The Astrological Magazine 
in J aimini theme since a decade, the author has special 
interest in The Krishnamurti Paddhati and is a serious 
Student of this subject. 


This is a recent case when one of my colleagues in the 
office came up with the query “When will | start staying 
together with my wife”. On my request he gave me the 
horary number 1001 out of 1-2193. 


| was aware that the colleague stayed in Bangalore in his 
own house and his wife was engaged in a job at 
Hyderabad since about last 4 years. 

The prashna chart with cuspal details is produced here. 
The chart is being analyzed as follows: 

The Query 

Let us judge the mental setup of the native through 
Moon. Moon by itself is placed in Lagna as 11°" lord and 


thus poses the sincere interest of a harmonious life. 
Moon is in the sub of J upiter, placed in the 3°° house 





ensures his effort to pursue his partner. Thus, the chart 
may be considered genuine. 


Lagna sub-lord Rahu is the sub-lord of 3-5-7-9 cusp as 
well, thus Rahu controls the matters of staying and 
interacting together with wife (3°, 9°" and 7" cusp) and 
leading to harmony (5'" cusp). 


Looking to the disposition of Lagna sub-lord and Moon, 
the horary chart seems to be genuine and it is safe to 
proceed further. 


The co- ordinates for judgment 


|n a prashna for harmonious life with wife and children; 
Lagna, 5'° and 7'" cusp must get involved with the 11'? 
house to indicate the promise in the chart. The 
fructification of the desire to stay with family shall be 
realized only if the 11'" cusp indicates its linkage with the 
Lagna, 5'" and 7'" house without getting linked to the 
adverse houses. 


Analysis of the chart 
Look for the promise inthe chart from various angles: 


e Note that Rahu dominantly holds its say on the 
matters of the native, wife and the harmony. Thus, it 
IS important to analyse the signification of Rahu as 
seen from various reference points. 


e Looking from the view point of the native: 


Rahu is placed inthe star of J upiter, placed in the 3" 
house meaning the request of the native to his wife 
for leaving the job and staying together. Note that 
the job of the wife is indicated by the 4" house (10°" 
from 7'") and 3"° house would mean the wife to join 
the native by quitting her job. Since, Rahu falls in the 
sub of Mercury placed in the 4‘ house, the 
profession of the wife has the promise of continuing, 
bleaking the chances of staying together. 


e Looking from the 7'" cusp from the point of view of 
wif e: 


Sub-lord Rahu in the star of J upiter placed in 9°" 
house might led her to think about quitting the job 
but Mercury (sub-lord of Rahu) placed in 10°" house 
promises her to continue in the job. 


Note that there is no planet inthe star of Rahu, thus 
Rahu is a strong planet to dictate the indications 
largely on the matter in question based on its 
placement in the horary chart. Since Rahu is placed 
in the 6°" house, it poses a setback on the desire of 
the native and it seems that the wife does not 
approve her staying together with the native. 


Rahu, by way of being a shadowy planet, disposes 
Saturn (sign dispositor) and J] upiter (star dispositor). 
Let us see, If the Rahu’s dispositions of Saturn and 
] upiter provide some additional viewpoint. 


Saturn is in the star and sub of Ketu and the 
placement of Ketu in the 12'" house seems to weaken 
the hopes of the couple to stay together, as Rahu by 
itself signifies 6" house by its strong placement and 
12'" house through its sign dispositor-Saturn. 


J upiter is in the star of Saturn and in its own sub. 
Note that the placement of star lord Saturn in 11°" 
house and the placement of sub lord J upiter in 3" 
house is favorable. Since, J] upiter receives sextile 
aspect from 11'" lord Moon, there seems some hope 
for the good. 


Whether the desire of staying together in harmony is 
going to be realized or not may be seen from the 11'" 
Cusp. 


Mars is the sub-lord of the 11°" cusp. Mars is in the 
star of Ketu placed in 12'" house and does not offer 
the choice to the wife to quit the job (12'" house is 
6'" from the 7'" cusp), which puts off the native (12° 
house). 


Mars is inthe sub of Venus placed in the 5'" house, a 
house of harmony. Venus falls in the star of 11°" lord 
Moon that form trinal aspect on Venus, thus 
transferring the beneficence of 11°" lordship to 
Venus, offering some solace to the desire of the 
native, as it is the beneficial house for the native for 
marital felicity. 


Looking at the promise and fructification aspects, it 
was concluded that there could be some hope of 
Staying together amongst a lot of constraints. 


Timing the event 


Take a cursory glance on the dasha result. 


Moon dasha runs upto 2013 within which, Moon- 
J upiter dasha runs till 18-04-2007 and thereafter 
the bhuktis of Saturn, Mercury, Ketu, Venus and Sun 
are pending. 


Dasha lord Moon is in its own star placed in Lagna and 
its sub lord | upiter gets placed in the beneficial 3" 
house. Note that J upiter (sub-lord of Moon) gets the 
sextile aspect of the 11'° lord Moon and J upiter 
offers its sextile aspect on Venus placed in the 5°" 
house. Thus, Moon dasha does offer a possibility to 
have re-union. 


At this juncture, Ruling planets were taken at 18-54- 
21 Hrs on 10-01-2007 at Bangalore to gauze the 
possibility of a fruitful dasha spread, which came out 
as Saturn-Moon-Mercury. 


Since, J upiter was not a RP, J upiter bhukti (currently 
running) in Moon dasha was eliminated. The bhukti of 
Saturn (which is a ruling planet) is to continue from 
18-04-2007 to 18-04-2008. Can Saturn cause staying 
together? 


As noted earlier, Saturn is placed inthe star and sub 
of Ketu signif ying 12'" house due to Ketu’s placement 
in 12°" house. 12'" house represents the 6'" house 
(job) of the wife and if Ketu is taken to dispose Sun 
(Ketu in Leo), then the placement of Venus (the star 
lord of Sun) in 5'" house (11'" house of wife) makes 
her gainful and too strong in the ongoing profession. 
Note that apart from Sun, Ketu also disposes Venus 
as its star dispositor and the placement of Venus in 
Moon star (11'" lord placed in Lagna) and J} upiter sub 
(7'" lord placed in 3°° house) does help towards 
realizing the objective of staying together. 


Thus, it was assessed that Saturn bhukti in Moon 
dasha could help the native to realize his ambition in 
Staying together with his wife, though wife continues 
her job strongly. 


The next pending ruling planet is Mercury whose 
antara in Saturn bhukti runs from 19-7-2007 to 12- 
11-2007. Mercury does not have any planet inits star, 
thus its placement in 4'" house does promote the 
environment of home. Mercury falls in the star of 
12'" lord Sun placed in 4‘ house. Mercury falls inthe 
sub of Ketu placed in 12'" house and providing trinal 
aspect to the Sun placed in 4'" house. As such, 


Mercury does not actually pose a felicity at home and 
the native may not enjoy the bliss of homely 
environment even if he gets it and could be put off by 
reasons pertaining to his own dissatisfaction (12'" 
house). 


e From the beginning of Mercury bhukti, Sun starts 
transiting Pushya star in Cancer (both Moon and 
Saturn be the RP) and perhaps, the desire could be 
fructified then temporarily. 


Conclusion 


The overall indications of staying together in this 
oprashna are not seen straightaway, though some threads 
are available for felicity. Since, 6°" and 12'" houses are 
Signified very strongly, it was concluded that staying 
together might not be possible on permanent basis, 
except for some brief periods as indicated above. 


The facts of the case 


After, the conclusion was communicated to the native, he 
mentioned that he had faced hatred from his wife since 
the time they married and that was the principal driving 
force for the wife to take up the job outside Bangalore, 
meeting her requirements of keeping off from the 
husband. 


Well, in this prashna chart, the 6"" house was in focus of 
signification from Lagna sub-lord and that was almost 
overriding on the entire prashna chart. The 12°” house 
Signif ication was also dominant and that made a thread of 
mutual discord in the larger domain. The 11°" cusp does 
link to the 5-11" signification through Venus-M oon aspect 
and is thus able to barely maintain the marriage in the 
backdrop of discord. 


Acknowledgement 

The KP principles are infallible and are crystal clear, 
although, they require genuine efforts for understanding 
and application. Prof. Krishnamurti has devised a 
pioneering predictive model in astrology, which deserves 
Sincere appreciation.

OM GANESHAYA NAMAHA 


THE IMPORTANCE OF KP 
AYANAMSA IN APPLIED KP 
PREDICTION 


By: Prof. Andrew Dutta 
Faculty Member , The | CFAI Business School, 
Aditya Court, 8-2-334, Road No. 5, Banjara Hills, 
Hyderabad 500034, I ndia. 
Tel: 91-4023430415- 19 Extn: 262 
Fax: 91-4023430414 Cell: 0-0-98666 20483 

It gives me immense pleasure in authoring this 
article for the inaugural issue of KP E-magazine edited by 
a scholarly KP professional, Shri Kanak Bhai Bosmia, who 
is well known in India and abroad for his astoundingly 
correct predictions using the Krishnamurthi Paddhati 
(KP) astrology. In fact, the launch of this electronic 
magazine for KP astrology will, perhaps, be the first of 
its kind inthis branch of astrology inthe world. My best 
wishes are with the editor and this scholarly journal. 

The role of Ayanamsa in applied prediction can 
hardly be over emphasized. This article is not an attempt 
to advocate any particular Ayanamsa, since we are all 
aware that the Ayanamsa given by our revered Guruji 
late Shri K. S. Krishnamurthi (KSK) is a very important 
ingredient for using his system of astrology. The 
Krishnamurthi Paddhati would not yield correct results if 
one were to use any other Ayanamsa, namely Lahiri, 


Bhasin, Sanatana, or Raman. For correct prediction 


through KP astrology we invariably need the Ayanamsa 


Suggested by Shri KSK, which he arrived at after 
decades of painstaking research. In his First Reader, 
Shri KSK spent over 16 pages in discussing the role of 
Ayanamsa and his exposition on this matter leaves no 
room for doubt that the Ayanamsa suggested by him for 
5th April, 1900, taking the Epoch year as 291 AD, was 
22 Deg 22 Min 30 Secs (KP & Astrology Yearbook, 2003; 
pp 92-93) would yield consistent results with the 
precision rate per second per year as 50. 2388475 
seconds (also Known as Newcomb’s rate of correction) 
however, recently there has been some modification in 
this Ayanamsa. Some researchers in the field of KP 
astrology have taken a different Epoch year and arrived 
at an Ayanamsa which is different by about 4 mins 44 
seconds. This Ayanamsa is popularly Known as the KP 
Straight Line Adjusted Ayanamsa. As a result of this 
correction rate, the Ayanamsa value for the same date as 
above turned out to be 22 Deg 27 Min 14 Secs thereby 
giving a difference of 4 Mins 44 Secs. Though this may 
appear to be a minor difference, practitioners and 
researchers in the field of KP are well aware that this so 
called ‘minor’ difference can cause the entire prediction 
to go haywire. 

Before | cite a case example to illustrate the 
importance of Ayanamsa, let me briefly elucidate the 


concept of Ayanamsa. The word ‘Ayan’ means movement. 


Therefore, ‘Sha Ayan’ means moving position or with- 
Ayan whereas, ‘Nir- ah Ayan’ means static position or 
without Ayan. This gives rise to the Sayana zodiac (the 
moving zodiac) of Western astrology and the Nirayan 
Zodiac (fixed or sidereal zodiac) of | ndian astrology. The 
Ayanamsa value is the distance between the Hindu first 
point and the Vernal Equinox, measured at an Epoch. 
Vernal Equinox refers to one of the two points that arise 
due to the intersection of the celestial equator and the 
ecliptic or the apparent path of Sun. Thus, the 
difference in values for the various Ayanamsas occurs 
due to the different Epoch years that are considered as 
the dates of coincidence of the two zodiacs. A number of 
Epochs were used by researchers and scholars such as 
361AD, 394 AD, 397 AD, 498 AD 559 AD etc. Weare all 
aware that in KP astrology the smallest sub-division arc 
of a constellation is of a value of 4 mins. This belongs to 
Sun. Therefore, any difference in the Ayanamsa values 
greater than 4 mins would alter the sublord of a planet 
and cusp. 

In the example below, | provide a case example 
where the choice of a particular Ayanamsa yielded 
different results. This case is not an example to 
advocate any particular Ayanamsa value but a simple 
illustration that Ayanamsa plays a very important role in 


prediction. |t is up to the wise discretion of the readers 


to find out the Ayanamsa value that yield consistent 
results to them. 

On 24" November, 2006 a lady approached me to 
know whether her husband would get an interview call 
from a reputed educational institution. The question put 
forth was, “will my husband get a call for the interview at 
BMA?” She gave 20 as the horary number within 1-249. | 
analyzed the chart on the same day at 8:38:02 PM in 
Hyderabad using geocentric latitude correction and KP 
Straight Line Adjusted Ayanamsa value of 23 Deg 56 
Mins 30 secs. 

The cusps used for arriving at the prediction 
were 3, 9, and 11'" cusps from 7th, which means cusps 9, 
3, and 5 respectively. The Moon of the un rotated chart 
reflected the query by signif ying houses 3 at planet level, 
7 at Starlord level and 5 at the sublord level. The other 
signification of Moon—10, 2, 1, and 4—denoted that the 
husband of the querist was seeking a change in the job 
due to Increase In post and pay not due to any problem in 
the workplace. The lady confirmed this. In the rotated 
chart, the 7'" cusp sublord Venus denoted 10, 6, and 3, 
3™ cusp sublord J upiter denoted 3 and 9, 9°" cusp 
sublord J upiter denoted 3 and 9 and the 11'" cusp sublord 
Moon denoted 3. So, the call for the interview was 


definitely to be received by the husband of the querist. 


The time for receiving the call for the interview 
was arrived after taking the help of Ruling Planets at the 
time of judgment. The Lagna was ruled by Mercury- 
] upiter-Saturn and the Moon was ruled by J upiter- 
Venus-Saturn. The fruitful significators were considered 
as Venus, Mercury, J] upiter and Saturn. The running 
Dasa-Bhukti-Anthara (DBA) was that of Venus-Saturn- 
Mercury. All these planets were in the list of fruitful 
Significators. | decided that the matter has to come out 
during J upiter Sookshma period. 

It was found that Venus-Saturn-Mercury-] upiter 
period operated from 30'" December 2007 to 21% 
J} anuary 2007. The lady was informed that her husband 
would be receiving a call during this period. 

However, the call was actually received on 5‘ 
December 2006 and the lady was more than pleased at 
me for telling her that her husband would be receiving 
the interview call. But | was totally displeased at my 
wrong timing. Upon discussing this matter with some 
senior KP astrologers of Hyderabad, | was told to look at 
the same prognosis using the KP Old Ayanamsa. With this 
input, | re-casted the horary chart with the Ayanamsa 
value of 23 Deg 51 Mins 47 Secs. The chart Is provided in 
the next page. There is no change in the sub lordship of 


any cusps or planets except the Fortuna. However, the 


longitude of Moon and other planets have changed along 
with the longitudes of the 12 cusps. 

Therefore, a change in the longitude of Moon due 
to the change in the value of Ayanamsa gave different 
timings of the Dasa balance. | t was found that the same 
Venus Dasa, Saturn Bhukti, Mercury Anthara and J upiter 
Sookshma operated during 17'° November 2006 to 9‘? 
December 2006. Since, the analysis was done on 24‘ 
November 2006, it was clear that the result would have 
occurred between 25" November 2006 to 9" December 
2006. 

To conclude, therefore, | would like to say that in 
the above case example, using KP Old Ayanamsa brought 
us Into the actual period of fructification of results. The 
choice the fruitful significators gave us the DBAS but 
the timing of this DBAS changed due to different values 
of the Ayanamsa. Though there was no change in the sub 
lordship of the 12 cusps and 9 planets in this case, it may 
definitely happen when the degrees rising on the various 
cusps are near their transition. And in such situation, the 
entire analysis may go wrong because the fundamental 
premise of KP astrology depends upon the planetary 
lordship of the cusps and planets. | conclude this article 
with best wishes to the editor of this electronic magazine.

4 STEP METHOD - PART: 2 





By: Shri A.R. RAICHUR 8/147, GARODIANAGAR BOMBAY- 400 077 


SHREE GANESHAYA NAMAHA 


This is the 2™ Article in the series. We now outline the method of getting the Signified Houses in the 4 steps. 


Before we proceed, there are certain strict rules to be observed, so that all practitioners of this method can 
easily follow the articles written on this subject: 


Cast the chart. Note the Planets, which have no other planets in their stars, i.e. Planets, which are not Star Lord of 
other planets. Mark such planets by a sign say + Note planets whose star Lord is the same as the planet. Mark this by a 
sign say *. Note down planets, which are just behind the Cusp, I.e. within 3.33 deg. Note down the planets, which are 
conjunct (within 3.33 deg) of each other. Note Indian Aspects of planets, but with orb of 3.33 deg. only. These are 
Opposition; For Mars 4, 7, 8. For Sat 3,7,10. For J up 7, 5, and 9. Restrict planets to the 7 regular planets, and Rahu and 
Ketu. No other planets to be considered. Note houses which are empty, contain no planets other than Herschel, Neptune, 
Pluto, and Fortuna. 


The houses signified by a Planet, are the House, which contains the Planet, and 1 or 2 houses, which are owned by 
the planet. They MUST be written down inthat order only. 


The significance is again of two types. 1 Strong Significance, or Primary significance and 2 secondary significance. 
Only Primary/ Strong significance is considered for prediction. 


Rule 1. |f there are no planets inthe Stars of a planet (marked + then 
The house occupied by that planet becomes a strongly signified house, the houses owned by such a planet also become 
strongly signified, provided they are empty. 


Rule 2: |f there are some other planets inthe Stars of a Planet, thenthe 
House occupied by the planet becomes a secondary signified house, and so do the houses owned by it, even if they are 
empty. 


Rule 3: |f the planet is instars owned by it self, it becomes the strong Significator of its house of occupation, even 
if there are other planets in its stars. The houses owned by it are strongly signified only if they are vacant. 


These rules apply to steps 1 and 3.|n step 2 we find the houses signified by the Star Lord of the Planet, and in 4 
the houses signified by the Star Lord of the Planet's Sub-lord. 


Rule 4: When a Planet is the Star Lord of the main Planet, it strongly signifies the house occupied by it, and houses 
owned by it if they are vacant.|f the houses owned are not vacant then the significance is secondary. 
This rule applies even if there are other planets inthe stars of this starlord. 


Rahu and Ketu. 


Rule 5: The nodes in step land 3 signif y the House occupied and also the House occupied by the Lord of the signin 
which they are, and the houses owned by such lord. |f there are NO other planets in the Stars of Rahu/ Ketu, then the 
houses occupied by its, and Lord of sign are strongly signified, so are the houses owned by the Sign-lord, if such houses 
are Vacant. 

However, if there are other planets in the stars of the Node, the significance is of secondary nature for all houses, 
vacant/ occupied. 

Rule 6: Whenthe Node Is a star-lord of another planet (steps 2 and 4), in 
Addition to signif ying the House occupied by it, the Houses of the Lord of the sign occupied by it, it will also signify the 
houses of |TS Star-lord. 

Thus Rahu /Ketu can signify 4 or when it is a star lord 7, houses. 


Rule 7: Planets which are conjunct with the Main planet, or which aspect this Planet also contribute to the houses 
signified by the planet. The house occupied by such conjunct/ or aspecting planets will be principally signified, if the main 
planet is in own star or has no other planets in its stars, other wise significance is secondary. This rule is, however, not 
applicable in 4'" step. 


Inthe next article an example will be given showing application of these rules.

K.P.DASAVI DHA PORUTHTHAMS - RULES FOR 
MATCHING HOROSCOPES FOR MARRIAGE. 


By: K.P.KUPPU GANAPATHI, ASTROLOGER(K.P) 
Fate week NO.G/12, SECOND FLOOR, DDA SFS FLATS, POCKET-2, 
(BEHIND SARASWATHI SISHU MANDIR SCHOOL) 
NARAINA VIHAR, NEW DELHI - 110 028.(PH) 2579 4140 





KPDP NO.1 = CHARACTERISTICS COMPATIBILITY:- 
Ascendant Sub Lords in the charts of the Boy and the Girl should be NATURAL FRIENDS OR EQUALS and should 
not be NATURAL ENEMIES. 


KPDP NO.2 = HARMONY IN MARRIED LIFE:- 
Ascendant Sub Lords and the 7th Cusp Sub Lords in the respective charts of the Boy and the Girl should be 
NATURAL FRIENDS OR EQUALS and not NATURAL ENEMIES. 


KPDP NO.3 = ATTITUDES AND URGES:- 
The Ascendant Signs of the Boy and the Girl should be compatible, i.e., FIRE AND FIRE, WATER AND WATER, 
FIRE AND AIR, WATER AND EARTH AND AIR AND WATER. 


KPDP NO.4 = GENERAL HAPPINESS:- 
Work out the aspects under the WESTERN SYSTEM OF ASPECTS taking into account the ORBS of the Planets 
(GIVEN AT THE END), between the Ascendant Sign Lords of the Boy and the Girl in their respective charts. They 
should form favourable aspects - otherwise no marks to be awarded. 


KPDP NO.5 = MUTUAL UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE COUPLES:- 
1) Work out the aspects formed (by taking into account the ORB of the respective Planets) between the 7th Cusp 
Sub Lords of the Boy and the Girl, in their respective charts. 


lil) See where the 7th Cusp Sub Lord in the Girl's chart is occupying in her chart. Similarly find out the placement 
of the 7th Cusp Sub Lord in the Boy's chart and work out the aspect formed between these two by taking into 
account the ORBS of the respective Planets. 


Depending on the nature of aspect i.e., favourable or unfavourable, in respect of (i) and (ii) above give marks, 
proportionately. 


KPDP NO.6 = PLEASURE AND HAPPINESS AFTER MARRIAGE:- 
Birth Star Lord of the Boy should occupy houses 2, 3, 5, 7, 9 or 11 in the Girl's chart and vice- versa. 


KPDP NO.7 = GENERAL SUITABILITY FOR MARRIAGE:- 
7th Cusp Sign, Star and Sub Lords of the Boy should be Ruling Planets of the Girl at the time of birth and similarly 
the 7th Cusp Sign, Star and Sub Lords of the Girl should be the Ruling Planets of the Boy at birth. The occupant 
of the 7th in the respective charts can be taken as a RULING PLANET for this purpose. 


KPDP NO.8 = LIKELIHOOD OF MARRIAGE WITH THIS BOY AND THE GIRL:- 
The RULING PLANETS of the Boy should be the significators for 2.7.11 for the Girl and Vice- versa. 


KPDP NO.9 = SMOOTHNESS IN MARRIED LIFE:- 
See whether the 11th Cusp Sub Lords in the charts of the Boy and the Girl are in any way connected to houses 6, 
8,12 in any manner, in their respective charts. If they are not connected full marks can be given. Otherwise marks 
will have to be awarded proportionately. 


KPDP NO.10 = WHETHER THE PERIOD LORDS NOW OPERATING IN BOTH CHARTS INDICATE DESIRABILITY 
OF MATCHING FOR MARRIAGE:- 

I) At the time of matching if either is running 'A' Dasa, 'B' Bukthi and 'C' Anther see whether A,B,C are the 

RULING PLANETS at the time of birth of the other. 


li) The Planets deposited in the star of the above A, B, C Planets will be the RULING PLANETS at the time of 
birth of the other. Either (i) or (ii) above should be there. Accordingly give marks proportionately. 


After totalling the marks obtained as above, divide the same by 1000 and arrive at the percentage of matching. 
Anything above 50% can be taken as matching. But for happy married life the matching percentage should cross 
75% minimum.

Last month we discussed MST and inthis article we shall discuss how to find out significators. 
As per Dr. Kar there are two ways to calculate signif icators (A) Cuspal significators, and (B) Bhava signif icators. 


CUSPALE POINT SIGNIFICATOR 


In this method we have to look for the cuspal point planets and find out fruitful significators by F-1 and F-3 of 
MST theory. 

For example when we look for marriage: 

For marriage we, judge cusp 2, 7 and 11. First of all we note down Planets governing sign, star, sub and sub-sub of 
2,7 and ll cusps. Very first we have to check up whether marriage is promised by the 7'" Sub sub lord? Inthis example 7" 
Sub sub lord is Mar as per F-1. Mars is in the star of Ven. Ven is Sign lord of 11'°. So Mar is fruitful for marriage. So 
marriage is promised. And as per F-3 Mar is inthe sub sub of the Sun and the Sun is inthe star of Moo. Moo Is Star lord 
of 2" so Mar is fruitful for marriage. As per F-3 also, Marriage is promised.

When shall I get PNR status? 
A KP appraisal 


Effort by Vijay Kumar

Author: The author hails from the Electronics and Communication engineering background, presently heading a Senior 
Managerial position at The Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT), Bangalore. Besides teaching Parasharic and 
J aimini astrology at | CAS, Bangalore and contributing to The Astrological Magazine in J aimini theme since a decade, the

My family was to travel on 14-02-2007 from) aipur to Bangalore by train on a waitlisted ticket for which HO, Delhi 
had already sent a request for confirmation to J aipur. The train was to leave at 740pm from J aipur and normally, the 
reservation chart is released from the originating station completing all formalities of last minute reservations 4 hours in 
advance to the train departure. From this calculation, | was occasionally logging at | nternet from 4pm onwards to check, if 
the ticket was confirmed. 


My repeated efforts on Internet surfing at Bangalore continued till 5 pm but the results were showing that the 
chart is yet not prepared. After getting fed up, finally, | casted a prashna chart at 17-01-24Hrs 1ST, seeking the answer 
“When will the PNR status be available to me? 


The prashna chart with cuspal details is on next page. 
| made some quick observations as follows to arrive at the result ina matter of about 5-7 minutes, so that | could validate 
the results thereafter. 


The chart is being analyzed from the principles of cuspal interlinks as follows: 
The Query 


| was too focused and slightly in anxiety for the travel of my wife. Note that Moon by itself appears in 3"° cusp 
(showing the record of ticket confirmation) and 11°" cusp (realization of my desire), which did indicate the genuineness of 
the query. Moon is in the star of Venus placed in 3" cusp and 11'" cusp (realization of ambition). Thus, the mental focus on 
the query was represented inthe prashna chart. 


Lagna sub-sub lord Venus also indicates the promise of the query. Venus is inthe star of | upiter signif ying 11°" cusps 
and its sublord-Venus placed in 3"? cusp did indicate the query again. J upiter’s presence in 8'" cusp did show my 
anxiet y/ apprehension. 


Looking to the disposition of Moon and Lagna sub-sub lord, the horary chart was taken to Indicate the desired query 
and it was safe to proceed further. 
The co- ordinates for judgment 

This prashna chart was casted to find the ticket confirmation status for my wife’s travel. Thus the relevant cusps 


required to be judged were the 3™ cusp showing record of confirmation and the 11'" cusp showing the realization of my 
desire. 


ln order that the query meets the fructification, the 3-11'" cusps should be well connected either way. 


Analysis of the chart 
Look for the promise of fructification of event, which would be possible, if the principal cusp (3° cusp: record of 
ticket status) and 11'" cusp are committing to each other either way. 


Venus is the sub-sub lord of 3'° cusp, thus it signifies the reservation record. Venus, as said earlier, is inthe star of 
J upiter signifying 11'° cusps and its sublord-Venus placed in 3 cusp did indicate the promise of fructification. Since, 
Sublord-Venus also signif ies Lagna, the fructif ication has to be witnessed by me. 


Timing the event 


In this prashna, the results were almost sure because of the recommendation already given by Delhi HO but getting to 
see it finally was the issue. Since, the event was to happen almost within a matter of 10-15 minutes, there was no need to 
see the DBA etc and movement of cuspal positions was only sufficient to arrive at the results. 


e Lagna was running in Mars sub at the time of prashna, hence it was necessary to examine, if subsequent Rahu sub at 
Lagna would help to fructify the event. This was the first pointer for timing. 


Note that Rahu is the sub-sub lord of Venus (sub-sub lord of 3"° cusp). Rahu disposes Saturn and J upiter as sign and 
star dispositor respectively. Since, both J upiter and Saturn are strongly placed in 11'" cusp as sub lord and sub-sub 
lord, Rahu could fructify the desire of seeing the reservation status. Hence, it was decided that during the time span 
in which the Lagna transits Rahu sub, the reservation status could be available on internet. 


e The next step was to select the time in which the 11'" cusp would transit in the planets related to Rahu (such as its 
Sign/ Rasi dispositor/ sub-sub lord) within the span of time, Lagna transits Rahu sub. 


e | also looked to Moon, which was transiting in the sub-sub of Ketu. |! checked, if that was to change to Venus sub-sub, 
as that would activate the Lagna and 3™ cusp bringing fructification to my desire of seeing the PNR status. | found it 
to change very shortly within 8-9 minutes. 


e |t was noted that Lagna was to traverse in Rahu sub from 17-02-20Hrs to 17-11-00Hrs. Within, this period 11°" cusp 
transited in Saturn sub (Saturn: sign dispositor of Rahu) and Mercury sub-sub (Mercury is the sub-sub of Rahu) from 
17-09-06Hrs to 17-10-21Hrs IST. | n addition to it, the Moon was to start transiting in sub-sub of Venus from 17-9-30 
Hrs onwards. 


Looking to the above, it was inferred to get the result of PNR status after 17-09-30 Hrs, as this meets all the 
requirements discussed above. 


e This whole exercise took about 7 minutes and | was ready to surf the Internet from 17-08 Hrs onwards. While, 
continuously refreshing the page of PNR logging, | could observe the results at the interval of 8-10 seconds.

J udging the Outcome of Competitions through 
Krishnamurthi Paddhati 


Prof. Andrew Dutta

OM GANES HAYA NAMAHA 





The inaugural issue of KP E-zine published in February 2" 2007 has become an instant hit in the circles of 
astrologers, both traditional and KP followers. This magazine has found high respect and acclaim from many reputed 
astrologers across the globe for the scholarly articles that were published. On behalf of the KP astrologers’ community | 
extend my heartfelt gratitude to the creator and editor of this unique magazine—Shri Kanakbhai B. Bosmia. May Lord 
Ganesha bless him and this magazine for the great cause of astrology. 


Our revered Guruji late Prof. K.S.Krishnamurthi ji gave mankind a unique system of prediction which never fails if 
they are applied diligently with the principles that have been propounded by him. This unique system, popularly called as 
the Krishnamurthi Paddhati (KP), helps to provide answer to practically all the problems of human life. | ts vastness of 
application is truly unlimited and an applicant of this system can accurately predict the precise hour and minute of 
fructification of the outcome. 


In this article | shall discuss the practical application of KP principles as they have been propounded by our Guru}! 
with respect to horary questions related to winning competitions or elections. Two case studies will also be provided to 
illustrate the principles. 


Many astrologers have to face questions that have binomial outcomes. | n these situations the stake of reputation 
is high for the astrologer since the outcome can be either positive or negative. The astrologer has to be very sure about 
his/her prognosis before the pronouncement of his/her judgment. Questions that have binomial outcomes usually relate to 
matters such as competition, litigation, election, sports matches and such matters where there is only two outcomes for 
the querist—either win or lose. These are the situations of acid test for the astrologer. (Some people argue that there isa 
probability of 0.5 In these situations of arriving at the correct answer. But they forget that, by the same rule of 
probability, the chance of giving a wrong answer Is also 0.5.S0, the astrologer is not at all better placed). Therefore, the 
rules of KP should be strictly adhered to in order to offer accurate predictions to the querist. 


According to our Guruji Shri KSK, the 6"" house of a horoscope (whether birth or horary) controls he matter of 
competition, litigation, elections, winning etc among many other things. Thus, to judge matters related to these the 
signif ications of the 6'" cuspal sublord should be carefully noted. Along with this house, the signification of the 11'" cuspal 
sublord should also be noted because 11'" house is the house of desire fulfillment or “I ccha puran”. Now if Lagna is self 
then 7'" house is the opponent—the person whom we confront. The winning of this opponent will have to be judged by the 
‘opponent's 6'" and 11'" house’. This, therefore, means that the winning of the opponent is denoted by the 12°" and 5‘" house 
of the horoscope, which is the 6°" and 11°" house respectively of the 7'" - the opponent. As a result, for questions 
pertaining to competitions etc, the house 6" and 11'" should be analyzed along with 5°" and 12°". 


Our Guruji has also provided a set of golden rules that are infallible. With respect to judging the outcomes of 
competition, litigation etc, Shri KSK clearly mentioned that “note the sublord of the 6°" cusp. This sublord should not 
be retrograde. It should not be posited in the constellation of a retrograde planet. And this sublord should signify 
the 6" or 11°" house. All the above conditions should be simultaneously fulfilled. If any one of these conditions is 


not fulfilled, then results will not materialize”. | have always followed these rules religiously and they have never let me 
down. | nthe light of theses rules, | shall now discuss two case studies for the benefit of the readers. 


The first case study is just a few days old. It pertains to the recently held Bombay Municipal Corporation during 
February 1-2 2007. One of the contestants of this election, a very noted figure, gave a horary number of 153 to my friend 
in Hyderabad who is a KP practitioner. This friend of mine did his analysis but before he pronounced his results, he wanted 
a second opinion. He called me up on 1° February 1°, 2007 at around 5:00 pm and told me to do a horary analysis for this 
contestant. ! asked for the original horary number given by the querist and | was told by my friend that the number 
given by the querist is 153.1 sat for analysis on the same day at 6:33:15 pm in my residence at Hyderabad. The chart is 
provided at the end. 


Since the horary number is given by the original querist no rotation of chart was done. The Lagna Starlord and the 
Moon Starlord are the same planet—Saturn. Since | am the third party who did not get this number directly from the 
querist Saturn’s Starlord Mercury signified the mind of the querist by showing connections to the 6'" house and the 11°" 
houses. Thus, not only the query was honest, Moon also clearly reflected the mind. 


Next | noted the 6'" cusp sublord of this chart. It is Venus. Venus is not retrograde. Venus is not in the star of a 
retrograde planet. But Venus is not signifying either the 6‘ or the 11" house. Rather, Venus is signif ying the 7‘ and 
the 12" house. Venus is instar of Rahu and Rahu signified 5'" house. | got my first signal. 


Then | looked for the opponent's fate. 12'" cuspal sublord is Ketu. Ketu was signifying 7°" and 12°” houses. Ketu 
being anode, | looked at his Starlord. Ketu’s Starlord is Venus who was signif ying 7°" and 12'" again. | got my second signal. 


In both the situation there was only one clear indication: the querist was destined to lose the election. | sent a 
SMS to my friend telling that his querist is going to lose the seat in the BMC election. The next day, my friend called me 
up to say that his querist has indeed lost the election. 

The second case is about the Cricket Association of Bengal election for the post of the President held in J uly 
2006. The contestants were Mr. J agmohan Dalmiya and Mr. Prasun Mukherjee. Mr. Dalmiya is well known to all of us. Mr. 
Mukherjee is the Commissioner of Kolkata Police and was heavily backed by the CM of West Bengal as a candidate for this 
post. The election was to be held in Kolkata on 30'"| uly, 2006.1t was a much hyped up election since political masters took 
interest in the election. | myself posed a question as to whether Mr. Dalmiya would win the CAB elections tomorrow and 
provided a number 136 to myself. 


| took up the analysis on 29°" | uly, 2006 at my residence in Hyderabad at 9:56 pm. The chart is provided at the 
end. The genuineness of my query is reflected by the direct relationship between the Lagna sublord and the Moon star 
lord, which is Sun. Sun denotes matter of politics and is strong significator of 10‘ house denoting position power. Moon 
reflected the mind by signif ying the 11'" house and by being the sub-sub lord of the 6'" house. 


Analysis of this horary chart showed that the 6'" cuspal sub lord is Venus. Venus is not retrograde and is also not 
posited in the star of a retrograde planet. 11'° house denotes success and in this case, it is the next most important house 
to judge. 11'" house cusp sub lord is Rahu posited in the star of Saturn. Saturn is not retrograde. Moreover, 6°" cusp 
sublord Venus is also the star lord of the 11'" cusp. Rahu, the star lord of Venus is also the 11°" cusp sub lord. Dalmiya was 
destined to win the elections. Next day in the news, | came to know that J] agmohan Dalmiya won the elections of CAB as 
the President. 


To conclude, | would like to say that Krishnamurthi Paddhati is a very accurate system of prediction, the rules of 
which are simple and easy to follow. A sincere adherence to the rules propounded by our great Guruji would provide 
astoundingly correct results. Any follower of KP can safely pronounce the results of competition and election without fear 
by following the above rules propounded by Shri KSK after decades of painstaking research.

RECTIFICATION OF BIRTH TIME 


By: Abhijeet Lahiri.

Before going to start writing on the article my Pranam to our Late Guruji who Is the pioneer of this methods. 

Secondly, Thanks to Kanakji, who give me this opportunity to write a article on this subject. 

As we Know that for KP System Sub lord is very important. To know some thing about a person first we see the 
Sub lord of the concern house. Suppose anybody wants to Know about his / her marriage then we first look to the 7th 
house sub lord whether the marriage is promising or not then we go for other details. | f the Sub lord is wrong then the 
calculation will be wrong. So for to analyze a horoscope, it is very important to get the exact Birth time. 

But we Know that it is next to impossible to get the exact Birth time of a person, and we Know why. 1! don't think to 
write in details on it. But it is important, for to analyze a Birth chart - correct Birth time is needed. To get the exact 
Birth time through KP System Is called - RECTIFICATION OF TIME. 

Rectification means only to check ascendant is not right, to find out date, (if birth is near midnight this or that

Denial of Education: A Case Study 


G.S ubramanian, 
19, West Road, West C.l .T. Nagar, Chennai-35 
E-mail: gurusubra@ yahoo.com 





[In K.P.Astrology, certain clear and specific rules have been laid down by Late Shri.K.S.K and later on by his 
disciples to assess the educational level of a native from his horoscope. 

| t is well-known that, for deciding about education, we have to judge fourth, ninth and eleventh houses. 

lf the sub lord of the 4'" cusp is a significator of 4 and 11, the indications are that the concerned person will 
complete secondary education. | f the said sub-lord also signifies 9 and 11, the person will successfully complete college and 
post graduate education. 

Third house suggests denial of basic education, as it is the vryasthan for the main 4'" house. Likewise 8'" is negative 
to 9'" and shows adverse results for higher education .Similarly, while the 6'" house shows success in examinations; the 
fifth house is detrimental to studies. Thus houses 3, 5 and 8 point to denial of education or that education will suffer. 

W ith these introductory remarks, let us proceed to analyze the horoscope appended below to study the level of 
education: 

Let us first take up the 4°" sub lord, which in this case is Saturn. By itself Saturn, a malefic does not speak well of 
good education like J upiter or Mercury. 

Saturn inthis case is lord of 9'" and 10°" and is placed in the 9'" itself. One may, therefore, be tempted to jump to 
the conclusion that the girl will have successful higher education. But the truth is quite to the contrary. Though bornina 
respectable and well-educated family, she did not go to school at all and was thus denied even basic education. What are 
the factors responsible for this and how can we explain astrologically the reason for this position? 

|t may be observed that Saturnis inthe star of Mars, lord of 7 and 12, placed in 3, not a favorable position for 
education. The sub lord of Saturn is Sun, who star wise signifies 3 and 12 and is placed in 5. 

“lf the sub lord of the 4°" is Mars or Saturn and is connected to houses 8 and 12 the native will not go to school at 
all” (Astro Secrets and Krishnamurthy Paddhathi- Part-| , Page 142, item 7) Saturn is also connected to the 8"" by being its 
Sub-sub lord. |t has also to be remembered that Saturn is bhadakathipathi for this chart. 

Moreover, the Dasa period running during the formative years (6-12 years) 
ls that of | upiter, the 8°" lord in 12, with no planets in its star and thus strongly signif ying the two detrimental houses 8 
and 12. 

The cumulative effect of the adverse placement of planets influencing education has denied even basic education 
to this unfortunate girl. 

|n conclusion, | bow down to our Guruji, Shri.k.S.K and also thank Shri Kanak Bosmia, for allotting me some space,

Are exam dates authentic? A KP appraisal 


By 
Vijay Kumar 
Electronic City, Phase-1, Hosur Road 
Bangalore - 560 100 
080-25119580 (Off), 26587463 (Res) 0-9845039153(Mob) 


v kumar@cdotb.ernet.in 





Author: The author hails from the Electronics and Communication engineering background, presently heading a Senior 
Managerial position at The Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT), Bangalore. Besides teaching Parasharic and 
} aimini astrology at | CAS, Bangalore and contributing to The Astrological Magazine in J] aimini theme since a decade, the 
author has special interest in The Krishnamurti Paddhati and is a serious student of this subject. 


My daughter who has to appear inthe final exams of post-graduation in medicine was communicated about the dates 
of exams falling on 26°" and 28'" of March, 2007 by some communication channel. The exam dates were yet not notified on 
the college notice board. 


|n order to find out whether the exam dates as communicated by rumor were authentic or not, she telephoned me 
about her query and gave me Horary number 77 (1-249). 


The prashna chart was delineated at 14-32-1]1Hrs 1ST on March 12, 2007 at Bangalore (12N51, 77E40) and Is 
presented herewith with cuspal details. 


The chart is being analysed as follows: 
The Query 


Moon is placed in 5'" house in the house of benefic J] upiter, shows that the news about the exam date was welcome, 
as It was perhaps much awaited. 


The co- ordinates for judgment 


Any rumor or a piece of information is a communication, which is represented by the 3"° cusp in a prashna chart 
where the intent is to find out whether the communication is true or false. 


It is advised to look for the nature of star lord of the 3" cuspal sub-lord and generally, the malefic planets 
indicate the un-truth/ malice in the rumor whereas the benefic planets portend it to be true. |t should also be understood 
that the signs lorded by the malefic planets do carry the behavior as their lords. The major malefics are Mars, Saturn and 
Rahu who have the attributes of haste/ panic/ mischief, deceit/ part information and conf usion/ conspiracy respectively. 


lt is necessary to integrate the observation of the nature of the star-lord of the sub-lord of the 3" cusp with its 
placement also. As an example, if the star lord of 3°? cuspal sub-lord is Mars, it may be assumed that the rumor is spread 
in haste or has a mischievous intent. |f the same Mars Is placed in the sign lorded by another malefic-Saturn, it may 
completely be discarded to be false. On the other hand, if the star-lord of the 3"° cuspal sub-lord is J upiter (a benefic), 
then it is taken as true but if placed ina malefic sign, does arise the element of confusion about its authencity. | n cases, 
where the star-lord of the 3" cuspal sub-lord has varied indications, the sub-sub lord of the 3"? cusp may be analyzed for 
verification. 


The impact of the rumor may be studied by the house where the star-lord of the 3° cuspal sub-lord is placed and 
where it aspects. |f the star-lord falls in the 6-8-12'" houses, it causes worries. 


Analysis of the chart 


Look for the 3 cusp, which falls in Virgo and whose sub-lord is Mercury. Mercury falls in the star of Mars (a 
malefic), which indicate that the rumor is spread with mischievous intent to shake the students for the fear of exams. 
Since, the Mars Is placed in the sign of Saturn (another malefic), the rumor of the date of exams may definitely be taken 
to be un-reliable. 


Ruling planets at the time of judgment were J upiter, Moon and Ketu.1f Ketuis further expanded to represent Sun 
(sign lord) and Venus (Star lord), the ruling planets could be taken as J upiter, Moon, Sun, Venus and Ketu. Note that the 
horary number given was 77, which denote Moon-Mercury-Venus as sign/star/sub-lord. Since, the planets signifying the 
horary number does not match with the ruling planets, it does indicate the intent of the question as un-true. Thus, the 
rumor was branded false by second level of verification. 


Look to the dasha sequence on the day of prashna, which was Ketu-Ketu-Ketu-Rahu. The sookshma dasha lord is 


Rahu, which is a strong planet, as no planet falls in its star. Since Rahu falls in 8'" house in saturnine sign, the rumor did 
Shake the students. 


Facts of the case 


While, the rumor of exam date as 26'" and 28'" March 2007 floated for about a week strongly, the official dates of 
the exam displayed on the college notice board thereafter indicated it to be on April 2 and 7'" 2007.

Ruling Planets and Events within 24 Hours

OM GANES HAYA NAMAHA 


Krishnamurti Paddhati is a crown among all the systems of prediction in astrological science. The rules of prediction 
are uniform across cases and the route of prediction followed is always the same. The modus operandi of this system Is 
Same for all sorts of prognosis and an applicant of this system need not get confused at all as to how to reach a concrete 
conclusion. 

|n order to bring this clarity inthis system of prediction, our great Guruji late Shri K.S. Krishnamurti invented two 
concepts, the credit of which is solely his. The first is the breaking up of a constellation of 13 deg 20 mins into 9 unequal 
divisions according to the Vimsottori Dasa proportion of planets. These 9 unequal divisions of every constellation are called 
as the Sub-division or more popularly as the “sub”. It is this sub which acts as the determining factor in KP based 
prediction. 

Guruji’s second invention was the concept and use of Ruling Planets, popularly called as the RP. Guruji used to call 
the RPs as ‘divine indication’ because the RPs help a KP practitioner to correctly pinpoint events correct to the nearest 
minute. This article is an endeavor to discuss some fundamental principles of ruling planets where the use of RP was made 
in day to day life to pin point the time of an event correct to the very minute. 

To become an adept in KP based prediction methods one has to be well conversant with the use of RP. One of the 
best to understand the role of RP and how it behaves and gets linked with the event is to constantly use it in one’s own 
personal life in day to day events. Only then shall the actual role of RP come to the fore. 

As ruling planets, our Guruj! originally gave 4 planets. | n decreasing order of importance they are: 

Ascendant Lord 

Moon Star Lord 

Moon Sign Lord, and the 
Day Lord 

Here ‘Ascendant Sign Lord’ means the lord of the sign which Is rising on the eastern horizon at the time when the 
judgment for the query Is undertaken. Therefore, for the same time, the lagna or the Ascendant will differ in different 
places. For example, the ascendant at 10:30 am in Hyderabad would be different from that of Ahmadabad. So, it Is 
necessary to ascertain the correct ascendant which is rising at the time and place where the astrologer is drawing up the 
ruling planets 

Even though Guruji originally advocated 4 ruling planets, later he suggested the inclusion of the 5'" RP, which is the 
strongest in power, as the Ascendant Star Lord. Thus, ruling planet usually means, in descending order of power: 

Ascendant Star Lord 
Ascendant Sign Lord 
Moon Star Lord 

Moon Sign Lord, and the 
Day lord 

For pin pointing the time of events that are expected to happen within the next 24 hours, we need to see when a 
proper lagna sign, star and sub comes that contains in it the ruling planets that we received at the time of judgment. In 
other words, if one is expecting something to happen within the next 24 hours our focus should be to trace the ascendant 


that will comprise of sign lord, a star lord and a sub lord who were found inthe list of RPs during judgment. This is because 
within 24 hours lagan moves over all the 12 signs, 27 star and 249 subs. 

Let me take the first example. On 24" February 2007, | came to know in my office that | will have to meet my 
Associate Dean on Monday 26'" February 2007 for an important issue. My AD gave me atime of 9:30 amin the morning on 
Monday. Later on 25'", a Sunday, | thought why not | find out the exact time when the meeting will actually happen 
tomorrow? So, after my dinner that evening, | sat for finding out the time of meeting my AD the next day. The RP on 25- 
2-2007 at 9:50 pm in Hyderabad, Somajiguda was as follows: 

Ascendant Star Lord: Mars 
Ascendant Sign Lord: Venus 
Moon Star Lord: Mars 
Moon Sign Lord: Venus 

Day Lord: Sun 

Out of these 5 RPs | rejected Venus since it was in the star of retrograde Saturn. So, | was left with only Mars 
and Sun. Mars Sign Mesha started from 9:15 am the next day whereas Sun’s sign Leo started from 5:20 pm the same day. 
My office gets over at 5:00 pm, so! was sure that Sun's sign will not be the time. Moreover, Leo does not have a Martian 
constellation. As a result, | had no alternative but to choose Mesha lagna as the sign when the time to meet will come. 
Next, in Mesha sign! looked for Sun’s star. | saw that Mesha sign and Sun star will operate from 10:45 am to 11:40 am. 
Therefore, to finally pinpoint the exact time, | chose Mesha sign, Sun star and Mars sub (because Mars appeared twice 
and was the only ruling planet) which started from 10:50 am. The next day when | was waiting outside my AD’s cabin, | 
was Called inside for the meeting precise at 10 50 am on 26" February 2007. 

Many such incidences can be cited. However, upon close scrutiny it can be found that a few fundamental rules must 
be followed while using RPs for making predictions for events that are expected to happen within 24 hours. Some of the 
rules that hold good are as follows: 

1. The lagna point must contain the ruling planets only. 

2. The lagna sign star and sub lords should be chosen according to ‘first come first serve’ basis depending 
upon the hierarchy in which they appear in the RP list during the time of judgment. 

3. A ruling planet is strong by virtue of its level of appearance and not how many times it has appeared. 

4. However, whena ruling planet repeats itself, the lagna point must also contain the same repetition 

| hope this article will help the readers of KP Ezine to use RPs more fruitfully. | thank Shri Kanak Bhai Bosmia for 
being very kind and cooperative in publishing this article. | dedicate this article at the lotus feet of Lord Ganesha and our 
great Guruji Shri k.S. Krishnamurti ji and also to Shri Suresh S ahasne JI.

Before | discuss the details why | predicted about "fired from job", let us see what is Muhurat? 

An auspicious time to start any event is a Muhurat. The chart for that special moment is MUHURAT CHART. Here 
it should be clearly understood that WE HAVE TO TAKE MOMENT OF STARTING, WE DO NOT CARE WHEN THE 
EVENT GETS FINISHED. We take only time when we start. 

Inthe following example | took the time when first time he joined the job.

Place of J oining: ATLANTA- GEORGI A- USA.

W hen we do special work we always think for long life of that work, and for long life/ longevity of event we have to look Asc 
sub lord. For good longevity if we set time when Asc sub lord signifies 1,5,11 that means good longevity. And if we take 


Chara Lagna i.e. MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR 11°" is not good but becomes a Badhaka. So we should avoid Chara 
Lagna for any Muhurat.

long life and rest indicate Balarist.

Positive points
