IMPORTANCE OF FERTILITY 
MUHURAT 
AS PER KP SYSTEM 


By: Kanak Bosmia (KP Astrologer and Editor KP Ezine) 
Sahkar- 2, Flat No: 28 
J) agabhai Park, Ram Baug, Maninagar 
AHMEDABAD 380008 
Gujarat- India 
Phone: 079- 25431165 Mobile: 09825131165 





This is my second article in this series. In this article | want to discuss MUHURAT for Fertility 
Muhurat chart. Before | start my analysis | reproduce again some important points from my last article 
on MUHURAT. 


An auspicious time to start any event is a Muhurat. The chart for that special moment is MUHURAT 
CHART. Here it should be clearly understood that WE HAVE TO TAKE MOMENT OF STARTING, 
WE DO NOT CARE WHEN THE EVENT GETS FINISHED. We take only time when we start. 


Very important point in any MUHURAT chart Is, never select MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR ras 
as a Lagna. These four Rasis--MESHA, KARKA,TULA AND MAKAR are CHARA Rasis and for Chara Rasi 
the 11'" cusp is Badhaka Sthana. When we do special work we always think for long life of that work, and 
for long life/longevity of event we have to look at Asc sub lord. For good longevity if we set time when 
Asc sub lord signifies 1,5,11 that means good longevity. And if we take Chara Lagna |.e. MESHA, KARKA, 
TULA AND MAKAR, 11°" is not good but becomes a Badhaka. So we should avoid Chara Lagna for any 
Muhurat. 


W hat is the fertility cycle? 


The lunar cycle was rediscovered by Czech psychiatrist Dr Eugene J] onas in the 1950's. His interests in 
astrology led him to ancient writings which stated that "women are fertile during a certain phase of the 
moon"... Dr J onas' clinical studies were based on the premise that the natal lunar fertile time was the 
only time a woman would conceive. Astra International, a private clinic in Vienna using Dr J onas' single 
fertile time premise had a success rate of 80 - 85% contraception if abstinence is practiced only during 
lunar fertile times. An individual has his particular natal lunar phase repeated when the moon is in 
the exact position relative to the sun as it was at his time of birth. 


Women can conceive not only directly after ovulation, i.e. at the moment in their hormonal cycle, when 
their ovule is ripe and ready for conception. They can also conceive at the moment when lunar phase in 
the sky (I.e. angle between the Moon and the Sun) reproduces the phase which was at the moment of 
their birth. 


Fertility Awareness relies upon the following assumptions: 


* An egg (ovum) can live inside a woman’s body for 12-24 hours. However, in calculating the fertile 
time we use 48 hours in case more than one egg Is released. 

* Sperm can live in a woman's body up to 5 days after intercourse, though more often 2 days. 
Pregnancy is most likely if Intercourse occurs anywhere from 3 days before ovulation until 2-3 
days after ovulation. 

* Since the exact time of ovulation cannot be predicted, we add 2 to 3 days to the beginning and 
end. 

Each month when the moon returns to this same position (as it was at birth) it can trigger woman's body 
to spontaneously ovulate even if this time occurs outside your normal mid cycle fertile time. 


Furthermore - the moon's trigger effect is increased by two factors - stress and sexual intercourse. 
That is, if you are having sex during your natal lunar phase, the chances of ovulation being triggered are 
increased. 

|n Reader: 5 Ninth edition: 2004 page No: 234 under heading: Life With wife: Root for fruit. 

Sri KSK ji gives details about How to find out MUHURAT for such people who are not having children 
after long time of marriage. 


Onthe basis of the ABOVE INFORMATION I tried to find out some rules to find out the best 
Muhurat Time for Child Birth. And tried on some couples; but as always, | do not get any feedback from 
them about the result. So 1 amnot able to give any feedback on this work. The readers may use this as 
per his/her understanding and inform me as to what is the outcome with all details. 


W hat are the rules to follow? 


1) Find out fertility date (in other world find out birth TI THI of woman and note down the date of 
each month of birth TI THI. For example, if the woman is born on ashtami, then each month of 
asthami is best fertility day for her. 

2) Take Place where lady live at present. Not as per her birth place. 

3) Onthat day select the time when the 5'" SL signifies strongly 2, 5, 11 and does not signify 1, 4, 
10 anyhow. 

4) At that time Asc sub lord should not signify Marka and Badhaka. 

5) Running Dasa, bhukti , Antara and sookshma Dasa clearly signify 2,5, 11--this is a must. 


Now| discuss one example:

Denial of childbirth: A KP appraisal 


In cases of delayed childbirth, generally the couples have the anxiety to know about the prospects of 
childbirth, as by then they are fairly frustrated. The childbirth is a complex issue and the delay or 
denial of birth of children could involve a host of possibilities such as the lack of fertility, deformity in 
sex organs etc In one or both the partners. 


The prospects of childbirth may be tackled both from the natal charts and through prashna. Since, | do 
not have any chart where the natives were denied of the children, | preferred to take up the birth data 
of such cases from some authentic publications. 


| have chosen to write on Denial of childbirth and | have selected the case of a childless couple from 
The Astrological Magazine, J] une 2007 issue, Page 517, Chart-6 (Husband) and chart 7 (Wife). The 
charts were corrected for minor variations of birth times. The couple reportedly did not have any 
childbirth since 18 years of marital life. 


The KP styled chart for Husband and Wife is produced End of this Article. 


The methodology of judgment: 


KP recognizes the childbirth to be governed by the significators of 2-5-11'" houses from Lagna. The 5°" 
house is the main house of childbirth both for males and females and is necessary to be evaluated to 
know, if one is capable of producing a child or not. |In case, if the childbirth for the spouse is also to be 
examined from the male chart (reverse also), the 11'" house gives the clues for the children of spouse, 
as it is the 5'" from 7‘ house (spouse). | n case, if 5°" and 11'° cusps jointly deny children, the couple 
may be sterile and may enter the domain of denial of childbirth. 


As per standard canons of KP, if a person is to be blessed with childbirth, the sub-lord of the 5'" cusp 
should signify 2-5-11'" houses in any way through star-lord of the 5'" cuspal sub-lord and validated by 
its sub-lord. 


In KP, a house is destroyed by the 4-8-12'" houses from the house under consideration, similarly the 
cusps. The denial of children happens if 5‘" cusp signifies 4°", 8°" and 12°" house counted from itself 
which means that the 5'" house should not signify the 8'" house (4° house from 5‘"), 12°" house (8'" 
house from 5'") and 4'" house (12'" house from 5'") looking from lagna, if it has to promote the 
childbirth in principle. 


|n addition to the above, the 2™ house from 5'" house acts as the maraca house for the 5" house and is 
thus detrimental to the sustenance of pregnancy in principle. Thus the 6°" house acts as the house of 
death (maraca) for the 5'" house (childbirth) and it is generally seen that all abortions and loss of 
childbirth necessarily involve the 6'" house. 


The negation of 11'" house (pregnancy of the spouse) is required to be observed from 10°" house, which 
covers the possibility of having children through spouse (such as children from earlier marriage or with 
Some other person etc). KP observes a few modalities in these regards in the reader-6 on horary 
astrology. 


In case, if the denial of childbirth for the spouse is to be examined from 11'" house, the 4-8-12'" houses 
from 11°" and 2" house from 11'" as maraca shall have to be examined. Referring from the Lagna, if 11°" 
cuspal sub-lord only signifies 2-6-10-12'" houses it would point to the sterility of the spouse. 

To sum up, KP dictates that if the 5'" cuspal sub-lord signifies 4-8-10-12'" houses only without having 
any connection with the fruitful houses of childbirth (2-5-11), the native will be childless. In case of 
mixed influences, the childbirth is delayed. 


After having assessed the basic promise for denial of childbirth, it is generally seen that the native 
runs the dasha of planets, which also deny children. 


The judgment methodology given above equally applies both on the natal charts and on horary charts. 


Analysis of Husband's birth chart: 
The husband’s chart is being analyzed as follows: 
e Inthis chart, J upiter as star-lord and sub-lord rules the 5th cusp. J upiter is placed in the star and 
sub of Saturn placed in 3™ house. Note that the J upiter is the lord of 10'" house placed in the star 


of 8°" lord Mercury and Saturnis 8°" and 9" lord, not signif ying 2-5-11'" houses at all. 


Looking from cuspal angle, Saturn as the star and sub-lord of 5'" cuspal sub-lord J upiter links 4-7- 
8-9-10'" cusps, thereby not linking 2-5-11'" cusps, thus denying childbirth. 


e Look to the 11'" cusp whose sub-lord is again | upiter and as per the assessment made above, it 
signifies 3-7-10-8-9 houses only, not conducive for the childbirth. 


e During the last 18 years of married life, the husband was running the dasha of J upiter, which denies 
childbirth, as described above. 


In view of the above, the prospects of childbirth do not get indicated in the husband's birth chart. 


Analysis of Wife’s birth chart: 
The wife's birth chart is being analyzed as follows: 
e I|nthis chart, the 5‘ cusp is ruled by Sunas its star-lord and Venus as its sub-lord. 


Sub-lord Venus falls inthe star and sub of Rahu. Rahu is placed in the 6" house, which is the maraca 
of 5'" house, hence detrimental to it. Venus is the lord of 1-6'" houses, not conducive for childbirth 
again. 


Rahu may be taken to dispose sign lord-Mars and star lord - Saturn as per its placement. Mars as 
12'" lord is placed in the star of Moon placed in 12'" house. Saturn on the other hand is placed in its 
own star signif ying 6'" house by placement and 10'" house by ownership. 


Looking from cuspal angle, 5'" cuspal sub-lord Venus is placed in the star and sub-lordship of Rahu 
that links 2-4-6 cusps, denying the childbirth. 


e Look to the 11'" cusp whose sub-lord is Venus. The analysis of Venus is already done above which 
signifies 6-10-12'" house, not conducive to the childbirth from the husband that tallies the analysis 
of the husband’s chart for childbirth. 


e During the last 18 years of married life, the wife was running the dasha of Rahu, which was not 
fruitful for the childbirth, as described above. 


In view of the above, the 5‘ and 11'" cusp denies childbirth in wife’s chart with the husband. 
Conclusion: 
In both the example charts of husband and that of wife, the 5'" and 11°" cusp do not signify the houses 
fruitful for childbirth (2-5-11) but predominantly signify adverse houses (4-6-8-10-12) only. This was 
the reason that the couple did not enjoy the fruits of childbirth even after 18 years of marital life. 
The KP principles are infallible and are crystal clear, although, they require genuine efforts for 


understanding and application. Prof. Krishnamurti has devised a pioneering predictive model in astrology, 
which deserves sincere appreciation.

Divorce, Love Affairs and 2"¢ Marriage 
(DR. H. S. NAGI, 9/43, PAU, LUDHIANA, MOBILE-09417717910) 





History: 
The querist lady was passing through bad experience in her married life. |t was a case of desertion. 
Then an NRI, whose wife had died, was in contact of this lady. After initial resistance the lady agreed to get 
married with that person. 
Then she applied for divorce in the court and got divorce and got married. At every step she took 
astrological advice from me. So first of all she asked whether her husband will come back to her, then she 
asked about divorce, and at the same time she asked marriage prospects with the person in contact. 


Rule 
Divorce is caused when the significators of 2, 7 and 1l are also the significators of the houses 1, 6 or 6 
and 10 or 6 and 7 or 10 and 7 and so on. Therefore, the 12'" house to the houses 2, 7 and 1lare all detrimental 
for smooth, pleasant family life with wife/ husband... Hence these houses are to be judged and then only one has 
to declare the result whether they will go for divorce. |f the significators of 2, 7, 11 happen to be the 
significators of 1, 6 and 10, then separation will surely happen and then it may lead to divorce.. 


|f separation is caused by the wife running away, saying that she has no mind to stay with the husband, 
then in one’s horoscope, the significator of 7 will also be the significator of 6 and 9.If the person does not like 
wife, and he goes away, then we have to judge the houses 3 and 12. The 4'" house is place of residence and 3" 
vyaya to It.. Therefore, one will go away from his residence, proceed on a journey and thereby get separated. (p. 
191-192, marriage, married life and children) 


For married life, planets connected with 6'" house, i.e. significators of 6'" house, bring about separation 
due to partner's walking out or desertion. 12'" house significators denote that the native will seek separation, 
get out and live singly, 8°" house significators denote disharmony and quarrel. 8'" house doesn’t threaten 
separation. The native will experience difficulties and continue to live together. (page 154, marriage, married 
life and children) 


Analysis 
7'" cusp sub-lord is Mercury. Look in which star mercury is. Mercury is instar of Rahu. Now see whether 
this Rahu has got signification of 6 or 12 or 10 or 1./f it has, then there will be divorce. Now look, Rahu is in 6"" 
house. Therefore Mercury, which is sub lord of 7‘"- a house for marriage, became significtor of 6'" house (end 
of marriage), through its star lord Rahu. Since 7" sub-lord is a significater of 6'" that shows the husband has 
no mind to stay with this querist. Therefore divorce is sure. 


Court case Rule: 


— 


. According to KP, the 6th house represents litigation, and the 7th house indicates the opponent in litigation. 


NO 


. Therefore, litigation would be imminent whenever the significators of the 6th and 7th houses are operating 
in life. 


UJ 


. The cause of the litigation is represented by the planets connected with - or associated with the 6th house 
or its lord. 


4. Success tn litigation is promised by the lord of the 11th house or planets in the 11th house. Success is also 
ensured if the 6th and the 7th houses come under the influence of the lords of the stars or the occupants 
of the Ist, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 10th and 11th houses. 


5. 1f the lord of the 6th house Is connected with the 11th house, or the llth house is connected with the 
lord of the 6th house, success in litigation is realized. 


6. The above (#5) also suggests that the connection of the lords of the 12th and 5th houses will cause failure 
in absolute. 


The matter was in the court. To know whether one will win the case in the court or the elections or 
victory in any competition, 6'" cusp sub lord should have strong signification of 11 or 6 or 10°" house, and it 
should not have a strong signification of 5 or 4 or 12 houses. And 11'" cusp should have a signification of 6 or 11 
strongly. 


Analysis 
Here in this chart, J upiter, the sub-lord of the 6'" cusp has got the strong signification of 11'" house. 
How? Look into the star in which J upiter 1s deposited. J] upiter is in star of Saturn and Saturn is occupant of 
11'" house. So J upiter became significator of 11 strongly. |t means she will win the case. At the same time 11°" 
cusp sub-lord Venus is also is a strong significator of 11' house. Because Venus is in star of Saturn, who is 
occupant of 11'" house. |t shows she will win the court case very easily. | told her: "Don't bother, because you 
are going to win this court case and will get divorce’. 


She doesnt believe my wordings, because she Is afraid that the court case will linger on. But to her 
Surprise her husband didn't turn up in the court, and the judge gave decision in her favour on Nov 20, 2006. 


Love affairs 
|f the sub lord of the 5th cusp (love affairs) has the signification of or connected with the 2nd or 11th, 
it shows a love affair, and if it is connected with Rahu or Ketu, the love affair is with a person belonging to a 
different caste, creed, or province. |f the sub-lord of the 7th (marriage) is the significator (inthe star of the 
occupant or owner) of the 5th or 11th, or connected with the 5th or 11th, it denotes marriage with the person 
in the love affair, and if it is connected with Rahu or Ketu, it denotes marriage with the person who belongs to a 
different caste, creed, or province. 


Here in this chart 5‘ cusp sub lord is Venus. Venus is in the star of Saturn. Saturn is in 11, so Venus 
becomos full significator or 11'" house. Her love affair was going on, and it will be successful since Venus is sub 
lord of 2"? house and 11'" house, and karka for marriage also. 


After getting divorce, she got married with the person tn love. 


After one month of getting divorce, she got married with other person. It Is interesting to know how 
the dasa lord and bhukti lord which gave her divorce, which she wanted, also fulfilled her desire to get married 
again with a person she wanted. 


2™ marriage Rule 
Note the sub lord of the seventh cusp. |f the sub lord of the 7'" cusp is either Mercury or any other 
planet occupying a dual sign or deposited in the constellation of a planet in a dual sign, there will be more than 
one marriage (p. 183, reader 4). Actually, second marriage is mostly represented by the 2™ house. (p. 184, 
Reader 4). 


lf the lord of the sub or the lord of the constellation in which the sub lord is situated is in a dual sign 
or happens to be a dual planet, then the second marriage Is promised. (p. 180, Reader 4). 


Analysis 
Here in this chart, 7°" cusp sub-lord is Mercury. Mercury is occupant of 2™ house. So the second 
marriage is assured. Finally she got remarried on Dec. 22, 2006.

KP Settings 
1. The settings for a KP chart are: 


Geocentric positions 

True positions for planets 
Mean nodes

Placidus house system

Geographic and Geocentric 


2. The geocentric latitudes calculated to the true center of the spheroid earth is commonly used to 
ensure much more accuracy and precision. The geographic latitudes assuming as if the earth is a perfect 
Sphere, which is not so, are automatically converted into the geocentric latitudes in astrological SWs, 
and it is usually a default setting. 


3. In order to properly use the tables of houses, which generally furnished geocentric latitudes, the 
conversion formulas and tables from geographic to geocentric latitudes are available in Astrosecrets & 
KP, Part 2, 2003, page 304-320 and Shri K. Hariharan: How to Cast and Read Your Horoscope, page 78- 
87. Guruji KSK has mentioned the "tan" formula for conversion of the Geographic latitude into 
Geocentric one in Astrology and Athrista, 1978 May. (Mrs. Kousalya Sattainathan says in her KP 
Astrology & Prime Ministers, page 3 that geographic latitude has been used and not geocentric because 
Gurujui KSK had used geographic latitude.) 


True Positions for Planets 
4. The true positions for planets (Sun to Saturn) are taken in all systems of astrology. 
True and Mean Nodes 


5. The Nodes are the points of ecliptic where the plane of Moon's orbit intersects the plane of the 
Sun's orbit. True is the exact position of the Nodes at any given time, while Mean is the presumed 
position based on the average speed. The Mean Node assumes that the nodes are always moving in 
retrograde motion, whilst the True Node are occasionally moving direct too as if it's wobbling due to 
the wobble of the earth and the moon orbits. 


6. Sages Parasara and J aimini's teaching is the constant Rahu retrogression which is also confirmed in 
Prasna Marga Rahu-Sun-Moon chakra and J ataka Parijatha. (Shri Sanjay Rath) Rahu and Kethu are ever 
retrograde. Never direct. (Sri M.P. Shanmugam: Astrosecrets & KP, 2003, page 27) 


7. The advantage of the True Nodes against the Mean ones is that when the Moon Is in exact 
conjunction with them, it has indeed a zero latitude. This is not true with the Mean Nodes. However, 
this seems somewhat illusory because the True Nodes are true only twice a month when the Moon 
crosses the ecliptic. Positions given for the times in between those two points are just a hypothesis. 
They are founded on the idea that celestial orbits can be approximated by elliptical elements. This 
works well with the planets, but not with the Moon, because its orbit is strongly perturbed by the Sun. 
True Nodes are applied by Shri V. K. Choudhry’s System Analysis followers and Westerners. 


New KP Ayanamsa 


8. It has been found in Mr. Kanak’s research that the New KP Ayanamsa (KP & Astrology Year Book 
2003) is working better than Lahiri Ayeanamsa especially in the Sookshma dasa level. 


Placidus House System 


9 The Placidus house system is one of three pillars of KP, together with Hindu zodiac and Vimshottar 
dasa. 


360 D/Y vs 365.25 D/Y Vimshottari dasa 

10. Only 365.25 days (interval of time taken by Sun to leave any one position in the Zodiac and again 
reach the same position) must be taken for a year and 360 D/Y is taken for convenience and for 
calculation of sub sub (DBAS) periods. (KP Reader |, page 97) 

The common application of 360 D/Y-based sub sub dasa tables does not mean using a 360 D/Y as long as 


356 D/Y is applied inthe Mahadasa calculation. 


11. Almost all East and West vedic astrologers have used 365 D/Y Vimshottari dasa without giving 
attention to the arguments of afew 360 D/Y advocates. 


O bservation 
12. The settings of Geocentric positions, true positions for planets, Mean nodes and 365 D/Y 


Vimshottari dasa are in line with most Vedic astrologers, and however, KP Ayanamsa and Placidus house 
system are the particular features of KP.

antaranga” on page 39 has opined that if 8th sub is significator of 6-10 one will get a job, as an 
inheritance. 


Shri Gonaldhalekar, of 4 step fame, has said that 8'" being 11'" to 10, can be considered as a

BALARISHTA YOGA 


By: Kanak Bosmia (Editor KP Ezine and KP Astrologer)

| decided to write series on question related First Bhava. And, inthis regard, this month, | have 
selected “BALARISHTA” as the subject. 


Sri KSK ji has taught us how to find out longevity. 


1) If Asc sub lord signifies 1.3.5.9.10 then Poorna Ayushya means more than 66 Years. 

2) If Asc sub lord signifies 1.5.8, 9.10,6,12 +Badhaka and Maraka, then Madhya Ayushya means up 
to 66 Years. 

|f Asc sub lord signifies 6,8,12 +Badhaka and Maraka, then Alpa Ayushya means up to 33 Years. 
|f Asc sub lord signifies 12, 7 +Badhaka and Maraka, then Balarishta. 

Death by Accident: | f Asc sub lord signifies 1, 6, 8, 12, +Badhaka, native faces accident. 

|f Asc sub lord signifies 2, 7, 8 +Badhaka, the native will commit suicide. 


| shall try to discuss all the above 6 rules each month. This month | am going to discuss balarishta.

When will the call materialise? 
A KP appraisal 


Effort by Vijay Kumar 
Senior Manager, C-DOT 
Electronic City, Phase-1, Hosur Road 
Bangalore - 560 100 
080-25119580 (Off), 26587463 (Res) 
0-9845039153 


v kumar@cdotb.ernet.in 





My family was traveling from Bangalore to Delhi by train on a 3-day journey starting from Bangalore 
on 29-06-2007.Onthe next day of travel (Saturday 30-06-2007), 1 was eagerly expecting a call from 
her about travel going well. 


| did not receive any call from her till noon but | kept on waiting. My attempts of calling her remained 
futile, as the mobile was off as per the announcements. | went into high degree of anxiety to know 
when will the call materialise at a point of time in the afternoon and thus approached the query by a 
horary chart. 


The prashna chart at the casting time is produced herewith. 


The chart is being analysed as follows: 


The Query 


| was extremely worried, if everything was well with my wife who was traveling. Since, the 
communication was not taking place, | was feeling helpless and handicapped. 


Look to the position of Moon, which appears in 6-8-12'" cusp indicating my frustration, disgust and my 
invisible fears respectively. Moon gets placed in the star of Ketu disposing Sun that is placed in 8°" 
house, indicating my turmoil. 


Take note of the sub-lord of Lagna, which is J upiter. J upiter falls in the star of Mercury placed in 8°" 
house, confirming my worries. 


Thus, the mental focus on the query was established in the prashna chart. Hence, it was OK to 
proceed for analyzing the query. 


The co- ordinates for judgment 


In this query, | represent Lagna and 7‘ cusp indicates my wife. The 3rd cusp represents the 
communication from my end and 9'" cusp represents the communication from wife's side. |n order that 
the communication is established, there must be an amicable connection amongst 3-9-11'" houses. 


|f 11'° cuspal sub-lord signifies 3-9'" houses, the communication will be established. | f the 3" cuspal 
Sub-lord signifies adverse houses from it, there would be difficulties to establish communication from 
my side. Similarly for the other side seen from 9" cusp. 


Analysis of the chart 


Look to the 3 cuspal sub-lord Rahu that indicates communication from my end. Rahu is placed in 
own star, thus signifies 4°" house, a house for halt. Rahu disposed Saturn because of its placement 
in Aquarius and by way of Saturn placed in 10'° house (8'° from 3" house), it blocked 
communication from my end. Saturn being 6'" lord made me tensed up. 


Look to the 9'" cuspal sub-lord Mars that indicates communication from my wife’s side. Mars is a 
strong planet, as there is no planet in its star. Mars signifies 7'° house, as it is vacant and 6'" 
house by way of its placement. !t could mean that my wife (7'" house) may be sleeping (12'" to 7°" 
meaning 6'" house indicating sleep). 


9'" cuspal sub-lord Mars would offer the results of its star lord Ketu. Ketu strongly disposed Sun 
placed in 8°" house (12'" to 9°" house), negating the 9°" cusp and blocking the communication from 
my wife’s side. 


Look for the promise of fructification of call establishment, which would be possible, if the 11'" 
cusp links to the required cusps. Here, 11'" sub-lord is J upiter who lords 3" house, its star-lord 
Mercury lords 9'" house and Mercury conjuncts with the 11°" lord Sun. This ensured to me that the 
call would certainly materialize. 


Till this point of time in analysis, it was inferred that the call would materialize, though is obstructed 
for the time being. 


Timing of the call fructification 


Look at the ruling planets at the time of casting prashna chart, which are] upiter, Venus, Ketu and 
Saturn. Since, Ketu disposes Sun and Venus, the Sun may also be included in the RPs. | ncidentally, 
Sun is a strong planet having no planet in its star and is useful as 11'" lord. 


In the fair logistics, | assumed that the call would materialize in a few hours, as 11'" cuspal sub- 
lord |] upiter was in Mercury’s star and sub (Mercury being a reasonably fast planet). Thus, | 
decided to monitor the movement of Lagna keeping an eye onthe movement of Moon's sub and sub- 
Sub lord. 


At the time of query, Libra lagna was running continuing in J upiter’s star till 1531 Hrs. Since, 
J upiter was placed in Mercury’s star placed in 8'" house, | was almost sure, that the 
communication would not come through during this duration. 


Since, RPs did not contain Mars, so! decided to ignore Scorpio Lagna and switched to Sagittarius 
lagna for timing the call fructif ication. 


In the light of RPs, | inferred that the call would materialize when Lagna transits in Sagittarius 
Sign in Ketu’s star, Venus sub and Sun sub-sub as all the planets were conforming to the RP. 


Accordingly, | inferred that the call would materialize at 1748 Hrs. 


| checked up the Moon position at that time which was transiting in the star/sub of Venus and sub 
of Sun (all in RPs). 


| was thus very comfortable with my calculations and made up my mind accordingly. 


Facts of the case 

Surprisingly, | received a call from my wife at 1642 Hrs, indicating that everything was fine with her, 
travel was smooth and she slept for the larger part of the day onthe upper berth without bothering 
to call me and she did not spell a single word of regret. 

The Lagna was moving in Scorpio signin Mars-Saturn-] upiter-Sun at 1642 Hrs. 

W hile, | was relieved of the anxiety, | was left perplexed why the call materialized at the time when 
the lagna lord was not conforming the RPs. | tried to find some excuse of my misinterpretation or 


oversight for along time after receiving the call but failed to reach any conclusion. 


However, | was taken to further surprise when she called me again at about 1748 Hrs to communicate 
me her concern and begged for a pardonfor her negligence of making a call whole day long. 


Would it be prudent enough to say that KP principles are perfect and errors in judgment are 
accounted to our lack of understanding, prompting us to look deeper into the invisible?

Garbage In Garbage Out! Can We Depend On 
Our Software-based Predictions?-- Part I 


Dr. Andrew Dutta 


Faculty Member 
The ICFAI Business School, 
Survey No. 156/157, Dontanapally, 
Shankerpally Mandal, R. R. District, 
A. P. 501 203, India Cell: 0-0-98666 20483 


Email: andrewinfinitum @ yahoo.com 





When Charles Babbage first invented the Difference Engine and the Analytical Engine in the 
nineteenth century, which later became the design of our modern day computers, he made it amply clear 
that garbage fed into the computer system will lead to garbage coming out of it. | n other words, faulty 
data fed into the system will lead to faluty output. And so we should not blame the computers for our 
own folly. So, GI GO is the all time favorite catchword of all systems people. Time has come when GI GO 
Should also become the favorite phrase of all astrologers. 

The inventor of the Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) technique late Prof. K. S. Krishnamurti 
categorically emphasized on the accuracy of three important inputs for arriving at correct 
predictions. They are: 

1. Correct time of birth for birth charts or correct time of judgment for horary charts. 
2. Correct Ayanamsa for sidereal system of house and planets’ position. 
3. Correct longitude and latitude for house division and planets’ longitude. 


|t is now well known in the KP circles that the issue of correct birth time is a matter of serious 
concern. Many a times we get a birth time provided by the client that appears to be dubious in quality. 
J ust by looking at the birth chart we come to know that the birth time is not correct (Dutta, 2007b). 
Though there are a few well tested methods of birth time rectifications, for all practical purposes, 
these methods only provide us with a probable time of birth and we can never be 100% sure that we 
have arrived at a cent percent correct birth time. Similarly in horary charts, the time of judgment also 
needs careful consideration. Not two watches ever tally. And with the plethora of ‘World clocks’ and 
‘atomic clocks’ available on the internet, the time that has been corrected by us in our watches still 
remain doubtful. 

Ayanamsa is another important issue that requires careful handling, understanding and 
application. The relevance of KP Old Ayanamsa has already been demonstrated in the inaugural issue of 
KP Ezine (Dutta, 2007a) 

The next most important ingredient is the longitude and latitude of the place of birth or the 
place of judgment. This is because both the longitude and the latitude Is an important determinant of 
the house division and the position of the Ascendant series of the Ruling Planets (RP). As KP follows the 
Placidus system of house division, changes in the longitude and latitude of the place has the potentiality 
to alter the degrees and minutes of the cuspal positions of the houses (bhavas), which in turn can alter 
the sub-divisions of the constellations occupying such positions. |n other words, changes in the 
longitude and latitude of place by minor increments may change the subs occupying the house cusps. For 
example, the Ascendant, the most important house of a chart, is dependent on the Latitude of a place 
and the sidereal time. Difference in the values of the latitude would alter the cuspal positions of the 
ascendant to the extent of altering the sub-divisions. Similarly, the longitude of a place helps in 
determining the actual degrees of the planets. Change in the value of the longitude will also alter the 
Sub-division occupied by a planet. | ntotal, all these will result in faulty diagnosis and prediction. 

Inthe year 1998, Sri A. R. Raichur published a research paper in KP Yearbook on the impact of 
variation of longitude and latitude by 3 minutes and 1 minute on the cuspal position of the ascendant. 
The simulation experiment was conducted on live datasets of 372 and 348 pairs of data. The results 
obtained by Raichur (1998) are very important for scientific minded astrologers. He was able to find 


that for a change in 3 minutes of latitude (holding the longitude constant) there has been 1 incidence of 
change in starlord, 5 incidences of change in sublord and 25 incidences of change in sub-sub lord. For a 
change in 3 minutes of longitude (holding the latitude constant) the incidences change in the ascendant 
Starlord was 1 and that for the sublord was 12 and for sub-sub lord it was 108. 1n probabilistic terms, 
though the incidences may appear to be negligible apparently but it does create awareness that there 
might be occasions where differences in the values of the longitude and latitude may give sublord 
positions that lead to wrong analysis. 
The chart below shows the variation of few key cities of | ndia as it is found in the software.

The problem is that all astrological software in the market today claims accuracy of their basic 
databases. But a look in the above chart clearly tells us that there are large variation in the values of 
the longitudes and the latitudes. The point is that as astrologers we are relying on materials that 
itself requires further probing. 

Going by the result of the experiment conducted by Raichur (1998), variation of 5 minutes in 
latitude and longitude, as found in the softwares above, will increase the chances of errors in 
Starlordship and sublordship positions of cusps and planets by a factor multiplied by the magnitude of 
variation in the coordinates. |n other words, for a variation of 9 minutes we would find 3 incidences of 
change in the starlordship and 10 incidences of change in sublordship position of the ascendant. 

The implication of these would be overwhelming for any astrological endeavor for two reasons. 
Firstly, though Raichur (1998) conducted the experiment of variation of latitude and longitude on the 
ascendant, It leaves no room for doubt that the other 5 cusps may also change due to such variations. 
That is, the second, third, fourth, fifth and the sixth cuspal starlordships and sublordships may also 
undergo a change. Secondly, as Krishnamurti Paddhati uses the Placidus system of house division, a 
change in the first house cuspal lordships would invariably mean a similar and corresponding change in 
the seventh house cuspal lordhips and other subsequent houses. 

ln effect therefore, what we may get from a variation in the latitude and longitude of a place Is

Analysis of Mars Dosha 
as per KP Principles 


Rangarajan Krishnamoorthy 


ranga@ mmsindia.com 


Kanak Bosmia 


kanakbosmia@ yahoo.com 





Shri.kSK and his followers have enumerated various rules characterizing Mars dosha and its impact on 
marriage. Every time an example is discussed, one such rule is cited in support of the example. We 
decided to study Mars dosha In greater detail along two dimensions: 

1) Clearly identify the rules that are supposed to Indicate Mars dosha Ina chart 

2) Apply the rules to a reasonably large data set to determine if Mars dosha has an effect on 

these data 

We will first list the 11 rules that we picked from various sources, as defining Mars dosha in a chart 
cast as per KP principles. 


Rl) Mars in own star or in Sun star, and occupying any of 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, or 12 

R2) Any planet deposited inthe Star or Sub of Mars, and occupying 1, 2,4, 7, 8, or 12 
R3) 7th CSL is Mars and Is located in 6, 10 or 12 

R4) 7th CSL is inthe star of Mars and is located in 6, 10 or 12 

R5) 7th CSL is inthe sub of Mars and Is located in 6, 10 or 12 

R6) 7th CSL is Sat and is located in 6, 10 or 12 

R7) 7th CSL is inthe star of Sat and is located in 6, 10 or 12 

R8) 7th CSL is inthe sub of Sat and is located in 6, 10 or 12 

R9) Mars is the 7th CSL and is located inl, 2, 4, 7, 8, or 12 

R10) Mars is the starlord of the sublord of 7th cusp and is located in 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, or 12 
Rll) Mars is the sublord of the sublord of 7th cusp and is located in 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, or 12 


We got hold of fairly reliable birth data of persons with single or multiple marriages. The following 
table shows the data Set size. 


Marriages Size 
4A RB 





Thus a total of 172 charts were analyzed. 


Analysis Methodolgy 
Since both the number of rules and the size of the data are large, we decided to do a computer analysis 
rather than doing it manually. A program was written to encode the above 11 rules, and to apply the 
rules on the given data. When looking at each chart, the program would emit “yes” if a particular rule 
was satisfied on the chart, or would emit “no”. The result was then loaded into Miscosoft Excel ™ 
program for a manual interpretation of the results. 


Instead of merely stopping with this, we decided to go one step further. What if the data sets we used 
were not accurate enough? Although the charts were rated “AA”, we did not want to exclude the 
possibility of marginal error inthe birth time. We adopted a fairly novel approach here. Since the focal 
point of our analysis was the 7'" cusp, we decided to consider two more time points for each chart 
where the 7'" CSL was the “previous” sublord, or the “next” sublord. We used a maximum time offset of 
10 minutes from the given time since we did not believe the birth time could be off by more than that 


interval in each direction. For instance, if the 7'" CSL for the given birth time was | upiter, the program 
computed the time when the 7'" CSL was Rahu (previous sublord) and the time when the 7'" CSL was 
Saturn (next sublord). | t then applied all the 11 rules to these two “hypothetical” charts. 


Analysis Results

Sublord as explained above. For each rule, the value given is the percentage of cases where the rule is 
Satisfied. The numbers in brackets indicate the sample size in the respective category.

Conclusion 
From the analysis performed, it appears that there is no strong correlation between Mars dosha and

Case History 


| was trying to get an interim order fromthe court for some issue. The court was expected to hear the 
case on 5J uly, 2007.

KP Rule and my Findings 


The 10H stands for judgement.1|f cuspal sublord of X, becomes a significator of ||, VI or XI one could 
expect a favourable judgement. 

However, in my personal studies, | have observed whenever, the cuspal sublord of X happens to be Rahu 
or Kethu or a planet in Retrograde Mode, a fair judgment is out of question. 


Analysis 
Querist -Self

KP Horary No--132(computer generated) 
Authenticity of the query 
Libra, the Law sign ascends as per the KP Horary No 
Moon, the natural significator of Mind owns the 10H of judgement and Is posited in its own star .So the 
query is true. 


The Sublord speaks emphatically

lf we probe further, we could find Kethu posited in XI (Success) and getting a signification of 
Ascendant (Success) VII1 (Failure)& X . 
(Negation of 11H of success, hence unfavorable) .So| was sure, my prayer won't be granted. 


Actual Outcome 


On 5}] uly2007, the court declined to pass the interim orders citing some flimsy reason and | lost the

Now-a-days the subject of education is being discussed at length and breadth by parents,

In ancient times, parents used to send their children to Guru-kula, but history says that

The world has since grown at length and breadth and the necessity of establishing

The below-mentioned horoscope is of a student, who had passed Intermediate examination 
and joined B. Pharma degree course in Ayurveda in Banaras Hindu University (BHU),

3) | f so, what will be the line of education?

4‘" house signify school education, 9° house is for higher education. 11" house stands 
for fulfillment of desires. 

b) The fructification will take place during the conjoined period of the significations of 
4,9,11.

4™" CUSP SUB LORD.

Star and Mercury sub.

g™ HOUSE.

A Report on KP Astrologers’ International Summit, 2007 


14'° and 15'" of J uly, 2007 was a historical date in the annals of Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) astrology. 
The first ever international summit in the field of KP astrology was held on these dates in the 
Administrative Staff College of the ] NT University in Hyderabad under the aegis of the KP Astrologers’ 
Forum, | ndia. 

The KPAIS, 2007 was over subscribed inthe first place, where hundreds of spot delegates’ request 
for a seat was turned down since the hall was full to its capacity. The Summit had delegates from all parts 
of India and a few members from abroad too. Many of the dignitaries present in the Summit were direct 
disciples of late Prof. K. S. Krishnamurti who shared their beautiful experiences with the Maestro and 
certain secrets of prediction. 

In the first day of the Summit, the delegates heard stalwarts in the field of astrology like Sri 
Suresh Sahasane of Mumbai on Profession and Business, MST and TSP techniques by Sri Kanak Bosmia of 
Ahmedabad, and 4 Step Theory by Sri Sunil Gondhalekar. But all these started with a vigorous Primer on KP 
by the President of KPAF, Shi Rajendra N. Nimje which was well received by one and all. The first day ended 
with a highly interactive panel discussion on the role of Nodes and retrograde planets in KP where the 
Speakers of the day and the session chair persons formed the panel of experts. 1n the evening, a thrilling 
Sitar performance Kept all the delegates spellbound for hours, which was performed by artistes of the Dept. 
of Culture, AP. 

The second day had more value and Knowledge for the delegates than was expected by them. Sri G. 
V. K. Rao of Hyderabad conducted a session on medical astrology, which was an eye opener for even some 
professionals in the field. This was followed by a session on Educational prospects through KP by Sri 
Sahasane and the importance of sub-sub lords was beautifully elucidated. Thereafter, Sri Vinayak Agte of 
Mumbai showed all the delegates how Stock market can be predicted with the help of KP. Finally, the panel 
discussion focused on Ruling planets as the master key in KP. 

Dignitaries and stalwarts in the filed of astrology, both KP and traditional were felicitated by the 
KPAF. These included Sri V.B. N. Sarma, one of the direct students of Sri KSK and a patron of KPAF, Sri A. 
V. Sundaram, | CAS and the invited speakers. A Lifetime Achievement Award was given to Sri R. N. Acharya, 
Founder, Kadambi Booksellers for his lifelong support to astrology and astrologers and was conferred the 
title ‘}) yotisha Bandhu’ 

|t was found that all the delegates, unanimously and unequivocally were praising the efforts of the 
organizing committee members. But kudos is surely due to the founder members Sri Rajendra N. Nimje, 
President, KPAF and his friend Dr. V. V. K. Mohan, Secretary, KPAF along with the Dr. Andrew Dutta, Vice- 
President, KPAF who gave a historical milestone in the field of KP by organizing such international level 
summit. All the 50 odd regular members of the KPAF gave inthe best of their efforts to pull of f this event. 
The Summit paved the way for an international level interaction on KP astrology first time ever and was one 
of the most successful technical get together of the field till date. 





L to R: Dr. VVK Mohan, Dr. A. Dutta, Sri. Vinayak Agte, Sri Suresh Sahasane, Sri Rajendra.N. Nimje, Sri. 
Sunil Gondhalekar, Sri, Kanak Bosmia and Sri. M.V. Rajaraam.

TWO OPPOSING SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT 
1. There are two opposing schools of thought (Anukul-vad v/s Pratikul-vad ) in choosing gems: *1/, *2/ 


(a) ANUKULA-VAD (Benefic Planet Method): the gems act SAME as their planets and so the gems 
Should be used for a native's Anukul grahas (benefic planets) to improve the performance of the 
benef ic influence. 


(0) PRATI KUL-VAD (Malefic Planet Method): the gems act OPPOSITE of their planets and so the gems 
should be chosen for a native's Pratikul grahas (malefic planets). 


2. Both methods assume that the gems increase cosmic colors of their planets. A follower of the 
Benefic Planet Method believes that the gems do not act opposite of their planets, and so the 
magnif ying of a malefic planet's color will surely increase the ill fortune. | t was voted in the Planetary 
Gemologists Association (PGA) to follow the Benefit Planet Method, which is applied by Dr. Khilanath 
Bastakoty of Nepal, Gemologist Howard Beckman and Astrologer Shyamsundara of USA, Astrologer 
Pandit Vidyadhar Shukla of Thailand, and many others. *1/, *2/ 


3. However, many practicing astrologers are advising the client to wear a gem that signifies the weak 
planet in the astrological chart in order to propitiate planetary weaknesses. |n their opinion, wearing a 
gem for a planet which causes suffering due to unfortunate positioning at the time of a person's birth 
will propitiate that planet or cause it to give less trouble. 


4. Regarding the continuing debate on anukula (favorable, risk free) and pratikula (unfavorable, 
appeasement) gemstones, Shri Sanjay Rath, In principle, supports the use of anukula gemstones and 
would recommend a pratikula gemstone only if it was involved in a strong favorable yoga in a kendra 
(quadrant). He has advised the gemstone of lord of dharma (9th house) and lagnesha as it is a *no risk* 
method and enhances the good qualities and sattva guna. *3/

EFFECTIVENESS OF WEARING GEMS 


13. According to Guruji KSK, anyone, putting on the gems of the strongest significators of the 
beneficial houses is lucky. Only when luck is to be enjoyed shortly, he will or she will acquire this color; 
we attribute the luck to the gem.*7/ Truth is this: Acquisition of any Gem is indicated mostly by a 
benefic. So one acquires when the period of that planet operates. So, when you put the gem, that good 
period operates and so you enjoy and you attribute to the gem.*5/ Only a few KP articles have been 
found regarding the effectiveness of wearing gems. *8/, *9/, *10 & *11/ 


14. Sri Yogananda has mentioned how the period of his predicted ailment was shortened by an 
astrological bangle suggested by his Guru, Sri Yukteswar. *12/ The wearing of gems ts still very widely 
practiced, for instance by almost all | ndian PMs. Napoleon Bonapart, Alexander and J ulius Caesar were 
known to have intense belief and interest in gemstones. 


15. In the case of Princess Diana, the Blue Sapphire was chosen for her engagement ring perhaps 
according to a traditional belief that it is useful to maintain harmony and good relationship among the 
partners. *6/ The Blue Sapphire is the gem for Saturn, which is the sub-lord of 10th and 11th cusps 
and a significator of houses 1,2, 3 at the planet level and houses 7, 9 at the star level in her KP chart 
(01-07-1961, 18:45 GMT, 52N50, 00E30). Saturn is conjoined with J] upiter which is in 2nd house and 
lord of 4th house. So the Blue Sapphire is supposed to be the best choice by KP. A Vedic astrologer also 
might advise the same because the lord of 2nd house (precious stones) J] upiter (as per Vedic chart) Is 


conjunct with Saturn in Saturn’s own sign giving rise to Guru-Shani Yoga (bestowing wealth etc.) even 
though Saturn owns a Vedic natural and functional malefic 3rd and 4th houses. The results are mixed 
with sadness and betrayal by her loved ones and reaching to a height of fame to be declared by PM 
Tony Blair after her death as the People’s Princess. 


OBSERVATION 


16. As per KP, the gem indicated by the most beneficial planet in the KP chart is to be chosen. However, 
this subject of two opposing methods in choosing gems and the effectiveness of wearing gems calls for 
an independent research. 


17. Some words of caution are necessary. Firstly, bystrengthening a malefic planet which is conjunct or 
aspecting another planet, there is danger of harmingthat other planet. *13/ Secondly, benefics when 
weakare usually safe to strengthen. *14/ Thirdly, thewearing of a gem with major flaws may be 
harmful. *15/ Fourthly, it is better not to use the gem when there is any doubt whether the planet is 
malefic or benefic.*10/ Finally, in Mr. Kanak’s personal view, it Is not advisable to wear any gem to any 
native because the success giving houses for the native may be the undesirable houses of Badhaka, 
Marka, Moksha, 10°" (retirement from this world) and 4th (end of everything) for the native or the 
native’s family members like parents, children and brothers etc.

The Query 


Look to the position of Moon, which appears in Lagna close to the cusp, indicating that the native’s 
mind is focused on to establish himself by this career opportunity. Since, Moon falls in 3-6-10-12'" 
cusp, it indicates his concern on the modalities of the contract (3 cusp), gain from the party (6'" 
Cusp), career building through this proposition (10'" cusp) and association with the foreign land (12'" 
cusp). Moon is a strong planet, as there Is no planet in its star; hence the concern of the native is much 
focused. 


Take note of the sub-lord of Lagna, which is Mars, a very strong planet, as there is no planet in its 
star. Mars is placed in 9°" house as 4" and 9°" lord, indicating the activities related to the education 
(4'" house) in the distant land (9'" house). Mars falls in the star of Venus, which is 3° and 10°" lord, 
Suggesting the scope of career activities (10'" house) building through the contract agreement (3% 
house). 


Thus, the mental focus on the query was established in the prashna chart. Hence, it was reasonable to 
proceed for analyzing the query.

In the query of this nature, Lagna represents the native who raises the question and the 7'" house 
represents the party at the other end with whom the contract is being built. 


3rd and 9th house represents the contract document mutually signed between the 2 parties and its 
fruitfulness to meet the desired results is represented by the linkage of 3-11'" cusp with the 11°" 
house. Since, the query happens to be the gain of earning through the said contract; these houses 
should be usefully linked to the 2™ house.

Analysis of the chart 


e Let us see, if the contract built between the native and the commonwealth college, UK Is lucrative 
to the native. 


Note that the 3"? cuspal sub-lord is Moon, which is in the sub of Rahu that being the sub-lord of 
the 9'" cusp. Thus, the 9°" cusp (contract terms of the commonwealth college) would dominate the 
activities of the native’s activities and initiative (3° cusp). Cuspal sub-lord of the 11'" cusp is Sun, 
which falls in the sub of Rahu, thus the 11'" cusp establishes its link with the 3 and 9°" cusp. 
Hence, the 3-9-11'" cusps are interconnected. 


Sun as the 11°" cuspal sub-lord is a strong planet, as there is no planet in its star. Note that the 
Sun as lagna lord and the 11'" cuspal sub-lord is placed in the 11'" house, thus there is a fair ground 
to believe that the contract drawn between the native and the commonwealth college would be 
beneficial to the native (11'" cusp), in principle, enhancing the status of the native as a lead 
contractor (1° house) for the commonwealth college admissions. 


e Look further to the 11° sub-lord Sun. Sun is in the star of Venus placed in 12'" house and lording 
3"? and 10°" house. Since, both 3"? and 10°" houses are occupied, Venus would only be the weak 
significator of the houses lorded and would mainly signify the 12‘ house. Thus, the matters of 12°" 
house (foreign connection) gets in force in priority by the 11'° sub-lord Sun through its star lord 
Venus. 


Now, note the sub-lord of Sun that is Rahu placed in 6'" house. Rahu disposes Saturn (its sign lord) 
and since Saturn is the sub-lord of 2"? cusp of earnings. Note that the Saturn is in the star of 
Ketu that disposes Sun, which is the sub-lord of 11'° cusp and placed in the 11'" house. Thus, the 
11'" cusp gets favourably connected to the 2™ cusp. 


Till now, the establishment of the mutually favourable link amongst the 11°" cusp with the 2™ and 
6'" cusp suggests that the contract deal shall be beneficial to the native for monetary gains. 


Timing the financial gains 


e At the time of prashna, the native was running the dasha of Venus and bhukti of Rahu ending J an- 
2009. 


Venus as dasha lord is placed in the Ketu’s star in 12'" house bringing the focus on the activities 
connected with the foreign land (12'" house). Since, Ketu disposes Sun placed in 11'" house, the 
foreign land (12'" house) may confer gains to him (11'" house). Further, since Venus is placed in the 
sub of Rahu placed in 6°" house, the connection is extended to the 2-11'" cusps and Venus dasha 
may be taken as the fruitful period for the native to proceed inthe proposed business venture. 


e Look to the Rahu bhukti. As analysed earlier, Rahu is a very favourable planet to start the business 
venture as it is placed in the 6"" house in own star and sub of Mercury as 2-11'" lord placed in 10'" 
house. Mercury would strongly dispose the 2™ house, as it is vacant, thereby conferring a 
reasonable earning out of the said business venture. Thus, Rahu bhukti is the right time to start 
the venture. 


Thus, it was assessed and communicated to the native on the same day that he may very well proceed 
to take up the proposed business contract with the commonwealth colleges at UK and he has fair 
chances of success in gaining wealth through the proposed contract proposal.

a fantastic dogma by which accurate results are obtained. 


Guruji has taught the world that an event will take place during the dasha, bhukti and antara 
of significators of a particular event when transits too agree.

nativities and two examples are given below with the analysis.

First let us see what is Muhurat? 

An auspicious time to start any event is a Muhurat. The chart for that special moment is MUHURAT CHART. Here it 
Should be clearly understood that WE HAVE TO TAKE MOMENT OF STARTING, WE DO NOT CARE WHEN THE 
EVENT GETS FINISHED. We take only time when we start.

Very important point in any MUHURAT chart is, never select MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR rasi as a Lagna. These 
four Rasis--MESHA, KARKA, TULA and MAKAR are CHARA Rasis and for Chara Rasi the 11°" cusp is Badhaka Sthana. 
W hen we do special work we always think for long life of that work, and for long life/ longevity of event we have to look at 
the Asc sub lord. For good longevity if we set time when Asc sub lord signifies 1,5,11 that means good longevity. And if we 


take Chara Lagna i.e. MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR 11'" is not good but becomes a Badhaka. So we should avoid 
Chara Lagna for any Muhurat.

When will my daughter come home after shopping? 


Effort by : Vijay Kumar 
Senior Manager, C-DOT 
Electronic City, Phase-1 
Hosur Road 
Bangalore - 560 100 080- 
25119580 (Off), 26587463 (Res) 0-9845039153

On July 28, 2007, my daughter went to shopping and was scheduled to come 
back by evening. Being enthusiast of KP astrology, I ventured to find out 


when would she come home. 


With this intent in mind, I casted a prashna chart at 15-12-29 Hrs IST at residence to know the outcome 
of my query. 


The chart at the casting time is produced herewith. 
The chart is being analysed by the application of ruling planets as follows: 
The Query 
Look to the position of Moon, which appears in 5-7™ cusp indicating my concern about my daughter (5™ 
cusp) and her being out of the house (7™ cusp being 3 from 5™ cusp). Thus, the mental focus on the 
query was established in the prashna chart and it was reasonable to proceed for analyzing the query. 


The co- ordinates of judgment 


This query has been handled by the application of ruling planets and employing the transit of Lagna and 
Moon to handle the outcome. 


Since, the query happens to be the coming home of my daughter, the 4 cusp (home), 5™ house 
(daughter) and realization of ambition (11™ cusp) was in focus. 


The methodology was to note the ruling planets and validate each of them who could be useful to 
fructify the event. The ruling planets were validated in the shade of cuspal interlinks. I have not 
considered the retrogression of planets. 

Analysis of the chart 


e Let us note the ruling planets at the time of query. 


At the time of self-query, while the Lagna was transiting in Mars sign and Mercury star, the Moon 
was transiting in the Jup sign and Venus star. The day was Saturday. 


Thus the ruling planets were Mercury-Mars-Venus-Jupiter-Saturn.

y Mercury does not have any planet in its star, thus is a powerful planet and effectively lords 
the 11 house. The placement of Mercury in 4™ cusp as cuspal sub-lord indicates its lead role 
in bringing my daughter home. 


Mercury is deposited in Jupiter's star placed in 4" cusp and in the sub of Saturn taken to 
signify the 11™ cusp, as Rahu as sub-lord of 11™ cusp disposes Saturn. 


Thus, Mercury has a lead role in the query. 


yY Mars also does not have any planet in its star, hence powerful but effectively lords only the 
Lagna, as it is vacant. Though, Mars does not have connection to the 4™ house, it gets placed in 
11 cusp, hence looks useful. 


Mars is placed in the star of Sun, not connected with either of the 4™ or 11" cusp. Mars is 
placed in the sub of Rahu, which is the sub-lord of the 11™ cusp. 


Since, Mars does not have any connection with the 4™ house, it may not indicate coming home 
and fructify the query. 


y Venus effectively lords 7™ house meaning the roaming of my daughter in shopping (3 from 5™ 
cusp). Venus gets placed in the star of Ketu, which disposes Sun and Venus as sign and star 
lord. While, Sun does not support either of the 4 or 11 house, Venus falls in the sub of 
Jupiter placed in 4™ cusp, thus, Venus could be useful to bring to fructify the query. 


y Jupiter effectively lords 5™ house. Jupiter in the star of Saturn signifies the 4™ cusp and the 
11 cusp by way of being disposed by 11™ cuspal sub-lord Rahu. Jupiter in its own sub signifies 
4*" cusp strongly. 


Thus, Jupiter was rated useful to fructify the query. 
y Saturn lords the 4™ house effectively and gets disposed by the 11™ cuspal sub-lord Rahu, thus 
completing the 4-11" cuspal connection. Saturn is thus useful to fructify the query. 


It may be noted that I have not considered the retrogression of planets in any way. 


Timing of coming home 


First of all, it should be prudent to know, whether coming home of my daughter would be in time or 
late. 

For this reason, take note of the 11™ cuspal sub-lord Rahu that disposes Saturn, indicating me that 
her return may be late and beyond my expectation. This gave me sufficient hints to look for the 
lagna operative in late hours and was contended because serious shopping in Bangalore is all the 
way time consuming. 


In the process of timing the coming home of my daughter, I looked at the Moon. 
At the time of prashna, the Moon was transiting in the sign of Jupiter, star of Venus and sub of 
Jupiter. Since, the Moon was to transit Venus star even after midnight and because of the fact 


that Venus was an useful RP, I resorted to look which sub in the Venus star could be conducive to 
bring her back, looking to the indications of her late coming. 


KPEzine_October_2007 Page 27 


yY Moon in Jup sub in Jup sign and Venus star was transiting till 17-03 Hrs 
Y Moon in Saturn sub in Jup sign and Venus star was transiting between 17-03 to 20-54 Hrs 
yY Moon was to start transiting Mercury sub in Jup sign and Venus star from 20-54 Hrs 


Since, all the Jupiter, Saturn and Mercury as sub-lord of Moon were amongst the fruitful RPs, I 
thought it prudent to zero it down to Mercury sub, as it had the lead role in bringing back my 
daughter. 


Thus, Moon transiting in Jup-Ven-Merc was the selected time starting from 2054 Hrs. As said 
already, the indicated delay as seen by the 11™ cusp prompted me to reach to such conclusion. 


Next was to look at the Lagna. 
I directly looked at the lagna at 2054 Hrs at the time of entry of Moon in Mercury sub. 


The Lagna at that time was transiting in Aquarius sign in Saturn-Rahu-Sun-Moon. I was satisfied 
with Saturn as sign lord and Rahu as star lord as both signify 11" cusp. 


I left at that point and decided to check the outcome in actuals, may be my patience of 
calculations was over. Thus, it was assessed that my daughter would come home after 2054 Hrs 


only. 


Facts of the case 


It was a pleasant surprise when the bell rang at 2056 Hrs and my daughter entered home with lot

Though, the lead role of Mercury as lagna's sub-sub lord was noticed, I was left perplexed why Sun 
as sub lord of the Lagna fructified the results. 


However, I was happy to at least come closer to the timing of the event.

Introduction to K.B. System :- Part: 1 


By: A. Devaraj (Jyothish Kalaa Rathna ) 
Sri Bruhaspati K.B. Jyothish Training School, 
No, 68. P.G. Avenue, 3rd St., Kattuppakkam, 
Chennai-600056, Ph.044-24765320, Cell: 9382339084. 





I heartily worship and submit this article at the feet of our beloved Guruji, Jyothish Marthand 
Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti, the founder of the K.P. Method Astrology. He lived at Madras. He was the 
first man to sort out the new method of calculation in the field of astrology through scientific way. He 
made a very strong base for the Stellar Astrology 


Before the period of K.S.K the history of astro-philosophy had lots of — confusion and 
controversies. In my point of view, after K.S.K entered, he done away with unwanted things in the field 
of astrology and newly constructed astrology with scientific methodology. This methodology definitely 
reduced the confusions and controversies in the field of astrology. If anybody wants to develop the 
astrology field, first he will have to start research from K.P system only. 


On the basis of our beloved Guruji K.S.K.'s principles, my Guruji Prasanna Jyothidamani. K. 
Baskaran, Madurai, invented and created the new methodology in astrology called the K.B .System 
(Krishnamurti-Baskara system). I hope, the K.B. system is the first renovated system in the history of 
astrology after K.P system and the Jyothish world would accept this method very soon. 


Before we start to know the principles of K.B System, I want to explain the readers, how the 
K.B. System scientifically differs from K.P. System. Here I am not criticizing K.P system or K.P 
followers. Readers may please justify the difference in between the two systems. 


1. K.P System: For Marriage, the 7™ cuspal sub-lord should be connected with the 2, 7, 11 houses. 


K.B. System: For Marriage, Lagna and 7th Cuspal sub-lord should be connected with the 5, 7, 11 bhava 
sub-lord. 


Reason: The 1% and 7™ bhava indicate the Husband and wife running the family life with the 
recognition by the society. 6, 12" bhava are the 12th bhava to the 1st and 7th bhava, indicating the 
separation of the Husband and wife relationship before the society. 


5, 11" bhava is the 12™ bhava to the 6, 12, indicating the thickest affection relationship 
between the husband and the wife. 


Then, 2nd bhava is the 8™ bhava to 7™ bhava. So, the 2"° bhava gives opposite response to the 
marriage. So the 2nd bhava should not be taken for the marriage purpose in the K.B method. 


2. K.P. System: In this System to predict the results of any one planet they consider by the star 
lord and sub-lord of the Starlord. These planets’ owning houses, residing houses, aspect of the planets, 
aspect to bhavas, and retrogression and exaltation of the planet are taken into consideration. 


K.B. System: In this System to predict the results of any one planet we consider by the star lord of 
the planet, sub-lord of the planet, and consider cuspal inter-links of these planets. 


Reason: Approximately Two hours will take to move the Lagna from O degree to 30 degrees ina bhava. 
Some planets may be positioned in the lagna with exaltation, retrogression, aspect, conjunction, 
ownership of the lagna. If we give the same result to all the persons who own the same lagna within the 
KPEzine_October_2007 Page 29 


period of two hours, how can they give the same result to all the persons? Scientifically the result will 
not coincide with all the persons. 


But the Bhava cusps move rapidly, within a minute some bhava sub-lord will change and we can 
find-out the differences. So the K.B system gives importance to the cusps only. Readers please think, 
“no two human beings are alike in lives”, all human beings are different from each other in thinking, 
living etc... 


3. K.P. System: Any bhava connected to the 11th bhava means that bhava will give good and 
successful result. Mostly this method is handled in the Horary method. 


K.B. System: Concerned bhava's successful result will be determined by its 11 bhava. This method is 
also adopted in the Horary method. 


Reason: For example, we will take the 4th bhava. 11™ bhava is the 8" bhava to 4™ bhava. For example 
we take the House construction which is indicated by the 4 bhava karaka. Here 11™ bhava is the 12" 
bhava to 12™ bhava. 12™ bhava indicates the investment for house construction. Let us take the 
current dasa; bhukthi is connected with the 11th bhava. 


According to 11™ house, it will not give the sufficient investment to the construction work; the 
house work will stop with incomplete stage and failure in the construction. 2"° house is the 11 house 
to 4th house, refers to own money and 2™ bhava is the 3 bhava to 12th house; indicates the 
investment of money for construction of the house successfully (2"° bhava connecting dasa, bhukthi) 


I request the readers to think of the other houses in the same method. 


4. K.P: From lagna bhava 1, 2, 3, 6, 10, 11 bhavas are considered as developing bhavas. These bhavas 
give benefits and 4,5, 7,8,9,12™ bhavas do not give the benefits. 


K.B.: From the concerned bhava 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 11 bhavas give good and benefic results; 4, 8, 10,12 
bhavas give bad and 6, 7th bhavas give neutral effects (not good and not bad) to the concerned bhava. 


Reason: For example 2, 6 bhavas are 8, 12th bhavas to 7th bhava. So the 2, 6 bhavas gives trouble to 
the wife in the marriage life. Like that 3, 11 bhavas are 8, 12" bhavas to 4™ house. So these give 
trouble to properties. 


In the same way 5,9 bhava comes 8,12 bhavas to the 10th bhava. 4 house comes 8, 12 bhava 
to 5™ and 9 bhavas. Also 4 house comes to 3™ house to 2™ bhava. So 4™ house does not give any 


disturbance in profession and no lack of money transaction. 


Thus, each bhava rules on other 11 bhavas, and gives different results like positive for some 
bhavas and negative result to some bhavas. 


So, in the K.B. method, each and every bhava gives the result or response according to the 
connection with other bhavas, counting from the particular bhava. 


5. K.P System: One bhava's fate is determined on the basis of the bhava cuspal sub-lord and it’s star 
lord positioning in the bhava: exalted, retrograde, conjunction, aspect, positions. 


K.B System: One bhava's fate is determined on the basis of bhava cuspal sub lord and it’s star lord and 
sub lord are connected with other bhavas cusps (inter-links) will determine the fate. 


KPEzine_October_2007 Page 30 


Reason: Example, take the Venus is the 7th bhava's sub lord. It will stands in the same position roughly 
about 9 minutes (that is 7™ sub lord venus). In the K.P method, in-between the period of 9 minutes (who 
are born they get the same effects) marriage life fate, good or bad response are the same. 


But in K.B. we take care about the bhava sub lord only. If the 7™ bhava sub lord is Venus, It 
moves in the particular sub for about 9 minutes. But within the time of a minute the sub lord Venus star 
lord will change and the fate response will automatically change within the one minute. 


6. K.PSystem: 9 planets and 12 bhava karakas explained in the old pattern style. 


K.B System: Planets karaka explained on the base of the bhava cuspal links.12 bhavas and 9 planets are 
sorted out to modern period like lagna dependent and lagna non-dependent. Each bhava has twelve bhava 
karakas and they give 12 types of responses in the easy way. 


Reason: K.B's important rule is each and every bhava connect with other bhava gives a different result. 
That is, it gives one result to the lagna bhava and other result to own bhava.. 


For example, in the 6th bhava disease is the lagna depended karaka, and loan is the lagna non- 
dependent karaka. If you want to analyze the lagna dependent karaka (disease) we should analyze from 
the lagna. If you want to analyze the lagna non-dependant karaka (loan) analyze from the concern bhava. 
Thus K.B. Methodology is a newly formed method with multiple angles to predict the results of the 
horoscope. 


Generally, 10™ bhava indicates profession. But each bhava has a karaka for profession. For 
example, the 4" bhava indicates the house, plot, vehicle, education related professions, 5th bhava 
indicates the profession of commission agent, fine art, cinema, drama, politics related professions etc. 
The above example is useful to analyze various charts in a new way, and with different angles it gives 
best individuality in results. 


7. K.P System: so much confusion in handling to rectify the birth chart, so we can't follow an 
unanimous method to rectify the birth chart. Example, they are considering the Rahu, Kethu are the 
strong nodes and fix Rahu and Kethu as the Lagna sub lord mostly. 


K.B. System: Each and every birth chart can be rectified easily without any controversy, confusion and 
all the astrologers can follow an unique method. Example, K.B. has the single rule, i.e. R.P. lagna position 
shows the natal chart’s Moon position and R.P. moon position shows the natal chart's Lagna position. 


Reason: In the K.P method to rectify the birth chart, to adjust time between 30 to 45 minutes 
difference and confusion to move up and down to the position of R.P of Day lord, Rasi lord, star lord, 
Lagna lord, Lagna star lord etc. and meanwhile the R.P connected with Rahu and Kethu means, it will give

Which One is Krishnamurti Ayanamsa? 





By: Rangarajan Krishnamoorthy 
Man Machine Systems 
Plot 24, Ramalinga Nagar Extn. 
1 Street, Puzhuthivakkam 
Chennai - 600 091 
Phone: 044-22580377 


ranga@mmsindia.com 


The ayanamsa issue has been debated by astrologers for many years and there is no sign that this will 
end soon. The popular Swiss Ephemeris program supports over a dozen ayanamsas including Lahiri, 
B.V.Raman, Krishnamurti, and Fagan Bradley. Since each astrologer has his favourite ayanamsa, software 
developers tend to support as many as possible so that their users will be happy. 


What baffles me is that there are at least four flavours of Krishnamurti ayanamsa! It is difficult for 
me to digest this because I feel that during all these years KP has been in existence, the correct 
flavour of Krishnamurti ayanamsa should have been identified and standardized. Although in various 
internet forums a mention is made of KP ayanamsa, the specific flavour is not often indicated. This can 
cause a lot of confusion because the sub lord or in many cases, the sub sub lord, can differ if an 
incorrect version is used. In this short article, I would like to list the four flavours and indicate what I 
believe is the correct KP ayanamsa (not what I believe is the correct ayanamsa - this is an open issue). 


The four KP ayanamsas in use by KP followers are 
1) KP Ayanamsa as supported in Swiss Ephemeris program 
2) KP Straight line 
3) KP Straight line adjusted 
4) KP Ayanamsa (2003) 


Many western and Vedic astrology software support option (1) because it is built into the Swiss 
Ephemeris library. I do not know the history of “KP Straight line", but in this flavour, the ayanamsa 
remains the same for all days ina year. As far as I know, Shri.Raichur was the first to support this in 
his software. I did some checking and found that this ayanamsa is just about 1 minute different from 
the value published in the “Universal Table of Houses" (UTOH). I know of some senior astrologers who 
still use this ayanamsa. The third, “KP Straight line adjusted” starts with the same value as “KP Straight 
line" on April 15th of each year, but instead of remaining the same over the year, varies proportionately 
for any other date in the year. The followers of “Krishnamurti Baskaran" (KB) system use this option in 
their charting. 


The fourth flavour, identified as “KP Ayanamsa (2003)", was clearly formulated in an article by 
Shri.K.Balachandran in "K.P & Astrology" year book of 2003. The author based his article on another 
article by Shri.M.G.G.Nair that appeared in “Astrology & Athrishta", May 1980. A formula for 
calculating the ayanamsa for 15™ April 5:30 am IST was given, with a note that ayanamsa for any other 
date in the year must be calculated proportionately. Senior KP astrologer Shri.A.R.Raichur and many 
others argue that this is the correct KP ayanamsa. I too believe that this is the one that all KP 
astrologers should be using. 


Let us try to understand why there is so much confusion about Krishnamurti ayanamsa. In KP Reader-1 
(“Casting the Horoscope"), Shri.K.S.Krishnamurti proposed his own ayanamsa although he was aware of 
other ayanamsas in use at that time, including the popular Lahiri ayanamsa. According to KSK, the date 
of coincidence of the Tropical and Sidereal zodiacs was 291 A.D. and the rate of precession was 
50.2388475 seconds (Newcomb). In the book he promised to publish the details of his ayanamsa at a 
later date, but unfortunately did not do so. However in the book he published a table of his ayanamsas 
for the years 1840 to 2001. The values shown in the table have only degrees and minutes, no seconds. It 
KPEzine_October_2007 Page 37 


would appear from the table that the aynamsa was valid for the whole year. If you read some of the old 
articles you will find that the same ayanamsa was used for various dates in the same calendar year. For 
instance, the "K.P. & Astrology" year book of 1997 mentions an ayanamsa value of 23 deg 43 min for the 
year 1997 along with its listing of Nirayana positions of planets for that year. 


The table below shows the values of ayanamsas (1), (2) and (4) for various years, as on 15™ April, 5:30 
am IST. Ayanamsa (3) has been excluded because on 15" April of each year, it has the same value as 
that of (2). The value published by Shri. KSK in his First Reader and the value from UTOH are also 
included for comparison. 





You can see that KP (2003) ayanamsa is the closest to the values given by KSK. 


In conclusion, I wish to state that whereas there is no immediate solution to the ayanamsa problem, a 
KP astrologer should be using KP (2003) ayanamsa. As the above table shows, this is probably what KSK 
had in mind when he published the table of ayanamsas in his book. It is also to be kept in mind that it is 
not correct to use the same ayanamsa throughout a year.

There is nothing more on Muhurat chart in KP books. When I was a student of Vedic astrology and 
joined the School of Astrology, in advance course, I learnt on Muhurat and specially with reference to 
the book "“MUHURAT MARTAND". 

When first time I predicted using MUHURAT chart very correctly about Discovery Shuttle Launch, my 
friend Sri Tin Win ji sent me a good Vedic Muhurat book "CLASSIC MUHURAT"-By Ernest Wilhelm as 
a gift. After reading the book I thought to do more work on muhurat chart in KP. 


First let us see what is Muhurat? 


An auspicious time to start any event is a Muhurat. The chart for that special moment is MUHURAT 
CHART. Here it should be clearly understood that WE HAVE TO TAKE THE MOMENT OF 
STARTING, WE DO NOT CARE WHEN THE EVENT GETS FINISHED. We take only time when we 
start. 

In the following example I took the time of Launching of Barbie Doll. 

Now I discuss why this product is still a hot selling toy today. Detailed analysis is as under: 


Date of Launching: 09 March 1959 

Time of Launching: 10.00.00 AM 

Place of Launching: Manhattan- New York - USA. 
Long/ Lat: 40 N 46, 73 W 59 


Very important point in any MUHURAT chart is, never select MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR rasi 
as a Lagna. These four Rasis--MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR are CHARA Rasis and for Chara 

Rasi the 11" cusp is Badhaka Sthana. When we do special work we always think for long life of that 
work, and for long life/longevity of the event we have to look Asc sub lord. For good longevity if we set 
time when Asc sub lord signifies 1, 5, 11 that means good longevity. And if we take Chara Lagna i.e. 
MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR 11 is not good but becomes a Badhaka. So we should avoid Chara 


Lagna for any Muhurat. 
Role of Asc. Sub lord 


In this case Asc Rasi is Vrishbha, so badhaka sthana is 9™. Sub lord of Asc is Sat. Sat is in the star of 


Ket and sub of Mer. 
Sat is in 8, lord of 10, 11. Ket is in 11, Ket Conj with Mer and Ven and Jup.. Mer is in 11 lord of 


2(Maraka), 3. Ven is in 11 Lord of 1, 6. Jup is in 6, lord of 8, 9(Badhaka). So it is clear that there is long 
life, 1, 11 supports long life and 2, 9 indicate some danger to this product; but only in unfavorable DBA 


only.
