In K.B.system I.e.Baskaran method, the starting point of a bhava cusp is the main entrance of 
the bhava. Like that, the cusp starting point determines fate of the bhava or the whole result 
Is being fixed at the starting point itself. 


A bhava cusp starting point is, a rasi lord, star lord, sub lord, sub-sub lord etc, are functioning 
like a minute fraction. 


The prediction is determined according the ratio of the planet is, rasi lord 20%, star lord 40%, 
Sub lord 80%, sub sub lord 100%. I ncase of cuspal sub sub lord it will changes its position within 
few seconds. so, if we use only this, it is practically difficult to find out the result.for this we 
need accurate time. 


So, in the K.B.system, it is advised that the cuspal sub lord is enough to determine the result. 
Why because, only the cuspal sub lord itself can give different results who born within one 
minute different. So, cuspal sub lord is more than enough to determine the fate or result. 


Finally, in a cusp, Starlord is more strengthen than Rasilord, and Sublord is more strengthen 
than starlord. 


How the cuspal sub lords determine the prediction? 


We have to consider that the bhava cuspal sub lord is a planet. | t stands in a star and sub. This 
Star & sub links to some bhava (cuspal sublord or starlord orsubsub lord) and it gives the good 
or bad results to the particular bhava. That is the fate of that bhava. This is called cuspal 
linterlinks in KB system. 


For prediction technique in KB system, we have some importance rules and regulations. 
Rule- 1: 


From the concerned or questionable bhava 1,2,3,5,9,11 bhavas gives good and benefits, 4,8,10,12 
bhavas gives bad and 6,/th bhavas gives good and bad mixed neutral result according to of the 
circumstances. 


Explanation: 


Now, take the 2nd bhava as the questionable bhava. The 2nd bhava has so many karaka; among 
these money is the one of the Karaka of the 2nd bhava. Here, 1,2,3,5,9,11 bhavas from 2nd 
bhava called 2, 3, 4, 6, 10,12th bhavas. When 2nd bhava connected with 2, 3, 4, 6, 10,12th 
bhavas, the 2nd bhava gets strengthened and the person’s finance position will develop day by 
day. Thus, we determine the result to 2nd house. 


In the same method, when 2nd bhava is connected from its 4, 8, 10,12th bhava, called 5, 9, 


11,lst bhava. Here, the 2™ house looses its strength and the person's finance position will

Every bhava (Planet), with its links gives results in two ways. |t gives results (good or bad) to its

The present UPA government is in crises over nuke deal and Left parties again made it clear

agreement. Noe the question is whether Left will pull of f its support. 


Let us try with swearing in ceremony time chart of UPA govt. UPA governemt swear in at 17-34 
IST, at new delhi on 22-5-2004. at this time it was Libra ascendant rising inthe east. Usually in 
muhurta charts moveable signs should be avoided, and Libra is a moveable sign. 


In kp stellar system of predictions, emphasis is given to planetary stellar signification. The 
present UPA govt. is depending upon the LEFT parties support to remain in power. Let us 
analyses their alliance. |t is like a partnership or contract between two parties . viewing it as an 
angle of will this partnership will go on or it will break down? 


Rule 


|f 7°" cusp sub lord signify 6 or 12 then the partenership will break. | f it signify 5-8 12 houses

|n swearing in chart of sh. Manmohan Singh J |,

Here inthe chart 

1- Rahu is conjoined with mercury (lord of 12 in 6 seperation) so alliance party (left) will

All these significations tell us that this alliance will break.

IMPORTNACE OF MUHURAT AS PER KP

This Month | have very good news for KP Lovers. | n response to the April 2006 issue of AM, wherein 
Smt. Gayatridevi Vasudev's analyzes of Swearing in chart of former Karnataka Chief Minister, Shri H.D. 
Kumaraswami’s Govt, | decided to check it with KP system and | found opposite result what written by 
Smt Gayatridevi Vasudev. | wrote a mail to her with my finding but she never published it. In her 
article she gives more importance on ABHI] |T MUHURAT and SUN in 10'" house. With this point she 
predicted long life of Karnataka Govt, as per my finding this swearing chart shows short life as per KP 
rules, and now we know this Govt. is not in power. 


| wrote in my message in KP system group (Now | am silent member of that group) 
http:// groups.yahoo.com/ group/k_p system/message/ 7525 and prediction come very correct. 


| don’t want to compare both systems, |.e., Vedic astrology and KP astrology, but my humble attempt is 
to find out difference between the both. We have to always remember that basis of KP Is only on 
Vedic astrology. 


First let us see what is Muhurat? 


An auspicious time to start any event is a Muhurat. The chart for that auspicious moment is MUHURAT 
CHART. Here it should be clearly understood that WE HAVE TO TAKE THE MOMENT OF 
STARTING THE EVENT, WE DO NOT TAKE INTO CONSIDERATION WHEN THE EVENT GETS 
FINISHED. 


Now! shall discuss Shri Kumaraswami’s Govt’s swearing in chart. 


Date of Swearing: 03 Februray 2006 

Time: 12.21 PM 

Place: Vidhana souda- Bangalore- Karnataka 
Lat/Long: 12 N 59, 77 E 35 


Very important point in any MUHURAT chart is, never select MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR ras 
as a Lagna. These four Rasis--MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR are CHARA Rasis and for Chara 
Rasi the 11'° cusp is Badhaka Sthana. When we do auspicious work we always think for long and 
prosperous life of that work, and for long life / longevity of the event we have to look Asc cusp sub 
lord. For good longevity if we set time when Asc sub lord signifies 1, 5, 11 which means good longevity. 
And if we take Chara Lagna i.e. MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR 11°" is not good but becomes a 
Badhaka. So we should avoid Chara Lagna for any Muhurat. 


In this chart lagna is Mesh, the selection of this Lagna is that at this time SUN comes in 10" and time 
of swearing in is in Abhijit Muhurat. As per Vedic system of astrology Muhurat, Abhijit Muhurat with 
Sunis in 10'" house is the best for RAJ YABHI SHEK Muhurat.

W hat will be the outcome of Election?

Thought One

Government and movements), 11(gain) then power come in hand of Democratic Government. 


3) If Asc Sub lord (Tendency of people of country) signifies 9(Religious leader), 11(gain) 
then power come in hand of Religious leaders. 


Thought Two

Government and movements), 11(gain) then power come in hand of Democratic Government.

then power come in hand of Military or dictator. 

3) If 10” (outcome of election and referendum) signifies 9(Religious leader), 11(gain) then 
power come in hand of Religious leaders.

How to predict horoscope for wealth 
Through K.B system 


By: A. Devaraj (Jyothish Kalaa Rathna ) 


Sri Bruhaspati K.B. Jyothish Training School, 
No, 68. P.G. Avenue, 3rd St., Kattuppakkam, 
Chennai-600056, 
Ph.044-24765320, Cell: 9382339084 





Now a days in human life, we can involve in all the activities, the money is the more 
important. The Thiruvalluvar also quote the importance of wealth in his Thirukkural. i.e. one who 
have all the good qualities and good characters, but if he has no wealth, the society will not give 
a proper response to him. But the people give response and obedience, one who have a good 
wealth. 


In the modern cultural world, so-called wealth like money, jewels and other materials, are 
more important to a man. A true is that a man, even though who is in the old age, edge of the 
life, also having greediness to make the money. 


This article explained through the astrological way, who will get the much money, jewels, 
house, land and vehicle in his life through the best way. 


A Horoscope has 12 bhavas and the 12 bhavas sorted out two parts as 6 odd number bhavas 
and 6 even number bhavas. These two sorts of bhavs play on the one's life and conduct his life 
up to last. In the K.B System, all karakas in the world are divided into two categories. In this, 
the odd numbers bhavas are called “Soul dependent bhava" and the even number bhavas are 
called “Material dependant bhavas”. 


First of all, I wish to explain briefly, which way the soul dependent bhava karakas and 
material dependant bhava karakas, are run the human life. 


Soul dependent bhava Karakas: 

The soul dependent bhava karakas indicate the love, obedience, sharing with other, 
dependent with each other, sharing and understanding the sensitive feeling with other, move 
with other without any material expectation, Love affair with another, good healthy without any 
disease, creates happy situation ever, Understanding with other's love feelings. These karakas 
are not related with economic, so these are called the Sole dependent bhava karakas. 


In the horoscope, one can enjoy peaceful and pleasure full benefits of the sole dependent 
bhava karakas, when the odd number bhavas of 1,3,5,7,9,11, are very strong and powerful. 


If the sole dependent bhavas, (i.e1,3,5,7,9,11,bhavas) are inter-linked with their group 
bhavas, the sole dependent bhava karakas will get strengthened. i.e., 1,3,5,7,9,11 bhava cuspal 
sub lord, inter-linked with its own groups through its star lord and sub lord. The above 
interlinks determines the fate or potential of the soul dependent bhavas. Here the fate 
donates in the beneficiary to the odd number bhavas. Therefore the person will enjoy soul 
dependent bhava karakas up-to his end of the life (if dasa, bhukthi not to oppose the bhavas) 


Material dependent bhava karakas: 
Material dependent means, who is make movement with another with the idea of money, not 


control to others, have not give and take policy, not obey to attraction and feelings, not 
KPEzine_December_2007 Page 15 


interest in the love affairs, always not satisfy in all the matters, competitive, jealousy, gambling, 
greedy sense, and always thinking to earn Gold, material, money, property etc,. 

In a horoscope, Even number bhavas like 2, 4,6,8,10,12 bhavas gets strengthen, that such 
person will be a wealthy person. 


The material dependent karaka will strengthen, while the bhava inter-related with the same 
material dependent bhavas. 


The material dependent bhava , (i.e. 2,4,6,8,10,12 bhavas) are inter-linked with the same 
group bhavas, i.e., 2,4,6,8,10,12 bhava cuspal sub lord, inter-linked with its owngroups through 
its star lord and its sub lord.The above interlinks determines the fate or potential of the 
material dependent bhavas. Here the fate donate in the beneficiary to the even number bhavas. 
There fore the person will enjoy material dependent bhava karakas up-to his end of the life (if 
dasa, bhukthi not to oppose the bhavas) 


I hope that all are understood about the above explained the soul dependent and material 
dependent karaka and I continue this article. 


So, in a horoscope the material dependent bhavas, 2,4,6,10 bhavas, inter-linked with the 
same material dependent bhavas, while such a person economic back-ground will be very good. 
Even though the 8, 12 bhavas also material dependent bhavas, but these will give disturbance to 
the lagna (Native) .So, the 8,12 bhavas will not give such a benefit to the lagna. 


I.e. The 8,12 bhavas are favorable bhavas to the 2,4,6,10 bhavas and at the same time, this 
8,12 bhavas gives unfavorable results to the lagna. So, if the 2,4,6,10 bhavas connected with 
8,12 bhavas, such connection give trouble to the lagna and as well as, the 2,4,6,10, bhava karakas 
also not to give benefit and give disturbance to the lagna. I request the readers to think over it. 


I explain through the K.B.'s important rule to understand more about the above explained 
matters. i.e., a particular bhava cuspal sub-lord (or planet) in the star-lord and its sub-lord 
inter-linked with other bhavas and the inter-linked combination result will be good or bad to the 
particular bhava and at the same time it will give a good or bad result to the other bhavas also.

My travel A KP appraisal 


Effort by : Vijay Kumar 
Senior Manager, C-DOT 
Electronic City, Phase-1 
Hosur Road 
Bangalore - 560 100

This case study analyses my recent travel from Bangalore to Allahabad and back. The travel was 
initiated on Nov 15, 2007 at 0717 Hrs and got concluded when I reached back home on Nov 21, 
2007 at 1434 Hrs IST. This travel program was intended to discuss some important matters 
with someone known to me. 


Since, I had to write for the Dec-2007 issue of KP-ezine, I thought it prudent to write about 
the travel muhurta co-relating the incidents that took place during the journey. By this 
exercise, I wish to bring the importance of KP styled delineation in muhurta charts. 


The chart at the commencement of travel time is produced herewith. 

This write-up is prepared after the travel is made. An effort is made to study the various 
incidents during the travel and stay which does show a strong co-relation with the planetary 
configuration at the time of travel muhurta. 


The chart is being analysed as follows: 
The co- ordinates of judgment 
Ina muhurta chart for travel, we may look into various aspects of travel as follows. 


a. The Lagna signifies the person who travels. Lagna also indicates the focus with which the 

travel is undertaken. 

Moon signifies the purpose of travel. 

The 7™ cusp/house is the final destination of travel. 

The quality of forward travel is signified by the 3" cusp/house. 

The quality of return travel is signified by the 9" cusp/house. 

The person with whom we need to interact at the destination is signified by the 9™ or 1 

cusp/house depending on whether the person is unknown/known one. 

g. The 4 cusp/house indicate the vehicle with which the forward travel is made, while the 10" 
cusp/house signify the same in return journey. 

h. The 6th house from 3/9th cusp/houses indicates the odds/difficulties of the 
forward/return travel as the case may be. Thus, the 8™ cusp indicates the odds for forward 
travel and 2° cusp/house for return travel. 

i. The quality of stay arrangements at the destination may be seen from the 10™ cusp/house 
(4" from 7"). 

j. Dasha and sub-dasha lords during the travel period dictate the events as per their 
significations. For a successful travel, the dasha should be generally favorable while the 
bhukti must be necessarily favorable to realize the fruits of travel and that of ambitions 
for which the travel is made. For finer timing of events, the prana dasha (5™ level of dasha) 
may be looked into which may decide the fructification of events as per its flavor.

The purpose of travel 


Incidentally, the Lagna sub-lord is Moon itself, thus looking from the Moon would indicate the 
focus and purpose of travel. 


Moon falls in the 2™ house indicating the matter connected to my family. Moon falls in the star 
of Venus as 7™ lord placed in 10™ house close to 11 cusp. At stellar level, the matter pertained 
to relationship/marriage (7™ house), my assertions (10 house) and interaction with the known 
set of people (11 house). Moon falls in the sub of Mercury, which is 11th lord placed in 11™ 
house, assuring the fruitfulness of the indications. 


Thus, the focus of travel was aptly clear and it was comfortable to proceed further. 


Analysis of the chart 


Here are the details of the various events and its astrological connection with the muhurta 
chart. 


1. Note the dasha indications. 


For the travel period, the dasha lord is Venus, bhukti lord is Mercury, antara lord is Moon 
and pratyantara lord is Saturn. The period of Venus-Mercury-Moon-Saturn runs between 
Nov 11, 2007 to Nov 24, 2007 and hence covers the entire travel period. 


y Dasha-lord Venus falls close to the 11 cusp. Venus falls in the star of Moon, which 
governs the 7-11th cusps and as lord of 9" house falls in the 2" house. Thus, Dasha- 
lord Venus is largely helpful. 


1% qth 


y Mercury as bhukti lord is a strong lord of 11" house, placed in 11 house. Mercury 
falls in the star of Rahu placed in 3% house, making the journey fruitful to achieve 
the desired purpose. 

y Moon as antara lord is already analysed to signify 10™ house close to 11™ 

useful.

y Pratyantara lord Saturn is the lord of 4 house, placed in 10™ house. Since, Saturn

the discussions at times. Saturn in the star of Venus as 7™ lord placed close to 11™ 
cusp was yet a good indication to discuss matters to sufficient details, if not upto 
full (Saturn). 


y The prana dasha spread within the span of Saturn's pratyantara dasha during the 
travel time are as follows.

2. The forward journey was very comfortable and the gentry around were very co-operative.

y My whole of forward travel was in the prana dasha of Venus, which made it

y Look to the 10™ cusp indicating the place of stay at the destination. 10™ cuspal sub-

purposeful and comfortable. 


y My stay at Allahabad was from the morning of 17-11-2007 to 19-11-2007 afternoon.

On the morning of 18-11-2007, some confusion crept in my booking request for the

On Nov 18, 2007 the prana dasha of Sun was ruling. Sun as 10™ lord (lord of 
accommodation at the destination) was placed in 12 house, causing me to get in 
trouble. However, Sun in the star of Jupiter placed in Lagna helped me to prevail 
upon the officials (lagna) and seek continued staying there comfortably. Venus, as

with strong assertion. 


4. My meeting with the party's side on Nov 17-19, 2007 was very good and fruitful. 


y Note that Lagna indicates me. The 11th cusp indicated the party with whom I was to 
interact. 3™ cusps from my side (Lagna) and 3™ cusp from the 11™ cusp (party's side) 
signified our mutual deliberations. Thus, the 3°-1%' cusps were to be delineated 
signifying our mutual dialogues. 


y Note that Moon was the sub-lord of 1-3" cusps and as discussed earlier, Moon was

Venus prana dasha on 17-11-2007 helped me to initially discuss the matter and come

to be purposeful.

y

Conclusion 


At the time of starting for the travel, the RPs were Saturn-Mars-Venus-Jupiter. 


At the time, when I entered home at 1434 Hrs on 21-11-2007 (Wednesday), the 
Pisces lagna was rising at 10-26 deg with the Moon transiting in Pisces at 19-13 deg. 
The ruling planets at that moment were Saturn-Jupiter-Mercury. 


Out of the RPs (Saturn-Jupiter-Mercury) at the time of entering home, Saturn and 
Jupiter were the same as the RPs at the time of starting the journey, leaving 
Mercury. However, we found that at the time of entering home, Mercury was 
transiting in the Venus sign-Jupiter star-Jupiter sub and since Venus & Jupiter were 
amongst the RPs at the starting of the travel, the Mercury is taken to conform the 
RPs at the starting of travel. 


Thus, a golden principle of KP was proved which states that the planets governing 
the beginning of an event are the same as the one, which end the event. 


Here, the RPs were same when the travel was started and concluded. 


This write-up makes an effort to highlight the role of KP styled delineation applied to muhurta 
charts, where the events unfold as per the dictate of the cuspal/house interlinks and the 
linkage of dasha/sub-dasha lords. 


This exercise furnishes good clues and encourages us to select the muhurtas for various 
purposes as per KP styled delineation.

Music is a divine gift. From the ancient times there has been music, both vocal and instrumental 
practiced, exhibited and imparted training in a scientific way, especially in India. Both carnatic 
and Hindustani versions had versatile singers and instrument players from centuries in its pages. 


In the 20™ Century, Cinema also became a medium in which music has been taking part. 
Astrology is a divine subject through which an attempt has been made to analyze the natal 
horoscope charts and to see whether the chart promises Sangita Vidya or not. 


Late Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti had also advocated astro-combinations for Sangita Vidya. A 
celebrity natal chart has been examined based upon the birth details available that of Late MS 
Subbulakshmi of Carnatic music fame. 


MS SUBBULAKSHMI-- RENOWNED EXPONENT OF CARNATIC MUSIC. 


Late Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi, Bharata Ratna, 
popularly known as M.S (16-Sept-1916 to 11-Dec-2004) was egendary 
Carnatic singer. 


| M.S.Subbulakhsmi was born into a musical family, in the temple town 
rd i of Madurai, situated in the state of Tamil Nadu in South India. M.S. 
| started learning Carnatic music from a very early age and released her 
first recording at the age of 10. Since then, she performed countless 
musical forms in different languages of India. She was the first musician ever to be awarded 
the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor. 





M.S. became famous as a film actress. Her most memorable role was Bhaktha Meera in Meera 
(1945). The movie had M.S. sing the famous Meera bhajans, which continue to enthrall listeners 
till date. 


She travelled to London, New York, Canada, the Far East, and other places as India’s cultural 
ambassador. Her concerts at Carnegie Hall, New York; the UN General Assembly on UN day in 
1966; the Royal Albert Hall, London in 1982; and at the Festival of India in Moscow in 1987 were 
significant milestones in her career. 


She gave the inaugural concert at the India Festival, London in 1982, and has also performed in 
Tokyo, Bangkok, Hong Kong, Manila, Singapore and Malaysia. She introduced Carnatic music to 
the West at the Edinburgh Festival (1963) and at the United Nations (1966). A first-time 
foreign listener once opined, "M.S. does not sing: She makes divinity manifest." 


Mahatma Gandhi was so charmed of her Meera bhajans that he had requested her to sing the 
song Hari Tum haroJ an ki bheer (Lord, please dispel the fear in mankind).

| ntroduction 

Even though there are a number of birth time rectification techniques available in the 
astrological literature, there is no method or technique available to us as of today that can 
guarantee us the accuracy of the reported or rectified birth time. In other words, we still do 
not have any technique, system or method available to us with the help of which we can assure 
ourselves that the birth time that we have received from our clients, friends or relatives is 
indeed correct beyond doubt. Neither do we have any means to ascertain that after the 
laborious exercise of birth time rectification the time that we have arrived at is fully correct 
or not. 

In Dutta (2008), I have provided a very novel, accurate and practically effective 
technique of birth time rectification. Many professional astrologers have given me their valued 
feedback about the efficacy of my method of birth time rectification. However, in this article 
instead of writing on my technique of birth time rectification I will rather elaborate on my Rule 
of Origin and its basic applicability with the help of a few AA rated birth charts. The Rule of 
Origin is a technique devised by me which helps you to know exactly whether the reported birth 
time or the rectified birth time is truly correct or not. Detailed elaborations are found in Dutta 
(2008). 

The ‘Rule of Origin’ 

Elaborate description and numerous examples have been provided on Rule of Origin in 
Dutta (2008). The Rule of Origin is a technique that is based on Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) 
though with certain modifications this technique can be used for ascertaining correctness birth 
time in Vedic astrology. In this article I restrict myself to KP only and show how my Rule of 
Origin is applicable to birth charts that are based on Krishnamurti Paddhati. 

The logic and rationale behind my Rule of Origin is found in the ancient texts of 
astrology. According to the classical tenets of astrology, the birth of a native happens due to 
his past Karma, Purva Punya (good deeds in past life) and the father (who is the giver of the 
Beeja). The mother is only a bearer of the child (Kshetra) but the seed of life comes from the 
father. Thus, the 9™ house of a birth chart shows the ‘origin’ of the native. So, if the given or 
the rectified birth time is truly correct, then the Ascendant/Lagna must be linked with 
the 9°" cusp. 

In my Rule of Origin, the original/rectified birth time is considered to be indeed 
correct, if the following are observed: 

1. The original/rectified Lagna Starlord connected with the 9™ cusp directly. 

2. The original/rectified Lagna sublord is connected with the 9" cusp directly 

3. The original/rectified lagna starlord or sublord is connected with the 9™ cusp 
indirectly. 

This therefore, means that if the lagna cusp star lord or sub lord is linked with the 9" 
cusp sub lord or star lord respectively either ‘directly’ or linked ‘indirectly’ (through a third 
planet) then the birth time is fully correct. For in depth illustrations and examples see Dutta 
(2008).

the users of KP based astrological analysis of natal horoscopes by indicating whether a birth 
time is correct or not. Rule of Origin is applicable in all KP birth charts based on Placidus House 
Division. It is also applicable for birth charts based on Vedic astrology but I will write about it 
in some later article. 

I would like to conclude this article by urging all readers to look up their own charts and 
seek the connection between 1" cusp and the 9™ cusp and find out for themselves whether their 
birth time is truly correct or not. They can also find out the correctness of the reported birth 
time of their clients, friends and relatives by using my Rule of Origin technique. I can assure 
that they will come to know the truth about birth time.

PROMOTION OR RETIREMENT ? 


By: Dr. H.S. Nagi, 
9/43, Punjab agricultural university, 
Ludhiana 
Mb 094177 17910 





One of my colleagues was waiting promotion: it was in the air that she will be promoted to the 
post of principal before retirement. She was also curious and was expecting promotion. But in 
govt. departments everybody knows how file moves. Knowing her eagerness which she pretends 
to hide I asked her horary number between 1 - 249 for astrological calculations. I was also 
eager to know astrologically. 


She gave horary number 108 , I calculated on July 18, 2007, at 8-5 AM, at Ludhiana. If she 
doesn't promoted then her date of retirement was September 30, 2007. knowing this date I 
calculate and my focus was whether she will get promotion before her retirement? 


Rule for promotion 


1- if 10™ cusp sub lord signify 2 or6 or 10 or 11, then one will be promoted. If it is 
retrograde then wait till it become direct. But if it is deposited in star of retrograde 
planet then there will be no promotion. 


Analysis 


In the example chart 10™ cusp sub lord is Venus. Now we have to look does Venus signify 2 or 6 
or 10 or 11 houses? Venus is in star of ketu. Ketu is in 12 th house. Now we should not make 
haste and say here no for promotion. We have to analyse ketu. 


BASIC RAHU/KETU RULES (Compiled by Tin Win) 


1.1. Origin of Rahu/Ketu Rules 
(KP Reader II, 1983, page 315 ) 


Rahu or Ketu will act as a strong agent to the planets to which they are conjoined. If they are 
not conjoined with any planet, then they give the results of the planet which aspects them. Only 
when they are neither conjoined with, nor aspected by any planet, they represent the lord of 
the house. (Uthrakalamrita -- Khanda VI Sloka 14 onwards) 


1.2. Rahu/Ketu Rules by Guruji KSK 
(KP Reader IIT, Old Edition/OE/, Part 1, page 123/New Edition /NE/ page 130; KP Reader V, 
1983, page 123) 


1) Rahu or Kethu indicates the results of planet which it is conjoined: 

2) If no planet in conjunction, the results of planets aspecting it: 

3) If neither conjoined nor aspected, the results of the constellation in which it is deposited; 
4) Lastly the result of the sign in which it is deposited. 

In example chart ketu is in conjunction with moon, Saturn and venus. 


Moon is lord of 11 , it shows gains, by promotion or retirement? Moon is in 12 in star of ketu in 
12. so it will be only after retirement gains. Saturn is in 11 as lord of 5 and 6, but in star of ketu 
in 12. 5-12 retirement. 6-11 gains with delay due to slow nature of Saturn.

FOUR STEP THEORY 
By: Tin Win 


E MAIL: tw853@yahoo.com 





|. INRTODUCTION 


1. With the objective of providing an easy presentation of the Four Step Theory for 
enthusiasts, this study article has been prepared according to the rules and views expressed in 
the currently available references of this theory. 


ll. SIGNIFICATORS 
2. Aplanet signifies the event through the following four steps: 


1) The Planet itself 

2) The Star Lord of the Planet 

3) The Sub Lord of the Planet 

4) The Star Lord of this Sub Lord 


3. The 4th step is an extension of the KP 3 steps on the basis of the ‘Sub Lord Speaks’ articles 
by Shri K.M. Subramaniam. The 3rd and 4th steps are given more importance in using them as 
significators like the first 2 steps. 


4. In each step of the 4 steps, the houses signified by the planet are the house occupied and 
the houses owned by the planet. All the houses indicated in the 4 steps are basically the 
‘secondary’ significators of the ‘main’ planet in the step 1. Out of them the strong or ‘primary’ 
significators are chosen by the basic and special rules, which are crucial in this theory. 


5. ‘Only the primary significators' are considered in this theory and the ‘secondary’ significators 
are ‘not’ taken into consideration. In judging whether an event is promised for the native in life 
and when it can happen, the relevant cusp sub-lord and the DBA lords are considered whether 
they are the primary significators of the required houses under consideration in all the 4 steps. 


lll. PRIMARY SIGNI FICATORS 
I11.1. ‘Basic’ Primary Significators 
6. The ‘basic’ primary significators are chosen according to the following basic rules: 


1) Star Lord, and 
2) Star position. 


[11.1.1. Rule 1 of Star Lord, ie. Planet being a Star Lord 


7. A planet acting as the starlord of another planet, i.e. a planet in the step 2 or 4, is a primary 
significator of the house occupied and the houses owned by this planet, provided they are empty 
(not occupied by Sun to Ketu, without taking into consideration of Fortuna, Uranus, Neptune and

8. In the ‘attached’ example chart 1, the empty houses, ‘1, 2, 6, 8, 11, 12’are to be noted down. 
Sun occupies house 7 and owns house 1. When Sun is the star-lord of Venus in the steps 2 and 4 
of Venus, house 7 is the KP grade ‘A’ significator and house 1 is the grade 'C significator for 
Venus. The grade ‘A’ significator of house 7 is a strong or ‘primary’ significator by Rule 1 in this 
theory. Since house 1 is empty, there is no grade ‘A’ or 'B' significator for house 1, and thus the 
grade 'C' significator becomes a grade ‘A’ significator and consequently a primary significator of 
house 1. 


111.1.2.Rule 2 of Star Position,ie. Planet with no Planet in its Star or Planet in its own 
Star 


9. A planet with no planet in its star or a planet in its own star is the primary significator of the 
house it occupies and the houses it owns, only if the houses are empty. Otherwise the planets in 
the 1st step and 3rd step are the ‘secondary’ significators only, which are not considered in this 
theory. The planets in the 2nd step and 4th step are always the ‘primary’ significators by the 
above Rulel. These houses of the primary significators by Rule 2 are the ‘upgraded’ KP grade ‘B’ 
significators for the planets with no planet in their stars and in their own stars and the 
‘upgraded’ grade 'D' significators, when the relevant houses are empty. 


10. In the example chart '1', the planets with no planet in their stars ‘Mo, Me, Ju, Sa’, are to be 
marked by “+", and the planets in their own stars, 'Ra, Ke’, by “*". All these planets, ‘Mo, Me, Ju, 
Sa, Ra, Ke’, are the ‘primary’ significators in ‘any’ step of the 4 steps. But Venus, having Mars in 
its star, not in its own star, is a primary significator in the 2nd step of Mars only but not in the 
Ist step of Venus and 3rd step of Venus, Sun and Saturn, except being a primary significator of 
6 by the Rule 4 of Conjunction with the Cusp in the point 16. In the ‘attached’ example chart ‘2’, 
Saturn occupies house 5 (KP grade ‘B’ significator) and owns houses 11, 12 (KP grade ‘D' 
significators). Since there is no planet in Saturn star, these grade 'B and 'D' sigificators become 
the grade ‘A’ and 'C' significators respectively, ie. there is no other planet for the grade ‘A’ 
significator of house 5 and for the grade 'C signifcator of houses 11,12. Consequently as 
explained in the point 8, the grade ‘B'significator, upgraded to 'A’ significator of house 5, 
becomes a primary significator, and the grade ‘D'significator, upgraded to 'C’ significator of 
house 12 (empty), becomes a primary significator in the the ist step of Saturn. But house 11 
does not become a primary significator because it is occupied by Moon. 


11. When a planet is in its own star, the house occupied by this planet is the KP significator of 
grade 'B' as well as ‘A’, for instance in the example chart 1, Rahu in its own star, in house 3 
(grade ‘B’) and its star-lord Rahu is also in house 3 (grade 'A’), and so Rahu is a primary 
significator of house 3 in any step of the 4 steps, ie. in the Ist step of Rahu, 2nd step of Sun, 
Rahu, Jupiter and Mercury, 3rd step of Jupiter, and 4th step of Moon, Mars, Jupiter and 
Mercury. Similarly the houses owned by a planet in its own star are the KP significator of grade 
‘D' as well as 'C’ and they become the primary significators when these houses are empty as 
explained above. 


12. The Four Step primary significators are useful in choosing the ‘strong’ significators in KP as 
the primary significators of this theory are equivalent to the KP grade ‘A’ significators. 


111.2. Rule 3 of Primary Significators through Rahu/ Ketu 


13.1. The above two rules (Rule 1 and 2) apply to Rahu/Ketu, which gives the results of the 
conjoined and aspecting planets within the 3d:20m orb, its star-lord and its sign-lord in the 
ascending order. As a practical starting point, the house occupied by Rahu/Ketu, 


KPEzine_December_2007 Page 44 


and the house occupied and the houses owned by its sign-lord are usually taken into 
consideration. Rahu/Ketu's aspect on each other or another planet is not applicable but its 
aspect on the opposite cusp by 7th aspect is considered in this theory. 


13.2. Only if Rahu/Ketu is itself the ‘primary’ significator (as per Rule 1 and 2), then the house 
occupied, the planets in conjunction or aspecting , star-lord and sign-lord also will become the 
‘primary’ significators. If Rahu/ Ketu is itself the ‘secondary’ significator only, then they also 
will be the ‘secondary’ significators even though they are by themselves the ‘primary 
significators. In the example chart ‘1’, since Rahu in its own star is a primary significator in any 
step of the 4 steps by Rule 2, its ‘3 Occupied’, Cnj Ju(3-8, Asp Mo[10-12], Asp 7,9,11, Cnj 3), 
‘Asp 9’, and ‘Sgl Ve(5,12,6) also become the primary significators in lst step of Rahu, 2nd step of 
Sun, Rahu, Jupiter and Mercury, 3rd step of Jupiter and 4th step of Moon, Mars, Jupiter and 
Mercury. In the ‘attached’ example chart ‘2’, Rahu with Moon in its star and not in its own star is 
a primary significator in the steps 2 and 4 only by Rule 1, ie. in the 2nd step of Sunand 4th 
step of Saturn only, ie. "7 Occupied’, ‘Asp by Ju(3-10)’,, ‘Stl Ma(2-9)' and ‘Sgl Me(4) but it is not 
a primary significator in the 1st step of itself Rahu. (R 1, pages 30, 41-42,R2,R5) (RlandR2 
represent the Reference item no. 1 and no. 2 respectively) 


13.3. There is an emphasis to take into consideration of the house occupied and the houses 
owned by the star-lord of Rahu/Ketu when it is the star-lord of another planet, ie. Rahu/Ketu is 
in the step 2 or 4. The house occupied and the houses owned by the star-lord are considered. 
The star-lord gives the stronger results than the sign-lord of Rahu/Ketu. The primary 
significators of the conjoined and aspecting planets are also to be considered when they are 
relevant. The results of the conjoined or aspecting planets or star-lord (when Rahu/Ketu is a 
primary significator) should be given first priority, then the sign-lord cannot give its results. In 
the example chart ‘2’, among the primary significators of Rahu in the 2nd step of Sunand 4th 
step of Saturn, ‘7 Occupied’, ‘Asp by Ju(3,10) and Stl Mo(2,7) are supposed to be stronger than 
‘Sgl Me(4), which is assumed not to give its results in such a case. The ‘star-lord’ of Rahu is 
taken into consideration when it is in the ‘2nd step of Sun and ‘4th’ step of Saturn. But the 
‘star-lord’ of Ketu in the ‘3rd’ step of Mars is not considered because the star-lord is to be 
considered, only if Rahu/Ketu is in the ‘2nd or 4th step’. (R 1, pages 28, 30, 41-42, 61, 77, 79, R 
3.R 14) 


14. Rahu is called as a blemish planet, which creates problems and does not give the results 
effectively to the native when it is in the DBA. If Rahu is a strong significator of the improving 
houses in all 4 steps, which is not found in most cases, then it won't create problems. Ketu does 
not create problems if it is supporting the favorable houses. 


11.3. ‘Additional’ Primary Significators from the KP ‘E’ Grade Significators 


15. The special rules of upgrading the weak KP 'E’ grade significators to the primary 
significators in this theory are as follows: 


1) Conjunction with the Cusps, 

2) Conjunction between the Planets, 
3) Aspect on the Cusps, and 

4) Aspect between the Planets.

this cusp in ‘any’ step of the 4 steps, ‘irrespective of other planets ‘being’ in the house whose 
cusp is conjoined by the planet or the planet ‘not being’ a primary significator. In the case of

11.3.2. Rule 5 of Conjunction of the Planets 


19. If a planet is conjoined with another planet within 3d:20m orb, the planet becomes a 
‘primary’ significator of another planet, only if the original planet itself is a primary significator 
(as per Rule 1 and 2). These two planets (excluding Rahu/Ketu) in conjunction will offer the 
results to each other vice versa. However, in the case of 'Ra/Ke Cnj a planet’, it is only ‘one way’ 
for Rahu/Ketu to offer the results of the conjoined planet as an agent of this planet, and the 
conjoined planet ‘not’ to offer the results of Rahu/Ketu vice versa. Rahu/Ketu is an agent of the 
conjoined and aspecting planets and its sign-lord but it does not act as an agent of its star-lord. 
As an agent, Rahu/Ketu will give whatever the planet is to give but the planet ‘cannot’ offer the 
results of RahuKetu vice versa. (R 1, pages 27-28, 41-42, 51-53, R 5-Part 4 & 5) 


20. In the example chart 1, in the case of ‘Su Cnj Me’, Sun will give the results of Mercury(7-2- 
11, Asp 1, Cnj 7) when Sun is a primary significator in the 2nd and 4th steps of Venus by Rule 1. 
On the other side, Mercury, having no planet in its star, a primary significator in any step of the 
4 steps by Rule 2, will offer the results of Sun(7-1) in the 1st step of Mercury and 3rd steps of 
Mars and Mercury. However, in the case of ‘Ra Cnj Ju, ‘only’ Rahu, in its own star, a primary 
significator by Rule 2, will offer the results of Ju(3-8, Asp Mo[10-12], Asp 7,9,11, Cnj 3) in 1st 
step of Rahu, 2nd step of Sun, Rahu, Jupiter and Mercury, 3rd step of Jupiter and 4th step of 
Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Mercury. On the other side, as per only ‘one way’ of giving results by 
Rahu/Ketu, Jupiter ‘cannot’ give the results of Rahu vice versa although Rahu is an agent of 
Jupiter. 


11.3.3. Rule 6 of Aspect on the Cusps 


21. If a planet throws the Hindu aspects on the cusps (not houses) within the 3d:20m orb, the 
planet becomes a ‘primary’ significator of these houses whose cusps are aspected, only if the 
‘original’ planet itself is a ‘primary’ significator (as per Rule 1 and 2), ‘irrespective’ of other 
planets ‘being’ in these houses. Ketu's 7th aspect on the ‘cusp’ within 30d:20m orb is taken into 
consideration, implying to consider Rahu's similar aspect on the opposite cusp. Nevertheless, 
Rahu/Ketu's aspect on each other or any other planet is not considered. Any aspect of 
Rahu/Ketu is not applicable in KP. (R 1, pages 28, 34, 70, 87, R 14) 


22. In the example chart ‘1’, Jupiter aspects the 7, 9, 11 cusps within 3d:20m. Since Jupiter 
with no planet in its star is a ‘primary’ significator by Rule 2, it becomes a ‘primary’ significator 


KPEzine_December_2007 Page 49 


of the 7, 9, 11 houses by Rule 6. In the example chart ‘2’, Saturn aspects the 2nd cusp only 
within prescribed 3d:20m orb but its aspect on the 7 and 11 cusps are beyond the prescribed 
3d:20m orb. Asa ‘primary’ significator by Rule 2, Saturn with no planet in its star also becomes 
a ‘primary’ significator of the 2nd house by Rule 6 but not 7 and 11 houses. ‘Me Asp 1, Ju Asp 9, 
Ve Asp 12, Ra Asp 9, Ke Asp 3’ are all the ‘7th’ aspects, and consequently at the same time ‘Me 
Cnj 7, Ju Cnj 3, Ve Cnj 6, Ra Cnj 3, Ke Cnj 9°. Thus these planets become the primary 
significators of the opposite houses, ie. ‘Me for 1 & 7 houses; Ju for 3 & 9; Ve for 6 & 12; Ra for 
3 & 9; Ke for 9 & 3’, indicating opposite matters, such as sickness and cure, loss and gain. So 
there is a difference of opinion ‘not to consider’ the ‘7th’ aspect on the cusps or planets and to 
consider ‘conjunction only’. Depending on which option (with or without 7th aspect) is applied, 
the result can be entirely different in some cases; for instance, in the case of the actual 
marriage on 25-12-2005 (Me-Sa-Ve DBA dasa) in a male chart, 09-09-1978, 06:32 AM, 
Belgaum, Karnataka, India, 15N52, 74E30, New KPA 23:28:10, Asc Le 24:38:40, by KPAstro 3.0. 
Mercury Dasa and Saturn Bhukti are justified for marriage. But the Antara lord Venus is 
capable of giving marriage, if ‘Su Asp 7’ by 7th aspect is considered in the 4th step of Venus, 
otherwise marriage is denied by the only primary significatior of the ‘totally negative houses 1, 
12 for marriage in the 4th step of Venus as shown under.

11.3.4. Rule 7 of Aspect between the Planets 


23. If a planet has the Hindu aspect (throwing or receiving) with another planet within the 
prescribed 3d:20m orb, the planet becomes a ‘primary’ significator of another planet, provided 
the ‘original’ planet itself is a ‘primary’ significator (as per Rule 1 and 2). Aspects on each other 
of two planets in the opposite signs are also considered. However, Rahu/Ketu's aspect on each 
other or another planet is not applicable but its 7th aspect on the opposite cusp is considered. 
(R 1, pages 28, 30, 54, 57, 70, 75, R 14) 


24. In the example chart 1, regarding ‘Mo Asp by Ju’, on the side of receiving aspect, Moon with 
no planet in it star, a primary significator by Rule 2, will offer the results of Jupiter(3-8, Asp 
Mo[10-12], Asp 7,9,11, Cnj 3) in any step of the 4 steps, ie. Ist step of Moon. On the other side 
of throwing aspect, Jupiter with no planet in its star, a primary significator by Rule 2, will give 
the results of Moon(10-2) in any step, ie.Ist step of Jupiter. In the case of ‘Ket Asp by Ju’, Ketu 
in its own star, a primary significator by Rule 2, will give the results of Ju(3-8, Asp Mo[10-12], 
Asp 7,9,11, Cnj 3) in Ist step of Ketu, 2nd step of Ketu and Saturn and 4th step of Ketu and 
Rahu. Since there is only ‘one way’ of giving results by Rahu/Ketu, Jupiter ‘cannot’ give the 
results of Ketu vice versa although Ketu is an agent of Jupiter. In the example chart of a male, 
09-04-1958, 04:25 AM, Indore, MP, India, 22N43, 75E50, New KPA 23:11:03, Asc Aq 18:41:01, 
the aspects of Mercury in Aries and Jupiter in Libra on each other by 7th aspect within the 
prescribed orb are to be considered, ie. Mercury giving the results of Jupiter(8-11) and Jupiter 
offering the results of Mercury(2-5), like in the example chart no. 14 in page 56 of R1, where 
Jupiter and Moon aspecting on each other by 7th aspect, Jupiter giving the results of Moon(2, 
etc) and Moon offering the results of Jupiter(8, etc)..

IV. RULING PLANETS 


25. The RPs of only 4 items applied in this theory are in the following order. (R1, pages 2, 32, 34, 
40-42, 81-83, 88, 91,R 2, R 5- Part 5) 


1) Lagna Lord, 

2) Moon's Starlord, 

3) Moon's Sign Lord, and 
4) Day Lord. 


26. The Rahu/Ketu is to be taken as the RPs, only if it ‘directly’ appears in the RPs and not to 
take it while appearing as the ‘agents’ of the RPs. 


27. The ‘main essence’ or ‘advancement’ of this theory is to judge the timing of events without 
the help of the RPs, which are not used in fixing the DBA. The RPs are used ‘only’ to confirm or 
correct the sub-lord of the relevant cusp under consideration before the prediction of a natal 
chart, as if there is some change in the birth time. But the horoscope is not recasted. If the 
sub-lord is among the RPs, it is supposed to be correct. If it does not appear in the RPs, the RP 
(planet), which is ahead or behind the original sub-lord is to be taken as the corrected sub-lord 
of the relevant cusp. The preference is given to the RP as per the above given order of priority, 
if both planets ahead and behind the original sub-lord appear in the RPs. 


28. The RPs will vary from person to person, depending on the place and time of the query 
without giving support or help to everybody at every time. (R1, page 2, R 14) 


29. For the example chart 1, the RPs at the time of judgment, at 22:03:27 PM, TZ (GMT-5) on 
08-10-2007 at Rockville, MD, USA, 39NO5, 77WO9 are as follows: 


1) Lagna Lord = Venus 

2) Moon's Star Lord = Venus 
3) Moon's Star Lord = Sun 
4) Day Lord = Moon 


30. In this example chart 1, for a foreign visit, the 12th cusp sub-lord Moon is in the RPs, and so 
it is supposed to be a correct sub-lord. For a case where the relevant sub-lord is not in the RPs, 
suppose the Day Lord is Mars, then the sub-lord Moon is not in the RPs. So Moon is to be 
corrected to Sun (before Moon) or Mars (after Moon), which are in the RPs, and the preference 
should be given to Sun as per the above given priority order of the RPs. 


V. PROMISE OF AN EVENT 


31. If the sub-lord of the cusp governing the event under consideration is a primary significator 
of any or more of the required ‘positive’ houses (2, 7, 11 and 5, 8 for marriage) in any or more of 
the 4 steps, then the event is promised to happen unless there are only the primary 
significators of totally ‘negative’ houses (1, 6, 10, 12 for marriage) in the ‘more important’ steps 
3 and 4. Whatever it may be or even though there are only the primary significators of the 
totally ‘negative’ houses in the steps 1 and 2, any primary significator of the required ‘positive 
houses or a ‘mixture of positive houses and negative houses in the steps 3 and 4, will give the 
‘positive’ result. The event will not be promised, only if the primary significators of totally 
‘negative houses appear in the steps 3 and 4. A caution is needed in taking ‘12th to any house’ as 
a ‘negative house’ for this house, for instance the 1st house, though 12th to the 2nd, is not held 
as a negative house for 2nd, but considered as a primary house to get money as it represents 


KPEzine_December_2007 Page 51 


the native and his efforts etc; 10th is not considered as a negative house to 11™ but it is not 
applicable in marriage matters. (R1, page 41-42, R 3, R14) 


32. In the example chart 1, the 12th cusp sub-lord is Moon, which is a primary significator of 
the required ‘positive’ houses 12, 3, 7,9, 5 in the steps 1 and 2, and 3, 5, 12, 7, 9 houses in the 
steps 3 and 4. So foreign going is definitely promised. It will be denied, only if Moon is a primary 
significator of totally ‘negative’ houses 2, 8, 11 and 4, 6 in the steps 3 and 4, without any primary 
significator of ‘positive’ houses. Moreover, since Moon is a primary significatot of 11 in the 1st 
step and most importantly 6 and 11 houses in the 3rd step, it is possible for a monetary gain to 
‘some extent’ through foreign visit during the jointly favorable DBA for getting money, even 
though the primary significator of 1, 2, two main houses for getting money, is missing. If the 
12th cuspal sub-lord signifies 2, 3, 6, 10, 11, the fortune and success can be expected in the 
foreign land. 


VI. CHOICE OF DBA 


33. The DBA lords are to be judged by the above same approach in considering when an event 
can happen. The event will fructify only when the DBA lords are jointly the primary significators 
of all the required 3 houses (2, 7, 11 for marriage), signifying at least one different house each. 
Suppose the Dasa lord is the primary significatotr of the house 2 and the Bhukti lord is a 
primary significator of the house 5 or 11, then the Antara lord should be the primary 
significator of the remaining house 7 to make the chain of DBA complete for fructification of 
the event. The event will not materialize, if there are only the primary significators of totally 
‘adverse or negative houses in the ‘more important’ steps 3 and 4 of the DBA lords. (R 1, pages 
31-32, 39, 41-42, 75-76; R 4, R 5- Part5; R 8, R 14) 


34. In fixing the DBA, firstly it is to check whether the running Dasa lord is a primary 
significator of at least one of the required houses (2, 7, 11 for marriage). If it does, then take 
it and repeat the same to check the running Bhukti lord. If it does not, leave this Dasa and go to 
the next Dasa, till finding the Dasa lord, which is a primary significator of any of the required 
houses. Secondly it is to repeat the same to choose a Bhukti lord, which is a primary significator 
of any of the required houses other than already signified by the chosen Dasa lord. Thirdly it is 
to choose the Antara lord, which is a primary significator of the missing house to make the DBA 
chain (2, 7, 11 for marriage) complete. The 3 required houses must be found in the DBA lords. 


35. A fruitful Antara can be chosen out of many primary significators of the required houses as 
given under: (R 1, pages 37-38, 46-47, 68, 80) 


1) the priority is given to (a) the earliest Antara, at the time of question, if the Lagna is ina 
movable sign; (b) the next Antara, if the Lagna is ina fixed sign; and (c) the following Antara of 
the last priority, if the Lagna is in a common sign: 

2) if it is still doubtful, Rahu/Ketu Antara can be chosen, as the nodes are stronger than the 
planets. 

3) When a main house of the required houses (2 for marriage) is primarily signified by a planet 
only, a primary significator of a supportive house (5 or 8 for marriage) can be chosen to make 
the DBA chain complete. 

4) If there is not any planet, which is a primary significator of the required houses, the sub-lord 
of a cusp under consideration (4th in buying a house) can be taken into consideration with giving 
preference to the cusp sub-lord, which is also a primary significator of the required houses (4, 
11, 1 in buying a house). 

5) Another practical way is to choose the Antara, of which lord signifies the required houses in 
the ‘more important or stronger’ steps 3 and 4. (R 14) 


KPEzine_December_2007 Page 52

DBA chain jointly signifying 3, 9, 12 and 5, 7 along with 1, 2,6, 11. A lot of combination of DBA

below from the details attached.

2) Ra/Ke are the primary significators of all houses except 1-2 houses. 

3) Mo/Ju are the primary significators of all houses except 1-2-4 houses. 

4) Ve is the primary significator of 1-2-6-7-11 houses.

VII. TRANSIT 


40. A near timing of event can be fixed by the transits of the DBA lords. Here it is to check 
the star-lord of the fast moving planets (Sun, Mars, Mercury and Venus) and the sub-lord of the 
slow moving planets (Jupiter, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu) in the ‘first 2 steps only’, without taking 
into consideration of the more important steps 3 and 4. The event ‘will fructify’, if these star- 
lord and sub-lord are the primary significators of any or more of the required houses (2, 7, 11 
and 5, 8 for marriage) in the first 2 steps, without taking into consideration of ‘negative houses’. 
The event ‘will not happen’ during the period while the transit does ‘not agree with DBA, ie. if 
there are only the primary significators of the totally negative houses (1, 6, 10, 12 for marriage) 
in the first 2 steps even when the DBA lords are favorable. Moreover, the event will ‘not’ 
materialize while the star-lord or sub-lord, in which the DBA lords are transiting, is ‘in 


KPEzine_December_2007 Page 53 


retrograde’. In such a case, the next transit is to be considered. (R1, pages 49, 52-54, 71-72, 
76-77; R 5-Part 5, R 14) 


41. For the example chart 1, around the planned timing of foreign visit, Nov - Dec 2007: 


1) Dasa lord Saturn (slow moving planet) will be transiting in the Mercury ‘sub’ till 9-11-2007, and 
then in the Venus sub. 

2) Bhukti lord Rahu (slow moving planet) will be transiting in the Jupiter ‘sub’ till 20-11-2007, in 
the Rahu sub till 27-12-2007 and then in the Moon sub. 

3) Antara lord Mercury (fast moving planet) will be transiting in the ‘star’ of Mars till 11-11- 
2007, then in Rahu star till 20-11-2007, Jupiter till 29-11-2007, Saturn till 8-12-2007, Mercury 
till 16-12-2007, Ketu till 24-12-2007, Venus till 02-01-2008. 

4) No star-lord or sub-lord will be in ‘retrograde’ to negate the positive results of favorable 
DBA.

VIII. RETROGRESSION 


44. In this theory, the retrogression is not applied in the horary as well as natal prediction. It 
is used ‘only’ in considering the transits of DBA lords in fixing the near timing of an event. The 
transiting DBA lords should not be in the relevant sub and star of retrograde planets for the 
materialization of an event. (R1, pages 54, 75, R 14) 


IX. URANUS, NEPTUNE AND PLUTO 


45. These three planets are also taken into consideration to avoid the mistakes in prediction. In 
an example chart of a sports match (R1, page 63-64), Mars aspecting Pluto within the 3d:20m 
orb gives the result of Pluto, unexpectedly loosing the match, reversing Mars’ primary 
signification of winning houses 1,6. In an example chart of child birth (R 6), the prediction of 
child sex is reversed due to the conjunction of the star-lord of the 5th cuspal sub-lord Jupiter 
with Neptune in retrograde. However, the negative affects of Neptune and Pluto are not yet 
conclusive. Pluto was found no more a planet in 2006. Moreover, to make or break a rule, a study 
or one's experience of ‘at least’ 100 cases with around 70-75% favorable results is supposed to 
be a standard requirement.

By: Prof. Vaikari Ramamurthy 
Plot No: 10, D.No 2/1088, 11°" Cross Street, 
Radha Nagar, Perum Bukkam, 
Medavakkam 
Chennai - 600100 
Phone: 044 22771543 Mobile: 09444270514 





A Quarry has been raised to predict the time of publication of a book by giving a Horary No: 222( 1 To 
249) to be solved through KP Horary Principles. 


The Quarry was taken up to judgment up to 21/10/2007 Sunday at 11.55 AM, at Chennai. 


Analysis 
Book & publication are comes under the preview of house 3 i.e. 3 bhava which tells about writing, 
contacts, communication etc. 3' house also memory and thinking. The planet mercury is a karaka planet 
for writing speech & imagination. 


11 cusp indicate success and fulfillment of desires etc. so, mainly the cuspal sublord of 3" should be 
signifies the houses 3" and 11™ or lord of 3 & 11™ also should be well placed in a chart then only he will 
be able to write or publish a book successfully. 9 which stand for higher education, deep knowledge 
and research study also should be examined for writing and publishing a book. 6™ cusp indicate success 
in the attempts. 


In the above example horary chart, the sublord of 3" cusp is Ketu. Ketu is in 6™ bhava and signifies 6™ 
bhava. Ketu is in the sub of Saturn as lord of 1,12 and in 6" cusp. The sublord of 3" cusp ketu though 
not clearly indicate 3™ cusp, we shall also discuss sub sublord of 3™ cusp. It is Mercury. Mercury is 
karka planet of writing & speaking etc. Mercury in 8 as lord of 5™ indicates some initial delay and 
obstacles but as mercury is in the sub of Jup a full significatore of 11™ bhava is good. Mer indicates 
Astrology so the subject may be connected to astrology or occult science. 12™ cusp indicates occult 
Science. 


The lord of 3™ bhava is Mars. No planet in 3" thus mars signifies 3" bhava.the 11 cusp sublord Rahu in 
the sub of jup. A significatore of 11 and 10. The lord of 11™ (fulfillment of desires) is Jup, Jup A 
significatore of 11 & 10 is good. So, I come to the conclusion that the queerest will be able to write and 
publish a book. The subject may be connected to occult science, Astrology etc. 

WHEN: 
Significtore of 3"? and 11™ ( By star) are Moon, Sun, Mars and Jupiter. 
Significtore of 3 and 11™ (by sub lord) are Ven, Rah, Moon. 
No planet in Sun, Moon, Jup, Ven star. 
At the time of Judgment then ruling planets are Jup, Ven, mars, Sat and Rahu, common ruling planets 
are Mars, Jupiter, Venus, and Rahu. Venus lagna Star is a strong R.P. 


At the time of judgment, Mars dasa Jup Bhukti operates till 11/06/2008, both Mars and Jup are good, 
so before this period the queerest will be able to publish a book.

How to predict horoscope 
Through K.B system-4 


By: A. Devaraj (Jyothish Kalaa Rathna ) 
Sri Bruhaspati K.B. Jyothish Training School, 
No, 68. P.G. Avenue, 3rd St., Kattuppakkam, 
Chennai-600056, Ph.044-24765320, Cell: 9382339084 





We will get more experience, when try to analyze a chart by the 
way of various angles and we will become an expert to predict in horoscope, while we applied the 
previous experience in the various chart. So, I analyzed the chart of my best friend, Mr. 
sivadhasan Ravi who expert in the Nadi astrology, by the way of so many angles and wish to 
share my experienced result with the readers. 

Mr. Sivadhasan Ravi's chart is calculated in the K.B. method and given below. Further, the 12 
bhavas and 9 planets interlinks tables are given here to the readers, to understand easily. 
Now, we try to analize the chart according the base of the various questions. 


1. How is the Health? 


Lagna bhava sub lord is Saturn. Saturn is in the Kethu star and Venus sub lord. Kethu 
is the sub lord of 3, 9 bhavas. Venus is the 11 bhava sub lord. Moreover, the Lagna sub lord 
Saturn is the sub lord of 4, 7,10th bhava also. 


Here the Saturn's sub lord is having favorable bhavas (Venus 11") to its star lord (i.e3 and 9™ 
bhavas). So, the 3, 9 bhavas gets strengthen and make weaken the Saturn's 4 and 10 bhavas. 
So, the lagna bhava strongly inter-linked with the 3, 7, 9 and 11 bhavas. The above indicates 
bahvas are good to the lagna bhavas and gives good health to the lagna. So, his physical body, 
mostly, is in the healthy condition. So, the lagna bhava Fate supports to be a healthy physical

Recovery from sickness A KP appraisal 


Effort by Vijay Kumar 


Senior Manager, C-DOT 
Electronic City, Phase-1 
Hosur Road 
Bangalore - 560 100 
080-25119580 (Off), 26587463 (Res)

This case study analyses my daughter's sickness who was down with viral fever recently. On the third 
day of the sickness when the condition was worsening, I had the anxiety to find out with the question 
“When will my daughter recover from fever?" 


In pursuance of the above, a prashna chart was casted on Dec 15, 2007 at 18-41-57 Hrs at Bangalore. 
Since, the query was related to my daughter, the chart was rotated to 5™ house. 


The rotated chart is produced herewith. 
The chart is being analysed as follows: 
The co- ordinates of judgment 


In reference to the patient, treatment, recovery and the doctor, there are some houses that 
become important for the patient as follows. 


a. The patient and his scope of longevity is indicated by lagna and in case if the dangers are 
seen ahead, the 8-3H of longevity need be examined vis-a-vis the 2-7H (maraka houses) with 
badhaka connection. 

b. While, the diagnosis of the disease requires the scrutiny of 6H, the 8th house sees the 
possibilities of the complications. 

c. The recovery is judged by the scrutiny of 5H, whereas the 11H could be assessed for the 
discharge from the hospital. 

d. On the side of doctor, the 7H indicate the attending doctor. The professional competence 
of the doctor is assessed by the 4H (10 from 7™) whereas the doctor's prescriptions are 
represented by 9H (3 from 7"). 

e. The mutual disposition of Lagna and 7™ cusp decide about the manner in which the patient- 
doctor interaction would sail. 

f. The disposition of 7" sub-lord decides about the usefulness of the doctor for the patient. 

If the doctor is able to give cure to the patient, 7™ sub-lord must have some link with the 
5-11H. 
If the patient has to suffer in the hands of the doctor, the 7™ sub-lord must find link with 
the 6-8H. If the patient has to succumb to the prescriptions of treatment process, the 9™ 
sub-lord (3 from 7™) must find linkage to the maraka houses such as 2-7-12™ houses 
having connection with badhaka-lord. 

g. Dasha, sub-dasha and finer periods lords during the disease dictate the events as per their 
significations.

The query 


Look for the Moon, which gets placed in 5™ house, indicating my worries about her recovery. 
Since, Moon falls in the 8™ cusp, the apprehension of the fever getting chronic was looking as a 
possibility because of her being in critical condition. My worries on this account were aptly 
indicated by the position of Moon. 


The query was reasonably indicating my anxiety, thus it was safe to proceed ahead. 


Analysis of the chart 


The chart is analysed as follows. 


1. 


Lagna sub-lord Rahu falls in the 5™ house showing the possibility of recovery. Rahu falls in 
its own star, thus it confirms the signification of the 5™ house strongly. 


Both 3™ and 9 cuspal sub-lord are Saturn and since, Venus as Saturn's star lord gets placed 
in lagna, there was no threat of longevity. 


The disease takes shape when the 6™ cusp connects to the lagna and disease gets 
complicated, if 8 house gets connected thereby. 


6™ cuspal sub-lord Saturn falls in the star of Venus that as 8™ lord falls in Lagna, thus 
connecting Lagna - 6™ and 8™ houses. As Saturn does not have any planet in its star, it is 
strong and its placement in 11™ house indicated delayed cure and its conjunction with Ketu 
indicated complications in achieving cure. 


Thus, the disease looked to be complicated and indicated late recovery. 


Look at the 11™ cuspal sub-lord Moon that again is a strong planet, as there is no planet in its 
star. Because of Moon being a fast planet and placed in 5™ house, it suggested a fast 
recovery. This seemed in contradiction to the late recovery as indicated in #2 above. 


Jupiter was the cuspal sub-lord of the 7™ cusp (doctors), which as 3" and 6™ lord was 
placed in 2"° house in the star of Ketu placed in 11 house. Thus, the doctors were not to 
boost the courage of the patient for recovery (2"% house negated 3" house indicating the 
courage of the disease fighting capacity of the patient) and were not helpful to her. 


Moon is well placed in 5 house and also lords as the 11™ cuspal sub-lord. Thus, it was 
anticipated that the day when the Moon transits in Rohini star (Venus sign and Moon star), 
the full recovery could be possible, as Venus gets placed in lagna supports health and Moon 
supports as stated above. 


The sookshma dasha was also checked and Mars-Moon-Sat-Moon was found to run from Dec 
20, 2007 till Dec 23, 2007. Within this period, Moon was to transit the Rohini star on Dec 
22, 2007. 


Thus, Dec 22, 2007 was fixed as the target date for the patient's recovery. 


The facts of the case 


KPEzine January 2008 Page 24 


1. The patient was taken to the emergency ward of hospital on the late evening of Dec 14, 
2007 but the doctors were not able to reach any conclusion and said to watch for some time 
and prescribed the palliative doses of crocin. 


On Dec 14, 2007, Moon was transiting in the sravana star lorded by Moon itself. Since, Moon 
is placed in the star of retro Mars placed in 9™ house, that was sufficient to suggest that 


the doctors (7H) were not able to diagnose the problem (retro Mars in 9H). 


2. After returning from the hospital, the patient started her own treatment (note that the 
patient is himself a doctor). 


The 5th cusp whose sub-lord is Venus represents the recovery. Note that Venus falls in the 
star of Rahu (the Lagna sub-lord), perhaps suggesting that the patient himself may be useful 
to herself for recovery. Rahu's placement in the 5™ house, further affirms it. 


3. The fever took the shape of malaria, remained very unstable and caused a lot of weakness. 


4. The patient recovered after struggling with fever for about 10 days and got fully cured on 
Dec 21, 2007 without any complication. She took bath on Dec 22, 2007 and got fit for work.

Short life: An example chart 


By: DR.H.S.NAGI, 
9/43, PUN) AB AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY 
LUDHIANA. 
MB. 09417717910 





Rule 
1- For long life, Ascendant sub lord should signify houses 1-3-5-8-10 


2- For short life Ascendant sub lord should be connected 2-7 and badhak stan (for common 
sign 7™, for moveable signs 11" and for fixed signs 9 house is badhak stan. ) 


3- The badhaka houses are houses that are harmful to life, and badhaka houses are considered 
to be more harmful for life than maraka houses. The badhaka houses are the 11th for those 
born in Cardinal (moveable) signs, the 9th for those born in fixed signs, and the 7th for those 
born in Mutable (dual) signs. 


4- For death, first consider the badhaka houses, and then the maraka houses as 
dangerous times for the native, as there is danger to life during the joint period (dasha/bhukti) 
of the significators of the badhaka and maraka houses, whose lords respectively are Ju/Ve. The 
chart significators for the 7™ are Jupiter, Rahu and Sun. Chart significators for the 2" are 
Me/Ve/Ra/Ju/Ma/Su/Sa. 


Analyses 


When assessing death ina KP chart and according to KP dictum, the first consideration is the 
badhaka, followed secondly by marakas. Bahkahasthana and marakasthanas for Virgo lagna are 
7 2" and 7™ respectively: badhaka/maraka Jupiter, in addition to maraka Venus. Her natal 7" 
falls in the star and sub of bhukti lord, Mercury (who is sub lord of lagna) and in the sub sub of 
natural lord of death, Saturn. 


Here in this chart ascendant falls in Virgo, common sign, so 7™ house is badhak to this sign. It 
falls under mercury-moon and mercury. 


Sub lord of ascendant is mercury. 

Know we have to see what signification mercury holds. Mercury is lord of 1-10, in rapt 
conjunction with 2 H. this shows the native will live life of status. But mercury has mars in its

Second Marriage 


By: G.Subramanian 
19, West Road 
West C.I.T.Nagar 
Chennai 





Marriage is an important landmark in the life of an individual. But unfortunately, in some cases the 
first marriage gets annulled on account of divorce or the death of the first wife and the 
concerned person goes in for a second marriage. I am presenting a study of one such case for the 
benefit of the readers. 


Attached herewith is the horoscope of the gentleman who married a second time after the demise 
of his first wife after prolonged illness. 


The rules laid down in K.P for second marriage are set out below: 


Rule- 1( as given in Reader VI) 
Second marriage is indicated if the following two conditions are simultaneously satisfied: 
1) The sub- lord of the 7th cusp is deposited in a dual sign or in the constellation of a planet 
in or owning a dual sign or if the sub- lord of the cusp is Mercury. ) 
li) The sub- lord of the 7th cusp is also a significator of either of the housed 2 or 11. 
If any of the above two conditions is not satisfied, then second marriage is denied. 


As per K.P. the dual signs are Gemini, Sagittarius and Pisces only. Our editor Kanak Bossmia has 
undertaken a thorough research on this particular question and has arrived at the result that 
Jupiter, a planet owning two dual houses can also be considered along with Mercury for the above 
rule. 


Rule- 2 (as per Reader | V) 
J) ust as we judge the first marriage by looking into the 7th cusp, second marriage is to be 
predicted from an analysis of the 2nd cusp. If the sub- lord of the 2nd cusp is connected in 
any manner to the seventh, then second marriage in that particular case is a certainty. 


Rule- 3 
As stated already our respected Editor has researched into the question of multiple marriages 
by studying a large number of charts and has given his findings elaborately in his messages in 
the KPsystem group. His view is that the second wife may also be considered as the sister of 
the first wife and so second marriage is indicated if the sub- lord of the 9th cusp is a signif icator 
of 2 or 9 or 11. 


Let us now proceed to study the above case to see how far the above rules hold good in this case. 
The seventh sub-lord, MARS, is not a dual planet by itself and it is not also posited ina dual sign. 
Its starlord, Rahu is also not ina dual sign. Hence rule 1 fails in this case. 


Let us examine the sublord of the 2nd cusp. It is Rahu. Rahu is in 8, its starlord Mars is in 4, lord 
of 5 and 6 and its sublord is Kethu in 2. Even if we take Rahu as representing its signlord, Saturn, 
the houses signified by Satrun are 3,8 and 9. It is thus evident that the sublord of the 2nd cusp in 
not connected to 7 in any manner. Thus as per this rule also, there is no second marriage to the 
native.

Then how is it that the second marriage took place? 


It is in this crucial context that the principle enunciated by Shr.Kanak comes to our rescue 

The sub-lord of the 9th cusp is Kethu. Kethu is in 2 and therefore becomes a strong significator 
of the house. If we proceed on the basis that Kethu represents its signlord Sun, Sun is in the 11th 
another eligible house. Thus the third rule based on Kanak's experience is fully substantiated in 
this case. 


This example moreover stresses the need for examining cases on the basis of all the three rules 
instead of arriving at our prediction relying on one rule only. 


Another interesting offshoot of this horoscope is that the lady who married this gentleman has 
obviouly married a widower. What are the rules for marrying a widow/widower? This will be dealt 


with in a subsequent article citing some examples. 


IT am extremely thankful to Shri.Kanak for providing some space in his esteemed KPEzine for this 
article.

Dear all Readers, 


This is FIRST ANNUAL ISSUE OF KP Ezine. We have 
completed one year with the co-operation of readers, authors, friends 
and specially those who helps us from behind the curtains, A dvisory 
board member Sri Raichur ji, Sri Tin Win ji, Software support by Sri 
Rangarajan Krishnamoorty, spelling and grammatical checking of 
article by sri Hasmukhbhai Mehta and Sri Vishwanath Nair. | am 
very thankful from the bottom of my heart to all of them. Now 
number of K PEzine readers touched nearly 900 and hope to see the 
readers up to 1000 very soon. 

Why | started this magazine? We found many literatures in 
Krishnamutry system but | found mostly Prediction-come-true type 
articles published. | always wanted to read some educative articles, 
but they are in very low in numbers. So | thought of starting the 
magazine on KP but didn’t want to publish Prediction- come true- 
type articles. It is very difficult in getting educative articles and not 
good for commercial way, but | don’t want to start any commercial 
magazine, and there is no purpose to earn money through this 
magazine, or anyhow no hidden intention to earn money from this 
magazine. So | discussed with some of my near and dear and after 
some months of discussions, | decided to start E-magazine, and for 
that | needed first a website. So | started the website and after 
launching web in December 2006, | stared K PEzZine WROLD’S FIRST 
ELECTRONIC MAGAZINE ON KRISHNAMUTRY SYSTEM on 
February 2007. | wish to thank Sri Kuppu Ganpati- Delhi, Sri, 
A.R.Raichur - Mumbai, Sri Tin Win - USA, Sri Rangarajan 
K rishnamoorty- Chennai to encourage me and help in to start this 
magazine. AS we know now | am successful in my thinking and 
getting educative articles, and | want to give you assurance that in 
futurel will try to select only and only educative articles only. 

The authors, whose article rejected, please do not take it 
personally; This is only due to not finding the articles in compliance 
with publishing criteria of K PEzZineor K P System by advisory board. 
When we wrote any article we thought we have done great job, but 
we have to accept decision of advisory board, and take it in the right 
Spirit. 

Now Old issue of K PEzine will available on CD only. From 
February to December 2007 and price is Rs 500 + Postage 50 Rs. Total 
550Rs in India, For foreign country price is US $50 +Postage( By Reg. 
post) US $5 Total 55 US $. Separate issue for 2007 not available now. 

Form 2008 J anuary, Old issue price will be Rs 100 per issue.

Leukemia and Stem Cell Donation 


By: Ilona Hellmann 


HellmannC200 @t-online.de 





Woman, 30.1.1961, 3:05 AM, (GMT +1), 7E50, 50N26, Germany 
AC 2°23 Scorpio, New KP Ayanamsha 23:13:25 


Her ascendant sublord Rahu and 6th cusp sublord Venus signifying Badhaka, Maraka 12th house have 
proved to be very difficult for her health and this woman was subjected to acute meningitis already 
shortly before the age of two. Until now she experienced several dangerous diseases including also 
blood poisoning in her Ketu-Rahu DB period. 


This woman developed acute leukemia some time after a breast cancer treatment. She had to undergo 
two bone marrow stem cell donations to save her life. The first unsuccessful one took place on 6th 
December 1999 and the second happened on 30th May 2001. Miraculously the woman is still alive thanks 
to her ascendant sublord Rahu's signification of 1,5,11 on the other side. 


I will now try to explain some astrological reasons for both, the failed and for the lucky stem cell 
donation. 


We have to concentrate strongly on the 3rd house in this topic because this natural house of 
communication rules also our body's energy depending on the exchange with disease causing agents. 


The 3rd house rules power and immunity. Stem cell donations can only be successful if a person's 
immunity is nearly completely driven down before the cure starts because otherwise a body will as soon 
as possible try to reject the donated stem cells. The body's own bone marrow must be destroyed with 
X-rays and chemotherapy during a difficult procedure of several weeks or months. 


Bone marrow can be found especially in the vertebrae, shoulders, hips and thighs. It is astrologically 
represented by Capricorn, Saturn, the 10th house, Mars (red blood cells) and also by Jupiter (growth of 
cells), Moon and Venus. For my observation bone marrow is well represented by the Mars star 
Dhanishta. 


The connection of the 3rd house of energies with the above mentioned astrological symbols for bone 
marrow can be clearly discovered in this example chart. The 3rd cusp expands between 14°39 Capricorn 


and 23°54 Aquarius including completely Dhanistha star. 


Running DBAS on 6th December 1999: Mercury- J upiter- Mars- Ketu. 
(unsuccessful first bone marrow stem cell donation) 


A fruitful planetary combination should activate the houses 1,3,5 and 11. 


For my opinion also the 2nd and the 4th house could play a role in the sense to balance the loss of 
immunity and its further regain.

FATE CANNOT BE ALTERED 


By K.S.V.Ramani 
E-mail: kadavasalramani@gmail.com 





In this Article, I have analysed a chart of my friend's second son, Mr.Sundar, strictly 
under K.P.Rules. 


In early 1996 my friend and father of the native approached me to find out the 
marriage prospects of his son and he was anxious to know whether it would be 
materialised in the nearest future. He was much worried about his son of of 28 years 
age with good personality, well settled and with sound financial back ground but no 
suitable alliance is forthcoming. I too know his son personally and I was also wondering 
about the delay in the settlement of marriage. I prepared a fresh chart under 
K.P.system from the traditional one brought by him, which is given below. 


After examining the chart, I found that marriage is promised, as 7" CSL is Kethu. who 
is in the star of Moon at 7.But the Bhukthi of Saturn, which is to commence shortly 
tends to delay the event. Dasa lord Jupiter is also in the sub of Saturn, planet of delay. 
7 Bhava and Moon therein is aspected by Saturn by 10™ aspect (Hindu Asp.) Further I 
noticed that the boy is prone to some vehicle accident during the Bhukthi period of Satn. 
because Saturn is Strong significator for 8™ house, house of accident, danger and 
difficulties. Again Saturn is in the sub of Venus, Karaka for vehicle, attained Strong 
signification for IVth , VIIIth & XIIth cusps, having no other planet in its 3 stars and is 
posited in 12™ strongly. 12" is for hospitalisation. Saturn has square aspect on him 
too.All these planetary position made me puzzeled. According to me, Saturn sookshma 
period upto Novr. 1996 in Sat. Bhukthi will be crucial period for accident. Marriage may 
not take place before 22/12/1998 i.e.till the end of Saturn Bhukthi. Due to PP Dosha, 
Saturn will allow only such planetary period which is connected to him. As marriage is 
not likely to be delayed beyond the reasonable period of age, I felt that the Mercury 
Bhukthi will offer the marriage because it is the earliest period of planet, connected to 
Saturn, (i) Merc. being aspected by Saturn by 3™ asp. (ii) Merc. in the sub of Moon at 7, 
who is also aspected by Saturn. 


I informed my friend that the marriage of his son is promised, but with dealy and he 
has to wait till the beginning of 1999 for the arrival of Mercury Bhukthi, as present 
Saturn. Bhukthi is not very favourable. I also told him that his son is prone to accident 
during the Saturn Bhukthi and asked him to advice his son to be catreful in vehicle 
driving during this Satn.Bhukthi period, to avoid any possible accidents, I cautioned the 
boy also, when I met him latrer and advised him to take care while riding a vehicle to 
avoid accident. The father told me that he had consulted 2 or 3 professional astrologers, 
who had not told him anything about the accident affair. It seems that both the father 
& son took my advice very casually & did not bother much on my advise reg. accident 
matter, as noticed from the subsequent events that had happened which is narrated 
here.

Which planet to propitiate? 


By: Vijay Kumar 
Senior Manager, C-DOT 
Electronic City, Phase-1 
Hosur Road
