The Horoscope of Jyothish Marthand 
Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti 


Prof. Vaikarai Ramamurthy 





Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti, founder of K.P System, was born on I-!1-1908 at Thiru Vaiyaru near Tanjore in Tamil 
Nadu (10-48 N-Lat/79-15E long) at 12:11 PM IST and STD time at Birth was 14 hrs 38mts 36 sec. The Nirayana 
chart of Sri Prof. K.S.K. is also attached in the next page. 


Prof. Krishnamurti was fascinated by the divine science of Astrology. He studied the Hindu and western system 
of Astrology thoroughly, but as deeply disappointed at the inadequacy and lack of accurate predictions. He noticed 
that a planet in its period invoked the results of a house with which it is not connected by occupation, ownership 
association or aspect, which are the ordinary considerations in the art of prediction. 


This opened his eyes to the supreme importance of constellation in predictions. Prof. K.S.K. understood that the 
difference should be attributed to the exact portion the constellation occupied by the tenanting planet, the con- 
stellation had to be divided in some significant, scientific manner. The idea of dividing the constellations in the 
mysterious un-equal Vimshottari proportion attributed to sage Parasara struck him. Prof. K.S.K. succeeded again 
in establishing through his researches that the manner (favourable or adverse) in which house results are invoked 
by a planet is dictated by the lord of the division of the constellation in which the planet is posited (whom be 
calls as Sub Lord) according to the occupation ownership etc of the latter (SUBLORD) 


Prof: K.S.K. noticed the problem arose in the case of twin births. One of the twins gets married and other remains 
unmarried, why one has children and the other has none in spite of the planets remaining to be in the same 
degree and minute and in the same Bhava, same Navamsa, same Ashjavanga having same shad bale and everything 
remain same. Then Prof. K.S.K. found that it is the cusp of |2 Bhava which varies in twin birth and therefore it is 
the cusp which should indicate whether that house matters will prosper or that house matter will suffer. Sup- 
posing the 5th cusp in one falls in such a sub, the lord or which denies birth of children by signifying the matters 
of houses |,4 and 10. Then he has no child. Every chart indicates significators. Significators indicate times. If 
the CUSP denies, the significators can not give the result. So the CUSPAL SUBLORD is vital. 


Prof. K.S.K’s theory of that the planets co-ruling the moment when a matter is taken up for examination with 
real urge, wile co-rule the moment of fructification of the matter as well is immensely help full in pinpointing the 
tine of events. This is called the ruling planets theory, which will also help the subs of house CUSPS can be fixed 
accurately. Ruling planets completed with events are considerable as an excellent method of rectification of birth 
time. 


Prof. K.S.K.’s zeal to spread the real through of Astrology has eaten him up completely. Prof. K.S.K. served hu- 
manity (God in the world) through astrology and rose the highest heights of predictive power (siddti by such serv- 
ice) 


Now let us discuss the important combinations by making him,as a GRET Astrologer and discovering a scientific 
system as K.P. System and as to how his cuspal Sub Lord theory finds a place in his birth chart for the benefit of 
the esteemed readers of K.PE- Zine

What is KP Muhurat & 


How to Calculate 
Kanak Bosmia 





Se ie 


Generally in our society we start every good work in good Muhurta and we care much about it. 


In Traditional Muhuart there are five main Pillars (Points to be considered), |) Tithi (Hindu Date) 2) Vaar (Day) 
3) Nakshtra (constellation) 4) Yoga and 5) Karana. 


On a special day and time when the above five pillars are agreeable beneficially, we start our good work. In 
addition to these five pillars, we also check for Lagna, Moon, Sun and Jup, etc. 


We start certain work only in some special Tithi, and for some work we never select some Nakshatra. 


For example, Traditionally Pushya Nakshatra is considered very auspicious to start any work but it is never con- 
sidered for marriage purpose because of the reason that lord Rama was married on pushya Nakshatra day and 
he never had a good peaceful married life.At the time of his Rajyabhishek, he was sent to exile for |4 Years with 
his wife. At the time of birth of his sons also his wife suffered a lot.When it was time to enjoy life with his wife 
(After becoming the King), his wife had to undergo Agni-Pariksha. 


In Muhurata chart generally Astama Chandra is avoided. In addition there are some parihars Suggested by our 
Sages to neutralize the malefic effect of the planets. So as per them, even Astama Chandra can also be consid- 
ered. 


There are many rules and so many books are available on Vedic Muhurata. 

Inl996/1997, | started studying Vedic Muhurata in one of reputed school of astrology and tried to learn on 
Muhurata. During my learning | found many contradictory rules and | never found any good satisfactory answer 
for my questions. 


When first time my friend and very good Vedic astrologer Mr. Madhu Nair of Trivandrum insisted me to predict 
about discovery shuttle and when | started to analyze Discovery chart, | felt that KP muhuart is very easy and 
perfect. Without any complicated rules and parihars it works very well. We do not need to follow many rules. 
There is nothing written in KP readers about Muhurata.After some success | fixed some rules for my Muhurata 
works, and now by this Article | am going to share my findings and experiences with you through this Article. 


What is Muhurata Time? 


An auspicious time to start any event is a Muhurata. The chart for that special moment is MUHURATA CHART. 
Here it should be clearly understood that WE HAVE TO TAKE THE MOMENT OF STARTING, WE 
SHOULD NOT BOTHERWHENTHE EVENT GETS FINISHED.We take only the time when the event 
start. 


Rules for KP Muhurat 
|) Retrograde Planets: 


There is no Room for retrograde Planets in muhuart. |! totally agree with Dr. Keshab Ranjan Kar that Retrograde 
planet is not actually retrograde but it is our Drashti Bhram, so | never consider retrograde planet in any of my 


work, natal, Horay or Muhurat. 


2) Role of node in KP Muhurat .

How to Calculate 
Kanak Bosmia 





In KP Muhurat .Node is very important.When we found Node as a sub lord of relevant bhava, analyze node very 
carefully as detail given bellow: 


A) If any planet is Conjoint with Node, Node gives first the result of conjoint planet, secondly give result of star 
lord and last sub lord. 


B) If any planet is not conjoint with Node check for aspected planet to node. Here we have to look only special 
aspect, i.e Mars 4,8, Jup 5,9 and sat 3,10.VWhen we check any planet’s 7th aspect means that planet conjoint with 
other node, so we do not consider /th aspect. In KP muhurat we have to consider only Hindu rasi to rasi aspect. 
If any planet aspect on Node, Node gives first result of aspecting planet, secondly give result of star lord and 
last sublord. 


C) If any planet not conjoint with node or not aspect on Node gives result of Star lord, then sub lord and lastly 
sign lord. 


If we found condition (A) fulfill we do not try to look for condition “B” or “C”, if we found condition “B” then 
we do not try to look condition “A” or “C”, if we do not find condition “A” or “B” then only we consider con- 
dition “C”’. 


2) Relevant Bhava: 

In KP Muhurat, we consider House grouping as given in KP literature. For example if we are looking for marriage 
muhurat we will check 2,7,,1 1 bhava and Main bhava is 7th.We try to fix time when /th Sublord strongly signfies 
2,/7,1 | and not |,6,10. 


lf we try to fix muhurat for advertisement we will check 3,9,1 1 but main bhava is | Ith. In this muhurat we try 
to fix time when | Ith sublord signifies 3.9.1 I. 


Like this we have to fix time when Relevant bhava’s main sublord signifies goup of bhava. In practical example | 
will discuss this subject in details. 


3) Special Importance given to | |th cusp sublord. 

When we fix any Muhurat as per rules in 2nd we will try to check | Ith sublord too. If | |th sublord signifies the 
relevant house grouping, that is better. For example, while we are looking for marriage Muhurat, if | 1th sublord 
also signifies 2,7,1 1, that is very good. 


4) Runing dasa: 
It is must be that running dasa, Bhukti Anatara and sooksma also signfy relavant hous grouping.for example in case 
of marriage muhurat dasanath, Bhuktinath, Antra nath and sooksmanath also must signify 2,7,| I. 


5) Selection of Lagna: 

This last rule is very important in KP muhurat. In my practice | found that if Asc sublord of Muhurat chart indicates 
short life, even other factors are good and strong the event used to end within a short time. One of my friend 
joined a job in USA , at that time | am working on this KP Muhurat theory, so | asked him the time, date and place 
of joining job. When | checked the chart | found Muhurat chart of joining Job indicated Balrishtha, so | told him 
that he would be fired from this job within a short period, and actually he was fired form that job, | will discuss 
this case in details in the practical examples. 


This case is very important and eye opener for me.And | come to conclusion that in KP muhurat chart life of 
event must show long life. 


| strongly suggest that never select Char lagna in muhurat chart.Very important point in any KP MUHURAT 
chart is, never select MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR rasi as a Lagna. These four Rasis--MESHA,

KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR are CHARA Rasis and for Chara Rasi the | 1th cusp is Badhaka Sthana. When we 
do auspicious work we always think for long and prosperous life of that work, and for long life / longevity of the 
event we have to look Asc cusp sub lord. For good longevity if we select time when Asc sub lord signifies |, 5, | | 
it means good longevity.And if we take Chara Lagna i.e. MESHA, KARKA, TULA AND MAKAR | Ith is not 
good but becomes a Badhaka. So we should avoid Chara Lagna for any Muhurat. 


One of my KPAstrologer friend asks me | )“‘if a client wants muhurat for winning in a race. The event 

is short lived may be for few minutes. what is the use of longevity here?” 2) Similarly for wnining a con- 
tract, wining elections all are short lived events. The longevity is not the issue for such muhurats. 3) chara 
lagna is good for something where we want movement and not stagnant. e.g. It is understood from readers 
that chara lagna must be a requirement for buying a car.We don't want it to be parked always? Hence 
ruling out chara lagna saying badhaka may not be correct. Living and Non-Living classification is OK but 
finally non-living things are used for living people. 


|) Ifa client wants muhurat for winning in a race. The event is short lived may be for few minutes. 
What is the use of longevity here?”’ 


Longevity is very important here, for example we are looking for car race, the race period is very short but what 
happens if he faces accident in starting of Race and out of race? In this case if the chart shows us long longevity, 
it means he will complete race. We have also to judge 8th CSL not to show us accident in the chart.And some 
other factors also to be considered in Race MUHURAT. Each and every event have not same life, we have to use 
common sense too. If you are asking for betting money on race, then that is another question and it is to be han- 
dled by another way, both are not the same. 


2) Similarly for winning a contract, winning elections all are short lived events. The longevity is not 
the issue for such muhurats. 


Winning a contract: this is not a short life event, when we got a contract, after that what? Are we interested only 
in wining contract? After wining contract don’t you need to complete that work? Don’t you want to earn money 
from that? Don’t you want to get some reputation from your work? Can we only stop after wining contract? For 
example, we had done | 23 contracts with US, | predicted by MUHURAT chart of arrival time of Mr. Bush in India 
that it would materialize. Prediction comes very correct (details discuss on this chart in practical examples). Now 
think after years we are still discussing about it, is it a short life event? Same way, winning election is not a short 
life event becaue one needs to complete his 5 years term. What will happen if he is forced by party to resign? 
or Govt. falls and he has again to go to election? Don’t you think Long life of this event should be a requirement? 


3) Chara lagna is good for something where we want movement and not stagnant. e.g. It is understood 
from readers that chara lagna should be a requirement for buying a car.We don't want it to be parked 
always?Hence ruling out chara lagna saying badhaka may not be correct.Living and Non-Living classifi- 
cation is OK but finally non-living things are used for living people. 


What will happen when we don’t want to park and while going on highway the car is damaged in an accident and 
not able to run again? Don’t we think long life of car should be a requirement? Please understand the difference 
between the two circumstances. | know it is a little bit difficult to digest but if we think more and more, definitely 
all are to agree with me. 


But in some cases we have to drop the Char lagna idea. For example, a lady is admitted in hospital for delivery 
and Doctor says for caesarian immediately within 30 minutes, at this time we do not look which lagna is running 
but we will be careful about Asc sublord any how not to signify maraka and badhaka. Always we have to use our 
common sense. Without common sense an astrologer can never do good of others.

Will native survive? - a KP appraisal 
Vijay Kumar 


ha 


One of my friends whose wife was hospitalized because of a severe sickness approached me to find if the native 
was destined to survive. | replied by looking to some transits, though | wanted to be sure by KP analysis. 





In the evening, with the question in mind “Will the native survive?’, | casted an time chart on Sep 28, 2008 at 19- 
34-25 Hrs IST at Bangalore. The lagna of the time chart was taken as the lagna of the native. 


The time chart is presented as follows for analysis. 


Coordinates of judgment: 


¢ In the query when the survival of a patient is a question mark, the short life could be a case, if the lagna sub- 
lord gets linked to the maraca (2-7H) and badhaka houses. 


¢ In any query for patient, a default scenario does exist for the recovery from the disease (5H) and release from 
the hospital (1 1H). Thus, if the patient is to recover and released from the hospital, the lagna should be linked 
with the 5-I Ith houses. 


¢ | lth cusp has the final say on the query and should be judged carefully. If the patient is to get released from 
the hospital after death, the | [th house should get linked to the 8th house. 

¢ While the lagna indicates the patient (native), the 7th cusp indicates the attending doctor. 

The analysis of the chart: 

A brief snapshot of analysis is presented herewith. 

|. Examine Lagna for correctness of the chart 

This is done to assess the physical status of the native. 

Note that the Lagna sub-lord is Rahu, which is the sub-lord of the 7th house (doctor) as well. 


Rahu falls in the star of Moon (weaker lord of 5th house) placed in the 6th house indicating the sickness related 
to the nature of Moon (Soma-nectar). Note that Moon naturally signifies the replenishing of Soma in the body, 
in the want of which the body decays. Rahu, because of its head cut does gulps for the breath and classically, the 
Rahu-Moon combination cause severe breathing difficulties. In fact, it was the breathing difficulties because of 
which the patient was hospitalized. 


At the outset of indications, the chart seemed correct and it was safe to proceed ahead. 
2. Examine lagna for longevity 


Continuing on the analysis of lagna, it is noticed that the lagna sub-lord Rahu primarily signifies 6th house at the 
stellar level and denies recovery because it is a weaker lord of 5th house (recovery). Rahu falls in the sub of Venus 
who is placed in the 7th house (a maraca house) as the lord of lagna (native) and 8th house (longevity). Noting 
the fact that Rahu (lagna sub-lord) also owns Aquarius-a badhaka house (by parasharic canons), the linkage of 
Lagna sub-lord gets completed to the maraca and badhaka houses and thus portends a serious time ahead, per- 
haps, leading towards death. 


Rahu disposes Saturn and Moon and let these planets be also analyzed. 


Saturn is a strong lord of | Ith house placed in 5th house meaning the release from the hospital (1 1H) and that 
of the disease (5th house). At stellar level, Saturn signifies |-7-8th houses, as Saturn falls in the star of Venus 
placed in maraca sign (7th house) as the lord of |-8th houses. Saturn falls in the sub of | 2th lord Jupiter (a strong 
planet) placed in 9th house. Note that Saturn is also the badhaka lord as well, thus the Saturn’s significations of 
|-7-8-|2th houses as badhaka lord pose a danger to the longevity of the native.

|. In considering the effect of Saturn in the timing of events, the KP guidelines are as follows: 


|) Saturn is considered to be a delaying planet and occasionally a denying one depending upon the ownership 
and accidental occupation at the moment of birth of the native. Whenever Saturn is in any manner connected 
with Moon or Mars or Jupiter, there cannot be delay. It can delay till its own i.e. Saturn period commences and 
when Saturn sub-period starts, it fulfills surprisingly suddenly and most satisfactorily. lf Saturn is said to be a de- 
laying planet, it does not allow the lords of the previous sub-periods to offer the result which is he is also entitled 
to give.When Saturn is really very much connected with houses 2, 7 and | | by being the owner, by being the oc- 
cupant of the constellation of lord of 7, by aspecting the constellation of lord of 7, by aspecting || etc.and con- 
joined with Mars, aspected by Jupiter etc., then Saturn does miracles with lightning speed. (KP & Astrology 1996, 
page 38) 


2) Delay, dejection, disappointment, denial, etc. are caused by Sani, and strongly so if Sani occupies the 5th house 
where from it will aspect the /th, | Ith and 2nd houses by its third, seventh and tenth aspects respectively. When- 
ever Sani happens to be a significator of a particular matter, it will not deny but will cause delay. If it is connected 
with houses 2, 7 and | | by occupying the house or owning it or situated in the constellation of the planet posited 
in any of these houses, it will cause delay at every time- in fixation of marriage, celebration of marriage, etc. It 
will not deny marital happiness. But if Sani has no connection with houses 2, 7 and | | but only throws its aspect, 
this portends denial and even disappointment. Generally, all those in whose chart Sani is placed in the 5th house 
will have their marriage, delayed and delayed till the very end. (KP Reader IV, page 109) 


Saturn’s Effect of Delay or No Delay 


2.When Punarphoo Dosha is present in the chart due to Saturn-Moon connection in any manner, it is used to 
consider that there would be delay in marriage or happening of the event. However, Dr. Rangarajan Krishnamoor- 
thy has found in his study of 67 Punarphoo-effected Natal charts that only 32 (47.76%) charts corresponds to 
delayed marriage and 35 (52.24%) charts corresponds to no delay in marriage, like in the charts of Dr.B.V Raman, 
Mrs. Sandy Crowther etc. It would be no delay in the cases such as: 


|) When Saturn is very much connected with houses 2,7 and | | and Mars and Jupiter etc., then Saturn does mir- 
acles with lightning speed. 

2) If both Moon and Saturn involved in Punarphoo Dosha are connected strongly to 7th house, Saturn gives 
marriage in its Dasha and/or Anthara. 

3) Generally, whenever the 7th sub-lord happens to be Moon marriage comes in an earlier or in proper age 
never late. (KP & Astrology 1996, page 37) 


Choose or Avoid Saturn DBA 


3. In considering whether Saturn DBA dasa periods are capable of giving marriage in the Punarhoo-effected 
charts, the views as given under: 


|) Saturn who is a delaying planet will not allow marriage until his Bhukti or Anthara period is over and the event 
will materialize only in a favorable dasa periods of the succeeding planets. 

2) If Saturn becomes a strong significtor of the relevant houses under consideration, Saturn Dasa or Bhukti or 
Anthara should be preferably considered for the timing of event as Saturn takes the credit of giving the events 
while letting down his predecessor planets. It is supported by the above conditions in #2 and some experience 
that the event is used to happen in Saturn, Moon DBAS periods. (Dr. K.R. Kar, Shri Vaikari Ramamurthy, K. Sub- 
ramaniam and Mr. Kanak Bosmia)

Mars Dosha in KP 
Tin Win 


Tin Win 
tw853@yahoo.com 





Background 


1. Mars Dosha lacks a clear mention in any classical authoritative text. Even astrologers don't 
have agreement on it. Views of the astrologers and astrological texts vary and this has led to 
confusion. This Dosha is popular only with Hindus. (Umang Taneja: The Textbook of Astrology, 
page 203 & 207) Each one will have their own say according to their whims and fancies, and due 
to this it is the general public pushed to run from pillar to post. (Sri MP. Shanmugam: 
Astrosecrets & KP, Part 1, 2003, page 42) 


2. Generally, Mars occupying 1,2,4,7,8,12 houses (signs) counted from the Ascendant is 
considered to cause Mars Dosha. Some count the placement of Mars from Moon and Venus also. 
If it is counted from the Ascendant alone, half of us will be Manglik. If all positions from the 
Ascendant, Moon, Venus are counted, almost all of us will be Mangliks to suffer from separation 
or early death of the spouse etc. (Jataka Parijata XIV.34, V.S. Sastri translation pages 863-4), 
which is not the case. It is not known how this Dosha operates due to lack of systematic records 
or research supported by the sufficient number of horoscopes. 


3. In a study of the Traditional Mars Dosha, not KP Mars Dosha, on the TOB AA- rated 100 
foreign born charts of multi-marriages used for the multi-marriage study by Mr. Kanak Bosmia, 
Shri Raichur has found:- 


1) No Mars Dosha in 52 charts, 

2) mitigated Dosha in 38 charts, and 

3) unmitigated Dosha in 10 charts, ie.10% only. 

4) So it appears that Mars Dosha is not valid to cause multi-marriage, common evil result of 
this Dosha, with only 10% appearance of unmitigated Mars Dosha. 


One's Fate according to Own Karma 


4. All major life events of a native including longevity are to be predicted according to his Natal 
Horoscope. Therefore longevity of native cannot change by marrying anyone including a so-called 
Manglik as shown below: 


1) The reason why Mars alone will do so much harm to the couple which other planet 
cannot do is that there are some people who unnecessarily exaggerate the evil 
results of Mars. (KP Reader IV page 52) 

2) One need not unnecessarily entertain any fear about Mars and its untoward 
ef fects.(Ibid page 53) 

3) One should consider the individual horoscope, study for longevity, harmony, 
happiness, prosperity, etc., and should not confuse oneself with Dasa porutham and 
Mars Dosham. (Ibid page Jf) 

4) It is not wise to attribute success or failure in one's life to the fortune or 
misfortune of one’s life. Both have to happen according to one's karma which can be 
read by an astrologer. (Lbid page 174) 

5) Each horoscope has to be judged independently. Whatever is found in the chart will 
alone come to pass. By marrying one having Eka-Dasa or Dasa Sandhi, one will never 
alter the results indicated by one's chart. (Lbid page 264)

Tin Win 





6) There is nothing called ‘Mars Dosha’ in real effect, certainly not as the traditional 
astrologers and the public believe it to be. Mras Dosha has nothing to do with the 
life span of the couple as it is assumed wrongly. (SAri K. Hariharan, as per courtesy 
of Mohan Kumar Ragunathan) 

7) Since a horoscope is bound by Karmic parameters, matching cannot bring the 
miracles. But it can be an effective tool to fight premature loss of spouse and other 
problems that occur between spouses. (Gayatri Devi Vasudev: Clues to Interpreting 
Charts, page 224) 


Traditional Mars Dosha Explained in KP 


5. The traditional criteria of Mars Dosha explained in KP Reader IV pages 51-69 ‘up to 4th 
paragraph’ is the exact reprint of content in pages 215-228 of the original Krishnamurti 
Padhdhati Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications. In the same page 69, three paragraphs are added to 
give a clear opinion that not Mars alone, any planet can cause such undesirable effect of 
disagreement, dispute, divorce etc among the couple provided they happen to be deposited in 
such a position of the significator of 6 or 10 or 12. (KP Reader IV page 69, ‘5th paragraph’) On 
the other hand Mars also can give the beneficial results and so Mars like any other planet should 
not be branded as a fully malefic planet. 

The experience is that the house position of Mars ina chart does not make a native Manglik, if 
Mars is considered a functional benefit for the natal chart. (David Hawthorne, V.K. Choudhry: 
Astrology for Life, page 113) 


6. Sri M.P. Shanmugam has also explained the Traditional Mars Dosha in Astrosecrets & KP, Part 
I, 2003, pages 39- 48, and given opinion that in several ways a prediction is given which has 
neither clarity nor a systematic approach etc. and finally it is the public who suffer. 


7. The only one short theoretical article on Mars Dosha is found in all the KP. & Astrology Year 
Books from 1995 to 2008, i.e."Mars Dosha- A Myth' by N. Sarangan (KP & Astrology Year Book 
2002, page 48). Quoting the above Guruji KSK's opinion on the role of Mars (KP Reader IV pages 
695th paragraph’), it is concluded that the traditional ideas about Mars Dosha are meaningless 
without taking into consideration of the beneficial aspects received by Mars from other planets, 
its stellar position etc, and Mars Dosha does not suit our modern age. 


8. Mars Dosha is not found or not given any attention in:- 


1) the writings of referrable KP astrologers like Shri C.R. Bhatt (Nakshatra Chintamani), 
Dr. K.R.Kar (Sub-sub Theory), Shri K.M. Subramaniam (Sub Lord Speaks), Shri Vaikari 
Ramamurthy (Punarphoo), Shri K. Subramaiam and Shri K. Hariharan (sons of Guruji KSK) 
etc. 

2) the KPDP- KP rules for marriage matching by Sri Kuppu Ganapathi (KP & Astrology Year 
Book 1997, pages 32-44 , KPEzine March 2007) 

3) the books of cuspal interlinks through sub or sub-sub, 

4) in the Vedic Kuta matching (Prasna Marga) etc.

Mars Dosha in KP 
Tin Win 





9. Based on the Traditional Mars Dosha summarized in KP Reader IV pages 51-69, 

1) Some have got the impression that the traditional Mars Dosha is valid in KP, and . 

2) advocated the traditional way of matching, ie. for a native with Mars Dosha to marry 
with another one with Mars Dosha (KP Reader IV page 68), 

3) It is like adding more fire to a house which is already in fire and it does not agree with 
the KP principle to throw water and send when a house is in fire. (KP Reader VI page 
319) 

4) The same is with choice of gems as per KP, ie. it is wrong to suggest the gem governed 
by the malefic planet to mitigate the evil effect assuming that the planet in its period 
will give adverse results to a native and such chosen gem is actually doing harm to the 
consultant. When a house is in fire, it is to throw water and sand in stead of pouring 
highly inflammable ones on the fire. Therefore, the auspicious planet's gem is to be 
suggested. (KP Reader VI, pages 318-320) 

5) For traditional Mars Dosha one has to consider the house according to the sign of equal 
30 degrees each. In KP the division of houses is according to the Placidus house system 
of unequal houses. It needs a systematic approach of adaptation. 

6) So many confusing rules to follow for Mars Dosha and its cancellation is not in line with 
the simplicity idea of KP. No clear reason is found for the cancellation or exceptions of 
Mars Dosha. 

7) Without taking into consideration of Mars Dosha, the KP rules are clearly laid down how 
to judge longevity, multi-marriage, married life etc for each individual horoscope. 

8) Hence a horoscope should be read following the KP principles and rules only without 
mixing up with the conventional ways of identifying the Mars Dosha. 

9) Time might come to apply Mars Dosha in KP, if and only if some one could come up with 
the reasonable and practically applicable KP rules for Mars Dosha supported by reliable 
evidences.

Fed Up with Marriage - a KP appraisal 
Vijay Kumar 


ha 


This is a case from my file of records. 





One of my of my colleague had his marital life in trouble for a long time and he was fed up with it. His spouse 
was doing job out of city and they were not in amicable talking terms for a while. 


Out of visible frustration, he approached me on April 21, 2008 and asked me if he had chances to remain with 
his family or think for divorce. 


| prepared the time chart immediately on 21-04-2008 at 10-14-41 Hrs IST at Bangalore for analysis. 
The time chart at the time of query is shown as below. 

The chart is being analysed as follows: 

The Query 


In the time chart, Moon falls in the 5th house and is the lord of 2nd house, indicating native’s concern about the 
harmony (5H) and family (2H). Moon happens to be the strong planet hence its placement indicates a deeper con- 
cern from mental side.At the physical level, Lagna sub-lord Jupiter is seen placed in 7H (spouse), hence his concern 
is about the spouse in particular. 


Since Moon links itself to the emotions on account of family (2H) and harmony 5H) and the spouse (7H), it was 
sufficient to proceed with the query. 


The co-ordinates for judgment 


In a time chart, the harmonious life with spouse is promised if Lagna, 5th and 7th cusps get linked with the | Ith 
house in any way. The healthy marital life shall be realized only if the | Ith cusp indicates its linkage with the Lagna, 
5th and 7th house without getting linked to the adverse houses. The marital discord starts from the 6th and 
[2th house involving the 7th house. 


Analysis of the chart 


Primarily, the query seeks if the harmony may be established between the querist and his spouse. The analysis is 
attempted as follows. 


|.Assess the Lagna 
Lagna is assessed through the disposition of lagna sub-lord Jupiter. 
Jupiter as the lord of 7th house is placed in 7th house; hence it makes the spouse dominating. 


At the stellar level, Jupiter falls in the star of Sun placed in 10th house indicating the ego (Sun) being the issue in 
causing the discord (10H).As Sun is the weak 3rd lord, it could be some sort of false ego issue from the native 
himself (3rd house is the expression of Lagna-native). Moon as the sub-lord of Jupiter is placed in 5H and that is 
how the query is meant for harmony. 


Thus, the initial assessment suggests the separation to be due to some ego issue instigated from the native’s side. 
2. Look at the 3-9th cusps. 


It is important to assess about what must have transpired between the native (lagna) and the spouse (/th cusp) 
causing the discord. Note that the 3rd cusp decides the deliberations from the native’s side and that from the 
spouse's side are indicated from the 9th cusp. 


3rd cusp has Sun as the sub-lord. Sun, which also lords 3rd house indicates the rulebook attitude of the native. 
Since, Sun by itself falls in the star of Ketu placed in 2nd house; the family issues could be the focus of the marital 
discord. Sun is not a strong planet so the native’s assertion may not be very strong, however its stellar lord Ketu 
would dictate the origin of the issue. Here, Ketu placed in 2nd house suggests that the native’s side of family (ku- 
tumba) could be the main issue of tussel and since Ketu strongly disposes the Sun (which has the natural 
karakatwa of father), perhaps the needed care required for native’s father could be an issue ingniting the fire of 
discord. 


Sub-lord of Sun happens to be Jupiter who enjoys its placement in own house in /th house, the spouse's side seem 
stronger and thus the counseling efforts from native (3H) could not muster the support of the spouse and spouse 
emerging stronger in her own ways (jupiter in own house in 7H).

if DBAS signify 2 (12th from 3rd), 8 (6th from 3rd), 10 (8th from 3rd) and 4 Maraka (2nd from 3rd), 9 (Maraka 


and Badhaka 7th from 3rd). there is a possibility of Rail Accident.

KP METHOD IS THE ACCURATE ASTROLOGICAL SYSTEM 


About six years back when | was searching for the astrological solutions, | had an opportunity to send the birth 
details of my son to a famous Vedic Astro-Analyst, who through his website used to answer queries. 


The question in my mind was about the educational pursuits of my son, which was the major worry for me. Of 
course, my son was good at education. 


The Astrologer, upon checking the chart, gave me the following reply verbatim: 


Since the 4th lord in your son’s chart, Mars, is placed in 8th house and is debilitated in the Navamsa, your son 
will not have education. 


Later on, after studying KP System in a famous Astro-School in Hyderabad, | had drawn out the chart strictly fol- 
lowing KP method, which is also appended: 


Name: (student) Place: Kaduthuruthy, Kottayam Dist, Kerala Date: 26-05-1990 Time: 13-38-00 Longitude:/6-24- 
00 East Latitude:9-46-00 North Zone: IST 5.5 


KP dicta are very particular and articulate without confusion. One does not need to check many rules or refer 
many books or any such things. 


The rule says that the person will have College education academically completed successfully:-- 


I) When the 4th cusp sub lord (CSL) is connected to 4,9, | Ith houses. 
2) When dasha / bhukti / antara lords are connected to these houses. 
3) When the transits of planets signify these houses. 

4) When 4th CSL signifies 3,5,8, and |2 there will be break in education. 


In the chart under reference, 4th cusp falls in Scorpio sign in Mercury star and Saturn sub. Hence Saturn or any 
planets connected to Saturn should give the education, as per KP canon. Saturn is the top significator of 9th 
house by being in the star of Su in 9th house. Mars is the lone significator of both 4th and 9th cusps by its aspects 
on 4th and 9th lord Mars. 


CONVOCATION CEREMONY 


Hence Saturn is favourably placed to give College education to the native. Vimshottari Maha Dasha (VMD) op-

Predictive Relevance of Sahams in 


KP Astrology 
Vijay Kumar 





This article was written and presented in KP astrologers’ forum, Hyderabad on the occasion of 
2nd KP Astrologers’ International Summit-Dec 2008. 
This article is reproduced with minor updation / corrections herewith in KP Ezine with the oral permission of the 
President-KPAF, Shri Rajendra Nimje IAS. 
I humbly acknowledge the magnanimity of Shri Nimje for permitting the re-publication of this article. 


| Introduction: 


During my studies of various astrological principles in Parasharic and Jaimini system of astrology, | have felt that 
many parameters of that compendium of knowledge could be imported to KP domain which could be analyzed 
in the framework of KP way of delineation and used alongwith the existing parameters to gather better accuracy 
of predictive decisions by way of an additional opinion. 


One of such parameter is the Sahams, which finds its mention in Tajika system of astrology, brought to light by 
many revered commentators such as Neelkantha, Venkatesh and Kesava of yore. The details on Sahams may be 
obtained from the 8th chapter of the book titled “The hindu progressed horoscope by Dr. B.V.Raman”. 

This write-up is the result of my endeavor to bring the Sahams in KP astrology. 

2.What is Saham? 

Technically, the sahams are the sensitive points in the zodiac that control certain aspects of life. While, the com- 
mentator Neelkantha has derived about 50 sahams that encompass every aspect of life, yet about 35 sahams have 
been documented that are put to use for delineating the status of various aspects of life such as fame, ability, for- 
tune, business, finances, foreign travel, parents, children, marriage, death etc. 

3. Calculating Sahams 

A saham is obtained by the unique combination obtained out of the manipulation of the longitudes of planets, 
lagna, other few house cusps and some specific sahams by itself. Each saham is essentially represented by a formula 
like A-B+C with some associated modalities where A, B and C could represent the longitudes of 
planets/lagna/other house cusps/specific sahams in various combinations. 


For a quick understanding of the formula A-B+C, it may be viewed as follows 


a. If A is behind (lesser in longitude) than B, add 360 deg to A to make the result of A-B as positive. If B is behind 
(lesser in longitude) than A, no addition of 360 deg is required, as the result of A-B shall be positive itself. 


b.Add the longitudinal distance arrived by (A-B) as above to C to reach a defined point in the zodiac. 

A few important modalities associated with the calculation of sahams are as follows. 

c. Look whether C falls in between B toA or not, as follows. 

i. While counting from B to A zodiacally, if C is not found to be placed in between B toA, 30 degrees are added 
to the figure obtained by the formula A-B+C. 

ii. If C is found between B toA, then the figure obtained by the formula A-B+C is taken as it is. 

d. The steps a to d as stated above are mandatory. If the total exceeds 360 deg, it is needed to expunge the mul- 
tiples of 360 deg to bring the net result within the zodiac space (0-360 deg). This completes the calculation of 


the desired saham. 


e. For most of the sahams (unless specified), the formula differs for birth in day time and night time by a default 
pattern as follows.

‘a 


i. Take A-B+C for day births 
li. Take B-A+C for night births 


Thus, for calculation of sahams in night births, undertake the steps (a to d) stated above) by making an interchange 
between A and B and working out in the same way, as given for the day birth. 


For the simplification sake, the table at #3 define the sahams both for the day and night births. It also indicates 
the exceptions, where the saham is calculated by the same formula both for day and night births. 


lt may be noted that the Sunrise to Sunset constitute the day and Sunset to Sunrise as the night, thus the birth 
may be classified accordingly. 


f. The sahams do not differentiate with the gender of the native, though differ for the day and night births. Thus, 
any saham for a male or a female nativity would be the same. 


Example: 
|. Case of day birth: 


Day Consider calculating the Vivaha saham (saham indicating marriage) as Venus-Saturn+Lagna for day birth. Co- 
relating with the formula A-B+C, consider A to be Venus; B to be Saturn and C to be Lagna. 


Assume a chart of day birth to have the following longitudes. 


¢Venus at Leo: 25-00-10 (d-m-s) 
¢ Saturn at Virgo: 07-04-03 (d-m-s) 
¢ Lagna at Leo: 19-13-52 (d-m-s) 


Count from Saturn to Venus zodiacally to find the distance, which happens to be 347-56-07 (d-m-s).Add this lon- 
gitudinal distance to the lagna, which maps to the longitude at [27-09-59 (d-m-s). Note that while counting from 
Saturn to Venus, Lagna falls in between; hence addition of 30 deg is not required. 


Thus, the Vivaha saham is located in Leo: 07-09-59 (d-m-s). 
2. Case of night birth: 


Consider the same data of Venus, Saturn at Lagna for a night birth. Now the formula applied for calculating the 
Vivaha saham for the night birth shall be changed to Saturn-Venus+Lagna. 


Count from Venus to Saturn zodiacally to find the distance, which happens to be |2-3-53 (d-m-s).Add this lon- 
gitudinal distance to Lagna, which maps to the longitude of I5I-I7-45 (d-m-s). Note that while counting from 
Venus to Saturn, Lagna does not fall in between, hence additional 30 deg are required to be added making the Vi- 
vaha saham to fall at 81-17-45 (d-m-s) or in Libra 01-17-45 (d-m-s). 


3. Some important sahams 

Some of the important sahams and their formula are appended as separate sheet for quick reference. 
4. How does conventional astrology use Sahams 

In conventional astrological scenario, the sahams have the following usages. 


¢ Sahams indicate certain aspects of life, perhaps all about that aspect. 

¢ Sahams finds specific usage in the varshaphala charts (for finding results of a year). 

¢ Strength of sahams is in proportion of the strength of placement of saham lord and navamsa bala. 

¢ For the results to be obtained, saham need be connected to the lagna. 

eSaham lord should associate in benefic tajika yogas (ex. Ithasala yoga etc) to confer positive results. Negative re- 
sults are expected from the association of malefic tajika yogas (ex. lsarapha yoga). 

¢ The association of benefics with saham and saham lord strengthens the positive indications of the saham, reverse 
for malefic association. 

¢ In timing the event, generally the results are expected in the dasha/antardasha of the planet, which forms good 
tajika yoga with the lord of sahams.

¢ Some evidences are available on the progression of the sahams for timing the event. 
5. Scope of coverage in this writeup 


Out of many sahams indicated in the table at #3 above, examples related to Vivah saham (marriage), Putra saham 
(childbirth), Karma saham (Work, Job), pitra saham (matters related to father) and Paradesh saham (foreign travel) 
are dealt herewith with practical examples, pertaining to birth and horary charts. 


While, the example charts are a few with the constraint of the brevity of the write-up, the logic of delineation 
procedure may be extended to any saham keeping in mind its intent. | have tested the applicability of sahams in 
many cases and found the results to be very pointed and encouraging. 


4. Hypothesis of the applicability of Sahams 


In the effort to evaluate the sahams in the KP domain, the scope of the applicability of sahams in delineation 
process is defined with the following hypothesis. 


a. Sahams control a particular aspect of life thus anything relating to that aspect of life get reflected by it. This is 
applicable both for birth charts and that of horary origin. 


As an example, whether be the query pertains to the marriage timing or towards the quality of marital life; the 
vivaha saham has to be under scrutiny. 


b. The house where a saham gets placed shows its positional status and it works according to its placement at 
metal level. Example, if vivah saham falls in the 6th house, it indicates some sort of marital tension and works to- 
wards discord. Similarly, its placement in 7th or | lth house would cause the vivah saham to show amicability in 
the arena of marital life. 


c. Sahams are defined in terms of the location in the zodiac longitudinally. Thus, any Saham may be defined having 
a sign lord, star lord, sub lord and sub-sub lord just as cusps and planets are defined. Thus, the Saham may be plot- 
ted in the chart with a defined longitude as a sensitive point just as done for Fortuna. 


d. It is suggested that the Saham cusp may be evaluated exactly in the same way as is done for other cusps. 


In this spirit, the saham cusp may be evaluated for its placement, its stellar significations and the significations at 
the sub-lord level.As usual, the sub-lord signification of Saham cusp would decide the results. These significations 
may be evaluated in reference to the primary and other support houses considered for the purpose the saham 
is meant for. 


As an example, the vivaha saham should have an amicable connection with the primary 7th cusp/house in order 
to indicate marriage. 


e. The sahams may be looked for a second opinion to the existing rules of delineations and it is likely that it may 
present a decisive picture to arrive at the conclusions. 


f. The study of sahams is equally applicable in birth charts as well as in horary charts both derived with the horary 
numbers (be it within 249 or 2193 scheme) or through time charts. The results obtained with the sahams are 
very impressive. 


g.While dealing with the horary charts, depending on the time of judgment, which could be daytime or night time, 
the relevant formula meant for day/night birth may be applied to calculate the sahams. 


h. lt would be prudent to emphasize that the applicability of sahams does not get limited to natal or horary 
charts alone. This concept is equally applicable on mundane charts of national importance as well. 


i. There are a few sahams, which involve the usage of the cusp of certain houses. In parasharic astrology, there are 
multiple theories for defining the cusp of houses, which are based on equal house division and un-equal house 
division basis. Thus, the application of saham in such a scenario becomes doubtful. 


At this juncture, there is a lot of advantage in applying the sahams in KP domain, as the houses are clearly defined 
in terms of cusps.

Vijay Kumar | 





j. In classical parasharic astrology, sahams are considered the sensitive points in the zodiac with reference to 
which the transit of planets matters a lot. It means that a benefic planet transiting the saham or in its trines ac- 
tivates the saham to give good results, similarly converse for the transit of malefic planets. 





| have yet not covered this aspect in this write-up, but a good success rate is likely to be obtained. 


k. It may be noted that Prof Krishnamaurthi had used “Fortuna” in the KP predictive domain, which is nothing 
but the “Punya Saham” dealing with the fortune of the native in general for birth chart and for fortune related 
to specific domain of query in horary charts. 


In order to differentiate between the day and night birth, the definition of Punya Saham undergoes a change, 
which may be noted by those who tend to use this parameter for all the birth/horary delineations, as a general 
support to the other specific sahams and other cusps of the chart. 


|. lt may be noted that the above hypothesis of saham’s import to KP domain is framed keeping the logistics in 
mind to start with. The hypothesis is open to the modification after the concepts are understood in its intent and 
tested on a large database of cases. 

5. Practical examples 

Assorted cases of some aspects of life have been analyzed in this section. 

| have taken up the cases that have been written by me in different forums over the time. The charts are selected 
from a mix of birth charts, horary charts as per time charts as well as based on horary numbers, to prove the 
applicability of sahams universally. 

In order to maintain the brevity in this write-up, all the charts are analyzed by the consideration of sahams only. 
The readers may read the analysis of the charts given in the original articles in various magazines by conventional 


KP way and they would find a perfect similium of results. 


5.1 Marriage matter (Horary query) 
[Case written by me in KP Ezine-Dec 2008) 


A native was fed up with the marriage and asked, if staying with wife was a possibility. The time chart drawn at 
the time of query is given below. 


The query was analyzed in the day time, hence the vivaha saham is calculated with the formula as Venus- 
Saturn+Lagna, which adds up to 296-3 1-45 (d-m-s). It is observed that Lagna is not placed between Saturn to Venus, 
hence additional 30 deg are added by rule making the vivah saham (VS) placed in Aquarius 26-31-45 (d-m-s). 


Note that the vivaha saham placed in Aquarius is lorded by Saturn-Jupiter-Ketu-Mercury as sign lord, star lord, 
sub lord and sub-sub lord. 


Analysis by way of vivaha saham (VS): 
¢ Note that the question is related to the known marital discord. 


¢Vivaha saham falls in the 9th house, which essentially deals with the issues in stalemate from the spouse's side 
(9th house). 


¢ Sub-lord of vivaha saham is Ketu (intrinsically deals with the stalemates or obstructions), which suggest that the 
marriage could be a serious issue in the life of the native. 


* At stellar level, Ketu falls in its own star and sub placed in 2nd house makes the family matter as the cause of 
the issue. 


* Ketu disposes exalted Sun, which lords 3rd house indicating the rulebook attitude (natural karaka) of the native. 
Since, Sun by itself falls in the star of Ketu placed in 2nd house; the family issues could certainly be the focus of 
the marital discord. Note that Sub-lord of Sun is Jupiter (strong lord of 7th house) that is placed in 7th house, 
makes the buck to be on the spouse's side. 


A simple look on the vivah saham suggests that the native is following the rule- book of his ideals and spouse’s

Azoospermia - a case study 
kadavasalramani@gmail.com

‘AZOOSPERMIA’ is a medical term for sterility, unproductive, barren i.e. total absence of sperm in semen. Nor- 
mal male should have 60 to 150 millions sperms per cubic milli meter of semen, as per medical theory. Count 
below 60 millions is termed as oligospermia, whereas total absence of sperms in semen is termed as Azoosper- 
mia. 


Fruit of the marriage and marital happiness lies in begetting a child boy or girl at the earliest after marriage. Not 
getting a child even after 10 years or more, unless for specific reason, it is a cause of anxiety to both the couple. 
We have to find out who is abnormal male or female. 


Let us find out astrological reasons for such defect.A couple came to me for consultation whether at all they will 
get a child,as they were married more than |0 years ago and their parents are reported to be more worried for 
not getting grand child so far. 


| am attaching both of their charts and my observation thereon as follows. 


For child birth, we have to scrutinize 2, 5 and | Ith bhavas for fruitful results; especially 5th bhava, which is | [th 
to his partner. |,4 and [Oth bhavas are | 2th to the above houses and they give the negative result. The signs Aries, 
Gemini, Leo and Virgo are Aputra (Barren) signs and they negate the child birth. Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius 
are semi barren signs. These signs also will not give the result. The only fruitful signs are Cancer, Scorpio and 
Pisces. Taurus, Libra and Aquarius are the semi-fruitful signs. 


Among the planet the Sun is hot sand dry planet. Moon, Venus, Mars and Jupiter are fruitful planets. Especially 
Jupiter is of prime importance for normal semen in male. Mars is important for female. Moon is sex instinct in 
male. Jupiter is karaka for progeny and Venus is karaka for child birth. Sun and Mars are for male potential and 
sex vitality. Mercury and Saturn are eunuch planets. Kethu is incendiary by nature and called abortive planet, not 
good for child birth. The lords of 5, | 1, Moon, Jupiter, Venus, Sun and Mars should be in a fruitful signs. They should 
not fall in abortive Ketu’s star and barren signs. 


Thus we have to combine the bhavas and planets by their sign, star and sub position. Especially 5th & | 1th cusps’ 
sign lord, star lord and sub lord should have inter relations with each other for favourable results. In addition, 
benefic or malefic aspects to the concerned bhavas and planets .are also to be seen. 


With the above guidance, both of the charts have been analysed as follows.

they got separated and divorced.

and /th cuspal sub lord Saturn in 2, in star Rahu in 5 as an agent of 5th lord Venus, kalathrakarak has given him 
intercast marriage. Saturn with no planet in its star and being in own sub is a strong significator of 2,7 for marriage. 
But that marriage cold not sustain long as Rahu is agent of |O0th lord Venus is in | and Venus is conjoined with

ference of opinion between them and finally in divorce due to I,6, 8, 10, 12 signification. In addition, the | Ith sig- 
nification was also absent for conjugal relation. There is Punarphoo dosha by the conjunction of Moon and Saturn 
in Aquarius but it is supposed to be cancelled as Moon is in the sub of Saturn. No child was got from the Ist wife.

|. By occupation and lordship, the Dasa lord and its star lord indicate the houses, whose matters will be enjoyed

give the results indicated by another as the weak grade ‘E’ significators. 


2. The same can be said about the Bhukti lord also. The Dasa lord is the most powerful commander. No Bhukti 
lord can offer a result, if the Dasa lord does not permit.What the Bhukti lord can do is to obstruct the Dasa lord 
from giving results but he cannot alter the result. The Antaara and Sookshma lords can carry out the mandate of 
the Dasa/Bhukti lords, if they have similar significations as the Dasa/Bhukti lords. lf not, the event cannot take place 
in their Antara or Sookshma and will have to wait for another Antara/ Sookshma periods when they can execute 
the results destined by the Dasa/Bhukti lords. Planets form a cabinet. The prime minister is the Dasa lord. The 
Bhukti lords are the ministers and the Antara lords are deputy ministers.

and never will change. The cusps indicate whether the matter is promised or not. Significators point the time of

transit should also signify the required houses.An event, which is promised, happens in the joint period of DBAS 
signifying the required houses.A promised event cannot happen, if the Dasa lords are not favorable. 


7. Since an event cannot happen without being promised and the cuspal sub lord of a house is all powerful, it is 
worthy to test the following rules whenever they are relevant: 


|) One cannot suffer the accident in the period of the dasa lord signifying 8th , if the 8th cuspal sub lord is the 
significators of 3 and | 1, which promise a life without accidents; 

2) One cannot suffer all the adverse matters indicated by the | 2th house in the Dasa of | 2th house significator, 
if the | 2th cuspal sub lord is strongly signifies the improving houses |,2,3,6,10,11, especially | Ith, as in the chart 
of Mr. Tony Blair; 

3) The effect of the | Ith Badhaka can be relieved, if the | 1th cuspal sub lord signifies the |0th house, which is 
[2th to | Ith house, etc. 


8. The karaka without the signification of the required houses is not a significator itself but the limited use of the 
karaka can be considered: 


|) The dasa lords connected with 4th house and Mars will indicate 

house. 4th house and Venus indicates conveyance. 4th house and Moon govern mother. 4th house and Mercury 
indicates education. 

2) If the 4th cusp and Moon occupy the constellation of significators of the 9,1 1,3 houses and if the sub belongs 
to Badhaka, Maraka to the 4th house, the mother will be unhealthy and not live long. 

3) The karaka planets are helpful in the identification of diseases.

Education in KP System - Medical or Engineerin 


MK Viswana 


M K Viswanath, KP and Vedic Astrologer

We are apprehensive and careful to perceive that the educational part is a very important phase of a 
person in life, irrespective of the fact that the person is born in any era whether ancient, middle ages, 
or in modern period.Astrology and a shrewd Astrologer could be a perfect tool to determine educa- 
tional line of a person or if at all the chart promises education, of course, among many intricate events 
of a person's life. 





Stethoscope of a Doctor could measure heartbeat of a patient, while Astrology could diagnose the (ye==—% 
“educational heart-beat” of a person. The KP System, which revolves around cusp that marks the be- Be=#==*s 
ginning of a house and sub lord theory, _ is the accurate Astrological system available to human kind. ~ 





Once a Doctor by profession dropped in at my home seeking astrological advice on the chart of his beloved daughter. It 
is obvious that only Astrologer or the Creator of the Universe, Brahma himself, could only predict in advance of an event 
that could materialize in the future. 


The chart is analyzed as per the one discussed below:-- 


Name (Female) Date 15-04-1993 Thursday Time: | 6-03-51 hours IST (Reported time |6-04 hours) Sys: KPAY: 23° 40' 03" 
Place: Hyderabad Longitude: 78-27-00 East Latitude: | 7-26-00 North Zone IST 5.5 from GMT Settings Universal Time Sid. 
Time 5° 22' 03" Latitude Geographic Cusp System Placidus 


Of the two genders, viz. male and female, both should get educated well in order to maintain the equilibrium in the society 
and also to lift it from the current precarious status as well as for better prosperity for the generations to come. Women 
are the torch-bearers of an efficient and mature society. 


Under this view-point, the chart assumes significance since it belongs to a girl.A “girl child” is a “pearl-child”. 


In KP system, the rules are very straight-forward and not at all confusing. The students need to only understand its basics 
to analyze a chart for an event. 


The rules say that when 4th cuspal sub lord signifies 4,9, | 1, the native will have College education, and when 9th cuspal sub 
lord signifies 4,9,11, higher education is destined. The line of education shall be dictated by the significators of these cusps 
as per their characteristics. The lords of Dasha / Bhukti / Antara which are operating at the time of event should support 
along with the transit of planets. Well placed Mercury and Jupiter are the natural significators of education. 3rd cusp will 
signal the mental inclination to study. 


3rd cusp sub lord Venus is a strong significator of | |th by being the sub lord of this cusp without having no planet in its star. 
4th cuspal sub lord Jupiter indicates the native’s intelligence as lord of 5 in the star of Moon in 5. Jupiter is aspected by Mer- 
cury, lord of favourable 2, | |. 9th cuspal sub lord Sun is a self strong planet without having any planet in its star. Sun is in 
the star of Ketu in 9 and agent of Venus, which is a strong significator of | |th as discussed above. Thus the signification of 
9,11 by the 4th and 9th cuspal sub lords can bestow higher education to the native. 


The dasa period running at the time of the age from I5 years to |7 years (education in Intermediate) is that of Rahu-Saturn. 
Rahu is agent of Mars and Saturn aspected by Mars. Both Rahu and Saturn are connected to Mars. 


Native was studying in | Oth class at the time of analysis, and was likely to pass out of High School during March-April 2008. 
The advice given earlier to the father of the native toward educational line was Medicine, especially Dentist, as indicated 
by the 9th cuspal sub lord Sun. 


At this juncture it is felt that for a line in medicine, connection of Sun is a must. Sun is neither connected to Jupiter nor 
Mars. Dasha lord Rahu also is not connected to Sun. Hence it was respectfully declared to the consultant that the line of 
education is not Medicine, but it should be Engineering. Accordingly, the girl was put into an Intermediate Course of Maths- 
Physics-Chemistry (or more popularly known as MPC), which could take her to an Engineering Course. At the moment 
almost one year passed since the analysis was done, the consultant had confirmed that the girl is studying well and scoring 
more than 90% marks in the internal examinations conducted in-house at the College. 


Once the 4th and 9th houses declare that the native is destined for higher education, the current running Dasa lord would 
complete that matter Rahu is aspected by Saturn in 6, in the star of | Ith lord Mercury and its sign lord is Mars in I | as 
lord of 4,9. 


May God Almighty bless upon this girl and take her to an Engineering Course such as BE or B.Tech and let her pass out 
successfully with flying colors. At the lotus feet of Guruji. OM TAT SAT

Will Marriage Happen - a KP appraisal 


Vijay Kumar 


Vijay Kumar, Senior Manager, C-DOT 

Electronic City, Phase-1, Hosur Road, BANGALORE 560 100 

Phone: Office: 080-25119580 Res: 26587463 Mobile: 0-98450-39153 
E-mail: v_kumar@cdotb.ernet.in 





This is a recent case asked to me. One of my colleague asked me on phone “Will the native (his son) 
marry this girl” having in mind the candidates of marriage proposal. He gave me the horary number as 
3 


| prepared the chart on Dec 16, 2008 at 18-27-42 Hrs IST at Bangalore for analysis. In this case, there 
was no need to rotate the chart and | considered lagna for the boy and the /th house for girl, as the 
question was put directly by the name of the candidates. The horary chart at the time of query is 
shown on next page.. The chart is being analysed as follows: 





The co-ordinates for judgment 


In a prashna chart, if the prospects of marriage between two individuals are to be assessed, following combinations should 
exist. 


* The lagna indicates one individual and the 7th house indicates the other one for marriage in such a prashna. 

* 7th house also indicates the marital knot. Thus, 7th house need be connected to the lagna and the | Ith house. 

* | Ith house indicates the fructification of the query. Hence, if the marriage between two natives in view is to take place, 
* | 1th house should be connected to 7th house and lagna. 

* If all the connections exist, the dasha-bhukti would indicate the timing. 


Analysis of the chart 
The analysis is attempted as follows. 
|. Check for Moon 


Moon is placed in lagna, which may be seen as placed in 5th house as 5th lord from the 9th house (father), thus it is evident 
that the father is concerned for his child. Since, Ketu conjoins the Moon, there seems to be some concern with the son on 
his health issues, perhaps on mental faculty. Moon is placed in the 3-7-9-| Ith cusps indicating the existence of a marriage 
proposal between the said individuals. 


2.Assess the Lagna and 7th cusp 


Incidentally, the sub-lord of lagna and 7th house is Rahu. Rahu is a strong planet, as it does not have any planet in its star. 
Placement of Rahu in 7th house indicates that a proposal of marriage exists. At the stellar level, Rahu falls in the star of 
Moon placed in lagna. Rahu is in the sub of Mercury, which as 3-| 2th lord falls in the 5th house.While, the connection pro- 
vided by Rahu brings forth the matter of marriage in view, the sub-lord Mercury as | 2th lord tend to restrict it. Rahu dis- 
poses Saturn and Moon. 


Saturn is a strong planet as there is no planet in its star. The placement of 8th lord Saturn in 2nd house brings-in obstructions. 
At the stellar level, Saturn is in the star of Sun placed in 5th house. Saturn is in the sub of Moon placed in lagna. 


Moon falls in the star of Mercury placed in 5th house as | 2th lord. Moon is in the sub of Rahu placed in 7th house. 


Thus, from the initial assessment of lagna and /th cusp, while the lagna and /th cusps are fairly connected, the linkage of 
lagna and 7th cusps with the | Ith house is missing. Thus the fingers are kept crossed till now. 


3.Assess the | Ith cusp to look for the final outcome 
The | Ith cusp decides the overall fructification of the query. 


Jupiter is the sub-lord of the | Ith cusp. Jupiter is a strong planet, as it does not have any planet in its star, thus its placement 
is important. Note that Jupiter as 6th lord is placed in 6th house, which deters the marriage proposal in principle. At the 
stellar level, Jupiter falls in the star of Sun placed in 5th house. Jupiter falls in its own sub and by way of being 6th lord and 
placed in 6th house, it categorically denies the marriage. 


4. Conclusion 
Looking to the analysis as, it was indicated to the querist that the candidate in view for the marriage of his son would not 
materialize. 


Facts of the case 
My colleague told me that he himself was not satisfied by the marriage proposal, though he wanted to check astrologically. 
He refused the proposal and went ahead with the other proposals, which he had for his son. 

| thank KP methodology to show the light whenever approached.

Amputation 
K S V Ramani 


K S V Ramani 
kadavasalramani@gmail.com 





Amputation is severance of some part of the body surgically say leg, hand, fingers etc. for various rea- 
sons such as due to acute Diabetic, accidents or in the course of job of running electric machines, in- 
volving cut of his limb etc. etc. In these cases Amputation is unavoidable, when it is found that there 
is no other way to save him from getting septic resulting in death. It is very unfortunate for a person 
to lose any part of the body, which is very essential for his normal movement. And becoming handi- 
capped thereby depending on others for assistance throughout his/her life. 


One Indian Army Major Thambuswamy, born on 22-12 1926 at 1-20 PM IST at 13.40 (N) Long, 80.15 
(E),(birth data collected from a vedic astrology book) was snow bitten during the war with China in 
1962. His feet had to be amputed, with no other way to save him. The amputation took place in December 1962. His Birth 
chart is as attached, Generated from K.PAstro 3.0 SW 





Now let us analyze his chart for his known life events. 


I. Profession: He entered in service in Indian Army for Military service, Mars is main karaka, because of the Planet’s martial 
nature. Mars is also for courage, battle, valour wielding of weapons and he should be strong in the chart and also connected 
to 10th Bhava, which Bhava is for indication of his profession. Mars in this chart is : 


(i) placed in Lagna Bhava (ii) in his own sign in Aries,as owner of that sign, thereby getting good strength. (iii) As per K.Psys- 
tem for any event. of life, first Lagna is to be scrutinized whether the native is destined for that event. In this chart, Pisces 
is Lagna of the native, lord of which is Jupiter. He is posited in | |th in the star of Mars in Lagna. Jupiter is with positional 
status (self strength) i.e. no other planet is in its star. So Jupiter, Lagna lord thro’ his star lord Mars gets his trait. Whether 
it is useful or not, Lagna Sub lord and also Jupiter’s sub lord position is to be seen, as Sub Lord alone is the deciding factor. 
Lagna Sub lord is Saturn in his own star, lord of | Ith and [2th and Jupiter’s sub lord is Mercury, (Mars, the planet in Lagna 
is also in the sub of Mercury) who is also in his own star, and own sub. He is_ lord of 4th and 7th. Both Saturn and Mercury 
are in 8th in the sign of Mars and aspected by Mars by his special aspect of 8th. Thus Saturn, Mercury, Mars and Jupiter are 
all interoven in link to Lagna. 


Saturn is Sub lord for I, 3, 4, 6, 7,9 , 10, 12. As he is in own star he is strong significator for these houses. Saturn’s sub lord 
Venus also in his own star and own sub,Venus also supports Saturn for all these cusps. 6th signification is for service and

Il Away from home place due to profession: The reason for his being away from his home place to far off places is also 
clear. 4th -Bhava is for the native’s home place. Its sub lord is Saturn, lord of | 2th in his own star and also Sub lord of | 2th,

Ill. Feet Affliction: Now, coming to the reasons for his feet affliction and amputation, let us examine in detail Lagna effect

Zodiacal Ist Aeris. According to Kalapurusha, Piscess as | 2th to natural zodiac, the part of the body is Feet. Saturn is sub

A study on Father - 9th or 10 House 
Tin Win 


Tin Win 
tw853@yahoo.com 





Background View 


| According to Maharishi Parashara, the 9th house represents one’s experience of father, while the | Oth 
house governs matters pertaining father. This is how one could have a lot of care from the father even 
while one’s father is facing difficulties. In the Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Ch. | 1: Judgement of 
Houses, father is indicated by the 10th house and Chapter | 2: Effects of Houses, father is indicated by 
the 9th house. The actions of one's father and his place are judged from the tenth house in Varaha Mi- a 
hira: Daivagyna Vallabha, Chapter 2. Umang Taneja’s opinion is to take 9th when native is dependent | 
on father and | 0th when native is not dependent on father. 





2. Cyril Fagan wrote in “Solunars” that the |Oth house signifies the native’s reactions to his father. David said that the 9th 
house is the father as a person, and the | 0th house is what the father does. Jewell Starsinger said that the ninth and the 
fifth houses indicate the father. ln Robert Hand’s experience, the | 0th house does not always signifies one’s biological father 
and neither the 4th nor | Oth signifies either parent consistently. Noel Tyl’s “Four Ways to See the Parents” are Saturn and 
the Node together, the significators of the parental |0-4 angular axis (or 4-10, it makes no difference in this day and age), 
related angles of the horoscope and the Sun and the Moon. (Appendix- |) 


Common Practice in KP & Vedic Astrology 


3. It is a common practice of both KP and Vedic astrologers to consider the 9th house to represent the father and the rea- 
sons are as given under: 


|) In the ancient Hindu culture, one’s father used to give his knowledge to his offspring as a guru. In this light, dhama, pita 
(father) and guru are all seen from the 9th house. 


2) As the 10th house is taken for profession, name, fame, leaving it, the 9th house is taken for father. 


3) Counting the 9th house as the Ist, the 5th there from indicates the native. (However, such counting is not applicable to 
the 4th house of mother.) 


4. It is noted in the KP Readers that it is wrong to take 10th house for father and always to take the 9th house for father, 
and promotion as a result of 10th house is Maraka for the parents. (!Oth is 2nd for 9th and 7th for 4th.) 


5. However, some argue mainly by counting house to house like M.P. Shanmugam that if the 4th house denotes mother, the 
7th from 4th i.e., [Oth would be more appropriate to denote father as taken by the Westerners. 


Controversy in Western Astrology 


6. In fact, there has been a ranging controversy in Western astrology for these last 200 years to which house is which 
parent. Even though modern Western astrology associates the father with the | Oth house (Robert Hand, Robert P Blaschke, 
Amy Maddalozzo, Southern Cross, Cornelia Jones) and as per classical Western astrology, the 4th house rules the father 
(William Lilly, John Partridge, John Gadbury, Charles Jayne, Llewellyn George, Anthony Lewis, Lea Breuer, Serena Powers, Cur- 
tis Manwaring, Bob Marks,AstroGraph SW). Traditionally the father figure is signified by the Sun and Saturn (Ptolemy, al-Biruni, 
Charles Jayne, Robert Hand, Sarah, Helene Schnitzer, Christa Kroll) but for Claudius Dariot , John Gadbury, William Lilly, John 
Partridge, William Ramsey, the Saturn signifies father. In Andrzej Wesotowsk’s opinion, Sun is the significator of father for 
day born and Moon for night born. (Appendix- |) 


7.Alan Leo said of the Sun opposition to Saturn (conjunction as well) that unless in mutual reception, it would be very un- 
fortunate for all things signified by the two planets, bringing misfortunes in business, loss of public favor, likelihood of the 
father’s death, loss of father’s money or separation from or disagreement with him. 


Some Findings 
8. By going through the astrological literature and web sites, it is found that: 


|) The overwhelming majority of both KP and Vedic astrologers considers 9th house for father. (Appendix- 2) 
2) Only some astrologers take | 0th house for father. (Appendix- 3) 


9. Some findings of empirical studies are as given under: 


|) A KP study of 40 charts shows that the lords of Dasa, Bukti and Antara running on the date of death of father better fit 
to the KP death inflicting Badhaka, Maraka and Moksha significators by considering the 9th house for father other than [0th 
house.(Appendix- 4)

2) In a Western Church of Light study of 100 charts regarding death of father as per progressed aspect, it concluded that 
the 4th house rules the father and the |0th house mother. (Appendix- I, no 6) 


3) As per aVedic study of 10 cases by R. Santhanam on “Premature Loss of Father’’, 9th house and Sun for father are valid.

4) AVedic study of 10 cases by Liana Haywath “Casting Father’s Unknown Horoope from Children’s Charts” indicates the

|0.Any strong evidence has not been found to switch the common practice of considering 9th house for father tol Oth

As | am practicing astrology since six years, most of my friends take my advice and ask me to predict 
. This case was solved using Krishnamurti Paddhati method and using only Ruling Planets at the time 
of judgement. 


My friend who works as a sales executive in a reputed surgical company was having problems with his 
executive.As is the case in most marketing companies his executive was not sending him his promotion 
letter to extract more sales. So my friend , who knew that he is being promoted asked me the question 
about him receiving that letter. 





Rules: 


|. Ruling Planets at the time of judgement match at the time of event under consideration. 


2. If the event is to take place within a few days, take the position of moon forward so as to match with the ruling planets 
at TO}. 


| solved this query on 5th dec 2008 at | 7:39:34 at my office nakshatra jyotish sansthan 
Lat:23 N 16 ,Long:77 E 27 taking KP Ayanamsha Value 23:53:30 


Ruling Planets 


Lagna — taurus Shukra — rohini star ie Chandra — Shukra sub 
Chandra-aquarius Shani — shatbisha star ie Rahu Shukra sub 
Day lord — Shukra

.moon next transits in guru sign meena , guru was not among the RPs so | thought to leave this sign. Next was mesha which 
has the star of shukra which was very strong in ruling planets. Now question rise here why | do not select star in Meena 
lagna, as | take in Mesha lagna. Jup and Mar both are not in RP but in Meena lagna we have three star Jup-Mer- Sat, and in 
Mesha lagna we have three star Ketu-Ven-Sun.Ven is very strong in RP so | select Mesha lagna and Ven Star.Also taurus lagna 
was about 22:11’ at the TOJ and three planets Surya Mangal and Budh were exactly opposite to it in the seventh house i.e 
in scorpio. Looking at that mangal was at 19:57’ which is very near to the seventh cusp, so | fixed that when moon transits 
mesha rashi and shukra star my friend will receive that letter i.e on 10th dec 2008.Now to decide moon sub | took rahu 
sub as at TO] moon was in Rahu Star So | fixed it at Mesha Sign Shukra Star & Rahu sub which started from 08:11 IST bhopal 
but during this time transiting lagna was of guru i.e sagitarius as guru was not amongst the RPs , dhanu ascendent will not 
work so | fixed the ascendant to be makar as Shani was amongst the RPs. This ascendant started from 09:25 AM so | fixed 
the time of my friend receiving letter near this time around 09:30.Actually what happened in course of time was very sur- 
prising.On 10 th dec 2008 at 09:30 am when my friend actually went in the verandah his neighbour came upto him and gave

Before | commence this note, | wish to convey my sincere thanks with gratitude to Guru TW for his 
gratuitous suggestion and encouragement together with ten AIDS charts to analyse, which urged me 
to this task. 


AIDS cannot be directly classified as a Venereal and Sexually Transmitted Disease, as it's propagation is 
not limited to only on sexual matters in some cases. For example, any body can be infected with AIDS 
by blood transfusion, a doctor may be a capture while treating a patient of AIDS, an unborn baby may be attacked due to 
the mother's virus and so on. But the main root of the reasons of AIDS has run to the 

sexual engagement environments too. By the way the reason for transmitting is immaterial at this juncture but the infection 
of the ailment is important for astrological aspects. 





AIDS is aViral disease called the HUMAN IMMUNODEFICIENCY VIRUS or HIV.The word "Immunodeficiency" gives us a 
clue to broaden our way of findings the reasons for AIDS. The main reason for a good health and prevention of disease is 
the immune system of the body which is in the blood and it's cells, especially in White Cells. The very famous medical in- 
vestigation of blood, known as WBC & DC, witnessed for this. The cause for Immunodeficiency, should be checked with it's 
controller called Lymphatic System of the human body. So my main opine is to consider the Karakas for Lymphatic System 
and other objects which are syncronised with it. 


Pisces rules Lymphatic System, whereas the Moon governs the lymph. In other words, the | 2th bhava denotes the Lymphatic 
System and 8 bhava for blood clot related to AIDS and 10 for blood impurities. (Medical Astrology for All by K. Subramaniam, 
Rulership Book by Rex Bills) 


Further it is worth to mention that the KP Rule for incurable disease, ie; " If the Sb/L of the 6th cusp is | 2th bhava and be- 
comes a strong significator of 6th and lagna, then the native will definitively suffer from an incurable ailment." (Medical As- 
trology for All) is not matched fully in the charts under study. But the Sb/L of 6th is connected in anyway to the | 2th in 
support of the rule. On this aspects | have lined up the formulary objects as follows.

Comments 








|. Saturn Karaka for chronicle illness has not played a remarkable role in almost all the charts under study. 
2. The 4th house, which denotes the End of Life and one's final Illness, is not a house of signification by the sub 
lord of cusps 6, 8 or [2 in all charts. 3. In the charts No.4 and 7, the sub lord of the 6th cusp does not have any 
direct signification to 6, 8, 10 or [2 but indirectly connected as sub lord and sub sub lord. 4. Aspects and 
conjunctions have not been taken into account in this study as the signification of almost all houses can be 
found always.
