On page 213 of KP Reader Six (Horary Astrology) it is written: 


"What is lottery? It is a gain without pain, bringing casual income. Such an attempt will be made during 
a period of a planet connected to third house. Counted from ascendant third house indicates lottery. 
The query may be for the querist himself or for some relative of friend. If the query is for himself, make 
all calculations from the ascendant. If it is from younger brother or sister, take third house from ascen- 
dant as the ascendant from the younger brother or sister. If it relates to mother , take fourth house. 
To son or daughter take fifth, to wife or partner take seventh. To father take ninth, to elder brother or 
sister take | Ith and find out. 





To know whether one will win at all, judge the | Ith cusp and find out whether the sub lord of the | Ith cusp is either ret- 
rograde or deposited in a constellation whose lord is retrograde. If either is retrograde one cannot win. If sub lord of | Ith 
cusp and its star lord are in direct motion and if sub lord of eleventh cusp is also a significator of 2 or 6 or I 1, then one 
will win.’ 


The querent asks me whether she can win the lottery. 


Horary number- 43 
Place- Manchester 
Date- 8-5-2009, Time -18-38 BST 


Analysis 


The I Ith cusp falls at 22-11 in Aquarius. 

It is Saturn sign, Jupiter star and Saturn sub. 

Sub lord of | Ith cusp is Saturn which is retrograde. 
The rule or condition is not fulfilled. 

Result is NO. 

Actual Result- she does not win. 


Remark: It is a case of retrograde effect in Horary and not fulfilling another necessary condition that | Ith 
cusp sub lord is connected with 3 of lottery. (KP Reader Six page 214; Dr. K.R. Kar on page 71 of K.P. & As- 
trology 1996).

Willl I Pass My Driving Test¢

LUDHIANA

In Manchester, during one TV Live show, my presenter asked me this question, whether I'll pass my 
driving test. To get driving licence, one must pass the written test first and then next step is the driving 
test. This part is more difficult, it makes the person more tense, because in some countries one has to 
deposit hefty amount of money as fee, if one fails in that means losing the money. One can avail as many 
chances as one wishes. But one has to book the test first paying fee of 31 pounds for theory test and 
62 or 7/5 pounds for practical driving test in UK. In US only license fee of $ 45 for most drivers in Mary- 
land state is charged after passing the test. My presenter told me that she already failed in the test. Now 
it is her repeated attempt. 





This type of question is mostly asked in abroad.And in KP for driving test no rule has yet formulated. So it was matter of 
confusion for me to apply any rule. So | decided to follow rules for getting ticket or certificate to get the driving license. 
Because driving license is a permit given to you to drive a vehicle in the form of licence. So third and eleventh are the most 
relevant houses. | applied the following rules. 
| - Whether one has the courage to appear for the driving test? 

For this judge the third house. If the sub lord of the third cusp is Moon, one does not take bold decision and try 

to adjust in the present circumstances. 

If it is Saturn one lacks confidence and will be very cautious, if Mercury the native will be in two minds. 

Planets — Sun- Mars — Jupiter and Venus, gives courage and confidence to appear for the driving test 


2- Whether one will pass through and get driving license? 


Check the third cusp sub lord. If third cusp sub lord signifies 3 or 6 or || house, and I|1Ith cusp sub lord signifies 
3 or6or II house in any manner, then one will get the driving license. 


Example chart 

Horary number given between | — 249 is 10. Date- 28-04 2009, time - 10-08 am, place Manchester. 

Whether one has courage ? 

Checking 3rd cusp sub lord. It is Venus. So she has courage and confidence to appear for the driving test. Signification of 
6,11 by 3rd cusp sub lord also indicates that she is bold enough to take the test. 


Whether she will able to get driving license ? 


Chek the 3rd cusp sub lord. It is Venus.Venus is posited in the star of Saturn. Saturn is lord of || house and posited in 6. 
In this manner sub lord of 3rd cusp Venus is connected to 6 and || houses. 


The second condition is to check | 1th cusp sub lord. If it is connected to 3,6 or || house, then one will be able to get 
driving license or any document. 


| Irth cusp sub lord is Venus.Venus is in Saturn star. Saturn is in 6 and lord of | 1.In this manner,Venus is also connected to 
6 and || houses. 


The test was on 5th of May. On that day Moon was in Sun star.And in the horary chart Sun is a significator of | and 6 by 
occupation and lordship respectively. 


Result- She passed driving test. 
Editor's Note: Although 3rd and | Ith CSL Ven is in the star of retro Sat the result came out favourable.

|. Foreign Going Rule 
I.1. Basic Foreign Going Rule 


|. One can go foreign only if the sub lord of the [2th cusp is connected in any manner with 
house 3 (change of residence) or 9 (long distance travel) or |2 (life in an altogether new envi- 
ronment and separation from family), preferably house 9 during the DBA signifying 3,9, 12 when 
transit agrees.

Il. Foreign Settlement Rule 


LS: One can settle abroad if: 

I) [2th cusp sub lord signifies house 9,3, 12; 

2) Ist cusp sub lord also signifies house 9,3, | 2; 

3) house 3,9,12 are connected to each other for better possibility.

valid in more than two-third of 100 surveyed charts of foreign settlement. 


[5 If Ist and 12th cusp sub lords signify 9,3,12, one can settle in foreign during the DBA signifying 9,3,12. (K.P. 
Muhurat p 77)

foreign settlement as around one-third of 100 surveyed charts is found more or less equally allotted to each of

of Bhatt Narayana) 


18. House 9 has the rational justification because return from abroad will include long journey like going abroad.

by house 2. House 4 is one's permanent residence. Leaving it is shown by house 3 (12th to 4). If a person is

During the KP Astrologers Forum’s fortnightly meeting conducted on |4-June-2009 chaired by 
Dr. VV Mohan., some charts on Medical Astrology were taken up. Two natal charts regarding | 
Mental Retardation were discussed in detail. | 





In medical astrology, Ist house being Thanu Bhava any affliction to this house would lead to dis- 
ability of the relevant karakathawa. Moon is karaka for mind and Mercury is karaka for intelligence, any affliction 
to these planets would lead to impairment of mental faculties. Mental Retardation is a condition diagnosed before 
the age of |8 years that includes below average of skills necessary for daily living otherwise is known as less in- 
telligent quotient. Ist cusp sublord connection to 6 indicates diseases, 8 indicates congenital diseases and |2 in- 
dicates continuous medical care and disabilities. Moon at the time birth gives the clue for congenital diseases. If 
Moon is connected to the above houses at the time of birth, it would give problems at the same time, which is 
known as congenital health problems in medical terms. (“Medical Astrology for All” by Sri K Subramaniam S/o Sri 
KSK Guruji) 


Analysis: 
Chart | — Sri Apple, (Mr) 


(DOB: 31.12.1975, TOB: 04:44 AM, POB: Bagh Amberpet, Hyderabad, AP, Lat.| 7N23, Long.78E30, KPNA 23-25- 
54, Wednesday, Birth Star: Jyesta-3, Rasi: Scorpio, Asc. Scorpio | 6-42-39) 


The native is mentally retarded since birth. Ist cusp sublord Mercury who is also karaka for mental faculties (IQ) 
is /o 8 & I] in 2,in the star of Su and sub of Ju I/o 2. Moon, karaka for mind (mathi) is I/o 9 (Badhaka), in the star 
of Me and sub of Ra in |2. Ist cusp and Mo are conj. by Ve I/o 7 & 12 and aspected by Ma from 7 as I/o 6. Such 
combination at the time of birth strongly indicates Mo’s connection to Maraka, Badhaka, 6, 8 & |2 causing con- 
genital mental disability. The native suffered meningial fever and fits in childhood which had made irreparable dam- 
age to mental faculties. 


Chart 2 — Sri Banana (Mr) 


(DOB: 12.03.1981, TOB: 22:13 PM, POB: Bagh Amberpet, Hyderabad, AP Lat.|7N23, Long.78E30, KPNA 23-30- 
16, Thursday, Birth Star: Mrigasira-|, Rasi: Taurus, Asc. Libra 23-02-02). 


At the time of birth the native was a normal child but Moon in Ma-Ma as I/o 2 and 7 and Dasa lord at birth Ma 
in Ju-Ra which is agent of Mo (karaka for mind in 8) caused a head injury and consequently mental damage to be- 
come mentally retarded. Ist cusp sublord Sa is in | | (Badhaka) as I/o 4 & 5, in the star of Mo (karaka for mind in 
8) and sub of Ju who is in II l/o of 3& 6 establishing a strong connection to Mo through Mo star. 8th cusp 
sublord Venus is I/o | & 8 in orb of 5, in Ju-Sa is also connected to Mo in 8. 6th cusp sublord Rahu (agent of Mo) 
in 9, in Sa-Ju, connected to Mo has also made the problem of mind.

Economy 
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zimbabwe#Economy 


Zimbabwe maintained positive economic growth throughout the 1980s (5.0% GDP growth per 
year) and 1990s (4.3% GDP growth per year). However, the economy declined from 2000:5% @ 
decline in 2000, 8% in 2001, 12% in 2002 and 18% in 2003.The government of Zimbabwe faces ‘ 
a variety of economic problems after having abandoned earlier efforts to develop a market-oriented economy. 
Problems include a shortage of foreign exchange, soaring inflation, and supply shortages. Zimbabwe's involvement 
from 1998 to 2002 in the war in the Democratic Republic of the Congo drained hundreds of millions of dollars 
from the economy. 





Inflation rose from an annual rate of 32% in 1998 to an IMF estimate of 150,000% in December 2007,[citation 
needed] and to an official estimated high of 23 1,000,000% in July 2008 according to the country's Central Statistical 
Office,. This represented a state of hyperinflation, and the central bank introduced a new 100 billion dollar note.As 
of November 2008, unofficial figures put Zimbabwe's annual inflation rate at 516 quintillion per cent, with prices 
doubling every |.3 days. Zimbabwe's inflation crisis is now (2009) the second worst inflation spike in history, 
behind the hyperinflationary crisis of Hungary in 1946, in which prices doubled every 15.6 hours. By 2005, the 
purchasing power of the average Zimbabwean had dropped to the same levels in real terms as 1953.Local resi- 
dents have largely resorted to buying essentials from neighbouring Botswana, South Africa and Zambia. 


Private enterprise in Zimbabwe has weakened lately. Government spending is 56.4 % of GDP. It has partly been 
financed by printing money, which has led to hyperinflation. State enterprises are strongly subsidized, taxes and 
tariffs are high. State regulation is costly to companies, starting or closing a business is slow and costly. 


The labor market is highly regulated, hiring a worker is cumbersome, firing a worker is difficult and the unem- 
ployment has risen to 80 % (2005). Since 2000 president Mugabe has confiscated lands of white farmers, and this 
former net exporter of grain has now been plagued by hunger. The country has a high level of corruption. 


Currently one United States Dollar is equal to 37,456,777 Zimbabwe Dollars.

A Terrible Acciden 





Story of the Accident 


Mr. Saman is a toddy taper by profession and he used to climb up a large number of Jaggery 
Palm (Kitul) trees for a day for tapping. On the 30th March 2009, as usual he started his worka- 
day life of tapping and climbed up a tree at about | 1:15 a.m.and started to tap with his sharp 
knife. 





Suddenly he slipped off his leg from the branch where he was sitting and loosed his both hand 
and felt down from the tree on to a shrub under the tree, where he got damaged to his face.A piece of stick of 
the shrub has collided with his left cheek and has penetrated into the inner flesh of the face under the nasal 
bone and reached up to the lower area of the right eye. He was taken to the hospital by the neighbors with the 
broken piece of stick in his cheek. The surgeons had removed a | 3cm piece of stick from his cheek and saved his 
life from this terrible accident. 


Rules 


|. lf the sub lord of the ascendant is deposited in the constellation of the signifcator of the 8th house, he will meet 
with accident. If the sub lord of the ascendant is the significator of |2th house, he may be admitted in a hospital. 
Death is indicated only by significators of Marakasthana and Badhkasthana. (KP Reader VI page 1|55) 


2. The sub lord of the 8th house is to be deposited in the constellation of the planet which is the significator of 
8th house. If the significator happens to be also the significator of the 6th house, then he will have fever, etc., fol- 
lowing the accident. If the same sub lord is the significator of the |2th, he will be admitted in a hospital. If the 
sub lord happens to be the signficator of Badhaka Sthana and Maraka Sthana, he will succumb to it, provided his 
longevity not further more promised. If the longevity is promised, he will get over this, and the condition of the 
patient would be threatening. Some may be unconscious; some may be given blood transfusion and also oxygen. 
Therefore we have to judge both longevity and also the duration of disease. (KP Reader VI page | 59) 


3. If the sub lord of the Asc., 8th or | 2th cusp, be the significators (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 8 or 
|2, the native is likely to meet with an accident. If the sub lord of the Asc., 8th or | 2th cusp, be the significators 
(in the star of the occupant or owner) of |, 5 or || the native surpasses the danger, during the joint period of 
the significators of I,5,1 1. (Further Light of Nakshastra Chinthamani of Mr. C.R. Bhatt page 35) 


4.Accidents will take place during the DBA periods of the sub lords of the Trigonal 4-8-12 houses. (Kudanthai 
Nathan in Astrosecrets and KP part Il page 94)

A reader asks about rulership of sports which is not included in the KP House Grouping articles 
published in this magazine. 


5th house governs sports. 

lf 5th cusp sub lord signifies 6,1 1,5,10, one can be successful in sports. 

| Ith cusp sub lord signification of 6,11,5,10 is also important, especially in Horary. 
6 is for success in competition and profits from sports. 

4 (12th to 5 or 10th to opponent 7) is for losses in competitive sports. 

Here 2 (10th from 5) also indicates one’s reputation regarding sports, in addition to monetary gain. 

General karaka for sports is Sun; karaka for competitive sports is Mars; and karaka for non-com- 
petitive sports is Jupiter.

This book moves the readers cogently, clearly and step-by-step through the process of calculating the most as-

Though this book deals with Muhurat, it has also significant principles of choosing the required cuspal sub-lords 
and house grouping for around 80 events and activities according to the matters of | to XII Bhava which are 
useful in prediction by natal or horary chart. 


In summary, the author has made a valuable contribution to the evolution of the Muhurat method for the benefit 
of KP learners.

One senior citizen from Gujarat was worried for his 2 sons, as the elder was not allowing the 
younger one to flourish in the joint business and was coming his way. The father was too wor- 
ried and he telephoned me to look if there could be a solution to this stalemate between his 
sons, as this was affecting his peace of mind. 


He had sent his birth chart only to me to examine the compatibility issues between his Ist son 
(2nd issue) and the 2nd son (3rd issue). 





The birth chart of the father is presented as follows. The chart was rotated to /th house to rep- 
resent the 2nd child (Ist son). From this chart, the 3rd house would represent his 2nd son. 


The Query 


The chart was taken up for study on April 29,2009 when Moon was transiting the Rahu’s star (Aridra). Considering 
that Rahu disposes Saturn and Moon, the planets disposed by Moon were considered as Rahu, Saturn and Moon. 


lt was noticed that Rahu was the cuspal sub-lord of lagna (Ist son’s), Moon was the cuspal sub-lord of 3rd cusp 
(2nd son) and Saturn was the cuspal sub-lord of the | 1th cusp (harmony). 


With the above, | took the query to be genuine and proceeded for further analysis. 
Analysis of the chart 
|. Look from the Ist son’s side 


In the rotated chart, lagna (Aries 29-15-47) represent the Ist son and the 2nd son is represented by the 3rd cusp 
(Gemini 29-48-29). 


Various aspects between them are analysed as below. 


a. Rahu is the lagna sub-lord of Ist son, which decides the primary drive of the native. Rahu placed in 2nd house 
falls in the star of Jupiter placed in 9th house as | Ith lord, thus Rahu signifies 9-2-| 1th houses and is very good 
for the native to advance well in the business and earn heftily. 


b. The 3rd cuspal sub-lord Moon (indicating his younger brother) is strong as it does not have any planet in its 
star, thus its placement will matter the most. Note that Moon is placed in | 2th house, indicating that his younger 
brother’s presence in the business would mean loss to him. This is exactly the perception (Moon), which is reg- 
istered in his mind. 


c. Examine 3rd cuspal sub lord Moon at the stellar level, where Moon falls in the star of Venus placed in 2nd 
house with its sub lord Saturn placed in 6th house as |O0th lord. This makes the Ist son to get benefited by the 
professional involvement of his younger brother. Thus, he may have wanted his younger brother to be hanging with 
him for his own professional ongoing (2-6-| 0th house) whereas not considering his worth by way of the pre-con- 
ceived notion (Moon in | 2th house as cuspal sub-lord of 3rd cusp). 


d. Looking to the | 0th cusp, the cuspal sub lord is Ketu, which falls in the star of Venus (signifying 2-6-7th house) 
and sub of Saturn (signifying 6-9- 10-1 Ith houses), thus promising him luck of professional success. The placement 
of Ketu in 8th house could have given him the hold on father’s business as inheritance. 


e. Thus, it is observed that the Ist son had a good luck for advancing in the business. 


In the Saturn dasha, which had been running since 19 years, he must have progressed well in advancing the business 
and earning heavily, as Saturn lords the | Oth house, gets placed in the star of | 1th lord Jupiter with the support 
of sub lord Venus placed in 2nd house as 6th lord. Thus, Saturn dasha must have been a boon to him. 


2. Look from the 2nd son’s side 


3rd cusp (Gemini 29-48-29) is being considered as the Lagna of the 2nd son and the delineation in this section 
is worded accordingly (Lagna means 3rd cusp) and all other cusps are seen with reference to this lagna cusp.

signifies house 2,5,| I.

2,5,11.

Introduction 


One of my friend’s son is studying in a lycee, appeared for the French diploma Baccalaureat. Him- 
self and his friends expecting ““Mension Bien” and were curious to know the result early. So, | 
have applied the K.P Horary techniques to study and told them the result in advance. | would 
like to present the process | have used together with the results in this paper. In addition to as- 
trology, | am presenting the additional information for the readers who are not familiar with the French education 
system. 





French education system 


The French diploma Baccalaureat created in 1808 is the final examination at the end of the high school education 
and also an entry into higher studies in the university. The school where the students study is called lycee and 
first started in 1802 by Napoleon Bonaparte. The French education is free and open to all. 


In 2009, 622322 candidates from 4537 lycees appeared for the examination and about 78.6% got their diploma. 
Each candidate has to write the examination in 9 subjects and the scores are averaged to 20 (like 100 in India). 
One has to obtain 10 over 20 (50%) to have the diploma. Different ranks are given based on the score obtained: 


. Mention « Assez bien » (Fairly well) :Average superior or equal |2 and inferior 14; 
° Mention « Bien » (Good) :Average superior or equal |4 and inferior 16; 
° Mention « Tres bien» (Very good):Average superior or equal 16. 


One of my friend’s son is studying in a lycée in the city of Versailles very close to the Chateau (Palace) de Versailles 
(The Palace is one of the most beautiful achievements of | 8th-century French art. The site began as Louis XIll’s 
hunting lodge before his son Louis XIV transformed and expanded it, moving the court and government of France 
to Versailles in 1682. The palace attracts more than 10 million visitors per year). My friend’s son and his friends 
know me as studying astrology and they are eager to know their result through astrological techniques. 


Almost 100% of the students from this lycée pass the examination and so they are more interested if they obtain 
the result with Mention Bien (more than or equal to |4).All the five students asked me the question, are expecting 
Mention Bien.

Pluto is Not Always Malefic 





Background 


|. Since its discovery in 1930, Pluto has been a bit of a puzzle because of its small size, far dis- 
tance and irregular orbit. Pluto cannot be seen without a telescope. On August 24, 2006, Pluto 
was stripped of his planetary distinction and formally classified as a dwarf planet at the meeting 
of the International Astronomical Union, the recognized authority in naming heavenly objects, ® /* 
attended by the 2,500 astronomers from 75 countries in Prague. » 





2. Indian mathematical astrologer Mangal Prasad said the decision to drop Pluto as a planet had endorsed the 
mathematical and astrological treatises written by Aryabhatta and Varahamihira in the sixth century during the 
golden period of the Guptas. However, astrologers like Robert Hand, Madalyn Hillis-Dineen, Dave Roell, Bejan 
Daruwalla and Ravi K Goyal were unfazed by the news of that decision. 


3. The limited information on Pluto has delayed a realistic understanding of its characteristics. The Pluto is not men- 
tioned and not applied at all in the KP Readers. 
Western Experience 


4. Largely thanks to the books of Jeffrey Green, his daughter Deva Green and their spiritual mentor, Paramahansa 
Yogananda, Pluto is known as the evolutionary engine in the astrological chart. Jeffrey Green said that Pluto was 
where astrologers could begin to mange the mystery of soul, appreciate the sense of journey within evolution.A 
positive side of Pluto found by Robert Hand is that a fairly common Plutonian profession is physical therapy or 
psychotherapy. (Essays on Astrology, page 46) 


5. The nature of Pluto is similar to that of Hindu god Shiva, the creator and destroyer.As Pluto transits a house, 
it begins to bring deep transformation to that house and it's issues and the first step is destruction of anything 
that needs it. One can expect vast changes in that area of life and it is important not to try to prevent the energies 
of transformation as it is a part of our evolutionary growth. (Planets in Transit, page 477) A Pluto transit of the 
2nd house has the possibility of changing one's entire perception of material possessions as well as the spiritual 
values and the deeper meaning of life. 


6. In the lives of individuals Pluto transits will bring up issues that have long been buried or repressed, providing 
an opportunity for resolution and release, and — ultimately — for healing and transformation. Pluto brings us face 
to face with our obsessions and compulsions. Carl Jung said that when an inner situation is not made conscious, 
it happens outside as fate ie.a description of how Pluto transits work in the lives of the great mass of humanity. 


7.\n the birth chart, Pluto shows the area of life where one will personally face the intense powers of creation 
and destruction. [he house position of Pluto is key to understanding which area of life will enact the most dramatic 
transformation. Natal Pluto in the |0th house indicates someone who has leadership potential, ambition and is 
likely to have transformative career changes that seem in hindsight to be completely new chapters. 


8.As an outer planet, Pluto's influence is generational, transiting a sign about every |3-1/2 years. For an individual 
chart, Pluto signifies generational tendencies and must be considered in its relation to the chart holder's other 
signs and planets. Pluto’s transit is immensely powerful within an orb of 0- 1° and may be negligible otherwise. 
(Judith Hill, page 59) 


9. Pluto's sign, position and astrological aspects give clues to a person's destiny. Individuals with a well-placed Pluto 
can exercise power over others, or enjoy great wealth.A badly aspected Pluto can cause misery and torment. But 
destiny is still an issue. Great goodness and great evil live under Pluto's influence. Its two extremes are best sym- 
bolized by Hitler and Gandhi, each man possessed of a vision that he manifested in physical reality. Both men had

During the KP Astrologers Forum’s fortnightly meeting conducted on |2-july-2009 chaired by | 
Sri Rajendra Nimje IAS., somr charts on Medical Astrology were taken up. Three natal charts 
regarding Epilepsy were discussed in detail. | 


Most astrologers consider Epilepsy a mental disease, as many of the same planetary influences 
which cause Insanity also this disease. Medical authorities class it as a nervous disease, with loss 
of consciousness, and with tonic and clonic convulsions. Some writers say that Epilepsy is due 
to abnormality of one of the Ductless glands, the Pineal gland. 





Epilepsy is best regarded as the symptoms of some underlying brain dysfunction, which causes gross misbehaviour 
of brain cells, either at a specific place (focal epilepsy), or more widely (generalised epilepsy). 


This misbehaviour causes physical consequences, like the loss of consciousness, or loss of muscle control. These 
physical consequences are called epileptic fits (aka seizures or convulsions). 


In Medical astrology Ascendant (health, head), 5th cusp (house of mind), 6th cusp (disease), Mercury (conscious- 
ness) and Moon (karaka for mind) are be analysed for Epilepsy/ Fits. (“Astrological Diagnosis of Diseases” by Sri 
K Hariharn S/o Sri KSK Guruji pp 95-101) 

lt was also brought by Sri T Seshagiri Rao, Vice President of KPAF Hyderabad that any affliction of Venus would 
also leads to the above disease as Bharani star in Aries head is connected to Epilepsy n Fits.

Question: 


On July 10,2009 one more property (office space) was purchased by the person who asks this 
question.As per his chart (25 Feb 1961, 4:22 IST, 21N37, 71E14), there is no 4,1 1,12 indication 
at all by the running Dasa lord, how it is possible? 





Period DBAS lords are Me-Me-Sa-Mo. 

Me(2, 7-9), in the star of Ra(8), in the sub of Ra(8).Rahu is in the sign of Sun, Su(2), 
Me(2, 7-9), in the star of Ra(8), in the sub of Ra(8). 

Sat+(1, 2), in the star of Su(2), in the sub of Ju+(1, |-3). 

Mo+(6, 8), in the star of Ra(8), in the sub of Sat(I, 2). 


As per 4 step: 

Planet Me: 

Starlord of Me is Ra: 8; Sgl Su(2); Stl Ke(2, Sgl Saf, Cnj Ju{l, Asp 5,Asp 9}, Asp 3]) 
Sublord of Me is Ra: 

Starlord of Ra is Ke: 2; Sgl Sa(1, Cnj Ju[1,Asp 5,Asp 9],Asp 3); Stl Ra(8, Sgl Su[2]) 


Runing Dasa lord does not signfy 4,1 1,12. How he is able to buy property? 

Answer: 

|. In this case, the general rule of 4,1 1,12 to purchase or construct a property is found not working. 

2. If the purchased property is not a new building, 6 and 9 are also to be judged as 6 is |2 for 7 which stands for 
the seller, and 9 is |2 to 4 counted from 7. So it is necessary for 6 and 9 to operate for taking possession of the 
property purchased. (KP Reader Ill, New Edition page 242, Old Edition Practical Part page 83; KP & Astrology 1996 
page 105,Astrosecrets & KP Part | page 142 and Part Ill page 46; K Hariharan:A New Light on Jyothisha page 83) 
In this context, 9 is signified by Dasa lord Mercury. 

3.2 is possession or acquisition of property. (KP & Astrology 1996 page 105; Sublord Speaks-2 page 29; Sublord 
Speaks-3 pages 29 and 85; 2,4,| | to own a house in KP Reader VI page 272) Dasa lord Mercury signification of 
2 is in line with this view. 


4. It may therefore need to consider 6,9 and 2 along with 4,1 1,12 in the purchase of property already constructed.

Late Shri Suresh Ramchandra Shahasane was one of the prominent as- 
trologers who contributed a lot to impart knowledge of astrology. He 
was a wondertul astrologer, teacher and writer. His two books on KP- 
Jyotish Rahasya: Krishnamurti Padhati in two parts, published in Hindi 
| are asset for astrologers. He defined every rule with simplicity and in 
such a manner that anyone who wants to learn astrology, especially 
KP astrology in Hindi can become confident astrologer by reading his 
books. 


In Ludhiana, we invited him to conduct a workshop on KP astrology. He 
was here for three days, in those three days he delivered lectures on 
different topics and everyday he spoke |0 hours continuously in per- 
| fect manner, explaining the charts, applying the rules. The proof of his 
expertise was that no listener got tired during his lectures. He ex- 
plained everything in such an interesting and scientific manner that 
even after listening him for 10 hours, persons who were attending 
workshop wants more from him. | also learn many things from him. 
Whenever I ask for help, he was always available. | am grateful for 
everything he had done for me in understanding astrology. 





Now Suresh ji have been passed away, it is a big loss for astrology. 
Though he is not with us, his published work will always show the path 
like light house to learners, researchers and astrologers. 

Date of Birth: 30th May 1949 
Reached Heavenly Abode: 26th July 2009 


My Guruji, Param Pujya Shri Suresh Sahasneji (A Humble Shradhanjali) 


as we all know has been one of the great exponents of KP (Krishnamurti Padhdhati) 
astrology today in India. He was born in 1949 in Maharashtra, Thane district. He had developed keen interest 
and started learning astrology since the days he was in service from his days of early youth. He learnt KP from 
his Guru Shri Pandit Jyotindra Hasbe whom he met in | 982-83, who was himself a direct student of the originator 
of KP Shri Krishnamurti ji himself. In his journey of astrology Shri Sahasneji had taught about 10000 students all 
over Maharashtra and India and done many workshops too which have been remembered with awe and respect. 
In 1992 he published his great book “KrishnaMurthy Jyotisha rahaysa” in Marathi (and now in Hindi and Gujarati 
too) which is like a Bible for beginners and experts alike, to the lovers of the KP system. He has also written 
‘“Bhavasdhan, Ephemris, Krishnamurthy Jyotish Ved, which have reached the corners of Maharshtra to all those 
serious learners of this Padhdhati. 


Sadly for us, he had left us for his heavenly abode now, on the 26th of July 2009 leaving a huge legacy of his knowl- 
edge and thousands of students who will carry forward his teaching for the welfare and good of the mankind 
around us.A very short age for him to leave us but even God needs good men over there, near Him. 


| relate below now, my personal experiences with him. 


My first encounter with Him 

lt was someday in the month of March 2006 and | was awake at mid night casually surfing the net for some KP 
astrologers from whom | could learn to predict through KP system. | got an entry with Shri Sahasnes name, 
along with his telephone number on some websites, which | wrote on a slip of paper and kept for future use. Next 
day at office | called him and he spoke very warmly and re-assured me not to worry about his fees etc. but to 





August 2009 KP-Ezine A4 





join the course. From then on my journey of association with this great man began. 
Admission to English Class 


He was running Marathi class which | was not interested in joining and so | asked him to take a class in Hindu- 
English which he readily agreed. But we had only 5 students for the same. Shri Sahasneji was accustomed to 50 
students at a time in his Marathi class, but | must say with all credit to this master that he did not care for the 
number of students, did not care for the paltry sum of fees he received which was barely able to cover his 
monthly expenses of traveling to the class from his home. He did not care for the time he spent on us, but he 
surely cared for the imparting and sharing of knowledge to eligible students, which is why he came regularly to 
teach us privileged few. Privileged because he could have easily opted out of this with any number of excuses but 
he did not, rather did his work most enthusiastically. 


My Experience in his Classes 


We used to meet every Saturday evening for 2 hours near Dadar station in a school class room booked for that 
purpose. | must say that we 5 students and our experience with this Great Master had given me the best mem- 
ories of one full year of Saturday evenings spent in learning and enjoying the knowledge imparted to us by this 
gentle Teacher. | remember he was always in time for the class, came in heavy rains or any rough train schedules. 
He was always cheerful whenever communicating with us, always allowing us to ask questions whenever we had 
any doubts. But this does not mean that he was not strict when required. | remember he had asked us to purchase 
a Panchang from outside which was costing just Rs 30. He got angry after two weeks of instructing still it was 
noticed that 3 of the students had not done so, and were sharing from others during the class. He was blunt in 
saying that next time if he did not see their own Panchangs, they could leave the class, and he was not interested 
with those non serious students. He was a complete practical Teacher and not just theoretical. ln a span of 2 hours 
he would take up 3 charts, himself draw all of them one by one, noting the cuspal positions along with their 
sublords, planetary positions too along with their sublords, and he never tired of taking 3 charts per class and 
discussing on same.Within 5 minutes he could put the whole chart along with the positions on the black board. 
We had interactive sessions in our learning.After teaching us the basics, it was all total a great learning process 
for us. He would put a chart and ask us to locate the profession of the native or predict the marriage date or 
the divorce date etc.And the "why" of the answer was discussed of, eventually. We had certain Saturdays just for 
discussions unlike in other institutes of astrology where the professors shy away from too much of questioning. 


His astrological prowess 


This was unmatched to any one as far as | know among the astrologers using certain forms of astrological tradi- 
tions and not into spiritually sought predictive inputs. He could tell within seconds the sublord of any Horary num- 
ber between |-249. He taught us certain techniques wherein one does not have to even erect a chart, but just 
tell the answer from the number chosen by the querent. He was an expert in the qualities of the nature of the 
answer given, in so far as explaining the predictions were concerned. For instance if a marriage was predicted, he 
could tell from the planets appearing in the equations what quality of marriage could be expected, the nature of 
the spouse, the characteristics to be expected, and almost every minute details too. He was an expert in the Ruling 
Planets theory and taught us to predict again without the use of paper and pencil, how to predict with the Ruling 
Planets. One of his classes was a heavenly event to watch, because with just one set of Ruling Planets he rectified 
5 birth times with just a chalk and the blackboard with no use of calculator or any such means or access, and 
they were live predictions given on the birth times of the students present in the class.So one had to believe and 
marvel at his class. One just had to tell him that a person was born on so and so date in the evening or in the 
morning, and that was enough for him.With the Ruling Planets at time of judgement he could come out with the 
correct Lagna, Star Lord, Sub Lord and also the SubSub Lord. This is something which has to be seen to believe, 
which now unfortunately we cannot witness again. 


Humility personified. 


| have never seen such a wise astrologer but yet a humble man. During the days we were associated with him 
and learning, certain facets opened up before us, of his great personality and character which we try as hard to 


August 2009 KP-Ezine 45 








emulate, would still not be able to come up to his levels. | remember at times when students could not pay the 
paltry sum of fees which was Rs. 200 per month, he never asked for the same, instead told them not to bother 
but just continue learning and pay whenever they could. He never charged us for the Xerox copies of notes he 
used to give us frequently. Whenever he could not reply to a certain query which was very rare, he would say “‘ 
do not know, when you find out let me know". He never said that he had the perfect learning, instead he told us, 
students to always consistently check the results and the analysis and keep on studying where we had made a 
mistake and try to correct it the next time. He explained that the more number of charts one takes for study; 
the better he gets to learn. He did not believe much in the mathematical or theory part, though himself an expert 
in same, but laid emphasis on the practical day to day astrology. He said that most of the Softwares were giving 
the proper calculations, and a student must spend more time on learning how to evaluate and analyze a chart, 
and then check the predictions. He also taught us certain techniques on predicting for share markets, lottery and 
such, but forbade us never to use this for earning money. He himself used these techniques a few times but 
always donated the money earned from such use of astrology.Another important point he taught us was - an as- 
trologer should never rely only on just his astrological income to run his home, but should know through his own 
horoscope what are the areas through which he can earn, and use those areas for further wealth creations 
through the proper knowledge and use of transits. Further he taught us never to waste time on controversies 
or try to explain to non believers. He said just leave them to their theories and work upon one’s own learning. 
Our last Saturday of learning at the end of the year was an emotional one.After the class got over, | asked him 
to please take another Year of Advanced KP or whatever he preferred. He replied "| do not want to give spoon 
feeding to my students. |! want them to learn how to swim in the water. | would always be there. But they should 
themselves be able to solve problems on their own". (I realize the words of the Great Guru today, for we have 
certainly managed to keep ourselves afloat on water, if not swim.) 


As a professional astrologer 


He was the only astrologer whom | have seen up till date who never cared for the fees but always cared for the 
contentment of the person coming to him for consultations. On few occasions when | visited him with problems 
of my own, or took along with some relatives for consultations, and if ever | offered him a Rs. 500- note or a 
Rs.1000- note and left, he would call me back immediately in a stern voice, and return me back 80% of the fees 
paid to him, with a smile and a small reprimand.And if | hesitated to take it back, he would insist and reprimand 
me again. Such a great person was he. 


When our learning with him got over and he invited us for the ceremony for the handing over to us of the 
"Nakshatra Jyotish Ratna" certificate, it was a great day for us, students. He had arranged for snacks, tea and a 
CD with some Softwares for us. We enjoyed seeing the crowd of the students as there was a mix of students 
from both his English and Marathi classes | was the only student from the English class present that day, and 
when my turn came and had to say some words on the podium | welled with emotions and offered my tribute 
to this great man with gratitude in my heart and tears in my eyes. For | knew, | would never be allowed to 
associate in the same manner with him again, and we had to part ways in our respective paths in this world. (| 
can write a thousand pages on him, but this is not the place and time to do so.) 

His smiling and cheerful countenance | could never forget, for that is not possible. He is too much ingrained in 
our psyches now. It is just a matter of time, and an "n" number of years before we meet on the heavenly paths 
again. But till then, | promise to carry out my Guru's work and share his knowledge to those who require it, and 
with the same spirit of always "Giving" and "never holding back knowledge". 

May the Great Lord grant My Guruji the everlasting peace he richly deserves, and may My Guru bless me and 
the thousands he had taught, to carry out our duties with honesty, integrity and faithfulness which he himself pos- 
sessed and shared in abundance with us, fortunate. 


With Pranams, fond remembrances, and a heart full of gratitude to one of the Greatest Masters. 
A humble shishya, 
Bhaskar Jyotish.

| was shocked to hear the sad news that Shri A R Raichur ji is no more with us at the age of 86 years and I0 
days. He was our guardian, guide and great KP scholar, co-author of the Universal Table of Houses and Krishna- 
murti’s Prediction by Horary Astrology: Scientific Tables of Houses for All, and first KP SW developer. He had 
also supported K. Baskaran’s Principles of Cuspal Interlinks (KB) book by his KP SW and advocated the Four Step 
Theory in English. 


He had dedicated his long term service to KP till the last moment, he could operate the internet a few months 
ago, in the KP & Astrology magazine, the KP discussion groups, KP-Ezine magazine etc. He was a sincere and hon- 
est man by saying that the Lahiri Ayanamsa was used in the UTOH while controversy of ayanamsa was going on,

to work with sub-sub lords. 


| am grateful to him for his sharing of KP knowledge, guidance and encouragement for research on KP rules that 
helped me a lot to learn KP. | ask for his forgiveness from his heavenly abode for having different views in some 
issues. We will miss him. But let me quote Mr.Atal Behari Vajpayee that the sun has set, by yet the shadows of 
the stars we must find out our way. The concepts, which he created, will be still guiding our study of KP. 

Most heartfelt condolences to his bereaved family! May his soul rest in peace! - TinWin

party, due to this situation | am curious to know what is the fate of Nepal.

Who will rule the country?

|) If Asc Sub lord (Tendency of people of country) signifies 6(Military Dictatorship), | |(gain), then the power 
comes in the hand of Military or a Dictator.

of Religious leaders.

Asc sublord is Ven.Vet+(4, 4-5-9), no planet in the star of Ven and Ven is CSL of I, in the star of Mo(I, 7), in the sub

ments), | | (gain), then the power comes in hand of a Democratic Government. 


Asc sublord is Ven. Vet+(4, 4-5-9),no planet in the star of Ven and Ven is CSL of I, in the star of Mo(I, 7), in the 
sub of Mo(I, 7).Asc Sub lord signifies 4, so the power comes in hand of a Democratic Government. 


3) If Asc Sub lord (Tendency of people of country) signifies 9(Religious leader), | | (gain), then the power comes 
in hand of Religious leaders. 


Asc sublord is Ven.Ve+(4, 4-5-9),no planet in the star of Ven and Ven is CSL of I, in the star of Mo(I, 7), in the sub 
of Mo(I, 7). Asc Sub lord signifies 9, so there is a chance of Religious leaders. 


Now we check the running dasa: 


Ju(12, 2-12), in the star of Su(4), in the sub of Mo(I, 7). 
No 6 and 9 but 4 signification in dasa shows only chance for democratic government in Nepal. 


My opinion: 
There is no chance of Maoists rule in Nepal.And democracy will be continued.

This case belongs to one of my friend from Delhi who was working in a management position 
in Government and was aspiring for the top post of the company. His application for this post 
was put on hold by the inimical action of one of the contender for the same post who was all 
set to get the post by hook or crook through ministerial influence. The native had floated a rep- 
resentation for the administrative injustice happening to him. 


| received a call from him on Feb | 1, 2009 at about 2 PM who was curious to know bluntly (ie, 
whether he would become the MD of the company. The post was to be finalized by July 04, 2009. 





| casted the time chart to assess the outcome of his query. 
Coordinates of judgment 


Lagna in this chart represents the native and /th the competitor. 3-9th cusps indicate the initiatives/representations 
floated by the native/competitor. 


The prospects in a horary chart relating to the profession are primarily governed by the IQH, as this house 
decides the way the flow of karma takes place for matters relating to profession. The 6th house indicates the in- 
imical action and the litigation raised thereby. 


lt may be noted that the analysis of cusps of various houses along with the planetary significations represent the 
fixed promises of the chart but the results are dispensed by the suitable dasha-bhukti in consonance with the tran- 
sits. 


The Query 


In the time chart, Moon is lord of 3rd house and placed in 3rd house but almost conjoined with 4th cusp within 
16 minutes. 3rd house signification indicates the matter pertained to some sort of initiative/action/representation 
by the native. Moon is placed in the star of Venus placed in | 0th house indicate the matter of the query to be re- 
lated to professional concern. 


With the above, | took the chart OK to proceed for further analysis. 


Analysis of the chart 


¢ Look at the promise indicated by the lagna. 


Saturn is the lagna sub-lord, which falls in the star of lagna lordVenus placed in the | Oth house indicating the desire 
for the native (Lagna) to seek the desired job position (10th house). Saturn is a weak owner of 9-|0th houses 
while the star lord Venus lords |-6th houses. Thus sub-lord Saturn practically signifies |0-4-|-6 houses and and 
Ath signification is not for gain. Saturn falls in the sub of Ketu placed in 2nd house, which seems a favorable bid 
but Ketu is aspected by Mars, Mercury and Jupiter from 8th house. 


Sub-lord Ketu disposes Moon (sign lord) and Saturn (star lord). Moon signifies |0-3-6th houses whereas Saturn, 
as described above, signifies |0-4-|-6th houses. 


In short, the indications of Lagna have some hope of the job position subject to other factors. 
¢ Look at the indications of 10th cuspal sub-lord. 


|Oth cuspal sub-lord is retro-Saturn and as per the analysis above, though it does signify |0-1-6th houses, it yet 
does not show a definitive promise to get the position because of the planetary retrogression. 


¢ Look at the 6th cusp 


In the scenario of some inimical action against native’s interest, 6th cusp may be evaluated for the outcome of 
the litigation caused thereby. 


Sun is the cuspal sub-lord of the 6th cusp, which falls in the star of Mars placed in 8th house causing an impediment

Rule: 


(1) When there is the influence of Venus, Tula rashi and 7th cusp predominantly in the DBAS, one has to face kidney 
related problems. 


(2)When there is influence of watery sign on planet itself, star lord & sub lord, one has to face major kidney 
problem. 


(3)When there is 8, | 2th house signification along with Mar’s influence in the DBAS, one has to go for transplan- 
tation or operation. 


Rule for Success in Transplantation 


When the donor’s blood (Karaka Ma and Mo) and bonemarrow (Karaka Ma) accept native’s Ist (self) and 5th 
(immune system) cusps, then there is dawn of hope for success.We need not to forget the two leaders, the Dasa- 
Bhukti, which can drive the doctors to the way for either success or failure of the operation. 


Dasa Lord:Venus (up to 14/9/2016) 


Ve is in the star of Ra and sub of Mo. No planet is in Ve star and it is a strong significator 3rd house by lordship 
of this cusp.Ve (2,5-10) signifies both Maraka (2nd house) and improvement from illness (5th house). Ve itself is 
a watery planet.Ve is aspected by Ma (cause for operation, transplantation and | 1th Badhaka lord).Ve is in star 
of Ra in | Ith Badhaka house, also signifying 9th house by its star lord Me. Star lod Ra is conjoined by | Ith Badhaka 
lord Ma. Ra is in the watery sign. Sub lord Mo (7,7) is Maraka and an indicator of kidney problem, Mo itself is a 
watery planet and also situated in the watery sign. Hence Dasa lord Ve indicates the kidney trouble and going 
abroad for possible successful operation. 


Bhukti Lord: Jupiter (up to 14/7/2009) 


Ju is in the star of Ke and sub of Ra. No planet is in Ju star and Ju is the sub lord 4,5,6,10,1 1 and 12 cusps. Thus 
Ju (7,3-12) indicates hospitalization, going abroad for medical treatment, anxiety and misery. Star lord Ke is in 5th 
house for success of operation. Ke’s sign lord is Ve as discussed above. Ke is aspected by Ma (lord of Badhaka, op- 
eration). Sub lord Ra is as discussed above. So this Bhukti lord Ju had taken the native abroad for operation and 
given success in kidney transplantation. 


Longevity 


Ist CSL Sa (10,1-2) is in own star Sa (10,1-2) and sub of Ke (5) as discussed above. The longevity is expected to 
be middle age up to 66 and the native was at the age of 53 when he underwent the operation. Hence it indicates 
the survival of the kidney operation whatever it may be critical. 


Conclusion 


In combination of Dasa-Bhukti and longevity indicators, it was concluded that the native would survive the mis- 
erable kidney transplantation.

is in Dhanishta star whose lord is Mars. Mars is lord of first and sixth house and is placed in seventh house which 
is Maraka house. Similarly Moon is lord of Badhaka ninth house and is placed in third house. Moon is also a strong 
significator of Maraka seventh house by occupation of its star lord Mars; hence query is justified as most houses 
signify the concerned houses for longevity.Also the ascendant sub lord Ketu is placed in 8th house, which is con- 
sidered for accident, longevity etc. 


Now looking at the RULES for longevity: 


|. For a native’s longevity we consider |, 3 and 8th house, and twelfth house to these |2,2 and 7 are Maraka sthana.

mon sign /th house is Badhaka. In this case under consideration, the ascendant is in fixed sign, and so 9th house 
is Badhaka. 

4 If the sub lord of the ascendant be the significator of the Badhaka and Maraka houses, then it is not considered 
good for longevity of the native.

5th houses. Ketu’s star lord Saturn is in |Oth house (retirement from this world) and lord of houses 3rd and 4th 
(end of everything including life especially in accident). Ketu’s sign lord Moon is placed in third house and lord of 
Badhaka 9th house. Ketu’s sub lord Mercury is in |Oth house (retirement from this world) and lord of 8th and 
| Ith house. Hence Ist cusp sub lord Ketu is a significator of houses for Badhaka, Maraka, accident, retirement 
from this world houses and end of everything, to be not good for longevity of the native. 


2nd Cusp :Ju Ke Ra -- Sub lord Rahu itself placed in Maraka 2nd house. Rahu is conjoined with Jupiter, lord of

house (retirement from this world) and lord of 8th and | Ith house. It is also not good for longevity of the na- 
tive. 


7th Cusp :Ve Su Ke -- As discussed above, Ketu is not good for longevity of the native. 


8th Cusp : Me Ra Ra -- Sub lord Rahu as discussed above is not good for longevity of the native.

was that his mobile was switched off and he also didn’t inform anyone about his situation. 

| received the call on August 23rd, 2009 at 20-10 IST in Ludhiana.

| calculated the horary chart at 20-13 IST, on August 23, 2009, at Ludhiana.

husband. 


| rotated the chart, and took 7th cusp as ascendant of her husband. (Rotated chart is attached) 
lt is owned by Sun sign, Ketu star and Ketu sub. In the case of missing person one should check longevity first.

to longevity. Ketu is in Saturn star, and Saturn is in I, indicating no danger to longevity. Ketu is in sub of Saturn;

pected to take place within a day.

Here Rahu (for Capricorn sign lord Saturn) and Jupiter qualify for this sign.

Next is Cancer, ruled by Moon.

right and left ears respectively. These are Taurus & Gemini/ Aquarius ruled by Venus, Mercury & Saturn. Any un- 
favourable effects on these houses from natural zodiac/ Ascendant would lead to speech/hearing problems. Mer- 
cury, Karaka for speech and hearing, 3rd and | [th houses from Lagna are affected by unfavourable significations 
and connected to evil houses 6-disease, 8-chronic, |2-hospitalisation would lead to dumb and deaf. 


Mute signs in Kalapursha, watery signs — Cancer, Scorpio & Pisces, would lead to deaf and dumb problems when 
it is connected to 8th it is congenital otherwise it would impair during DBA of the planets of unfavourable signi- 
fications. 


Planets Kethu and Rahu connection would lead to defects in the speech and hearing. 3rd house governs right ear 
and | Ith house indicates left ear of the native. Any affliction to 2nd /Venus would lead problems of nose in the 
ENT, as Venus is Karaka for beauty, nose is one among the face which adds beauty. Bharani Venus star indicates 
about nose, Rohini Moon star indicates about Larynx, throat,Arudra Rahu indicates ear/hearing in the natural zo- 
diac.

P for Beginners - Part 14 - 





Introduction 


|. This part is to present the original 5 Ruling Planets and basic ideas only. The additional Ruling 
Planets by taking sub lords and aspects etc, different views of KP practitioners and some con- 
troversies like retrogression will be discussed in the next part to try to determine which works 
the best for an astrologer. 





Original Five Ruling Planets 


2. The Ruling Planets are the planets which rule the moment at the time of judgment of any query. The original 5 
Ruling Planets given by Guru ji KSK are listed below in their order of preference or strength (Original KP Vol 2, 
Sagar Publications, 1965 pp 273-4, 412; KP ReaderVI p 123, RP & KP pp ix, xvii, 32; Dr. Satya Prakash Chowdhary: 
Ruling Planets in KP): 


I) Ascendant star lord 

2) Ascendant sign lord 

3) Moon star lord 

4) Moon sign lord 

5) Day Lord (Hindu Day from sunrise to next sunrise) 


3.Further Rahu and Ketu are to be included in the list, if they are in the signs of these Ruling Planets.Actually being 
stronger, they would replace the planets, in whose signs they are. 


Ruling Planets at the Time when the Urge is There 


4. lt is to work out the Ruling Planets at the time of judgment when the urge is there to find out the result of 
query at the place where an astrologer is examining the Natal or Horary or Time chart. The Ruling Planets are 
the divine guide to an astrologer and their help should be sought only when there is an urge to decide the sig- 
nificators who can bring out the event queried. (KP Reader VI pp 88, 129, 130) The real Ruling Planets would work 
and mysteriously God would help an astrologer only when there is a real urge on both sides of the querist and 
the astrologer. 


Retrogression 


5. The Ruling Planets in retrograde do not prevent the event to take place but will only give the result when they 
become direct in motion. Reject the ruling planets which are posited in the star or sub of retrograde planets. (KP 
Reader VI pp 167, |71, 176, 187, 202, 224, 274) 


Ways of Using the Ruling Planets 


6.As a method of choosing the fruitful significators, the Ruling Planets are to assist in timing of the events. The 
Ruling Planets at the time of judgment of query would be the same Ruling Planets at the time of fructification of 
the event in question. The Ruling Planets will agree fully with the DBA periods in operation, and so the significators 
which are in common with the Ruling Planets are to be selected as the fruitful significators for the event in ques- 
tion. (KP Reader VI pp 274, 138, 141, 200) 


7.|n the birth time rectification, in case of the querist’s doubt about the accuracy of his or her own birth time, 
the Ruling Planets of the time of judgment would agree with the Ruling Planets at birth time. 


8. Fast predictions can be given just based on the Ruling Planets directly.A timing of an event can be fixed by using 
only the Ruling Planets calculated at a particular moment of time without resorting to the Natal or Horary chart 
as follows (KP Reader V p 163, Reader VI p 131, RP & KP p 69-72): 


|) If an event is likely to take place within a few hours, move the Ascendant counting from the Ascending degree 
of the moment of judgment to the sensitive zone where one ruling planet becomes the sign lord, second ruling 





September 2009 KP-Ezine ae 


KP for Beginners - Part 14 - 





planet becomes the star lord and third ruling planet become the sub lord; 


2) If the event is expected to happen within some days, move the Moon to such a sensitive zone; or 
3) If it is to take place in some months, move the Sun; or 
4) If it is to happen in some years, Jupiter should be moved to find out the time of event. 


Food for Thought 
9. There is no KP without any of the following 3 KP pillars: 


|) Hindu constellational Zodiac; 
2) Division of the constellation in the unequal Vimsottari dasa proportion; 
3) Western Placidian cusps. 


10. There is also no KP without application of the following KP basic rule: 


"Planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the SUB is the deciding factor 
whether the matter is favorable or not." 


| |. Since the Ruling Planets are not related to the above three pillars and the basic rule, KP can be practiced with- 
out the Ruling Planets by using other methods of selecting the fruitful significators other than the Ruling Planets 
method. 


|2. By using the Ruling Planets, the following significators can be selected as the fruitful significators: 


I) Significtors which are common with the Ruling Planets, and 
2) Significators appearing many times amongst the Ruling Planets. 


|3.Without using the Ruling Planets, the following significators can be selected as the fruitful significators: 


|) Significators of planets without having any planet in their stars, which are strongest to give the results of the 
houses by being the sub lord to them. (KP Reader III p 309, KP & Astrology 1991 July p | & November p 8, PS 
Rao, Vikari Ramamurthi, R. Mukunda Rajan, Kuppu Ganapathi, Kanak Bosmia and others) (Golden Rule: Take the 
planets which are posited in the sub of the significators whose constellations are not tenanted, explained in As- 
trosecrets & KP, Part Il, 2003, pp 194-199) 


2) Significators which are posited in the stars of the cuspal sub lords of required houses for a matter under con- 
sideration, for instance 2,7,1 | houses for marriage, 


3) Significators which are the cuspal sub lords of the required houses. 


|4. In the case when all 9 planets appear as the Ruling Planets, those significators posited in a sub which is the 
significator of the main house of the matter under consideration can be selected as the fruitful significators. For 
example if marriage is being looked into, the main house is 7. 


15. Moreover, the different astrologers, tackling the same problem under the different urge, at different places at 
different times may get different Ruling Planets, and consequently different answers. 


|6. By the experience of KP Kuppu Ganapathi,AR Raichur and D. Santhil (KP discussion group), Sunil Gondhalekar 
(Four Step Theory), Baskaran (Secret of RP & the Birth Time, pp 64-65), Narhari Khake (KP & Astrology Year Book, 
1998, p 31) and mine (Will the Same Horary Number Give the Same Result? in Astrovision November 2008), it 
has been found that there is no such common solution for different astrologers. Here please note that it's enough 
to show ‘2 different cases only’ to say the result cannot be the same but one may have to go on up to the ‘same 
100 cases’ to show that the result will be the same.

2. These books are recommendable and useful for study of KP together with the late Sri Bhatt’s books as they 
cover almost all kinds of topics as shown by the contents below. For example, the KP house grouping can be found 
under “16. The 12 Houses” in 

pp 101-209 of the Vol. 1, under “33. Guidelines for Professional Astrologers” in 

pp 222-228 of the Vol. Il,and under “6. Principle of Sublords and Relevant Houses” in 

pp 35-59 of the Vol. Ill. The rule “The planets without having any planet in their stars are the strongest signifcators 
of the houses for which they are the cusp sub lords. (KP Reader Ill p 309)” is explained under “29. The Golden 
Rule in KP” in pp 194-199 of Vol. Il. 


3. The difference with the late Sri Bhatt’s books is that these three volumes are to be used with caution in some 
issues as KP scholars’ own views expressed there may not be in line with the original KP.

Question- 3 


Will you kindly clarify the following point? In traditional Astrology system, while reading the transit result of plan- 
ets or when the movement of slow moving planets such as Jupiter or Saturn from one Rasi to the other, the Moon 
Rasi of the natal chart is taken and from that Rasi to the other Rasi, where these two planets are moving is con- 
sidered from sign to sign, irrespective of the exact longitude of Moon's placement in Moon Rasi in the natal chart. 
Suppose Saturn is going to move from the present rasi Leo to Virgo in about next month. Then for Tarus Rasi 
(Moon's placement), it is read as Saturn is going to move from 4th to 5th and the result is offered by the tra- 
ditional system. Irrespective of Moon, whether it is in | degree or 29 degrees of Taurus. 


But in K.Psysem, Lagna of the native is given importance and not Moon for the transit result. In Placidus system, 
the point at which the cuspal degree falls to the next point where the cuspal point falls is taken as lagna cusp. 
Suppose Lagna is Leo, cuspal point is |5 degrees and the second bhavam is |5 degreees.In the above example 
case, Saturn may be entering into Virgo in Sun's star uttaram 2nd pada. should we say Saturn in 2nd from Lagna 
Rasi Leo or Saturn will move to 2nd Bhavam after it enters 15 degrees above. In other words we should treat 
Lagna Rasi as starting point or the exact degree as starting point ad go on for taking other Bhavas for transit. If 
we take Lagna Rasi and treat the other Rasi as Ist, 2nd etc.,| doubt whether we will get the correct result. The 
above is example of one case. | would like to the reading of all other planets with particular point. in the other 
Bhavams. This we may require to consider whether favorable planets are transiting in 7th bhavam for marriage. 
etc. Otherwise we will see the favourable planets are in either 6th or 8th, if we do not consider the exact lon- 
gitude of planets. | have not seen clear explanation about this either in K.PReaders or examples. | request your 
clarification on this point.

This case belongs to one of my friend from Delhi whose deputation in a government depart- 
ment was to be over by Aug 31, 2009 and he was to go back to his parent organization. Being 
comfortable in Delhi, he was aspiring if he could be posted to a suitable position in Delhi only 
instead of being posted outside. 


He posed a clear question to me “Will | be posted in Delhi or outside?” with horary number 
155 and | took up the case for scrutiny on Aug 27, 2009 at | 7-15-06 Hrs at Bangalore. The 
query chart is attached herewith: 





Coordinates of judgment 
Lagna in this chart represents the native. 


The prospects in a horary chart relating to the profession are primarily governed by the IQH, as this house 
decides the way the flow of karma takes place for matters relating to profession. 


lt may be noted that the analysis of cusps of various houses along with the planetary significations represent the 
fixed promises of the chart but the results are dispensed by the suitable dasha-bhukti in consonance with the tran- 
sits. 


The Query 


In the horary chart, Moon is placed in | 2th house indicating that the mindset of the querist pertained to some 
sort of hopelessness and depression (feeling lost). Moon placed in the star of Saturn placed in | Oth house pointed 
the query to the professional concern. 


With the above, | took the chart OK to proceed for further analysis. 
Analysis of the chart 
¢ Look at the promise indicated by the lagna. 


Mars is the lagna sub lord and is placed in 7th house, indicating that the native had influence on the other side to 
pursue his objectives of being placed in Delhi. Being fairly senior in position in the government sector, he had al- 
ready known that there was hardly any possibility of seeking posting within Delhi, as neither was there any vacant 
post nor was it seeming justified because the native was always posted in Delhi since he joined service. 


Mars is placed in the star and sub of Rahu placed in 2H, thus the lagna at the first place had some promise for 
the native to remain with his family (2H) and negating the possibility of his moving out of Delhi (2H negating 3H). 


Thus, the indications of lagna had the fair promise of the job position in Delhi as desired. 
¢ Look at the indications of [0th cuspal sub-lord. 


|Oth cuspal sub-lord is Venus which is a strong planet as there is no planet in its star, thus its placement would 
have some definite say. Note that Venus is placed in 8th house which shows that there could be some serious ten- 
sion prevailing with respect to his posting issue, but 8th being a good house from the 4th house (place of present 
stay — Delhi) does pose relief as well. 


As per stellar signification, Venus falls in the star of Saturn placed in |Oth house with its sublord Mercury (I Ith 
lord) placed in 10th house. Since, the sub-lord does not signify the 3-9-1 2th house, it does promise a high scope 
of his professional placement in Delhi only. 


¢ Look at the 4th cusp 


This cusp indicates the present place of stay — Delhi and should not signify 3rd house if the native has to remain 
in Delhi. 4th cuspal sub-lord is Mercury (1 Ith lord), which falls in the star of Sun placed in 9H and sub-lord Ketu 
placed in 8th house. With this combination, it was aptly clear that the native was to have his posting in Delhi only, 
as the posting at far-off places (9H) was denied by the sub-lord placed in 8H.

OM Gajaananam Namamhyam 


The Thyroid is one of the largest endocrine glands in the body. This gland is found in the neck | 
inferior to (below) the thyroid cartilage (also known as the Adam's apple in men) and at | 
approximately the same level as the cricoid cartilage. The thyroid controls how quickly the 
body burns energy, makes proteins, and controls how sensitive the body should be to other 
hormones. 





The thyroid participates in these processes by producing thyroid hormones, principally thyrox- 

ine (14) and triiodothyronine (13). These hormones regulate the rate of metabolism and affect the growth 
and rate of function of many other systems in the body. lodine and tyrosine are used to form both T3 and T4. 
The thyroid also produces the hormone calcitonin, which plays a role in calcium homeostasis. 


The thyroid is controlled by the hypothalamus and pituitary. The gland gets its name from the Greek word 
for "shield", after the shape of the related thyroid cartilage. Hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid) and hy- 
pothyroidism (underactive thyroid) are the most common problems of the thyroid gland. 


Anatomy 


The thyroid gland is a butterfly-shaped organ and is composed of two cone-like lobes or wings: lobus dexter 
(right lobe) and lobus sinister (left lobe), connected with the isthmus. The organ is situated on the anterior side 
of the neck, lying against and around the larynx and trachea, reaching posteriorly the oesophagus and carotid 
sheath. It starts cranially at the oblique line on the thyroid cartilage (just below the laryngeal prominence or 
Adam's apple) and extends inferiorly to the fourth or fifth tracheal ring. It is difficult to demarcate the gland's 
upper and lower border with vertebral levels because it moves position in relation to these during swallowing.

The Sanatan Hindu dharma has its own assumption about the number 9. 
The sages had recognized it as an auspicious number. 

That is not just a hypothesis but has its supplementary gesture and logic. 
Let’s illustrate it. 


|) Our Astrological base made of 9 planets. 

2) The Nakshatras are 27 which have the total of 9. 
3) The Puranas are 18 which have been totaled 9. 
4) The Reciting mala has 108 pearl s which total 9. 

5) The Prudent Sadhu’s creed (Akhada,Maha-mandaleshwar) put before their names is the number of 108 or [008. 
6) The Geeta has its 18 adhyayas. 

7) The Upnishads are 108.And further is a lot of examples on the number 9. 

8) The sum of the two-digits resulting from nine multiplied by any other single-digit number will equal nine. So 
9x3=27, and 2+7=9. 

9) Multiply nine by any two, three or four-digit number and the sums of those will also break down to nine. For 
example: 9x62 = 558; 5+5+8=18; |+8=9.And many more are unknown.

The inner planet weather mapped by astrological positions has an influence on all earthy things 
and enterprises. 


Weather Astrology 


Weather has been in existence as long as there has been earth. But during different period we feel change in 
weather. Main three factor of weather are |) Temperature 2) The Air movement 3) Moisture. 


We don’t have weather starting time so we need chart of each period affecting the temperature i.e chart of each 
period affecting the precipitation of moisture, Air, Temperature. 


Now let us go into the details of above three charts: 


Temperature Chart: 


We cannot consider that a given weather period has a long span of life compared to the life of man. The life of a 
weather period is short duration. To fix duration of above three weather, we have spring, summer, autumn & 
winter, each long recognized as a separate, distinct and well defined weather period. 


Our first step in weather predicting chart for the moment the sun enter each of the movable signs at the place 
where the weather is to be considered. Hot or Cold all are depend on Sun’s temperatures so each time when 
Sun enter in Movable signs times chart help us in predicting weather astrology. 


The sun is ruler of temperature, sun change polarity four times a year in its influence on the weather. When it 
enter in the sign Mesha at the commencement Spring. Day light become longer. When sun enters in Karka at the 
commencement of summer, the day started to shorten. VVhen sun enter in tula at the commencement of night 
become longer. When sun enter in Makar at the commencement of winter. 


The most important is when Sun moveing in to a movable sign A temperature chart is erected and we call it tem- 
perature chart. For place, our analysis is based on state’s capital. Or district headquarters of town or for any spe- 
cific town/city. 


Air movement Chart 


Temperature only is not connected with weather but Air movement also play important role. Because the air 
movement effect on temperature changes. Not in temperature but also effect on moisture too. 


Mercury is Karaka for Wind. like wind, Mer is so changeable more readily than any other planet.every planet has 
a different significations in each of the defferent signs; and the air is so susceptible of being influenced by slight 
change, & Mercury so readily changes to the quality of the sign in to which it movers. 


Both air movement chart and the moisture chart are subsidiary to the temperature chart of the Sun during the 
same period. But a new air movement chart is erected when mercury enter a new sign even by direct motion or 
by retrograde motion. Place of chart which it is desired to forecast. duration of chart it till Mercury enter in new 
sign only. Generally Mercury change Sign |8 days to 60 days depending how fast or slow movement of Mercury. 


Moisture Chart 
Moon is Karaka of Moisture. Moon is karaka of liquids of all kinds. the precipitation of moisture such as fog, rain, 
snow and hail is so dependent upon temperature change the moisture chart must always be considered subsidiary. 


For Moisture chart we take for chart of Moon, Sukla Paksha Ekadashi(First Quarter), Pooonam, (Full Moon) Kr- 
ishna Paksha Ekadashi (Third Quarter), and lastly Amas (New Moon). This four chart. 
For Moisture chart we erect a chart at the place which we want to predict weather.

P - Weather Astrology 





How to predict weather chart 


We have now three type of chart |) when Sun enter in Movable sign. 2) When Mer enter in sign 3) four type of 
Moon chart. Chart base on Sun position we check temperature, Chart base on Mercury position we check Air 
movement, and lastly Chart base on Moon position we check moisture, 


Planetary position( by sign and aspect) for all over world remain same but Asc will be change place to place, so 
we will give more important to Asc and Bhava in above mention chart.Also we have to check all three charts for 
giving forecast of weather. Without cocktail of these three charts we can’t predict correctly. the temperature chart 
is the most important chart to for temperature but also in regard to indicating the general conditions of weather 
for three month of period. because temperature is also important in rain and wind too. For example in Air move- 
ment chart indicate much wind during the period, but temperature chart not indicate same we can predict Wind 
storm, but we predict balance season. 


One more and important point is before an astrologer can predict successfully what weather is; he must familiar 
with the normal weather condition at that place during time of year. In short we can’t predict snowfall in Ahmed- 
abad or 480 Hot in San Francisco. 


Some sign are dry and other sign are wet. Some planet are dry and some are wet, when we found in temperature 
chart indicate wet and also moisture chart indicate wet, we can predict more them normal wet. Like this we have 
to analyze weather chart. 


The temperature chart not indicate only temperature for all three month but the general tendency of both wind 
and moisture also. But it does not indicate dates on which there will be change in wind or moisture precipitation. 
Like this Air movement chart does not indicate temperature or Moisture precipitation. To find out change we take 
help of Vomshiotry dasa. For Temperature chart we calculate three month dasa, for Air movement chart we cal- 
culate dasa for how long Mer stay in sign and for moisture chart we calculate dasa for 7 days. 


For those who use KPastro3.| or 3.5 can change dasa days as bellow: 


For temperature chart 
Setting > Vomshottari Dasa > Total Duration (in year)> 00.25 > Ok press F5 


For Air movement chart 


Setting > Vomshottari Dasa > Total Duration (in year)> Mer change sign with no fix days we can fix as 
below: 


Vomshottari dasa is for |20 year. For | yeas we enter only | but for one month we divide I/|12=0.083333 this is 
for one moth now if we want for 7 day we need to divide again by 30 and then multiply by 7= 0.0194444. if we
