Question & Answer 





Shortcut Method 


4.For the KPAsro (3.1 or 3.0 etc) users who own the ADB 4.0 data SW, a converter program of the ADB chart 
details into the KPAstro is available to download at this website of the Free KPE-zine — 
http://kpastrologer.com. 


5. However, for the ADB chart data, which are now available at the following link, --- http://www.astro.com/astro- 
databank/Main_ Page 
are to be manually entered into any KP chart making SW as explained below. 


SWs with ACS Atlas 


6. The SWs equipped with the Astro Communications Services (ACS) atlas usually will show the relevant latitude 
and longitude and time zone, after manually entering the name, gender, date of birth, time of birth and place of 
birth.Any other SW will also show the relevant latitude and longitude and time zone, if the place of birth (city) 
is in the SW’s built-in atlas. (For US cities it is necessary to choose the relevant state.) Any slight difference in 
the latitude and longitude can be adjusted as required or preferred. If there is a doubt, it can be checked with 
the Google Earth map, if the place under consideration is there. 


7.In order to get the accurate positions of cusps and planets, it is better to directly enter the preferred ayanamsa 
value, for instance the KPNA, before calculation (other than adjusting the cuspal and planetary positions by the 
difference of ayanamsa value used in calculation and the KPNA value). 


Check Points 


8. The check point figures for the correctness of the data entry are at the top right hand side of the natal chart 
(Placidus) , i.e. 


Time (of birth) 23:11 

Universal Time 17:41 

Sid. Time 03:01:06 

and Ascendant Le 20:05:15 (in sayana) at the bottom left hand side of the chart. 


9. If the chart details are correctly entered, the SW is to provide more or less the same Sidereal Time 03:01:06 
and Ascendant position Cn 27:28:01 (= Le 20:05:15 minus KPNA 22:37:14).. If the Sidereal Time or Ascendant 
position is significantly different, it is required to check the data entry and make the necessary correction. 


Any SW 


10. In the cases where the place of birth (city) is not found by the SW’s built-in atlas, whether ACS or any other, 
the latitude and longitude of the city and time zone are to be entered manually, for example: 


http://www.astro.com/astro-databank/Krishnamurti~Z2C_Jeddu 
Name : Krishnamurti, Jeddu) Gender:M, born on [2 May 1895 at 00:23 (= 12:23 AM ) Place Mandanapalle, India, 
|3n33, 78e30 Timezone LMT m78e30 (is local mean time) 


| 1. The Time Zone for the Local Mean Time (LMT) can be calculated from the time figures given at the top right 
hand side of the natal chart (Placidus) i.e. 


Time (of birth) 0:23 

Universal Time 19:09, | 1 May 

Sid. Time 15:40:15 

TZ = 0:23 (12 May) minus 19:09 (11 May) = 5:14 

(OR long. 78.5 multiply by 4 min = 314 min = 5h:14m) 

|2. Here it is to note that the TZ 5:30 East (5:30 East of GMT, i.e. GMT + 5:30) is shown with minus sign (-) 5:30 


in the Western ADB 4.0 SW but in our Eastern practice it is shown with the plus sign (+) 5:30.and the TZ 5h 
West (5h West of GMT, i.e. GMT — 5h) is shown with plus sign (+) 5:00 in the Western ADB 4.0 SW but in our 


October 2009 KP-Ezine Bye) 





Question & Answer 





Eastern practice it is shown with the minus sign (-) 5:00. 


|3.Another thing to note is that the TZ 5:30 is shown as 5:30 (in hour and minute) in some SWVs like Sri Raichur’s 
SW, JHora,Astraura, Smart Horary (KP) Astrology but 5.50 (in full hour and decimal hour) in some SWs like KPAs- 
tro, AstroSage or MyKundli, KPStarOne. So it should be careful to enter the minute portion of the TZ correctly, 
depending on the SW used. Here TZ 5:14 East is to be converted to 5.2333h East, if necessary. 


Easy and Safe Way 


14. For any Time Zone, LMT or TZ East or TZ West or TOB Standard Time or Day Light Saving Time (DST) what 
ever it may be, the easy and safe way is to enter the “Universal Time” (here GMT) and “TZ GMT” or Zero into 
the SW. The Universal Time is shown in the second line at at the top right hand side of the natal chart (Placidus), 
in the Indira Gandhi's chart, i.e. 19:09 of || May 1895. 


[5.Another way is to use IST derived from the Universal Time plus 5:30 with TZ 5:30 East or 5.50 East, in our 
example 19:09 of || May 1895 plus 5:30 = IST 0:39 of 12 May 1895. 


Some Notes 


16. It is to enter the latitude and longitude what is given with East or West, North or South, for instance West 
longitude for the US cities, South latitude for African cities, South latitude and West longitude for Latin American 
cities etc. 


|7. It is to note that the Day Light Saving Time is already adjusted in the chart details, for example: 


http://www.astro.com/astro-databank/Blair%2C Tony 

Name : Blair, Tony Gender: M, Birthname Blair, Anthony Charles Lynton born on 6 May 1953 at 06:10 (= 
06:10 AM ) Place Edinburgh, Scotland, 55n57, 3w13 Timezone GDT hle (is daylight saving time) 

Time (of birth) 6:10, Universal Time 5:10, Sid. Time 19:52:12 

Note: The standard TZ is GMT, i.e. hOw but here the TZ is given as hle because of | h adjustment for the DST, 
which is |h ahead of the standard time. In the SW TZ, the TZ GMT with DST Ih (as automatically shown by the 
ACS atlas) and TZ hle with the Standard Time (which can be entered manually) are the same. Such kind of the 
correct TZ combination is required to get the correct Sid. Time of the check point. 


http://www.astro.com/astro-databank/Bush%2C George _W. 

Name: Bush, George W. Gender: M, Birthname Bush, George Walker born on 6 July 1946 at 07:26 (= 07:26 
AM ) Place New Haven CT, USA, 41n18, 72w55 Timezone EDT h4w (is daylight saving time) 

Time (of birth) 7:26, Universal Time | 1:26, Sid. Time [1:29:42 

Note:The standard TZ is h5w but here the TZ is given as h4w because of | h adjustment for the DST. In the SW 
TZ, the TZ h5w with the DST Ih (as automatically shown by the ACS atlas) and TZ h4e with the Standard Time 
(which can be entered manually) are the same. 


18. In the case of only one TZ countries, if the required city is not found by the SW’s built-in atlas, the capital of 
the country or another well known city can be entered to apply the built-in TZ system and then to adjust the 
latitude and longitude and the name of city as required, for example: 


http://www.astro.com/astro-databank/Pele 

Name: Pele | Gender:M, Birthname do Nascimento,Adson Arantes born on 2! October 1940 at 03:00 (= 03:00 
AM ) Place Trés Coracgoes, Brazil, 21s42, 45wl6 Timezone BZT h3w (is standard time) 

If Tres Coragoes is not found, enter Brasilia or Rio de Janeiro and then make an adjustment for 21s42, 45wl6 
and Trés Coracoes.

This case belongs to one of my acquaintance who was worried about his mother’s health. | got 
a call from him on March 31, 2008 who indicated that his mother was not well and | need to 
look at the prospects for her well-being. 


Out of curiosity, | casted a time chart immediately to find what the trouble was with his mother, 
her recovery issue and survival etc. 


The time chart prepared on March 31,2008 at! 4-49-19 Hrs at Bangalore. The chart is rotated (it . 
to 4th house to represent his mother and the rotated chart is given below. 7 





Coordinates of judgment 


Lagna in query chart for disease represents the native and 6th house represents the disease. The star lord of the 
6th cuspal sub-lord represents the body part where the disease infects. 5th and | Ith cusps indicate the possibility 
of cure. In case, if the 6th house has linkage with the 8th house, the disease could be a chronic one and difficult 
to get cured. The linkage to the |2th house makes a case for hospitalization. 


If the 6th cuspal sub-lord indicating disease links itself with the badhaka and maraca houses, the chances 
of cure seem difficult and the patient may succumb to the disease. 


lt may be noted that the analysis of cusps of various houses along with the planetary significations represent the 
fixed promises of the chart but the results are dispensed by the suitable dasha-bhukti in consonance with the tran- 
sits. 


The Query 


In the rotated chart, Moon is placed in 3rd house indicating that the stage was already set for the patient (mother) 
to be moved out of house to the hospital and tallied with the state of affairs as indicated by her son on phone 
to me. With the above, | took the chart OK to proceed for further analysis. 


Analysis of the chart 
¢ Look at the promise indicated by the lagna. 


Lagna would indicate the state of the patient. Mercury is the lagna sub-lord and is also the sub-lord of the 3-/- 
9th cusps. Mercury being the dual natured planet enabling the requisite relatives such as the patient (lagna) and 
husband (7th) deliberating if the patient was to be moved to the hospital or be kept at home etc. 


Lagna sub-lord Mercury falls in the star of Jupiter placed in 3rd house making the movement of the patient out 
of the house as an issue in active discussions. [he sub-lord of Mercury is Rahu placed in 4th house ultimately de- 
cides her to be kept at home till the emergency arises. Since, Mercury is the strong lord of the |2th house, her 
admission to the hospital was inevitable at some point of time. 


¢ Look at the 6th cusp 
6th house/cusp defines the disease. 


6th cuspal sub-lord is Mars and having been placed in 8th house indicate the disease as inflammatory in nature 
(Mars) and chronic and difficult to be cured (8th house). Mars falls in the star of Rahu placed in 4th house gives 
the idea of disease located in chest area. Rahu is malignant in nature (carrying poison), thus it was inferred that 
there could be a malignant problem in the breast of the patient, typically some sort of cancerous in nature. 


Mars is the strong lord of 2nd and /th house placed in 8th house, thus signifying 8-2-7th houses. Mars in the star 
of Rahu placed in 4th house signify 4th house at the stellar level. Thus, the Mars signifies 4-8-2-7th houses in all. 


Note that all the houses are very bad houses signifying maraca (2-7) houses possibly threatening the longevity of 
the patient (8th house). 


¢ Look to the fortuna

Medical Astrology - Part 9 - 





Cervical vertebrae 

These seven (7) bones are generally small and delicate. Their spinous processes are short (with the exception of 
C2 and C7, which have palpable spinous processes). Numbered top-to-bottom from Cl-C7, atlas (Cl) and axis (C2), 
are the vertebrae that allow the neck and head so much movement. For the most part, the atlanto-occipital joint 
allows the skull to move up and down, while the atlanto-axial joint allows the upper neck to twist left and right. 
The axis also sits upon the first intervertebral disk of the spinal column. 


Thoracic vertebrae 

The twelve (12) thoracic bones and their transverse processes have surfaces that articulate with the ribs. Some ro- 
tation can occur between the thoracic vertebrae, but their connection with the rib cage prevents much flexion or 
other excursion. They may also be known as ‘dorsal vertebrae’, in the human context. 

Bodies are roughly heart-shaped and are about as wide anterio-posterioly as they are in the transverse dimension. 
Vertebral foramina are roughly circular in shape. 


Lumbar vertebrae 

These five (5) vertebrae are very robust in construction, as they must support more weight than other vertebrae. 
They allow significant flexion and extension, moderate lateral flexion (sidebending), and a small degree of rotation. 
The discs between these vertebrae create a lumbar lordosis (curvature that is concave posteriorly) in the human 
spine. 


Sacral vertebrae 
There are five (5) vertebrae (SI-S5) and they are fused in maturity, with no intervertebral discs. 


Coccygeal vertebrae 

There are usually four (4) and rarely 3-5 vertebrae (Col-Co5), with no intervertebral discs. Many animals have a 
greater number of "tail vertebrae" and, in animals, they are more commonly known as "caudal vertebrae." Pain at 
the coccyx (tailbone) is known as occydynia. 


In Medical astrology Natural Zodiac (Kalapursha), taken Cervical Vertebrae as a whole these Vertebrae are ruled 
by the Taurus sign which rules the throat and neck.Also planets and affliction in the opposite signs, Scorpio and Libra 
tend to affect the Cervical Vertebrae. The Taurus and Scorpio signs, being opposite and supplemental to each other, 
both strongly influence the throat and sex organs. (HL Cornell: Encyclopaedia of Medical Astrology pp 906-7) The 
2nd house Taurus represents throat & neck where the Seven Cervical Vertebras are existing (C|—C7/) which are 
representing Spondylosis. Saturn is Karaka for bones & Mercury represents nervous system. Discs are soft jelly 
made lubricant organs which makes vertebras to be flexible for movement any direction. Moon and Venus are 
karakas for these Disc formation and maintenance. 


Lumbar Spondylosis is 6th house Virgo & Libra of kidney region represents Lumbar and Abdomen region where 
the five Lumbar Vertebras are existing (LI—L5) which are representing Lumbar Spondylosis. 


Saturn is Karaka for bones, Taurus/Vir / Lib & 2nd/6th/7th houses from Lagna if afflicted and connected to evil 
houses 6-disease, 8-chronic, |2-hospitalisation would lead to Cervical Spondylosis problems.

lagna. 

Additional houses to be considered are 2 (addition of a family member) and I 1 (permanant tie of part- 
nership in life). Since the marriage issue is involved with romance and love, 5th house are required to be 
considered as per some astrologers. 


The sub lord of the 7th cusp will determine and decide the result. 


The chart of the native is appended, duly erected as per KP principles for the native born in Hyderabad Deccan 
(Longitude: 78-27-0 East Latitude: | 7-26-0 North) on: 10-03-1978, Friday at 10-32 am.)

cury sign, Moon star and Rahu sub.

Rahu signifies Mercury, Venus and Moon since is aspected from Pisces by them and Mars from Gemini. So

ficator to give result of 2,7 and 5 and | Ith houses involving all houses of marriage and romance.

munity. 

Native is running Ketu dasha, Saturn bhukti and Saturn antara upto 3rd week of Nov 2009.

Case History 


The coconut plucker of my gardens did not arrive at time for the harvesting last March, and 
suddenly he came on [4 March 2009 for excuse on not attending at the due date and informed 
me that his wife was badly sick and wanted to analyze her Kendra. 


According to him his wife had been experienced with some Oedema and pain in lower abdom- 
inal and joints since the mid of 2008. In the early days of Feb. 2009 she had swelling in the face 
and had more abdominal pain. 





She had been admitted to hospital on the 8th Feb,2009, after consultation with a physician. There she has been 
undergone a Scan test of the Kidney and have transfused some blood. The patient has been discharged from the 
hospital with some medical advice and drugs. 


Natal Chart Analysis 


DOB - 29.09. 1952 
TOB - 7.00.30 am 
POB - Veyangoda- Western Province-Sri Lanka 80.E 03 / 07 N 09 


As it was for a sickness, | had checked the chart as per KP Rule for sickness 
On the date of her first visit to the physician for Oedema, ie 15.03.2008, it was running Sa - Ke - Ke - Me as DBAS. 


Dasa lord Sat is I/o 5,6 (sickness), in |2 (hospitalization). No planet is in the star of Sa, which is the sub lord for 
|, 7 (Badhaka) cusps and is in the star and sub of Ma, which is I/o 3, 8 (danger), in 3. 


Bhukti and Antra lord Ket is in | 1, the house of Mo in 4, I/o | 1,and Mo also aspects Ke. Ke is in the star of Me 
in 12 (hospitalization), I/o |,10,and in the sub of Ra in 5, sign lord Sa as discussed above. 


Sookshma lord Me is in |2,I/o 1,10, in the star of Mo in 4, I/o || and in the sub of Sa in 12, I/o 5,6. 


Dasa lord Sa is also the Ascendant sub lord and Sa indicates sickness by signifying houses 6 &| as mentioned in 
the Astrosecrets and KP Part | page 153 by Sri M.P Shanmugam. 


In checking the disease, the 6th CSL Vet is I/o 2 ,9, in 2 by closed orb, in the star and sub of Ra in 5, whose sign 
lord Sa is in 12, I/o 5, 6. No planet is in the star of Ve which is the sub lord of 2,6 cusps. Further no planets is in 
the star of Sa which is the sub lord of |,7 (Badhaka) cusps. The Sa connection to 6th cusp is a sign of chronic dis- 
ease. 


As the native had an Oedema in the lower part of abdomen, it looks like a typical case of kidney troubles 
as the 6th cusp sub lord happens to be Venus and connected to the kidney rulers Libra and house 7. 
Venus, also a ruler of kidney, is in the Star of Swathy, which governs kidneys, urethra and bladder.. Venus 
is deposited in Libra, another kidney ruler. (Medical Astrology for All by K.Subramaniam; Dictionary of Sig- 
nifcators in Astrology by Umang Taneja) 


In addition 7th bhava, Maraka & Bdhakasthana for Virgo, is in the sign of Pisces, which is a watery sign responsible 
for Urinary diseases. Ju, the lord of this 7th cusp is also placed in the same bhava with a strong signification for 
such kind of diseases. By the placement of Ju in Aries owned by Mars, there is a connection of Mars with the kidney 
ruler 7th bhava and consequently as per medical astrology there is a tendency of inflammation of the kidney. 


As the condition of the native looked to be dangerous, the longevity of the native was checked as per KP House 
Grouping: Part - I, by Shri Tin Win Ji, in KPE-zine. The Ascendant sub lord Sa signifies |,5,3 along 6,8, |2,Badhaka, 
indicating the middle life up to 66 years. The native was already at the age of 56 with unfavourable prospect. 


Hence | told the husband of the native that she was suffering from a serious sickness of kidney and it would be 
a danger to her life and | advised him to seek further medical treatment for his wife. 

Later on | came to know that she was under local treatments and taking remedial supports through some Poojas, 
Yantra and Mantra, instead of proper medical treatment.

End of the Case 


The native was seriously ill in July 2009, and she was again admitted to hospital on 20th July 2009. The medical 
investigations had revealed that there was an inflammation of kidneys and it was beyond redemption. 


Panchathantra says, "These five are fixed for every man, before he leaves the womb - His length of days, his fate, 
his wealth, his learning and his Tomb”. As allotted by Karma, she passed away at 10 AM on the O5th of Aug. 2009. 
The cause of death is "Chronic Renal Failure complicated by cardiac failure" as per the verdict. 


Significators of Death 


At the time of exhalation of her last breath, the DBAS was Sa-Ve -Ve—Sa.Among the significators of death inflicting 
houses 2, 7, |2,Ve is found to be the most powerful planet for house 2 (Maraka) by being the sub lord of cusp 2 
without any planet in its star, and Sa for house 7 (Maraka & Badhaka) and 12 (Moksha) houses by being the sub 
lord of cusp 2 and placement in house |2 respectively without any planet in its star. This cuspal sub lord rule or 
Golden Rule is working in this case of death up to the 6th level dasa periods as given under. 

Sa-Ve-Ve-Sa-Sa-Ve (from - 00.40.18 Hrs to 20.34.24 Hrs on 2009.08.05) 


At the time of death (05-08-2009; 10 AM), the transit Ascendant was back to the natal Ascendant. Dasa and Sook- 
shma lord. Sa was transiting in the star of Bhukti and Antra lord Ve, and Ve in the star of Ra, which is agent of Sa 
and in the sub of Sa, showing how the transit agrees with the dasa.

method of KP.

SUN 
By nature Sun is’ hot’, in relation to Temperature chart if Sun gives hot weather. 


We cannot predict from Temperature chart only; we have to also consider Air-movement chart. 
During this period when Mer enters in new sign to present sign, we have to mix results of both 
the Temperature and Air- movement charts. Additionally, we have to consider Moisture chart 
too. Sun is a Dry planet, its influence is to bring dry weather and thus prevent rain. 


MOON 





In the relation to Temperature chart, Moon is ‘Cool’. It does not give excessive cold like Saturn, but temperatures 
are chilly. Where rain is concerned, Moon is the wettest of all planets. 


MERCURY 


Mercury’s influence is ‘Cold’; Mercury is the chief ruler over winds. Mercury is inclined towards dry weather; if 
it becomes a CSL of 4th cusp, tends to prevent rain. When the charts indicate ' wet and violent’, Mercury adds 
the wind element to storm, without moderating in any degree the amount of rainfall. 


VENUS 


Venus has a moderating influence. If the previous weather was hot,Venus tends to cool it, if the previous weather 
was cold, Venus tends to warm things up. In Weather Astrology, we can consider Venus as a violent planet. Com- 
monly Venus indicates mild and pleasant temperatures. 


Venus’s influences on wind is similar, Venus encourages mild movement of the atmosphere, but discourages wild 
movement and storms. In respect of rain, next to the Moon, Venus is consistently the wettest planet, Saturn may 
give floods or drought but Venus consistently gives beneficial rains. 


MARS 


Mars is ' Hot’ planet and tends more towards hot weather than any other planet.When Mars becomes 4th CSI 
generally brings warm weather. However, if Mars a member of violent and destructive combinations in the Tem- 
perature chart, there is likely to be extremely hot days followed by a sudden fall to unusually low temperatures. 
In relation to wind, Mars indicates some movement. Mars is not a windy planet, but assists action. Mars has a dry 
influence. He may in a Moisture chart release rain. 


JUPITER 


In relation to temperature, Jupiter is Warm. He is not so hot as Mars ,and not quite as heating as the Sun. His is 
pleasantly Warmth, and this Warming influence is consistent. 


Where Wind is concerned, he tilts towards pleasant breezes, Jup not a still planet like the Sun but Jup is not vi- 
olent. Because his influence is so powerful, his own influence is toward mild breezes. 


Where moisture is concerned, Jupiter tends to dryness. he is neither so dry as Mars nor the Sun, but he tends 
to drive away dark clouds, and to bring fine, clear, warm weather of the kind that makes us being out of doors 
agreeable. Even in a rather wet Moisture Chart, where some rain is not shown, during this period it will be 
pleasant and joyful. But under such a Moisture Chart if, instead of Jupiter, Saturn is the main planet, the days on 
which it does not rain, will be dull and disagreeable. 


SATURN 


Saturn is the storm planet.Where temperature is concerned his influence is toward cold. Sat is the planet which 
brings terrible ‘freezes’. However, in summer, if other indications point to a drought and extreme heat, his influence 
when prominent, will not then reduce the temperature, but will increase the severe heat to a destructive point. 
in winter. Saturn has a similar extreme influence on the wind. He is a still planet, tending normally toward cold, 
damp weather without breezes. But in a chart showing storm, or showing excessive wind, his importance in it

tends to cause the winds to reach destructive violence. More than any other planet, he signifies storm and de- 
struction. 


Floods are usually due to the prominence of Saturn in the weather charts. Sat is a wet planet. The blizzards in 
winter in which cold and driving snow do so much damage are directly under his influence. But in a real drought 
period, do not look for Saturn by position in the Moisture Chart, while normally wet, it is best to consider him 
the planet most favoring destructive and disagreeable weather, whes, whatever kind the charts as a whole and 
the seasons indicate. Because of his chilling influence, hailstorms are chiefly under his dominion. 


ARIES 


The sign Aries in its influence on temperature is hot. Scorpio, the other Mars sign, gives extreme weather con- 
ditions which usually are hot but which may tend to extreme cold. The other hot sign is Leo. These two signs, in 
so far as the temperature chart and temperature influences are concerned are the signs of high temperatures. 


Because Mars and Aries are both so restless and active we need not be surprised that this movable sign gives 
some wind.We may consider it only fairly windy, however, in comparison with Gemini,Virgo, Libra and Capricorn, 
which are windier, and in comparison with those signs which are calm. 


Of all the zodiacal signs Aries and Leo are the most dry.Aries is prominent in a chart that shows much rain, when 
the Moon is become a CSL of fourth or the first in Aries, it brings violence along with the rain. But when it is 
prominent in a dry chart in summer it brings dry, hot winds which tend to desiccate the vegetation and scorch 
the leaves of growing crops. 


TAURUS 


In its influence upon temperature Taurus, like its ruling planet Venus, has a moderating influence. If the preceding 
weather has been unusually cold, the influence of Taurus is to warm things up. But if the preceding weather has 
been extremely hot, the influence of Taurus is to bring cooler temperatures. Its general influence is toward those 
temperatures which are best for growing crops, during the times crops are in the field, and toward those tem- 
peratures which favor domestic stock at other times of the year. more than any other sign, Taurus is the farmer's 
friend. 


Taurus is a fixed sign, the most fixed of all the signs. This stabilizing influence marks it effect in an Air Movement 
Chart. More than any other sign, Taurus tends to calm weather in which not a breath of air stirs. Therefore, 
Taurus is main sign in an Air Movement Chart, it tends to stop winds. Just as its opposite sign, Scorpio tends to 
produce extreme weather conditions, so Taurus tends to produce moderate weather and a still atmosphere. 


Taurus tends toward wet weather. But this weather is not of the nature indicated by Capricorn, for example, in 
which cold rains delay the planting and growing of crops. The typically Taurus weather gives what the farmer calls 
growing rains. They are not floods, but of generous quantity that benefit crops. Steady rains. For a day or two, just 
enough falling that it has time to soak into the ground, and does not run off so quickly as the more copious 
downpours of Cancer. 


GEMINI 


Gemini is a cold and drafty sign. Its influence in the temperature Chart may be considered as favoring cold 
weather. However, it may also be considered to favour rapid changes and variable temperatures. It does not give 
extreme cold like Capricorn and Aquarius, but tends to real cold rather than the cool weather of Pisces. But in 
addition to the cold, when it has influence, look for fluctuations in temperature. 


No other sign is as windy as Gemini, although Virgo makes it close to it. Libra is windy, but not as windy as windy 
as Gemini and Virgo. In so far as this sign has influence in the season's, Temperature chart and Air Movement chart, 
you may expect lively winds without (surcease????). In weather charts which indicate storm, it shows that wind 
will be an addition. 


Gemini is bone dry, even though cold. It does not favor rain, and even tends to blow fog away.

Even if the rest of a weather chart shows rain, does it play any part with precipitation. 
indicates that it will be a driving rain, or rain which is part of a wind storm. 


CANCER 


Cancer is also a cold sign, but not drafty. Nor is the cold as intense as that given by Capricorn and Aquarius. It is 
colder than Pisces, however, and the coldness frequently is accompanied by rain in summer and snow in winter. 
In so far as it has influence on the Temperature Chart it tends to give low 

temperatures. 


Although Cancer is ruled by the Moon, which tends to restlessness and breezes, its influence is toward 

silence. It is the only one of the movable signs having such an influence, as Aries gives some wind, Libra is windy, 
and Capricorn gives wind and storm. The silence is not so evident as that of Taurus and Leo, but enough so that 
it can be considered as a sign tending toward calm weather. 


Of all the signs, Cancer is the wettest, although Scorpio, because of its extreme tendencies may, at times, give more 
violence to the downpours. Cancer, in its effect upon the Moisture Chart, and to the extent its influence becomes 
dominant, tends to steady and huge rains. It does not bring the cloudbursts, nor the sudden squalls; neither does 
it bring drizzles, nor just a few rainy hours. When it has power, it brings the kind of weather when it rains and 
rains some more, the water coming down in full force for several days at a time. 


LEO 


We all know Leo is hot sign. Dry and hot. Under its temperature control often not a breath of air stirs. The rays 
of the Sun bear down with a heavy hand, and the land swelters. Even in winter time, in so far as this sign has dom- 
inance of the Temperature Chart, warm weather may be expected; those bright, 

sunshine days that tend to melt the snow and drive the snow clouds from the sky. 


Next to Taurus it is the stillest sign of all. In so far as it has power to do so it stifles wind. Thus it is a fine influence 
in winter, warming the atmosphere and quieting the breezes. But in spring it may, when it is the dominant influence 
in the Temperature Chart, bring such fine warm days that the buds and blossoms of fruit may open prematurely, 
and the sap start running; to be followed, Aries tending to dry the earth. Uniformly, its importance in a Moisture 
Chart tends to delay rain and to prevent cloudy weather. Bright, clear, sunshiny days are typical of its influence. 
Yet it does have an influence when related with storms. Next to Aquarius it is the most electrical sign. When, as 
a result, there is a storm and the planets indicating it are in Leo, or the wet conditions are so evident as to bring 
rain in spite of Leo's importance in the chart, lightning and other violence may be expected. 


VIRGO 


Virgo, while not as cold as Capricorn and Aquarius, is yet a cold sign.And the Winds it Causes are cold winds. In 
so far as it has influence over the temperatures, either in winter or summer, it tends to cold, dry, windy weather. 
is typical. 


Its influence on the Air Movement Chart is regularly in the direction of wind. These winds are changeable, both 
w.r.t force and direction; but not so changeable 

as those of Gemini; for under Gemini it may blow a gale from one direction, and quickly change around and blow 
a gale from exactly the opposite direction. Cutting winds, such as to penetrate clothing and chill one to the bone, 
are quite characteristic. 


It is also regularly dry. It tends to discourage wind and fog; but when the wet influences are strong enough to over- 
ride this tendency, it adds wind to the storm. 


LIBRA 


Libra cannot be classified as cold, in the same sense that Capricorn and Aquarius, or even Virgo and Cancer, are 
cold. It is more correct to say that its influence is cool; a milder influence then those mentioned, but in the di- 
rection of lower temperatures rather than heat.

That it is an airy sign, and a movable sign, is fully natural out by its influence in producing wind. It does not just 
produce breezes, but those stronger air currents which are commonly called wind. In this respect it is not so ev- 
ident in its influence as Gemini and Virgo, but nevertheless it contributes clearly to the wind tendencies in any chart 
in which it is unusually prominent. Even though it is a Venus sign, it contributes to, rather than detracts from, the 
wind tendency of a storm chart, and may be one element in a tornado or hurricane. When the chart is not oth- 
erwise violent, the wind it brings is cool and refreshing, and not cutting and disagreeable like Virgo wind. 


On moisture it has a drying influence. Uniformly, in the Moisture chart its influence should be read, in so far as it 
is main, as favoring dry weather. It tends to drive the clouds from the sky and to give clear sunshiny days which, 
except for considerable wind, are enjoyable and favorable for outdoor work. 


SCORPIO 


Of this sign it may be said that it, more than any other, tends to extremes. Being very constructive or very de- 
structive. In so far as Scorpio has dominion in a weather chart, there is either plain cold or extreme heat. Its in- 
fluence seems never to be toward moderate temperature. 


In regard to its influence over the Air Movement Chart, however, its authority, if the chart as a whole 

shows violence, is always to increase the violence shown. if the chart show wind, Scorpio inclines the wind to be 
destructive in force. If the chart does not show wind, but heat, it gives still, airless days, in which the moisture and 
oppressiveness carrying into the night, making sleep difficult or impossible. Its power is often felt in storm charts 
which give rise to winds which reach the proportions of tornadoes and hurricanes. 


Scorpio is a wet sign, but not one which will break a drought. In weather charts which otherwise indicate dry 
weather, a dominant Scorpio merely makes the lack of rain continue and the dryness more extreme. But ina rain 
chart, or a storm chart showing rain, its influence is toward extreme rainfall. Thus it frequently is a noticeable in- 
fluence in the cloudbursts .and in the terrific downpours that sometimes come with the more violent storms. 


SAGITTARIUS 


Sagittarius, in its influence over temperature, is not hot like Aries and Leo, but is decidedly warm. in so far as it is 
a important factor in the Temperature Chart the weather to be expected is bright, clear, sunshiny and warm. It 
favors neither clouds nor fog, but tends to make visibility very good. 


The wind it brings is of moderate force and has an invigorating quality.Although giving some air movement, it nei- 
ther favors nor discourages storm winds to any a appreciable extent. 


It is a dry sign, and tends to dissipate clouds and prevent rain. To sum its general and consistent control up, it tends 
to fine, pleasant weather, such as favours outdoor work and outdoor sports. 


CAPRICORN 


This is the sign of storms, of extremes, of extreme cold, and of destructive floods and droughts. Its influence com- 
monly is toward low temperatures and in winter to temperatures so low as to be destructive of life. But in a period 
of excessive summer heat, do not look for Capricorn to make it reasonable . Instead, it will make the heat even 
more disagreeable. 


It is the sign which, more than any other brings blizzards. It increases the wind force when dominant in an Air Move- 
ment Chart.When the temperature drops to below zero, and the wind rises to a gale, driving sleet and snow before 
it, is typical Capricorn weather.And, at any time of year, when storm is indicated of any kind in a chart, such influ- 
ences as it has are toward increasing the destructiveness. 


It is the detriment of the Moon, and is not only a wet sign, but tends toward floods and detriments of the Moon, 
and is not only a wet sign, but tends toward floods and destructive snowstorms and hailstorms. In a drought 
period, however, it cannot be counted on to bring rain. It just tends to increase the drought.And in so far as it is 
dominated on to brings rain. It just tends to increase the drought.And in so far as it is dominant it brings disagree- 
able conditions, such as dark, damp, cold days, and cold drenching rains when rains are not needed. 'Unseasonable' 
weather of all kinds comes under its rule.

AQUARIUS 


Next to Capricorn this is the coldest sign, and a drop of temperature may constantly be expected under its in- 
fluence. Dry, crisp, cold weather, such as often occurs in February is typical of its influence. Only when other in- 
fluences are violent does it participate in storm, but when such conditions exist, it tends to increase the fury of 
a blizzard. 


Although it is a fixed sign, it tends to some movement of the air. Moderate breezes are characteristic of it, except 
when the chart is a violent one otherwise in which case, as mentioned, it makes for excessive cold and driving 
wind that drifts the snow in blinding clouds. 


lt consistently favors dry weather, but when the other parts of the Moisture Chart and Temperature Chart indicate 
rain, it adds to them the electrical element. Of all the signs, it tends most to give lightning. Whenever, therefore, 
in a chart for a region where lightning occurs, this sign is important in a rain chart, look for electrical pyrotech- 
nics. 


PISCES 


Pisces is not so evident in its influence as to be called cold, but is rather cool. Its influence in the Temperature Chart 
is consistently toward somewhat lower temperatures, but not of an extreme nature. in influence in general,it is 
not violent, but mild. 


Where the Air Movement Chart is concerned, it tends toward calm weather. In this respect it is not so powerful 
as Taurus and Leo but, nevertheless, it tends to moderate whatever windy influences are present. 


It is consistently a wet sign, but not given to the downpours that Cancer occasions, nor to the floods and disagree- 
able storms indicated by Capricorn. In a chart which shows storms, if important, it merely indicates that much rain 
will accompany the violence shown. But when free from extreme influences, it causes those rains which are’ sea- 
sonable’ and of marked benefit to the crops. 


In all its weather influences, next to Taurus, Pisces is most moderate, and produces conditions favorable to crops 
and to livestock. It also, therefore, like Taurus, only in a less degree, is the farmer’s friend. But do not plan a picnic 
when its influence is dominant; for the rain it brings is sufficient to discourage outdoor pleasures.

ANALYSIS 


Moon’s Placement & Significations 


As the client was quite apprehensive , | looked at the position and significations of Moon. Moon is placed in the 
7th house . Moon is placed in the star of Sun which is placed in the 5th house. Fifth house is the house of affairs 
. So Moon is the very strong significator of the 5th house. So | concluded that the client must be interested in 
the Love Marriage. Later on the client confessed having affair and also being interested in marrying his loved one. 
Hence the Moon really showed the way . 


Rules applied 


|. For Marriage 7th Cuspal Sublord must signify 2,7 & | Ith house. 

2.For Love Marriage 7th Cuspal Sublord must be connected to 5th house or 5th Cusp sublord must signify the 
houses 2,7 & II. 

3. Ruling Planets could considered to rule out unnecessary significators and also to time the event. 


Cuspal Analysis 


According to Krishnamurti Paddhati , when the query is regarding marriage one must consider the houses 2,7 and | | 
but when the /th cuspal sublord is related to fifth house by placement or by signification then there is Love Marriage. Here 
we will consider the possibility of Love Marriage as we had seen earlier the Moon signifying 5th house also.

house . 2nd house signifies Family ,hence growth in Kutumb is indicated here. 


7th Cusp ( Sagitarius 12:33:20 —-Ju Ke Me ) 7th Cuspal Sublord is Mercury , which is, as discussed above, the 
strong significator of 2nd house . 


[Ith Cusp (Aries 06:14:21 —Ma Ke Ra) I Ith Cuspal Sublord is Rahu which is placed in 7th house , it is placed

house of love affairs.So Rahu being | [th cuspal sublord is likely to give marriage with the desired girl. Involvement 
of Rahu also indicates that the girl belongs to the different caste. 


As it is now established that the client is interested in love marriage with a desired girl, which is very much likely 
to happen as | Ith house is the house of fulfillment of desires. | 1th house never acts independently. It always acts 
by linking itself to the desired houses. So now we will look at the 5th cusp also. 


5th Cusp ( Libra 06:14:21 —Ve Ma Mo ) 5th Cuspal Sublord is Moon in 7th house and placed in the star of Sun 
in 7.As we have discussed earlier, Moon is the significator of 5th and 7th houses. Therefore the client will marry 
with a desired girl.

Pre-Natal means before birth and EPOCH means beginning of an Era 





So, this is the beginning of a birth and it is the actual moment in which human generation com- 
menced is to say the moment of the conception itself. The conception in fact can be said to be the 
generation of mear human seed but the birth is that of man oneself 


Our beloved Guruji late Shri K.S.K. had invented the theory of Ruling Planets for birth rectification and also 
timing of an event. 


Myself and my uncle late Shri K.M.S. had an occasion to discuss with our Guruji why and how he had developed 
the Ruling Planet to 5 numbers as the Western astrology has taken only one i.e.,Asc lord only as R.P. 


He told us that he got inspiration only through pre-natal Epoch to form these R.Ps and also explained about the 
same, in a short way as he had given importance to Star Lord (Stellar theory) and he had taken both the Star Lord 
of ASC as well as Moon; these two are very important in a birth chart. He also advised to include Day Lord of 
that day. The lagna Star is the strongest and the day lord is the weakest R.Ps. 


That is why he used to advice us while checking the birth chart for rectification to see the Moor star lord or rasi 
lord, corroborate with lagna and the lagna star lord or Rasi lord at the moment of birth with the Moon possession 
as it was his personal experience. 


So is perfectly admissible that it is commitent with reason that the configuration of the R.Ps, as they exist at the 
time of birth fully agreeing with a configuration of R.Ps. found at the time of conception ( PNE). 


As per Llewellyn George in his book A to Z Horoscope Maker and Delineator, the possession of Moon at the 
time of pre-natal Epoch represents the degree, minutes and seconds to put on the ASC of the birth chart to find 
out the day of pre-natal Epoch (conception date).We have to count ten Lunar months or 273 days backward from 
the date of birth of a child. 


Count backward of number of days this found and it will bring you to approximate day of conception.And so the 
actual moment in which human generation commences is by nature of the moment of conception itself. In this 
article | want to make an attempt to prove that the RPs found at the time of birth are the same, as figured at the 
time of EPOCH, and then to explain how our beloved Guruji had found and was correct to tell that the RPs alone 
can be well used for the rectification of birth time in charts. 


The days of EPOCH can also be less than 273 and more number of days also, say between 250 to 281 days back- 
ward of a child birth as per my research study. 


According to our ancients who planned the conception of great man like king knew well that women can conceive 
during a certain time approximately. Iwo hours period Lunar Months when Sun and moon or exactly the same 
number of degrees apart as they were at the time of birth which may be discovered from the nativity of the 
female chart (Horoscope). The above information is found in “Santhana Deepika” , an old ancient Hindu test. 


The Natal Epoch which is merely an astrological method of counting back from the exact birth time of infants to 
the true and precise time of conception which will invariably and infallibly. reveals that a Sun — Moon relationship 
to match that of mother’s at her birth and will also match the sex of the child by the sex of the astrological sign 
in which Moon’s Sign lord or Moon’s Star lord was deposited at that time. 


lam going to discuss an example chart of a mother to find out the Pre-Natal EROCH using Sun-Moon relationship 
from the mother’s chart in terms of what is told in ““Santhana Deepiaka” as to how our great Guriji’s RP theory 
finds a place in the PNE and infant’s birth chart. 


The Sun-Moon relationship is nothing but actual Thithi of the mother found in the birth chart of MOTHER.

On Ayanamsa 


| follow only Newcomb. The Ayanamsa which | follow and which is followed by Mr. Lahiri or late C.G. Rajan and

Which Ayanamsa am | to follow? 


Follow Krishnamurti Ayanamsa. Forget all others. When Krishnamurti Ayanamsa is used and by using the subdi- 
vision of a constellation you come correct in minute details, it goes without saying that the other aynamsas are 
not to be followed, especially if it varies by degree? Follow only mine. 


On Astrologer’s Quality 
(He) who is honest, who is sincerely devoted to God, who does not speak ill of others --- It is Devine Grace. 


Analytical study, correct intuition, good judgment are needed for successful astrologers. Good astrologers will have 
in their horoscopes strong and favorable Mercury. 


On Karma, Destiny 


Chances, luck or misfortune are governed by the law of Causation or Karma. God is neither partial or unjust, and 
everything happens according to one’s action in the past birth. 


When we think we understand that the theory “Karma and Incarnation” alone can convince.--- what we have to 
enjoy is undoubtedly predestined. | cannot understand how the judgment of God can be, in any manner, modified 
or nullified by our efforts.--- 


Everything is predestined.---None can dodge fate.--- If one can change the event by one’s will, then astrology has 
no place. 


Karma can be divided broadly into three kinds: 


Dhruda (fixed) Karma that one has committed an inexcusable mistake or crime in the previous birth, 
Dhruda - Adhruda (fixed/non-fixed) Karma that one would have committed an excusable mistake in the pre- 
vious birth,and Adhruda (non-fixed) Karma that the crime committed may be negligible... 


The majority of people commit excusable mistakes called Dhruda —Adhruda Karma. Therefore Shanti will be done 
by them with or without their knowledge and they will not ultimately suffer... Just like one has no choice about 
his birth time, place and his parents, so also there is nothing left in one’s hands. Everything is pre-destined. None 
can change it. Then only one can use this science...Astrology is a science. It needs further research and confir- 
mation. There is no use for the word “Likely”. Everything is a certainty... It may be said, more as a compromise, 
that man is both a slave of the effects of his past deeds and is a free agent as regards his deeds which are in no 
way directed to thwart, arrest, alter or in any way modify or remold the effects of his Karma. 


On Research 
My Friends, we have come up to this- you should continue the research and you may reach to further truth. 


What we want is research for truth: Open mind to investigate---- Let them (students) also carry out further re- 
search--- It is for you--- to further study and make (KP) more useful, more simple---- 


Post-mortem alone will correct one. lgnorant people may say,“What is the use of post-mortem?” Such people 
do not want to keep a record of success and failure in their attempts and try to improve all or learn improved 
methods. 


On Remedies

be enjoyed shortly, he will or she will acquire this color; we attribute the luck to the gem. 


Truth is this: Acquisition of any Gem is indicated mostly by a benefic. So one acquires when the period of that

This book R.P. & K.P, first edition published in 1985, is a collection 
of 41 articles by 24 authors, including KM Subramaniam, KC Subra 
maniam, KR Kar, N Moham. In almost all of those earlier research ar 
ticles, only the original 5 RPs, mentioned by Guruji KSK have been 
used, and only a few authors had considered the sub lords of Ascen 
dant and Moon as ruling planets at that time, for example in pp 65, 
79, 108 of this book. 


RPs which are deposited in the sub of a planet in retrogression, or 
of a planet signifying houses detrimental to the matter in question, 
and are also not any way connected with the house relevant to the 
matter in query are left out of consideration. It is mentioned that 
after thorough research it has been established that a RP fails to 
offer results only when it is in a sub of the lord which is retrograde. 


(p xvi). 


It is to note that the ruling planets in retrograde do not prevent the event to take place but will only give the 
result when they become direct in motion. Reject the ruling planets which are posited in the star or sub of ret- 
rograde planets. (KP Reader VI pp 167, |7I, 176, 187, 202, 224, 274)

among the KP followers.

selective tool but not predicting tool. The success of RPs may depend on the urge of both the consultant and as-

QUESTION-| 
Implications of the Same Cuspal Sub-Lord for Different Cusps? 


| have a chart, where the Cuspal Sub-lord of: 

I) Ist, 2nd and 8th cusps is Venus in 5 I/o 4,9; 

2) 3rd and 9th cusps is Mecury in 5 l/o 5,8; 

3) 5th and | Ith cusps is Rahu in 8 etc. 

Note: (1) Jupiter and Saturn are ‘Retro’; (2) Sun, Mer & Jup are in Sat star. 





| would like to know whether the same sub lord for 2/3 cusps will act harmoniously for those cusps or differently. 
For example, whether the same sub lord for cusps 5 and || it will give the good result in the matter of child 
birth or not? Will the same sub-lord of 3rd and 9th cusps be good for higher studies in professional subject, and 
success in competition? 


ANSWER-! 


A general rule is that if the cuspal sub-lord is the same for more than one cusp, these cusps are deemed to be 
connected. The connection of Ist, 2nd and 8th cusps (houses) may be helpful for unearned money but may not 
be good for health. 5th and | Ith connection may be helpful to get the child, if it is promised. 3rd and 9th connec- 
tion may be good for higher education and foreign going, if they are promised.A connection of agreeable houses 
may act harmoniously, otherwise a favorable result may not be expected. It is still a general view but not yet sup- 
ported by sufficient research evidence. 


Such connection would be more effective when the same cuspal sub-lord does not have any planets in its star, 
and consequently it is self strong planet and also becomes the very strong significator of the houses for which it 
is the cuspal sub-lord. 


Retrogression effect may not need to consider in the natal chart.

I) Geographic Lat

down from those that appear in RP For example if there is Mer in RP then let say the main house CSL is 10th 
house then the |0th house CSL is either Sat or Ket. 


ANSWER-2 
The Geographic latitude may be preferable for doing KP horary analysis because of the following reasons. 


|) KP Horary is Guruji KSK's brain child born on Geographic. 


2) KP Horary Ascendant is according to the 249 sub table and other cusps are calculated on the basis of that 
Asc. position. 

3) Not yet sufficient research evidence that Geocentric can give better accuracy, as discussed in the Geo 
graphic or Geocentric article. 

4) Not yet widely used as Geocentric option is not yet supported in the mostly used Western Astrodienst 


(www.astro.com) and Vedic Hora.

This case from my file of records belongs to a bright student who passed graduation in medicine 
and on the occasion of convocation (due on | 3-03-2003), one of the prestigious awards of Best 
Outgoing Student was to be decided by the managing committee of the college. Since, there 
were a few who were extremely jealous of the merits of this student, the question came in de- 
spair from the student “Whether | would get the award” and she furnished me the horary 

number 79 for assessment. The horary chart was analysed by me at 19:47:30 Hrs on 09-03- ie, 
2003 at Bangalore. The horary chart is attached. 





This case is analyzed as follows. 
The Query: 


Lagna Sub-lord and Moon reflect the query and the mindset of the querist. Moon is the sole planet, which dom- 
inantly signifies the prestige of the querist (10-1H) placed in |Oth house as lagna lord. 


Thus, the question gets indicated in the chart and it was comfortable to proceed further. 


The co-ordinates of judgment: 


In order to acquire the award, the other contestants are to be defeated and so the 6H comes into picture. Since, 
the matter relates to the prestige and honor of the querist, the |OH gets the attention. 


The ultimate acquisition of the results is to be judged by the | 1H in any prashna chart. Thus an amicable connec- 
tion between 6-10-1 1H would matter for acquisition of a prestigious award, subject to the favorable dasha se- 
quence. 


The analysis: 


|. Analyse Lagna 


The lagna falls in an emotional sign Cancer with the Lagna-lord Moon ruling the lagna-sbL indicating that the 
querist must have been extremely emotional and could have made the acquisition of award as a prestigious issue 
by way of the placement of Moon in 10th house. 


Moon falls in the star of Sun placed in 8th house (signifying 8H) is closely conjunct with Rahu who signifies 8H 
again, thereby making the matter grave in concern. The manipulative nature of Rahu could influence the matter 
to settle either way. 


Moon falls in the sub of Mercury which is strong by way of having no planet in its star. Its placement in 7th house 
indicates the decision in other’s hands (7H). Mercury falls in the star of Rahu placed in |0th house (dominantly 
signifying |OH and providing saving grace for the question in view). 


2. Analyse 9th cusp 
9th cusp indicates the views of the opposition (3rd from /th). 


Sun is the sub-lord of the 9th cusp. Sun falls in the star of retro-Jupiter which suggests that the dictates of the 
judges who matter for the decision may not materialize ultimately. Sun falls in the sub of Mercury and as said in 
the previous para, Mercury strongly signifies |0th house and the opposition may have to revert in favor of the 
native. Thus, it provided high hopes to the ambitions of the native. 


3. Analyze the 6th and [0th cusps 
The 6th cusp would matter for the winning of the native and [Oth cusp would matter for achieving the honor. 


Incidentally, Saturn is connected to the cusps of 4-6-10-1 2th cusps as sub-lord. Thus, Saturn exerts its full influence 
on the matter relating to the acquisition of award (6-10H) which needs a connection with the | 1H for fructifi- 
cation. While Saturn gets placed in | Ith house, it falls in the star of Mars who owns the 5th and | 0th houses, thus 
signifying | |-5-10th houses dominantly. The Saturn being in its own sub affirms the indications to almost a certainty.

"One who neither hates nor desires the fruits of his activities is known to be always 
renounced. Such a person (Sannyasi), free from all dualities, easily overcomes material 
bondage and is completely liberated, O mighty-armed Arjuna." 

-Bhagavad Gita V-3 


Sannyasa 


|, Sannyasa is frequently translated as renunciation. One within the sannyasa order is known 
as a sannyasi who renounces all worldly thoughts and desires, and spends the rest of his life 
in spiritual contemplation. 


Sannyasa KP Rule 


2. If 1° cuspal sub lord signifies main houses 3,10,!2 and connected with Saturn in any manner, 
one can become sannyasi, during DBAS jointly signifying 3,10,12, and preferably connected with 
Saturn in any manner. 


3= mental trend, ability, forsake home forever 

|0= Parlok Sadhna, Karmasthana, regular practice of spirituality, action, name, fame 

|2= directed towards Moksha or salvation, worships, emancipation, renunciation, service to 
others 

Saturn= inasoonuh, seclusion, penance, renunciation, concentration, meditation, karaka for 
sannyasi 


3. In addition to the main houses 3,10 & I2, supporting houses 9 & 5 are also to be 
considered in checking I* CSL signification, and then especially house | | is to be considered 
in the timing of attainment of sannyasi or spiritual advancement. 


9= tapas, karmic influence, divine worship, moral, higher knowledge 
5= poorva punya, spiritual transformation on initiation 
| |= siddhi, attainment in spiritual mind

During the KP Astrologers Forum’s fortnightly meeting conducted on 08-November-2009 
chaired by Sri Rajendra Nimje, IAS. President, Spinal Curvature Disease was discussed in detail 
and 3 practical charts were taken up. 





Although Spinal Curvature (or curvature of spine) can refer to the normal concave and convex 
curvature of the spine, in clinical contexts, the phrase usually refers to deviations from the ex- , 
pected curvature, even when that difference is a reduction in curvature. Iypes include Kyphosis, 
Lordosis, and Scoliosis. 

Thoracic vertebrae: 


The twelve (12) thoracic bones and their transverse processes have surfaces that articulate with the ribs. Some 
rotation can occur between the thoracic vertebrae, but their connection with the rib cage prevents much flexion 
or other excursion. They may also be known as ‘dorsal vertebrae’, in the human context. Bodies are roughly 
heart-shaped and are about as wide anterio-posterioly as they are in the transverse dimension.Vertebral foramina 
are roughly circular in shape. 


Scoliosis is an abnormal curve of the spine, with the spine curving to the side, according to the American Academy 
of Family Physicians (AAFP). Depending on the extent of the curvature, one shoulder may be lower than another 
and the ribs or hips may stick out more on one side.AAOS says only 2 percent of the population is affected by 
scoliosis, which tends to be more common in girls, and runs in families. 


While scoliosis usually develops during childhood, it can also affect adults, according to AAOS. Actually, adult sco- 
liosis may be the progression of a condition that began in childhood, and was never diagnosed or treated. AAOS 
says adult scoliosis can be caused by changes in the spine that occur as we age. AAOS says, as more people age 
in this country, the incidence of adult scoliosis will probably increase. 


In most cases, AAFP says scoliosis causes few problems. Usually the curve of the spine is small, and rarely is there 
any back pain. (Read about "Back Pain") Cosmetics are a prime concern of many patients. However, according to 
AAOS, there could be some long-term effects if scoliosis is left untreated. AAOS says the condition can worsen.

Medical Astrology - Part 10 - 





Kyphosis 


An exaggerated curve of the back that looks like a rounded or hunched back could be 
Kyphosis, according to AAOS. Kyphosis might develop as a result of slouching. Poor pos- 
ture can stretch spinal ligaments and according to AAOS, increase the natural curve in 
the spine. It is more common among females than males. Luckily, kyphosis is rarely 
painful and AAOS says strengthening exercises may even help correct the problem. 


Congenital Kyphosis however is more serious. This occurs in some infants whose spinal 
column does not develop properly. AAOS says this type of Kyphosis will worsen as 
the child grows, but can be helped with surgery. Kyphosis or round back is also a com- 
mon problem among those suffering from osteoporosis. AAOS says, as more people 
age in this country, the incidence of adult Kyphosis will probably increase. Other con- 
ditions which can cause curvature include spinal problems such as arthritis and anky- 
losing Spondylosis - and connective tissue disorders such as Marfan syndrome. 








In Medical Astrology Natural Zodiac (Kalapursha) 5th sign Leo represents Spine & Makham Star where the Twelve 
Thoracic Vertebras are existing (T |—T. 12) which are representing Spinal Curvature. Sun is karaka for spine. Some 
are taking Mercury as karaka for spine. Any affliction to Leo, 5th house from Ascendant & Makha Star in Leo, thru 
6th cuspal sublord connection and Karaka Sun would lead to Spinal Curvature problem. (HL Cornell: Encyclopedia 
of Medical Astrology; Judith Hill: Medical Astrology and discussed by Sri S Kalyan, KP Astrologer, Sri Lanka). In this 
regard three types of curvature are indicated, including Kyphosis, Lordosis, and Scoliosis.

"Delay, dejection, disappointment, denial, etc. are caused by Sani, and strongly so if Sani occupies 
the 5th house where from it will aspect the 7th, | 1th and 2nd houses by its third, seventh and 
tenth aspects respectively. Whenever Sani happens to be a_ significator of 
a particular matter, it will not deny but will cause delay. If it is connected with houses 2, 7 and | | by 
occupying the house or owning it or situated in the constellation of the planet posited in any of these 
houses it will cause delay at every time- in fixation of marriage, celebration of marriage, etc. It will 
not deny marital happiness. But if Sani has no connection with houses 2, 7 and II but 
only throws its aspect, this portends denial and even disappointment. Generally, all 
those in whose chart Sani is placed in the 5th house will have their marriage, delayed and delayed 
till the very end." 

-KP Reader IV, page 109 (any Edition)

Colombo, 28 November, (Asiantribune.com): 


Sri Lanka’s Election Commission on Friday announced that the Presidential elections will be held on 26 
January 2010. 


Nominations will be accepted from 9.00 a.m to | 1.00 a.m on December | 7, Elections Commissioner | 
Dayananda Dissanayake announced yesterday. 





This will be the country’s fifth Presidential poll to elect the sixth Executive President. . 
President Mahinda Rajapaksa, the incumbent in office decided to go for a Presidential election though his term of off ice 
expires on November 2011. The announcement came four days after President Mahinda Rajapaksa decided to advance 
the polls by nearly two years. Objections against nominations can be raised from 9.00 am to | 1.30 on the same day. Ob- 
jections to the nomination papers could be raised by any of the rival candidates or by persons who had signed the nomi- 
nation paper, the official release said. 


All candidates of recognized political parties should make deposits of Rs 50,000 and independent candidates Rs 75,000 
before noon on the day of the nominations with the Accountant (Finance) of the Department of Elections. 

It is mandatory that a candidate other than those of recognized political parties should confirm that he/she had been elected 
a member of the legislature by a letter signed by the Secretary-General of Parliament, the official release said. The 2008 
electoral register will be used for the election with a total number of | 4,088,500 persons eligible to vote. So far except 
for President Mahinda Rajapaksa no one else has anounced their candidature to contest in the forthcoming Presidential 
election. It is reliably learnt that the former Army Commander General Sarath Fonseka is expected to anounce his candi- 
dature shortly. 

- Asian Tribune -

As already discussed in last two chapter, temperature is the most important influence both 
in air movements and in the precipitation of moisture, not only the temperature, but much 
about wind and moisture in their general effect on the season can be learned from the 
Temperature Chart. But the days during the season when such wind and moisture, are to be 
determined from the Air Movement Chart and the Moisture Chart, respectively. 


In its timing of weather conditions, the Temperature Chart is to be used exclusively to 
indicate changes in temperature. Temperature Charts are erected for the place where the 
weather is to be ascertained, at the exact moment the Sun enters Aries, enters Cancer, 
enters Libra, and enters Capricorn. As discuss in Part I. 





The chart for the time the Sun enters Aries indicates the temperature, and its changes, until 
the Sun enters Cancer. The chart for the time the Sun enters Cancer indicates the 
temperature, and its changes, until the Sun enters Libra. The chart for the time the Sun 
enters Libra indicates the temperature, and its changes, until the Sun enters Capricorn. The 
chart erected for the time the Sun enters Capricorn indicates the temperature, and its 
changes, until the Sun once more enters Aries. 


Thus do the four charts cover the temperature for the year. And time and amount of 
temperature changes will be check from DBAS. 


In the various ephemerides you will found table which shows the "Time when the Sun and 
Moon enter the Zodiacal Signs., in my analysis, | have used KPAstro 3.5' and KP new 
Ayanmasha.

indicates the temperature, and its changes, until the Sun enters Cancer.

indicates the temperature, and its changes, until the Sun enters Libra. 

Sun enters Libra on I|7/Oct/2009 at 09:03:43 the chart for the time the Sun enters Libra

Sun enters Capricorn at 14/1/2010 at 10.23.45 the chart erected for the time the Sun enters 
Capricorn indicates the temperature, and its changes, until the Sun once more enters Aries.

Sublord is Ven, Venus has a moderating influence. If the previous weather was hot, Venus 
tends to cool it, if the previous weather was cold, Venus tends to warm things up. In 
Weather Astrology, we can consider Venus as a violent planet. Commonly Venus indicates 
mild and pleasant temperatures. Ven is in Meena Rasi, Its influence in the Temperature 
Chart is consistently toward somewhat lower temperatures, but not of an extreme nature. 
in influence in general, it is not violent, but mild.

QUESTION-| 


Implications of the Same Cuspal Sub-Lord for Different Cusps? 
(continued from last month) 


There are some articles in KP & Astrology Annuals by different authors. | am unable to 
locate the year of the book readily. In that one author does not prefer the same S/L for 
different cusps. Another author has stated that it will create enmity between the 
relationship concerning the bhava. e.g. 3" and II" house CSLs are same for the native of 
Movable sign Lagna, | 1" being Bhadhakastana; there will be enmity between elder brother & 
the native. In the case | referred to you, 7" and 10" CSL both are same viz. Moon. Moon is 
friendly to Sun, the sign lord of 7" and also friendly to Mars sign lord of 10". In such case | 
presume that connection to 7" and 10™ may not affect the normal principle of denial of 
marriage (because of 10" signification). Here Moon is with self strength planet i.e. no planet 
is in its star. This may kindly be confirmed. | forgot to add this point in my previous mail. 


ANSWER- | 

|. In KP Badhaka applies to only longevity and health as per references given under. 

...even though it is Badhakasthana Athipathi which may affect only the health, if its Dasa or Bhukti 
is operating or the Dasa or Bhukti is ruled by the planet in the constellation of Saturn 
(Badhakasthana). Excepting that, Saturn has to necessarily do good to Mesha rasi borns.......... 


-KP Reader V page 263 second para (Old Edition page 228 first para) 


In Jataka Chandrika, it has been declared that the ||" house is the bhadhakasthana for persons 


born in movable sign (chara rasis)...... One should not go by the literal meaning of the 
‘bhadhakasthana and conclude that it is evil in every aspect, ‘Bhadhakasthana applies only to 
longevity and health...... -KP Reader II page 222 last para 


2. In KP friendship of planets cannot change the effects of bhava signification, i.e. the 
detrimental effect of 10" on marriage (12 to 11"). However, connection of 7” and 10" may 
not be considered to be denial of marriage as long as 7” is signified. 


QUESTION-2 

Which house is to be considered for girl friend? 

ANSWER-2 

|. For girl friend, lover, 7”, 5" house (Bill’s Rulership Book; Umang Taneja’s Dictionary of 
Significators in Astrology) seems reasonable as girl friend, lover is a candidate to marriage 
and 5" is love affair. 

2. In fact, the lover is more accurately ascertained from the ||" house, as the | 1" house stands for 


lasting friendship and intimacy that may end to marriage. 
-KP Reader Il, page 220 last para

answers to the question of Readers 





Can cuspal sub lord divert the dasa lord? 
ANSWER- 3 


The CSL can divert the dasa lord in some cases when the CSL is a strong significator 
opposite to the signification of dasa lord, for examples: 


a) If the 8th CSL gets strong signification for any one of (improving or favorable) houses 
|,2,3,6,10, a person need not at all worry about, whatever may the Dasa is on or to come. 
In this particular chart | 1th Badhaka bhava sublord is Jupiter, which is in | Oth. Therefore 
Badhakasthana loses its strength. - Astrosecrets & KP Part Il, 2003, pp 53 & 56 under 
‘Sub-Lords who Diverts the Dasa Lords' 


b) Rahu- X cusp sublord is Rahu. No planet in the star of Rau. Therefore Rahu is a strong 
significator of the X house, even’ though he occupies the IX..... 
- Astrosecrets & KP Part Il, 2003, p 197 under "The Golden Rule in KP” 


c) The cuspal sub lords become the strongest significators of concerned houses, if 
there is no planet in their stars. -KP Reader Ill page 309 (Old Edition, Practical Part 
page 145, KPA I99I July & November , PS Rao, Vikari Ramamurthi, R. Mukunda 
Rajan, Kuppu Ganapathi, Kanak Bosmia etc.

This Birth Chart was analyzed to find whether the native is destined to get married and if so 
when she is getting married. The KP birth chart is attached. 


For marriage, we need to analyse the seventh bhava of the native first. According to 
Krishnamurthi Paddhathi, sub lord of the seventh cusp plays an important role. This planet 
will indicate whether the native is destined to get married. If this is positive, this planet 
indicates all the details by his positioning in the birth chart, such as conjunctions, aspects etc; 





This planet will further give the details of marriage, nature of the would be partner and the 
period of marriage. 


In this birth chart, the 7th cusp falls in Capricornus, owned by Saturn and deposited in the 
12" bhava. Sub lord of this bhava is Venus. This sub lord is the owner of | 1 bhava and 
deposited in a star of Jupiter. 


According to Krishnamurthi Paddhathi, if the sub lord of the 7 cusp is a significator for 2" 
or 7" or II", marriage is promised. 7” bhava for partner, 2"° for the development of the 
family by marriage etc; and | 1 for fulfillment of the expectation. 


As the sub lord of the 7" is a significator for | 1", the marriage is promised. 

The 7“ bhava is owned by Saturn. The nature of Saturn is delaying. But not deny. Therefore 
we could say that the marriage is promised, but delayed. This marriage will be celebrated in 
the conjoined period of the significators of 2", 7" and | 1". 


Significators for Marriage

2°" bhava Owned by Sun. Sun is in very close conjunction with Mercury. No planet is 
deposited in the stars of Sun or in the bhava. 


7" bhava Owned by Saturn. No planet is deposited in the stars of Saturn or in the 
bhava. 

| 1 bhava Owned by Venus. Moon and Kethu are deposited in the stars of Venus. 
Moon and Kethu are also in close conjunction. No planets are deposited in 
the bhava. 


Accordingly, the significators are Kethu, Moon, Sun, Saturn, Venus, Mercury, Jupiter and 
Rahu.

In the ist chart, 4 CSL is Rahu. Rahu is in the star of Moon and sub of Rah. 


Rahu Conj with Jup so Rahu give result of Jup. Where Wind is concerned, he tilts towards 
pleasant breezes, Jup not a still planet like the Sun but Jup is not violent. Because his influence 
is so powerful, his own influence is toward mild breezes. Rahu is in Makar Rasi, It is the sign 
which, more than any other brings blizzards. It increases the wind force when dominant in an 
Air Movement Chart. When the temperature drops to below zero, and the wind rises to a gale, 
driving sleet and snow before it, is typical Makara weather. And, at any time of year, when 
storm is indicated of any kind in a chart, such influences as it has are toward increasing the 
destructiveness. 

Starlord is Moon, In the relation to Temperature chart, Moon is ‘Cool’. It does not give 
excessive cold like Saturn, but temperatures are chilly. Where rain is concerned, Moon is the 
wettest of all planets. 

Moon is In the sign of Meena, Where the Air Movement Chart is concerned, it tends toward 
calm weather. In this respect it is not so powerful as Vrishabha and Shimha but, nevertheless, it

Where Wind is concerned, he tilts towards pleasant breezes, Jup not a still planet like the Sun

breezes. Jup is in the sign of Makar, It is the sign which, more than any other brings blizzards.

drops to below zero, and the wind rises to a gale, driving sleet and snow before it, is typical 
Makara weather. 

Star lord is Mar, In relation to wind, Mars indicates some movement. Mars is not a windy planet, 
but assists action. Mars is in the sign of Meena, Where the Air Movement Chart is concerned, it 
tends toward calm weather. In this respect it is not so powerful as Vrishabha and Shimha but, 
nevertheless, it tends to moderate whatever windy influences are present.

normally toward cold, damp weather without breezes. Sat is in the sign of Mesha, Next to 
Vrishabha it is the stillest sign of all. In so far as it has power to do so it stifles wind. Thus it is 
a fine influence in winter, warming the atmosphere and quieting the breezes.

consistently gives beneficial rains. Ven is in the sign of Vrishabha, Vrishabha is a fixed sign, the 
most fixed of all the signs. This stabilizing influence marks it effect in an Air Movement Chart. 
More than any other sign, Vrishabha tends to calm weather in which not a breath of air stirs. 
Therefore, Vrishabha is main sign in an Air Movement Chart, it tends to stop winds. 

Sublord is Sat and we discuss about it. 

Mer in this Chart, Mercury's influence is ‘Cold’; Mercury is the chief ruler over winds. Mercury is 
inclined towards dry weather; Mer is in karaka, Although Karka is ruled by the Moon, which 
tends to restlessness and breezes, its influence is toward silence. It is the only one of the 
movable signs having such an influence, as Mesha gives some wind, Tula is windy, and Makara 
gives wind and storm. The silence is not so evident as that of Vrishabha and Shimha, but enough 
so that it can be considered as a sign tending toward calm weather. 

Mer is inj the star of Jup. Where Wind is concerned, he tilts towards pleasant breezes, Jup 
not a still planet like the Sun but Jup is not violent. Because his influence is so powerful, his own 
influence is toward mild breezes. Jup is in the sign of Kumbha, Although it is a fixed sign, it 
tends to some movement of the air. Moderate breezes are characteristic of it, except when the 
chart is a violent one otherwise in which case, as mentioned, it makes for excessive cold and 
driving wind that drifts the snow in blinding clouds. 

Sublord is Moon, In the relation to Temperature chart, Moon is ‘Cool’. It does not give 
excessive cold like Saturn, but temperatures are chilly. Where rain is concerned, Moon is the 
wettest of all planets. Moon is in the sign of Meena. Where the Air Movement Chart is 
concerned, it tends toward calm weather. In this respect it is not so powerful as Vrishabha and 
Shimha but, nevertheless, it tends to moderate whatever windy influences are present. It is 
consistently a wet sign, but not given to the downpours that Karka occasions, nor to the floods 
and disagreeable storms indicated by Makara. In a chart which shows storms, if important, it 
merely indicates that much rain will accompany the violence shown. But when free from extreme 
influences, it causes those rains which are’ seasonable’ and of marked benefit to the crops.

Dear Sir, 


Thanks for your mail; there are certain design aspects 
to be followed while designing an electronic book 
(eBook) or Digital Book. KP-Ezine is an eBook i.e. 
meant for reading, enjoying and acquiring knowledge 
onscreen without a need for print edition / publication. 


If it is a print edition, naturally most of the contents 
will be in black colour, but it is in an eBook format, 
hence wherever titles appear, use of multi colour style 
makes reading a pleasant experience and also en- 
hance its aesthetics. In multi colour format, different 
background and foreground colours gives it colour 
match. 


Main purpose, advantage and feature of an eBook is to 
eliminate usage of paper, a global eco issue. There are 
many advantages in presenting it as an eMagazine I.é. 
portable, shareable, archieving, no need to carry bulk 
printed books, cuts expenses on paper cost, printing 
ink cartridge cost etc. While we value your sugges- 
tions, certain aspects, if we change, may reduce its 
aesthetics and elegance. Hope this clarifies font colour 
issue and you will understand the design require- 
ments.

Dear Editor, 


| am very sad to hear the news of his demise of India's Number One Online Astrological Bookstore owner Shri 
Hasmukhrai Mehtaji. From my experience | had found him gracious, courteous and a fine person, lovable by all. 
| procured "Nakshatra Chintamni" book from him, which he promptly sent. On receipt | found about |5 pages 
were missing in the book. In this regard | still have a record of our e-mail correspondence how he replied very 
courteously. Later on he regretted his inability to send the photo copies of the missing pages and offered free 
supply of another book, if | purchased any other book. As | did not want any other book, | thanked him for his 
efforts. We have lost a great courteous person. | understand that he tried even to get the required books of cus- 
tomers from abroad, if he has no stock of them. Such a helpful nature person, he was. 


My deep sympathy and condolence to the bereaved family. May his noble soul rest in peace. It is irreparable loss 
for the astrological books lovers. 


Yours sincerely, 
K.S.V. Ramani
