One of my colleagues had to travel outstation on official trip and he had put up the matter to his management 
for approval. He indicated to me frankly that he seriously wanted this official journey to happen so that some im- 
portant personal commitments could also be done simultaneously at the destination planned for official travel. 
Since, he did not get management approval so far, he was not able to plan the journey and was anxious to know 
if the travel was possible. 


In this anxiety, the native asked me on Jan 07, 2010 if he was to travel within Jan 10, 2010. | did not ask any 
horary number from the native and just worked on the time chart. 


The co-ordinates of judgment 


In a horary chart for travel, it is the 3rd house that affects travel by making one get out of the house (4th 
house). This has to have a linkage to the | [th house for materialization of desire. The dasha sequence 
and transit enact the event accordingly. 


Analysis of the chart 
I. Analyze lagna 


Lagna being a moveable sign and its lord Mars debilitated in 4th house with retrogression indicated great urge to 
get out of the house (4th house) for travel. Mars is the sub-lord of the lagna, which as lagna lord falls in the star 
of Mercury (lord of 3-6th house) placed in 8th house making the native to get frustrated for travel. 


Moon was seen placed in 5th house; hence the chances of trip getting materialized were also indicated. 
| considered the chart OK and decided to proceed further. 
Ze Analyze 3rd cusp 


This chart was a difficult one. The reason was the 3rd cusp, which is lorded by Saturn as its sub-lord. By conven- 
tional norms, the journey was to be delayed against the wish of the querist. At first temptation, | also tended to 
declare the result in this tone. 

|, however, noted that Saturn was a self strong planet, as it did not have any planet in its star. Such planets when 
become the sub-lord of a cusp do have a dictate in the result of fructification of matters related to that house. 
Thus, Saturn had to decide the journey. It was noted that Saturn was in the star and sub of Moon (fastest planet) 
in the 5th house (a promising house). This gave me the inkling that Saturn not only would commence the journey 
but would also do it soon. 


| kept this observation reserved till further analysis. 
3. Analyse | 0th cusp 


This cusp was necessary to be analyzed, as the trip was to be materialized on professional ground. We have to 
see, if such combination exist. 


|Oth cuspal sub-lord was Ketu, which happens to be a strong planet as there is no other planet in its star. Such 
planets have a decisive say in the matter under scrutiny. Note that this Ketu is placed in 3rd house meaning that 
the travel was to be enabled. 


At the stellar level, Ketu falls in the star of Jupiter placed in |0th house as 9-1 2th lord. Incidentally, Jupiter is the 
| Ith cuspal sub-lord, thus linking Ketu to the | Ith cusp and tending to materialize the travel without doubt. 


4, Look to Fortuna 


Saturn happens to be the sub-lord of Fortuna and the analysis done at Sec 2 hold good here. Thus, Saturn pro- 
moted the trip in principle. 


5. Look to dasha sequence 


Since Saturn was found instrumental in effecting the travel and it was an event to happen in a few days, | pondered

Rectification of birth lime 
By Prenatal Epoch and Ruling Planets 


SREEPALEE Astrological Services, 
Ketawala — Leula, Sri Lanka 





In the past the Birth Time of a native was taken according to the facilities available at the 
place of birth. Now a days, we have the clock time which is internationally available and the 
clocks are the time keepers for the nations. Therefore it is not necessary to worry about 
the accuracy of the time of birth. 


However we are not expected to obtain the correct time from the staff in the confinement 
as all the members of the medical staff are concerned about the safe delivery and also the 
safety of the mother and the child to be born. Therefore they do not necessarily responsible 
for giving the exact time of birth. 


Generally we get the clock time of birth. This time is used to cast the horoscope of the 
native. If it is not correct, the horoscope details would not be correct and the predictions 
given accordingly will not be accurate. 


We normally rectify the birth time, when we prepare a horoscope to eliminate all the 
doubts about the time of birth. 


In the rectification of birth time, there are a number of methods according to eastern 
principles of astrology. Out of all, we, the followers of Krishnamurthi Paddhathi, use the 
Golden Rule of Krishnamurthi Paddhathi, the RULING PLANETS. 


According to the reliable system of Krishnamurthi Paddhathi, the ruling planets activate at 
the time of birth or any event of the life of the naive. Even at the time of any post mortem, 
these ruling planets appear conjointly. 


So the RULING PLANETS could be applied to any evnet of life. 


This is an attempt to rectify the birth time using ruling planets and the method of pre natal 
epoch. 


Pre natal epoch is the time of conception of a native. This conception takes place in the 
mother of the native. Approximately in a period of nine month, the naive will come out of 
the mother and start the life separately, in normal births. 


There are other abnormal births, where the native will not complete the nine months 
periods in the womb, in cases such as pre mature births. 


In the eastern principles of astrology, the time of conception is used to rectify the time of 
birth. It states that the time of conception and the time of birth have a very good 
astrological combination. Therefore we could use this principle to rectify any doubtful birth 
times. 


In the pre natal epoch method, the rule is that Moon and Ascendant of birth has a very good 
combination with that of the time of conception. Here the Moon and the Ascendant of birth 
will have an interchange with the Moon and Ascendant of the time of conception. 


lf the birth occured in a waxing Moon period, the birth Moon will exchange with the 
position of the Ascendant at the time of conception. The Ascendant at the birth will 
exchange with the Moon of the conception. If the Moon at birth is waning, the Ascendant of 
birth will exchange with the opposite sign of the Moon at the time of conception. In the

At the outset | wish everybody a Happy and Prosperous New Year 2010. During the KP Astrologers Forum's

Pneumonia is an abnormal inflammatory condition of the lung. It is often characterized as including inflammation 
of the parenchyma of the lung (that is, the alveoli) and abnormal alveolar filling with fluid (consolidation and 
exudation). 


The alveoli are microscopic air-filled sacs in the lungs responsible for absorbing oxygen. Pneumonia can result 
from a variety of causes, including infection with bacteria, viruses, fungi, or parasites, and chemical or physical 
injury to the lungs. Its cause may also be officially described as idiopathic—that is, unknown—when infectious 
causes have been excluded.

Typical symptoms associated with pneumonia include cough, chest pain, fever, and difficulty in breathing. 
Diagnostic tools include x-rays and examination of the sputum. Treatment depends on the cause of pneumonia; 
bacterial pneumonia is treated with antibiotics. Pheumonia is a common illness which occurs in all age groups, 
and is a leading cause of death among the elderly and people who are chronically and terminally ill. Additionally, 
it is the leading cause of death in children under five years old worldwide. 


In Medical Astrology Natural Zodiac (Kalapursha), 3rd House Gemini sign (breathing), its lord Mercury 
(karaka), ruling lungs, Saturn, Jupiter (karaka) indicate respiratory system & pneumonia disease. Cancer sign is 
for lower lung, 4th Cusp (Lungs) and Moon (depositing of fluids in lower lobes of the lungs) & Sun also indicate 
lung infection; Rahu is also a significator of lung problems. Star Punurvasu indicates lungs, respiratory system & 
pneumonia. (Bill Rex's Rulership Book/ Umang Taneja's Dictionary of Significators; Dr. J. Lee Lehman's 
Rulerships, Judith Hill's Medical Astrology, Dr. Jagannath Rao' Medical Astrology; K Subramaniam’s Medical

Book Review 





Raphael's Table of Houses for Northern Latitudes 


from the Equator to 50 Degrees N.O' Also for Leningrad 59 Degrees N. 56' (Paperback) 
W. Foulsham & Co., LTD. 104 pages 


|. Raphael’s Ephemeris and Table of Houses ruled the astrological world during the period when Guruji KSK was 
doing research and writing KP. Nowadays the highly accurate Swiss ephemeris dominates the current astrological 
SWs like KPAstro 3.5, Jagannatha Hora, Astro-Kundli, Jyotishya Deepika, Astracadabra, KPStarOne. 


2. The drawback of the Raphael’s Tables of Houses (first published in |821) is that only ascendant position is given 
to the degree and minute and other cuspal positions to the nearest degree only. The current Universal Table of 
Houses, Michelsen Tables of Houses and AFA Tables of Houses give the cuspal positions up to the degree and 
minute and Krishman KP Tables of Houses up to the second. The manual calculation by using these Tables of 
Houses provides the cuspal positions very close to the SW results. In the new era of high precision drive by SWs 
like Astrodienst/KPAstro 3.5, the Raphael’s Ephemeris and Table of Houses look like a historical record only. 


3.The manual calculation of planetary positions from the American Ephemeris can give the nearest accuracy of 
Astrodienst/KPAstro 3.5. The Raphael’s Ephemeris or Swiss online Ephemeris do not provide up to the second 
positions of all planets, except Sun and Moon, and so they cannot give the same accuracy of the American 
Ephemeris in manual calculation.

rectified or astrological birth time should be verified by major life events.

Reinstatement - 


Electronic City, Phase-1, Hosur Road, BANGALORE 560 100 
Phone: Office: 080-25119580 / Res: 080-26587463 Mobile: 0-98450-39153 
E-mail: v_kumar@cdotb.ernet.in 





This case is from my file of records. One of my relative was worried for his son who was serving in Merchant 
Navy. He was sent home on punishment without pay and any future scope in sight. He asked me if his son would 
be re-instated in the job, as the job was good in long term. He gave me horary number 13. 


The matter was taken up for scrutiny at 18:03:00 Hrs on 28-05-2003 at Bangalore. The chart was rotated to 5th 
house. The rotated chart is reproduced as follows. 


Co-ordinates of judgment: 


The prospects in a horary chart relating to the profession are primarily governed by the !|0H, as this 
house decides the way the flow of karma takes place for matters relating to profession. The indications 
of | 0th cusp are then verified by the examination of 6th cusp as it indicates the job in hand. In case if 
the ambition of the native under the framework of prashna is to be realized, the | 1th cusp should support 
the matter in full. 


In this query related to a job re-instatement, it is evident that the querent has already a job from where the re- 
instatement is sought, thus the 6th cusp in such a prashna chart relates to the present job. 


In case, if the job has to be re-instated, the 6th and |0th cusp/house should have connectivity with the I Ith 
house. These indications shall fructify to realization in proper spread of dasha-bhukti in line with the transits. 
Pratyantara dasha lord would matter for the fructifications in nearby periods. 


In this case study, the [Oth and 6th house refer to the present job in which the native was placed in, as he was 
not terminated from the job. 


The Query: 


Fundamentally, in any prashna, the lagna indicates the query, while the Moon indicates the status of mind and the 
matter on which the querist dwells about. 


Look to the lagna SbL-Jupiter, which being a strong planet gets placed in | 2th house as 5th lord. This shows that 
the native finds himself lost. 


Moon itself gets placed in 8H indicating a sense of choking and frustration. Moon falls in the star and sub of Venus, 
which is a weak lord of 3-!Oth house but placed in 9th house showing the native without job. 


Thus, the question was well indicated in the prashna chart and it was comfortable to proceed further. 
Analysis: 
[. Examine lagna. 


Lagna sub-lord is Jupiter, a strong planet and placed in | 2th house. Jupiter as 5th lord falls in the star and sub of 
Mercury placed in 9th house. The Lagna sub-lord signifying 5-9-|2th houses does point to the loss of job. 


However, Mercury being lord of | lth house does keep some positive promises waiting. 
2. Examine 6-10th cusp 


6th cusp indicates the present job in which the native was facing punishment for low performance. 6th cuspal sub- 
lord is Venus (3-1 0th lord) which being in its own star gets placed in 9th house with its sub lord Jupiter placed in 
[2th house. 


Saturn is the sub-lord of the |Oth cusp, which as 6-/th lord gets placed in |0th house. Saturn falls in the star of 
Mars placed in 6th house, which seemed positive to get continued in the same job (6H). The sub of Saturn is Sun, 
which as Lagna lord is placed in 9th house close to the |Oth cusp. This gave a hint that the native may continue 
in the same job. 


Note that in general scenario of job prospects, 9th and | 2th houses are negative which normally indicate loss of 
job. However, for the present case of job in Merchant Navy, the 3-9-1 2th houses actually define the job conditions

This is my second article on this subject. It thus proves that if anybody applies the Krishnamurti Padhdhati principles in 
solving the query , then one will get correct prediction all the time.A 2nd yr student of MBBS came to me with this query. 
Let us see how | solved it. 


Query > Result in MBBS 2ndYr Exam 

Horary no. : 136/249 

Date : 03-02-2009 

Time 19:57 PM 

Place : Bhopal, Longitude 77E26 Latitude 23N1/6 


Ayanamsa_ : KPNA 23:53:38 
Hints and Rules 


|. If the sublord of the 4th cusp is the significator of 4,9 and | 1th house, the success in examination is 
promised. 

2. Sublord of the [1th cusp when connected to the houses under consideration will give positive result; 
here in this case it needs to be connected to 4th & 9th house. 

3. Mars , Mercury and Jupiter promise success when they are connected to 4,9 and | |th house . 

4. For Failure the houses which are | 2th from 4th and 9th house i.e 3rd and 8th must be considered . 
Analysis 

First of all one must check the position of Moon and Ascendant Sublord. The query is genuine if the Moon or As- 
cendant Sublord is connected to the houses under consideration. Moon is placed in 7th house, it is in the star of 
Sun which is placed in 4th house .So the Moon is connected to 4th house. Now let us see the Ascendant Sublord 
which is Sun and it is placed in the 4th house . Hence the query is genuine and now we must proceed to solve 
the query. 

Cuspal Analysis 

4th Cusp : ( Capricorn :19:16:14 --- Sa Mo Me ) 

Mercury the 4th cuspal sublord is in the star of Sun, which is placed in 4th house, and no planet is in the stars of 
Mercury, so Mercury is a strong significator of 4th house. Mercury’s sublord is Moon which is also placed in the 
star of Sun hence signifying 4th house strongly. So it indicates success. 

9th Cusp: ( Gemini : 17:15:41 — Me RaVe ) 

Venus is the cuspal sublord of 9th house , it is placed in 5th house and it is in the star of Saturn which is placed 
in | lth house which is house of fulfillment of desires. So Venus is a strong significator of | [th house.Venus’ Sublord 
is Mercury which as already stated above is strongly signifying 4th house. So success is indicated here also. 

[Ith Cusp :( Leo ; 21:24:13 — SuVe Ju ) 

Jupiter is the cuspal sublord of | Ith house and placed in 3rd house. It is in the star of Moon, which is placed in 
7th house and sub of Rahu, which is conjunct with Sun, as stated above strongly signifying 4th house. Hence 
Jupiter although is strongly signifying 3rd and 7th house but is also connected to Sun of 4th house significator. 
Hence it indicates success. 

Dasa Bhukti Antara Analysis 

Running Mahadasha is of Sun which as calculated is strong significator of 4th house. Bhukti is of Mars which is 
placed in the 3rd house and is placed in the star of Sun thus connected to 4th house strongly, also Mars sublord 
is Mercury which is cuspal sublord of 4th house and also signifying 4th house strongly. Antara is of Moon, which 
is placed in the star Sun signifying 4th house. So Mahadasha, Bhukti and Antara lords indicate success. 


Conclusion 


As per the above analysis, | told him not to worry about the result and surely it would be in his favour . 


The Student called me three days later and told me that he passed the examination.

Acute bronchitis is an inflammation of the large bronchi (medium-sized airways) in the lungs that is 
usually caused by viruses or bacteria and may last several days or weeks. Characteristic symptoms 
include cough, sputum (phlegm) production, and shortness of breath and wheezing related to the 
obstruction of the inflamed airways. Diagnosis is by clinical examination and sometimes microbiological 
examination of the phlegm. Treatment for acute bronchitis is typically symptomatic. As viruses cause 
most cases of acute bronchitis, antibiotics should not be used unless microscopic examination of Gram 
stained sputum reveals large numbers of bacteria.

Mr Tin Win answers to the question of Readers\g 





Can the cuspal sub lord (CSL) divert the dasa lord? 


Answer 


|. The CSL can divert the result of dasa lord when the CSL is a strong significator and it is detrimental or | 2th 
to the signification of dasa lord. 


2. The CSL becomes a very strong significator of houses for whose cusps it is the sub lord, if there is no planet 
in its stars. (-KP Reader Ill p 309: KP & Astrology 1991 July p | & November p 8; PS Rao, KM Subramaniam, Vikari 
Ramamurthi, R. Mukunda Rajan, Kuppu Ganapathi, Kanak Bosmia and so on ---) 


3.In a particular example chart, |Oth CSL is Rahu and no planet is in the stars of Rau. Therefore Rahu is a strong 
significator of the | Oth house, even though he occupies the 9th house. (Astrosecrets & KP Part Il p197 in article 
“The Golden Rule in KP’) 


4.|In a particular example chart, | 1th Badhaka bhava sublord Jupiter is in |Oth. Therefore Badhakasthana loses its 
strength as | Oth is Vraya-|2th to | Ith. (No planet is the stars of Jupiter.) (Astrosecrets & KP Part Il p 56/ Sublord 
Speaks-3 p 170 in article ‘Sub-Lords who Diverts the Dasa Lords’) 


5. The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is favorable or not. The significators 
point the time of event. Both dasa, bhukti and gochara must agree. (KP Reader V page 224/ Original Edition p 21 I, 
KP Reader Ill pp 226, 362 ) 


6. If a bhava CSL gets the strong bhava signification of favourable houses |,2,3,6,10,1 1, then it could not give the 
negative results, whatever dasa may be on or to come. The results indicated by a particular bhava CSL alone has 
to be implemented by the dasa lord. (Astrosecrets & KP Part Il p 54/ Sublord Speaks-3 p 168)

One of my colleagues in the office asked me to predict “What happened to him on 21/-2-2010 at 1440 Hrs” while 
he was at home. 


This was asked in a challenging tone and | was not mentally prepared to answer it. However, | mustered courage 
and cast a time chart on 22-02-2010 at 18-13-34 Hrs at Bangalore to anticipate what happened to the native 
known to me at the specified time. 


The chart was rotated to | Ith house. The rotated chart is reproduced as follows. 

Co-ordinates of judgment: 

The prashna chart aimed to find the event that happened at the asked time could be deciphered as below. 

Principally, Lagna and Moon give sufficient clues to the nature of events that could have happened and the impact 

given. Beyond it, it could be read as follows. 

|. Plot the RPs in the prashna chart and read through sub-lord or sub-sub lord. If it is too closer to some cusp, 
read from the cusp. 

2. Read by the sub-sub lord of Moon 

3.Read by the | Ith cuspal sub-lord 

Analysis: 

|. Examine lagna. 


Lagna sub-lord is Rahu in the star of Venus placed in 9H and in the sub of Mercury placed in 8th house. The Lagna 
thus signifies 9th house (some thing unexpected) resulting into an accident (8th house). 


Moon is placed in its own star placed in | 2th house with its sub-lord Saturn placed in 4th house. Thus it pointed 
out a loss (12th house) through some household item (4th house). 


2. Examine RPs 


At the time of judgment, RPs were Sun-Ket-Venus-Moon.| could plot it to Leo sign (Sun)-Ketu star-Venus sub and 
Moon sub-sub. This sensitive point falls in the 2nd house very close to the 3rd cusp. Thus, | intended to read from 
the 3rd cusp whose sub-lord is Rahu. 


As indicated above, Rahu zeroes it down to some unexpected accident (8th house). 
3. Note the Sub-sub lord of Moon 


Moon has Mercury as its sub-sub lord. Mercury is a strong planet as there is no planet in its star, thus dictating 
on its positional status. Note that Mercury is placed in 8th house and thus it tends to dictate the 8th house 
results such as an accident. 


4. Look to the | 1th cusp 
| Ith cuspal sub-lord is Jupiter, which falls in the star of Rahu and sub of Mercury. 


At the stellar level, Rahu signifies 7th house and at the sub level, Mercury signifies 8th house by its positional status. 
This combination again indicated accident. 


| did not get inclined to study further and declared that there could have been an accident causing loss of money. 


| also noted that the native could have skipped the wrath of the accident and would have been safe without any 
injury, as the lagna lord was not involved strongly anywhere. Even though, Mercury was the lagna lord, yet the 
Mercury’s lordship of Lagna is weak as Ketu occupies Lagna.

My colleague told me that he encountered the blast of the coffee percolator in his kitchen and though some par-

Here are the reasons not to worry about adverse effect of Pluto: 

¢ Firstly, no planet is wholly benefic or malefic. 

¢ Secondly, in KP the planet which is conjoined or ‘aspected by’ the significators of grade A, B, C and D is a 
‘weak’ significator of grade E. This planet is to give the results by itself as a weak grade E significator only but 
not to change the results of the grade A, B, C, and D significators. 

¢ Thirdly, it is not logical for a far away, tiny object Pluto to change the results of other real planets always for 
malefic through mere connection within 3° 20' orb. Pluto is also no longer considered as a planet in astronomy 
since 2006. 

¢ Finally, the adverse effect of Pluto has not been found in the following charts as per courtesy of Astro-Databank,

This month | am going to discuss about Gastritis relating to Disease of Stomach and 4 practical charts were taken 
up (Source: Dr. Bhamidipati Satyanarayana Murthy & Astrodatabank). Sri K Raghavendra Kumar M.Sc. B.Ed, was 
extended his assistance in preparing this article. 


Gastrectomies are performed to treat cancer and perforations of the stomach wall. In severe duodenal ulcers it 
may be necessary to remove the lower portion of the stomach called the pylorus and the upper portion of the 
small intestine called the duodenum. If there is a sufficient portion of the upper duodenum remaining a Billroth | 
procedure is performed, where the remaining portion of the stomach is reattached to the duodenum before the 
bile duct and the duct of the pancreas. If the stomach cannot be reattached to the duodenum a Billroth Il is 
performed, where the remaining portion of the duodenum is sealed off, a hole is cut into the next section of the 
small intestine called the jejunum and the stomach is reattached at this hole. As the pylorus is used to grind food 
and slowly release the food into the small intestine, removal of the pylorus can cause food to move into the small 
intestine faster than normal, leading to gastric dumping syndrome. (Courtesy: Dr. Bhadmidipati Satyanarayana, MD)

>| Punarphoo - Saturn & Moon 





19. Unsettled life and profession

24. Negotiation broken and marriage delayed

1. In the Preface of this book, Shri Vaikari Ramamurthy has written that Guruji KSK in his KP Readers 
mentioned about Punarphoo only in some marriage matters. Vaikari Ramamurthy had lot of 
experience of this Sat-Moon combination, i.e. Punarphoo dosha not only in marriage aspect but each 
and every aspect of a man’s life such as marriage, progeny, love affairs, inter caste marriage, delays 
profession, denial of marriage, betrothal, marriage agreements, mismatched marriage and also 
some miserable life of the native due to the presence of this Sat-Moon combination, i.e. 
Punarphoo....". The table of contents (above) gives a good, brief, description of its possible effects in 


34 example charts in this pure research oriented book. 


2. The whole idea of Punarphoo is condensed by Guruji KSK in one paragraph as follows: "Whenever 
Saturn has got any connection what-so-ever with Moon, there will be some obstacle or impediment, 
not only during negotiation but also at the time of fixation and even at the time of celebration of the 
marriage. This connection between Moon and Saturn causes delay, though ultimately both of them 
do much more good with a better partner." (KP Reader IV page 74) 


3. Saturn-Moon connection is only part of the equation which can give very different results 
depending on their significations and relation with other planets. This connection may not be not 
benefic or malefic by itself, and inferring the conclusion other than delay effect by just relying on 
the mere Saturn-Moon connection might be baseless. Such conclusions are not yet proven by 
systematic research, and so it is not to worry about adverse effects of Punarphoo, which is open to 


empirical research. 


4. Out of the first 10 horoscopes in Dr. B.V. Raman’s Notable Horoscopes, 7 horoscopes are with 
Punarphoo, namely Sri Krishna, Sri Gautama Buddha, Augustus Caesar, Sri Adi Sankaracharya, Sri 
Jesus Christ, Prophet Mahamud , Sri Ramanujacharya and the author’s chart with Punarphoo is at 
the end of his book . 


5. There are plenty of other spiritual leaders with Punarphoo like Pope John Paul Il, Swami 
Vivekananda, Sri Yogananda, Acharya Rajaneesh (OSHO), Swami Jananananda, Sri Arbindo Gosh of 
Pondichery, political leaders such as Napoleon Bonaparte, Queen Victoria, Abraham Lincoln, Franklin 
Delamo Roosevelt, Benito Mussolini, Joseph Stalin, Dwight D Eisenhower, Z.A. Bhutto, Martin Luther 
King, Jimmy Carter, Henry Kissinger, F.M. Ayub Khan, Indira Gandhi, Rajiv Gandhi, SWRD Bhander 
Nike, astrologers like Michael De Nostradamus, K. Subramaniam, Sandy Crowther, Visti Larsen, 
successful celebrities such as Elvis Presley, Marilyn Monroe, Padma Shree Nargis Dutt, Raj Kapoor, 
Madhuri Dixit, Gina Lollobrigida, Greta Garbo, Sophia Loren, Raquel Welch, Whitney Houston, 
Angelina Jolie, Hugh Hefner and others like Karl Max, Jiddu Krishnamurti, Sir Jagdish Ch. Bose, Oscar 
Wilde, Steffi Graf, OP Jindal and R.P. Goenka etc.

Question | 


Will you kindly clarify my doubt: For men, 7th house is for Ist marriage, 9th house is for 2nd and | Ith for 3rd 
and so on, What house is to be considered for woman for 2nd marriage, after divorce? Whether the same 
method as for men will hold good? 


Answer | 
|. The ‘same way’ of counting from the last marriage e.g. 7th house is to be applied for ‘both’ men and women. 


2.But there are two views of counting from the last marriage: first view is to take ‘8th’ house from the last mar- 
riage e.g. 8th from /th, “2nd house for 2nd marriage’,and second view is to take 3rd house from the last marriage 
e.g. 3rd’ from /th,’9th house for 2nd marriage’, as given under. 


3.1.Second House for Second Wife 
a) Kalidasa: Utara Kalamrita, translated by Dr. DS. Sastri, 2001, page 107 (Rationale: 2nd being 8th from 7th signifies 
death of first spouse or 7th house matters) 


b) KP Reader Il, 1983, page 189 


c) KP Reader IV, 1984/2002, pages 83, 181 & 184 (the houses to refer to “ascertain the time of marriage, descrip- 
tion of partner and the state of married life are the 8th house from the most recent spouse’; for 2nd marriage 
8th-from-/th, i.e. 2nd house; 3 rd marriage 8th-from-2nd, i.e. Ith house; 4th marriage 4th house, 5th marriage | Ith 
house, 6th marriage 6th house etc. )

National Tragedy 


3.0n 10 April 2010, a Tupolev Tu-154M plane was carrying Lech Kaczynski, his wife Maria Kaczynska, and 
other members of a Polish delegation from Warsaw to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the Katyn 
massacre of Polish army officers and intelligentsia. The plane crashed while approaching Smolensk Air 
Base in Russia at 08:56 Eastern European Time (06:56 GMT). The plane hit trees in foggy conditions 
about 1 kilometre (0.6 mi) from the airport. There were no survivors of the crash. 96 people were killed 
in the crash, including many of Poland's highest military and civilian leaders.

analyzing the query.

Pancrea 


tic cancer: Pancreatic cancer is sometimes called a "silent killer" because early pancreatic 


Cancer often does not cause symptoms, and the later symptoms are usually non-specific and varied. 
Therefore, pancreatic cancer is often not diagnosed until it is advanced. Common symptoms include: 


a 


Goflclacider 


Lad aS | 


Digestive System 





Pain in the upper abdomen that typically radiates to the back (seen in carcinoma of the 
body or tail of the pancreas) 

Loss of appetite and/or nausea and vomiting. 

Significant weight loss. 

Painless jaundice (yellow skin/ eyes, dark urine) when a cancer of the head of the pancreas 
(about 60% of cases) obstructs the common bile duct as it runs through the pancreas. T his 
may also cause pale-colored stool and steatorrhea. 

Trousseau sign, in which blood clots form spontaneously in the portal blood vessels, the 
deep veins of the extremities, or the superficial veins anywhere on the body, is sometimes 
associated with pancreatic cancer. 

Diabetes mellitus, or elevated blood sugar levels. Many patients with pancreatic cancer 
develop diabetes months to even years before they are diagnosed with pancreatic cancer, 
Suggesting that new onset diabetes in an elderly individual may be an early warning sign of 
pancreatic cancer. 

Clinical depression has been reported in association with pancreatic cancer, sometimes 
presenting before the cancer Is diagnosed. However, the mechanism for this association Is 
not known.

Viedical Astrology XIIl - Pancrease 


Daivagnys SEO a mad i" 


A Ragnavendrakumal 





The pancreas is a gland organ in the digestive and endocrine system of vertebrates. 1t is both an endocrine 
gland producing several important hormones, including insulin, glucagon, and somatostatin, as well as an 
exocrine gland, secreting pancreatic juice containing digestive enzymes that pass to the small intestine. 
These enzymes help in the further breakdown of the carbohydrates, protein, and fat in the chyme. The 
pancreas is a dual-function gland, having features of both endocrine and exocrine glands. 


Diseases of the pancreas: Because the pancreas is a storage depot for digestive enzymes, injury to the 
pancreas is potentially very dangerous. A puncture of the pancreas generally requires prompt and 
experienced medical intervention. 


Pancreatic cancer, particularly cancers of the Exocrine Pancreas remain one of the most deadly cancers, and 
the mortality rate is very high.

On 23-06-2008 a student from Delhi asked me the question about admission in the engineering college of 
his choice near Chandigarh, for which he was trying and | asked himto choose a number between 1to 249. 
He gave me the number 5.1 made the calculation of horary chart on 23-06-08 at 9:54 pm (Chandigarh) and 
analysis as given under. 


Firstly, as per the Gulbarga Theory, if Ascendant sub lord is the same as the Moon start lord, then the 
answer is affirmative. |n this case, Ascendant sub lord is Mars and the Moon star lord is also Mars. 


Secondly, as per KP in page number 191 of Horary Astrology, Sixth Reader by Shri K.S Krishnamurti, the 4°" 
house indicates the educational institution and since his desire is to get admission, the 11'" house shows 
realization of his ambition. Therefore, sub-lord of the 4°" cusp is to be deposited in the constellation, 
which is the significator of 4 and 11 by occupation and lordship. Here in this case, 4'" cuspal sub lord is 
Mercury, which is the significator of 4°" house by lordship and Mercury is in the star of Moon, which is in 
the significator of 11'" house by occupation. So the condition is fulfilled for getting admission in the desired 
college. 


Thirdly, Moon is in 11'" house and 11'" cuspal sub lord Ketu is in the sign of Moon which is in the 11°" house. 
Moreover Ketu is inthe star of Mercury, which is the significator of 4'" house by lordship. So his desire is 
to be fulfilled at the earliest as Moon is the fast moving planet. 


Fourthly, the calculated horary chart Ascendant sign lord and sub lord is Mars and star lord is Ketu, which 
acts as agent for Moon. Mars and Moon are among the Ruling Planets at the time of judgment, i.e. Asc sign 
lord =Saturn, Moon star lord =Mars, 

Moon sign lord =Saturn, Day lord =Moon (Monday). 


So! told him that he would | get the admission inthe engineering college of his choice. 


ACTUAL RESULT - On 24-06-08 | got a message from the student that he had got the admission in the 
desired engineering college of his choice near Chandigarh.

QUESTION- 1 


Reg. matching of couple's charts for marriage, | would like to Know whether malefic influences such as 
Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Kethu and Sun on the charts including Bhadhaka and Maraka positons are taken into 
account inthe KPDP Rules framed by Shri K.P.Kuppu Ganapathi of New Delhi? Whether the percentage 
permitted for matching including the Rule 10, for which it is emphasized, should be above 50%? Whether 
the Rule 10 of KPDP Rules which is emphasized to be more than 50% also includes all malefic influences 
which Is called Doshas & Samyam in traditional astrology. |n KPDP how it is nullified of one Dosha with 
other? 


ANSWER-1 


1. AS explained inthe KP & Astrology Year Book 1997 pp 32-44,(KPEzine March 2007 page 8-9) the KPDP 
matching does not taken into account such mentioned malefic influences because in KP no planet is fully 
malefic or benef ic. 

2. The overall including the Rule 10 should be above 50% in order the couple can lead a happy , harmonious 
and prosperous wedded life. 

3. The Rule 10 of the KPDP matching also does not include any kind of so-called Dosha in traditional 
astrology. 

4, Longevity, health, finance, harmony, children, status of married life etc. are also to be analyzed as per 
KP rules. 


QUESTION- 2 


Clarification on the evilness of 8th house Is sought for as follows. As per K.P. Rules on p. 13 "How to] udge 
Longevity", lord of 6 or 8 or 12 are malefics. If lords of 1,5,9 and 10 also rule 6 or 8 or 12, thenthe 
planet may be taken as mostly benefic. In respect of Aries Lagna, Mars is lord of land 8 and placed in 8th 
Scorpio his own house. |n such case, whether the planets inthe stars of Mars or inthe sub of Mars, can 
they inflict harmto the Aries native to curtail his longevity. Kindly clarify. 


ANSWER- 2 


As Mars I/0 1,8 is in 8", it would be bad for longevity because 6,8,12 houses are generally malef ic for 
longevity . Moreover planets in the constellation of evil planets inthe 8th house, except Saturn, occupants 
of the 8th house, planets inthe constellation or inthe sub of lord of 8, lord of the 8th cusp and planets in 
any manner connected with them threaten (a) danger to one's life, (ob) the cause of death and (c) the place 
of death. (KP Reader I 11, Practical Part p 12/New Edition p 165) 1f Mars 1/0 1,8 is in any of 1,5,9 (not 
Badhaka) and 10, it would be good for longevity. 


QUESTION- 3 


In kK PSystem what power/ place is given to a combust planet and the planets situated inthe star of a 
combust planet what about that cuspal sub lord which is situated inthe star of a combust planet? Are they 
considered weak? | f so, how much weak they are? How can we judge the strength & power of the planets? 
P| make it clear for KP beginners. 








i Question & Answer 





ANSWER- 3 
1. Combustion Is well explained in KP Reader VI pp 147-154 based on the finding of the Stellar Astrological 
Research Institute, Madras, and at the end it is noted that a planet in combust ion does not become malef ic 
and does not fail to give the benefits If it has to offer. 
2. Any practical application of combustion theory inside the KP framework has not yet been found and 
combustion Is not having any place inthe KP system. 
3. The following empirical studies have supported the KP finding of a planet within a few degrees of the Sun 
not changing Its effects or combustion being invalid: 

e G. Dean: Recent Advances in Natal Astrology, England, 1977, p 333 

e H. Beer: Les Cahiers Astrologiques No 6, Nice, 1946, pp 294-297 

e Church of Light: Astrology 30 Years Research, ed D.C. Doane, Los Angeles, 1956, p 184 

e —E.Symours: La Combustion, Nice, 1946, pp 22,55

reply from Sri Narayanan ji, 

Dear Kanakji, 

| would like to reply regarding the font issue / file size / download time, highlighted by Mr Vadivel, as 
f ollows: 

1] All website are created using HTML / ASP / PHP / Dreamweaver but KP-Ezine is in PDF format; 
definitely there will be file size difference since the file format is totally different and also due to (1) 
inclusion of charts, (2) inclusion of picture images (similar to those used in medical astrology article), (3) 
inclusion of advertisements, (4) template design of each page / cover page where the intensity of image is 
more and (5) other features offered in the eBook (we have given hyperlink in contents page which will load 
the selected page). 

2] |1na website all elements / components are hyper-linked and load separately when the object is clicked / 
selected whereas In an eBook all pages (full of objects / components) are loaded as an whole object. 

3] Most of the websites use Verdana / Helvetica / Tahoma fonts but whereas an eMagazine layout is 
different from a website layout design. eBook is nothing but a replacement to a printed book in digital 
format. Naturally it will have all colour / image depth, aesthetics. A web-page can be designed to load in 
Stages but an eBook cannot be designed to load in stages. 

4] | compose each issue by assembling objects to the layout with a lesser file size; hence we are able to 
maintain a file size of approx. 1.5 MB each issue. (ranging from 44 to 50 pages). 

5] | presume that this gentleman would have downloaded KP-Navratnamala part 2 which Is of a very large 
file size approx. 7.5 MB since proper technology was not applied at the time of creating / composing the 
eBook whereas KP-Navratnama part 1 was created with an amazingly lesser file of 750 KB. 1 was not 
involved in creating KP-Navratnamala Part 2; when! downloaded the file sent by you, | realised that it will 
create file size / lengthy download time issues. 

6] My humble opinion in my experience is that embedding multi fonts will not increase the file size. | would 
like to differ inthis aspect from the opinion given by Mr Vadivel. Comparing a web page to an eBook in PDF 
format is not correct since their properties differ. 

7] Download time will very from PC to PC based onthe broadband speed / connectivity used by the reader. 
8] | ncrease in number of pages also will increase the file size but to the maximum possible | have been able 
to retain the file size range between 1.50 to 1.75 MB, per issue. | will endeavour my best. 

| suggest you to seek the views of Sri Rangarajan ji also inthis regard since he is a technical expert.

3. Examine the 6th house 


Analysis of 6th house/cusp would indicate the status of the disease. 


Moon lords the 6th house and is placed in 5th house close to the cusp. Thus, there seem to be some hope of cure 
but Moon lording the 4-6-|2th cusp as sub-lord being positionally strong leave lesser hope towards the cure. 


6th cuspal sub-lord is Moon and as observed in the preceeding section (1), Moon may not be relied for giving cure 
from the disease. 


At the stellar level, note that Moon is the sub-lord of 6th cusp and its star-lord Rahu gets placed in | 1th house 
whereas its sub-lord Moon itself gets placed in 5th house. On the face value, Moon does give some promise of 
relief to the patient. However, the life expectancy of the patient would decide whether the patient would survive 
or not. 


4. Examine 7th house 
The 7th house represents the attending doctor to the patient. 


Note that Sun is the sub-lord of 7th cusp which is the lord of maraca house (7th house). Sun happens to be in 
its own star placed in 3rd house and in the sub of Jupiter placed in lagna as | Ith lord, making the patient to 
struggle for life. Thus, the attending doctors would help the patient to recover. 


However, Saturn also gets placed in 7th house which being a strong planet positionally would try to disable all 
the efforts of doctors by slowing down the recovery pace and drag the patient in the hospital (Saturn being 
strong | 2th lord than lagna lord) and with slow and piecemeal recovery (Saturn aspect 5th house of cure). Thus, 
doctors would have to bow down to the desire of Saturn. 


5. Examine 8th house 
This house is also crucial for assessing the longevity and death. 


8th house is unoccupied and its lord Mercury is placed in a maraca house (2nd house) in the sign of Mars which 
gets placed in 6th house, showing the chronicity of disease and perhaps the continuation of disease till the life 
ends. 


8th cuspal sub-lord Saturn, a strong planet, dominates the hold on 8th house. Saturn, as said earlier, is the strong 
lord of |2th house, thus is a strong maraca planet. Saturn holds the sub-lordship of the 2-4-8th cusps thus is a 
strong maraca. Note that Saturn aspects Lagna lord Jupiter, 2nd house (maraca) and Venus (badhaka lord), thereby 
taking the sole charge of the maraca functions (2-7-|2) alongwith badhaka functions. 


Thus the struggle for life could be intense and the vitality of the patient seems to be low. 
6. Examine the | 1th house 
The assessment of | Ith cusp would indicate in overall context about the outcome of the query. 


| Ith house has Rahu posited therein that influences this house. Note that Rahu disposes Jupiter (maraca lord as 
2nd lord) and Venus (badhaka lord).At the stellar level, Rahu falls in the star of Venus and in the sub of Jupiter, thus 
Rahu gets dominated by Venus and Jupiter and is thus a branded maraca for the patient. 


| Ith cuspal sub-lord is Mars which is placed in 6th house (disease) and aspects 9th house (badhaka house), | 2th 
house (exit from the mortal coils) and lagna (patient’s itself).At the stellar level, Mars falls in the star of Mercury 
(strong 8th lord) placed in the 2nd house (a maraca house). Rahu being the sub of Mars acts as a full fledged 
maraca, as explained in the preceding para. Thus, | lth house supports maraca effects and does not save the pa- 
tient.

Accurate Death Prediction 


|. Accurate death prediction is the greatest mystery of all but astrology can predict this as 
we know it. Such prediction is considered as great achievement by great seers themselves 
and it makes them famous, for instance Varahamihira, Cheiro, Charles Carter, BV Raman, 
Guruji KSK etc. 


2. Mihira was awarded the Varaha title for his historical and famous prediction about the 
death of King Vikramathithya’s son to become famous as Varahamihira, and is praised “what 
he utters comes true’. (KP Reader Il pp!9-22) In his prediction, Varahamihira also said that 
no human remedies could avert the danger and save him from the jaws of death. However, 
some are referring Varahamihira as saying, after proper remedies, even in a bad period, if 
one falls in the mouth of a lion, he can come out unscratched. 


3. Cheiro correctly predicted the date of Queen Victoria's death, the year and month when 
King Edward VII would pass away, the grim destiny that awaited the late Czar of Russia, the 


assassination of King Humbert of Italy etc. http://www.free-numerology.org/cheiro.php 


4. As a final flourish, in 1955 Charles Carter correctly predicted that his own death would 
be in 1968. "I confess I'd like to live to hear about man's first trip to the Moon but this 
seems rather improbable. In 1968 my p.Moon is conj. P.Sun and p.Mars, near rad. Moon and 
oppos. rad. Jupiter, which seems to indicate a heavy strain; also at this time...the whole 
family joins in with typical ‘bereavement’ directions! We shall see; but as a good astrologer | 
feel | ought to place on record my own forecast on this point! Uranus is also at this time on 
p.MC and the commonest sign of death seems to be a malefic on an angle, though of course 
this often happens without much effect on health." (He died at age 81, on 4 October 1968, 
nine months before man’s first trip to the Moon.) 


http://www.charlescarter.co.uk/elections-degree-areas-death.html 


5. Dr. BV Raman had made correct and published death prediction in advance for many 
world leaders, Jawaharlal Nehru, Adolf Hitler, Benito Mussolini etc. (Astrological Magazine, 
Notable Horoscopes by Dr. BV Raman; ‘Proof of Pudding’ by KN Rao in “Astrology and the 
Hoax of Scientific Temper” pp 39-89) 


6. Guru ji KSK’s accurate death prediction for Jawaharlal Nehru, Bhahadu Sastri, a well 
known physician of Madras etc can be found in KP Reader Il, pp xv & xvi, p 24 etc. 


7. The Ministers’ astrologer Haveli Ram Joshi astonishingly foretold an exact date for Pandit 
Nehru's death five years earlier. ‘Nehru, The Invention of India’, by Shashi Tharoor, 2003, 
New York, p 214) 


8. K. Subramaniam and his brother K. Hariharan had done accurate death prediction for 
their mother, Mrs. K.S.. Krishnamurti by Horary. “Longevity”, 1986, by K. Hariharan, pp 
34-37) Present karma or free will may be reflected in predicting death by horary. 


9. In old times, astrologers were also much more forthcoming in predicting the deaths of 
emperors or kings very precisely. For instance, after astrologer Ascletario told emperor 
Domitian about his death, the emperor asked the astrologer about his own death. 
Ascletario replied he would soon be torn apart by wild dogs. The emperor immediately 
called his quards and had the astroger killed on the spot and gave orders that the funeral

10. The correct determination of longevity is very important and highly complex. Even sage 
Prasra has admitted “Knowing longevity is difficult even for Gods.” (sloka 2 of chapter on 
Longevity, BPHS)

angels might rightly fear to tread.

CKV Rule 





(1) Take the CSL of ‘Cusp’. Note whether it is deposited in Male or Female sign. Denote this gender by ‘G’, that 
is, G is either Male or Female. (Odd Signs Of Male:1,3,5,7,9,1 1. Even Signs Of Female: 2,4,6,8, 10, | 2)

Let this count be L. 


(4) Count the number of planets Rahu or Ketu or Saturn that appear in the sign where ‘Cusp’ CSL is deposited 
(i.e., conjoined with ‘Cusp’ CSL). Let this count be M.

(6) If N is an even number, then G is the guessed gender of the blood relative (of the native) denoted by ‘Cusp’. 
If N is an odd number, the opposite of G is the guessed gender.

OM GAJAANANAM NAMAMYAHAM 
This month | am going to discuss about Appendicitis relating to Intestine and 8 charts 
were taken up (Source: Dr. Bhamidipati Satyanarayana Murthy & Astrodatabank). Sri K 
Raghavendra Kumar M.Sc. B.Ed, was extended his assistance in preparing this article. 


Appendicitis: Appendicitis is a condition characterized by inflammation of the appendix. It is 
classified as a medical emergency and many cases require removal of the inflamed appendix, 
either by laparotomy or laparoscopy. Untreated, mortality is high, mainly because of 
peritonitis and shock. Reginald Fitz first described acute and chronic appendicitis in | 886, 
and it has been recognized as one of the most common causes of severe acute abdominal 
pain worldwide. A correctly diagnosed non-acute form of appendicitis is known as "rumbling 
appendicitis. 


Rovsing's sign: Continuous deep palpation starting from the left iliac fossa upwards (anti 
clockwise along the colon) may cause pain in the right iliac fossa, by pushing bowel contents 
towards the ileocaecal valve and thus increasing pressure around the appendix. This is the 
Rovsing's sign. 


Psoas sign: Psoas sign is right lower-quadrant pain that is produced with the patient 
extending the hip due to inflammation of the peritoneum overlying the iliopsoas muscles and 
inflammation of the psoas muscles themselves. Straightening out the leg causes the pain 
because it stretches the muscles, and flexing the hip into the "fetal position" relieves the 
pain. 


Obturator sign: If an inflamed appendix is in contact with the obturator internus, spasm of 
the muscle can be demonstrated by flexing and internal rotation of the hip. This maneuver 
will cause pain in the hypogastrium. 


Blumberg sign: Deep palpation of the viscera over the suspected inflammed appendix 
followed by sudden release of the pressure causes the severe pain on the site indicating 
positive Blumberg's sign and peritonitis. 


Causes: On the basis of experimental evidence, acute appendicitis seems to be the end 
result of a primary obstruction of the appendix lumen. Once this obstruction occurs the 
appendix subsequently becomes filled with mucus and swells, increasing pressures within the 
lumen and the walls of the appendix, resulting in thrombosis and occlusion of the small 
vessels, and stasis of lymphatic flow. Rarely, spontaneous recovery can occur at this point. 
As the former progresses, the appendix becomes ischemic and then necrotic. As bacteria 
begin to leak out through the dying walls, pus forms within and around the appendix 
(suppuration). The end result of this cascade is appendiceal rupture (a ‘burst appendix’) 
causing peritonitis, which may lead to septicemia and eventually death. 


Among the causative agents, such as foreign bodies, trauma, intestinal worms, lymphadenitis, 
and calcified deposits known as appendicoliths, the occurrence of an obstructing fecalith has 
attracted attention. The prevalence of fecaliths in patients with appendicitis is significantly 


June 2010 KP-Ezine 





Astrology-Part XV - Appendicitis 


M.Com. FCS. & 
M.Sc B.Ed 





higher in developed than in developing countries, and an appendiceal fecalith is commonly 
associated with complicated appendicitis. Also, fecal stasis and arrest may play a role, as 
demonstrated by a significantly lower number of bowel movements per week in patients 
with acute appendicitis compared with healthy controls. The occurrence of a fecalith in the 
appendix seems to be attributed to a right sided fecal retention reservoir in the colon and a 
prolonged transit time. From epidemiological data it has been stated that diverticular disease 
and adenomatous polyps were unknown and colon cancer exceedingly rare in communities 
exempt for appendicitis. Also, acute appendicitis has been shown to occur antecedent to 
cancer in the colon and rectum. Several studies offer evidence that a low fiber intake is 
involved in the pathogenesis of appendicitis. This is in accordance with the occurrence of a 
right sided fecal reservoir and the fact that dietary fiber reduces transit time. 


Diagnosis is based on patient history (symptoms) and physical examination backed by an 
elevation of neutrophilic white blood cells. Histories fall into two categories, typical and 
atypical. Typical appendicitis usually includes abdominal pain beginning in the region of the 
umbilicus for several hours, associated with anorexia, nausea or vomiting. The pain then 
"settles" into the right lower quadrant, where tenderness develops. Atypical histories lack 
this typical progression and may include pain in the right lower quadrant as an _ initial 
symptom. Atypical histories often require imaging with ultrasound and/or CT scanning. A 
pregnancy test is vital in all women of child bearing age, as ectopic pregnancies and 
appendicitis present with similar symptoms. The consequences of missing an ectopic 
pregnancy are serious, and potentially life threatening. Furthermore the general principles of 
approaching abdominal pain in women (in so much that it is different from the approach in 
men) should be appreciated.

2. KP is the sub lord theory only, nothing else. There is no KP system without considering 
sub lord. The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is 
favorable (promised) or not. Planetary sublord indicates whether it is beneficial or not when 
the significators of dasa period lords point the time of event. In timing of the events, this 
planetary sublord, along with cuspal sublord gives clue to the astrologer for a correct future 
prediction. 


3. Here the articles are found mainly relying on sublord and its starlord without giving much 
attention to the promise by the cuspal sub lord. However, the sub lord is considered as the 
deciding factor although the sub’s star is used to know the signification of sub. The 4 step 
theory is developed on the basis of the Sublord Speaks articles by using sub's star as 4™ step. 


It is to note that Guru ji KSK has used the sub’s star only in one place, one time and one 
example in the KP Readers to trace the signification of sub. It is to consider three level 
signification of planet, star and sub according to the KP fundamental rule, “The planet is the 
source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the sub is a deciding factor whether 
the matter is favorable or not”.

Question |: For finding whether a male native will be blessed with a child or not, which house is to be consid- 
ered? Whether 5th or | Ith ? In Mr. Gondhalekar's 4 step theory, for the sex of the child. it is said that 5th is 
to be judged for wife's chart and | Ith to her husband. PI. let me know the correct approach. 


Answer I: In KP and Vedic, generally 5th cusp for mother and | Ith cusp for father is considered in checking 
promise or sex of child. The rationale is that | Ith house of husband is the 5th house of his wife, and it is SHE 
who bears the child for him to become a father. (KP Reader VI pp 224 & 233) 


Question 2: Suppose two events are to be checked in a chart, are we to prepare two sets of RPs for two dif- 
ferent times in which each is judged? 


Answer 2: If two events are considered at the same time of sitting, one set of RPs at that time judgment is suf- 
ficient. If two events are analyzed at different times, two sets of RPs at different time of sitting are required. In 
Hoary analysis, one chart is to be used for one query only using the RPs at the time of judgment. “We must take 
only the time of judgment.--- When the urge is there, note the Ruling Planets,---- Note the time when the urge 
is there ----- immediately work out --- the Ruling Planets.“ (Guru ji KSK) 


Question 3: | am a regular reader of KPE-zine articles. Recently | read your KP navaratnamala part | & part2 
series. It’s really helpful for me to understand about KP system and cleared my many doubts. My sincere wishes 
to your dedication and presenting the articles to KPE-ezine. But | have some doubt about the retrograde planets. 
You didn't mention about retrograde planets in the articles. How it is important retrograde planets in prediction 
especially in KP? 


Answer 3: Retrogression is written at length in the article “KP for Beginners- Part | 1, Reading a KP Horary 
Chart’, under sub heading “3.2. Controversy of Retrogression” in points | 7 tO 30, in the KPE-zine April 2009 issue, 
concluding with: “29. Some scholars ignore the result of the retrograde planets by putting several examples in 
support to their opinions [K.M. Subramaniam (KPA 1997 p 51, Sublord Speaks- | p 84-5), Kanak Bosmia (KP 
Muhurat p 3), Sunil Gondhalekar (Four Step Theory p 54), Umang Taneja (Prashna), S P Khullar (Horary Astrology 
p ix)] But D.C. Ghose had found in hundred of Horary cases that the retrograde planet has failed to offer the 
due result. (Result of Planets in Retrogression, KPA 1995 p 6) 


30. -----So further research of a minimum of one hundred carefully documented Horary charts is required to form 
a credible opinion on retrogression whether it does matter or not in the Horary analysis.” 

We are in the process of collecting the Horary cases where retrogression does not work with the help of our 
KP brother Kanak Bosmia. 


Question 4: | ama regular reader of your articles that published in KPE-zine. In navratanmala 2 the article under 
the heading TIMING OF EVENT was not understood by me. Sir please explain me this article with an example 
that (HOW TO PREDICT TIME OF EVENT BY TRANSIT AND BY DASHA IN NATAL OR HORARY CHART). 
Thank you very much. 


Answer 4: Timing of event is really a very difficult task even for a very seasoned and experienced K.P Astrologer. 
The Step 5- Checking Dasa, Bhukti, Antara, Sookshma (DBAS) (point 53 to 56) and Step 6- Transit Check (point 
57 to 63) in the article “KP for Beginners- Part | 1, Reading a KP Horary Chart”, in the KPE-zine April 2009 issue, 
may be helpful to some extent. Next time this topic would be revisited with practical examples.

This case belongs to a head of the organization on deputation whose term was coming to an end on Feb 18, 
2010 and as known to me, he was in extreme tension for further continuing in the office in the same status. 
There was a possibility of his continuance but nothing was heard till Feb 8, 2010. 

Out of my astrological interest, | ventured to assess if the native would continue in the existing top position and 
| took horary number 81 for this question myself. The chart was casted on Feb 8, 2010 at 13-39-05 Hrs at Ban- 
galore. The chart was rotated to 11th house to represent the native. 

The rotated chart Is as follows 

Coordinates of judgment 


Lagna in this chart represents the native and 9" cusp/house represents the superiors whom he reports. 


The prospects in a horary chart relating to the profession are primarily governed by the 10H, as this house de- 
cides the way the flow of karma takes place for matters relating to profession. 


It may be noted that the analysis of cusps of various houses along with the planetary significations represent the 
fixed promises of the chart but the results are dispensed by the suitable dasha-bhukti in consonance with the 
transits. 


The Query 


In the horary chart, Moon is placed in 6" house indicating the matter pertaining to the job. Moon in the star of 
Mercury falling in the 8" house indicates some impediments and anxiety to the native. 


With the above, | took the chart OK to proceed for further analysis. 


Analysis of the chart 
Look at the promise indicated by the lagna. 


Rahu is the lagna sub-lord, which by way of its placement in 8"" house close to the 8" cusp makes the extension 
at the top position not so easy. 


At the stellar level, Rahu falls in the star of 6" lord Venus placed in 9" house, which favor the native by the su- 
periors. 


Rahu disposes J upiter (sign lord) and Venus (Star lord). 

Jupiter as 11" lord is placed in 9" house, hence the favor from the superiors is assured. 

In short, the indications of Lagna do promise the continuance of the job with the support of the superiors. 

Look at the 10" cuspal sub-lord 

10°" cuspal sub-lord is retro-Saturn. Saturn is a strong 10 lord and its placement in the 4" house of stagnation 
actually favors the native, as the continuation of the native in the same position may be looked as the stagna- 


tion. 


At the stellar level, Saturn falls in the star and sub of 3™ lord Moon placed in 6" house, which does promise fa- 
vor the native for continuing at the same position.

1. This article is to check the validity of three KP rules and seven Vedic rules regarding inter- caste, inter-community or 
inter-religion and love marriage on the basis of 60 charts. The Vedic rules are compiled by Sri R. Satish from the Astro- 
logical Magazine 2005/2006. 


2. In checking the KP rules, the KP charts with KPNA (2003) by KPAstro 3.5 and the signification by occupation and 
lordship at all three levels of planet, star and sub are applied. For the CSL planet, Rahu/Ketu acting agents of planets in 
conjunction and aspect and sign lord are checked, and the CSL’s star and sub are also considered. For Vedic rules , the 
Rasi charts are applied in taking house and lordship. 


3. KP Rules 


1. 7" CSL connection to Rahu/Ketu indicates inter- caste marriage. It is found valid in 54 out of 60 charts (90%). 
2. 5" CSL connection to Rahu/Ketu indicates inter- caste marriage. It is found valid in 48 out of 60 charts (80%). 
3. 5™ CSL signification of 7" house or 7 CSL signification of 5" house indicates love marriage. It is found valid 
in 55 out of 60 charts (91.7%). 
Note: 7" or 5" CSL connection to Rahu/Ketu is found in 59 out of 60 charts (98.3%). Both 7" and Sht CSLs’ connec- 
tion to Rahu/Ketu 1s found in 44 out of 60 charts (73.3%). 


4. Vedic Rules 


1. The conjunction and aspect between 7" lord, Mars, Rahu with Venus indicates inter -caste marriage. It is 
found valid in 31 out of 60 charts (51.7%). 

2. Lagna lord in 7th or the Moon aspecting 7th house indicates love marriage. It is found valid in 14 out of 60 
charts (23.3%). 

3. Retro Jupiter aspecting Lagna or occupying it indicates inter- caste marriage. Jupiter is found retrograde in 22 
out of 60 charts (36.7%). This rule is found valid in 3 out of these 22 charts (13.6%). 

4. 5" lord with Rahu /Ketu or in constellation ruled by them indicates inter- caste marriage. It is found valid in 22 
out of 60 charts (36.7%). 

5. Satin 5th /9th house or in constellation of Rahu/Ketu 1s found valid in 19 out of 60 charts (31.7%). 

6. Lagna lord and 6th lord in conjunction or aspect rule is found valid in 19 out of 51 charts (37.2%). Cin 9 out of 
60 charts, the same planet is both Lagna lord and 6th lord.) 

7. Sth/7th lords, houses afflicted by Saturn, Rahu, Ketu rule is found valid in 53 out of 60 charts (88.3%). 


5. Conclusion 


1“ and 2™ KP rules of inter- caste marriage and 3 KP rule of love marriage and Vedic 7" rule of inter-caste marriage are 
found valid in this study of 60 charts.

His Highness Sri J ayachamaraja Wodeyar Bahadur (J uly 18, 1919 - September 23, 1974) was the 25th and ae 
last Maharaja of the princely state of Mysore from 1940 to 1950. He was a noted philosopher, musicologist, po- 
litical thinker and philanthropist. He was the only son of Yuvaraja Kanteerava Narasimharaja Wadiyar and Yuva- 
rani Kempu Cheluvaja Amanni. He graduated from the Maharajas College, Mysore in 1938, earning five awards 
and gold medals. He toured Europe during 1939, visiting many associations in London and became acquainted 
with many artists and scholars. He ascended the throne of the Kingdom of Mysore on September 8, 1940 after 
the demise of his uncle Maharaja Nalvadi Krishnaraja Wodeyar. This month Mysore is celebrating 91st birth-day 
Of their dearest His Highness’. Courtesy: www.wikipedia.com & www.ourkaranataka.com 

Birth-Details: Date Of Birth: 18/7/1919, Time of Birth: 18:30, Place Of Birth: Mysore-012-18-N, 076-38-E 





http://www. gaia, com/ Articles/ starofmysore/ hsk/ maharaja06.htm 


He signed the Instrument of Accession with the Dominion of India on the eve of India attaining |nde- 
pendence in August 1947. The princely state of Mysore was merged with the Republic of India on J anuary 26, 
1950. He held the position of Rajpramukh of the State of Mysore from 1950-1956. After the integration of the 
neighbouring Kannada-majority parts of the States of Madras and Hyderabad, he became the first Governor of 
the reorganized or unified State of Mysore, 1956-64 and later was transferred as the Governor of the State of 
Madras (Tamil Nadu), 1964-66.

H.H ’s Charisma (Experience Written By HSK - The columnist) 


“ At last, the Muhoorta had come. The auspicious moment after Rahu Kala. We passed through a row of arched 
doors and at last we were greeted by none other than the Private Secretary, beaming a wide smile. With him 
were Palegar and Satyagirinathan. No sooner we went before the front door of the room where the Maharaja 
was seated, than the benign king who ruled our hearts stood up, came forward and, before we could bow be- 
fore him, he shook hands with us! Perhaps the Raja's men were flabbergasted. We exchanged pleasant greet- 
ings and the great Prince made us feel free with his disarming and enchanting smile. 

"| Know you will have many questions. | am afraid | may not have enough time. Would you come some other 
day?" 


"| would be glad to come some other day also. | request you to spare as much time as possible today, as we 
have come all the way from Mysore." 


The Maharaja just smiled, asked us to take our seats and sat with us. (What a surprise! No ‘respectable’ dis- 
tance!). Born as a prince. Became the ruler of an old State. Earned the devotion and affection of his subjects 


(art, Vedanta, literature, sports). It was hard to believe that he had become just a commoner like others. Has he 
been able to accept it, | wondered.”

OM GA] AANANAM NAMAMYAHAM 





This month | am going to discuss about Duodednal complaints relating to Intestine and 3 charts were taken up 
(Source: Dr. Bhamidipati Satyanarayana Murthy & Astrodatabank). Sri K Raghavendra Kumar M.Sc. B.Ed, ex- 
tended his assistance in preparing this article. 


Duodenum: The duodenum is the first section of the small intestine in most higher vertebrates, including 
mammals, reptiles, and birds. The duodenum precedes the jejunum and ileum and Is the shortest part of the 
Small intestine, where most chemical digestion takes place. The name duodenum is from the Latin duodenum 
digitorum, or twelve fingers’ breadths. In humans, the duodenum Is a hollow jointed tube about 25-30 cm (10- 
12 in) long connecting the stomach to the jejunum. It begins with the duodenal bulb and ends at the ligament of 
Treitz. 


Function: The duodenum is largely responsible for the breakdown of food in the small intestine, using enzymes. 
Brunner's glands, which secrete mucus, are found in the duodenum. The duodenum wall is composed of a very 
thin layer of cells that form the muscularis mucosae. The duodenum is almost entirely retroperitoneal. 


The duodenum also regulates the rate of emptying of the stomach via hormonal pathways. Secretin and chole- 
cystokinin are released from cells in the duodenal epithelium in response to acidic and fatty stimuli present there 
when the pylorus opens and releases gastric chyme into the duodenum for further digestion. These cause the 
liver and gall bladder to release bile, and the pancreas to release bicarbonate and digestive enzymes such as 
trypsin, lipase and amylase into the duodenum as they are needed. 


New studies have shown that around 80% of obese people who had gastric bypass surgery (bypassing the duo- 
denum) were cured of their type 2 diabetes. However, the disappearance of their diabetes came long before the 
actual weight loss. When the same operation was performed on diabetic rats, they too were rid of their diabetes. 
However, when the operation was reversed in the animals, the diabetes returned. This shows that preventing 
food from entering the duodenum can have a dramatic impact on people suffering from type 2 diabetes. 


It is most likely that one of the digestive additives produced by the Duodenum on entry of food in to it (or a sec- 
Ondary product) is absorbed by the jejunum and ileum and spread into the body instead of passing through the 
digestive system. The presence of those chemicals causes the muscles to exhibit insulin resistance and ulti- 
mately Type 2 Diabetes. Identification of these chemicals may lead to a cure for Type 2 Diabetes. 


Sections: The duodenum Is divided into four sections for the purposes of description. The first three sections 
curve in a "C"-loop concavity in which the head of the pancreas lies. Only the first 2 cm of the superior part is 
mobile (covered by peritoneum) - the distal 3cm of the first part along with the rest of the duodenum is retrop- 
eritoneal (immobile). 


First part : The first (Superior) part begins , for approximately 5 cm, before making a sharp curve inferiorly into 
the superior duodenal flexure (the end of the superior part). It is intraperitoneal.

Second part: The second (descending) part of the duodenum begins at the superior duodenal flexure. It passes 
inferiorly to the lower border of vertebral body L3, before making a sharp turn medially into the inferior duode- 
nal flexure (the end of the descending part). 


The pancreatic duct and common bile duct enter the descending duodenum, commonly known together as the 
hepatopancreatic duct (or pancreatic duct in the United States), through the major duodenal papilla (known as 
Ampulla of Vater). This part of the duodenum also contains the minor duodenal papilla, the entrance for the ac- 
cessory pancreatic duct. The junction between the embryological foregut and midgut lies just below the major 
duodenal papilla. 


Third part: The third (inferior/horizontal) part of the duodenum begins at the inferior duodenal flexure and 
passes transversely to the left, crossing the right ureter, right testicular/ovarian vessels, inferior vena cava, ab- 
dominal aorta, superior mesenteric artery and the vertebral column. 


Fourth part: The fourth (ascending) part passes superiorly, either anterior to, or to the right of, the aorta, until it 
reaches the inferior border of the body of the pancreas. Then, it curves anteriorly and terminates at the duode- 
nojejunal flexure where it joins the jejunum. The duodenojejunal flexure is surrounded by a peritoneal fold con- 
taining muscle fibres: the ligament of Treitz. 


Duodenal cancer is a cancer in the beginning section of the small intestine. It is relatively rare compared to 
gastric cancer and colorectal cancer. Its histology is usually adenocarcinoma. Familial adenomatous polyposis 
(FAP) is a risk factor for developing this cancer. The duodenum Is the first part of the small intestine. It is lo- 
cated between the stomach and the jejunum. After foods combine with stomach acid, they descend into the 
duodenum where they mix with bile from the gall bladder and digestive juices from the pancreas. 


Treatment: Resection is sometimes a part of a treatment plan, but duodenal cancer is difficult to remove surgi- 
cally because of the area that it resides in--there are many blood vessels supplying the lower body. Chemother- 
apy iS sometimes used to try and shrink the cancerous mass. Other times intestinal bypass surgery is tried to 
reroute the stomach to intestine connection around the blockage. A ‘Whipple’ is a possible surgery that is tried 
sometimes with this cancer. Some patients are fitted with tubes to either add nutrients (feeding tubes) or drain- 
age tubes to remove excess processed food that can not pass the blockage. 


The cancerous mass tends to block food from getting to the small intestine. If food can not get to the intestines, 
it will cause pain, acid reflux, and weight loss because the food can not get to where it is supposed to be proc- 
essed and absorbed by the body. Patients with duodenal cancer may experience abdominal pain, weight loss, 
nausea, vomiting, and chronic GI bleeding. 

(Courtesy: Dr. Bhadmidipati Satyanarayana, MD )

King of Bavaria Ludwig II 
Brief Background 


1. In the late 1860s, King Ludwig ||, often referred to as "Mad King Ludwig" due to his purported insanity, on 
the day of his death in 1886, began building castles. From a practical point of view, such things were quite 
useless in the nineteenth century. The king ignored government and supposedly drained the treasury away; in 
fact he used his own money on his luxurious castles. By J une 1886, Ludwig's extravagance had left the treasury 
severely in debt and some of his cabinet ministers conspired to have him deposed. Ludwig was declared insane 
by psychiatrist Dr. Bernhard von Gudden and three colleagues. He was deposed three days before his death, 
and was taken in custody at Berg Palace on the banks of Lake Starnberg. 


2. On 13 June 1886 at around 6:10 pm, the King and Dr. Gudden went for a walk but they never came back. 
On the following day, their bodies were found in Lake Starnberg. Leaving the question open of whether it was 
murder, accident or suicide, Ludwig's watch had stopped at 6:45 pm. Here are the theories regarding nature of 
his death:- 


1) Ludwig committed suicide as he had been talking of suicide all the previous day. 

2) Ludwig tried to escape by swimming across the Lake to safety but died of an accident as the water was 
freezing, and he was overweight. 

3) Ludwig and Dr Gudden were murdered to ensure the former ruler would not cause trouble in the future.

“Bouncing back from the setback of the unsuccessful launch of GSLV-D3 on April 15, Indian Space Research 
Organisation(ISRO) on Monday sent PSLV-C15 soaring in to space to place in orbit Cartosat-2B, a remote sensing 
Satellite with applications in mapping and infrastructure planning. 


lt was another copybook launch of Isro's trusted workhorse PSLV(Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle), which 
lifted off from Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota, at 9.22am. About 17 minutes later, it injected the 694- 
kg Cartosat-2B and four other satellites into orbit. Mission director Kunhi Krishnan said, "The mission to inject 
five satellites into a sun-synchronous orbit was precise. All the four stages performed well. Performance of the 
computers was good and all the events of ignition and separation happened at the predicted time. The satellite 


system Is normal. 


PSLV-C15, which was earlier slated for launch on May 9 was rescheduled after scientists noticed a marginal 
drop in pressure in the second stage of the vehicle in April. At the end of over 51-hour countdown, the 44-metre 
-tall four-stage PSLV-C15, costing Rs 260 crore placed in orbit one after another five satellites.”(http:// 
timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/|sro-launches-PSLV-C-15-with-5-satellites/articleshow/6157516.cms)

KP Muhurat Rules for Launch of Rocket/ Satellite 

(1) Do not select Chara (Moveable sign) lagna. 

(2) Asc CSL should signify 1, 5, 9, 11 for long life of event. (If you select dual sign lagna, do not consider 7th) 
(3)12th CSL should signify 3, 9 and 12 for good and safe journey. 

(4)3rd and 9th CSL should signify 3, 9, 12 for peaceful journey. 
(5)8th CSL should not signify 8 and 12. 
(6)Dasa-Bhukti should signify 3, 9, 12. 


Source: K.P. Muhurat by Kanak B. Bosmia, 2009, page 152

assistance in preparing this article. 


Kidney stone: 





A 8-mm kidney stone. 


Kidney stones (ureterolithiasis) result from stones or renal calculi (from Latin ren, renes, "kidney" and calcull, 
"pebbles" ) in the ureter. The stones are solid concretions or calculi (crystal aggregations) formed in the kidneys 
from dissolved urinary minerals. Nephrolithiasis (from Greek (nephros, "kidney") and (lithos, "stone")) refers to 
the condition of having kidney stones. Urolithiasis refers to the condition of having calculi in the urinary tract 
(which also includes the kidneys), which may form or pass into the urinary bladder. Ureterolithiasis is the condi- 
tion of having a calculus in the ureter, the tube connecting the kidneys and the bladder. The term bladder 
stones usually applies to urolithiasis of the bladder in non-human animals such as dogs and cats. 


Kidney stones typically leave the body by passage in the urine stream, and many stones are formed and passed 
without causing symptoms. If stones grow to sufficient size before passage on the order of at least 2-3 millime- 
ters they can cause obstruction of the ureter. The resulting obstruction causes dilation or stretching of the upper 
ureter and renal pelvis (the part of the kidney where the urine collects before entering the ureter) as well as 
muscle spasm of the Ureter, trying to move the stone. This leads to pain, most commonly felt in the flank, lower 
abdomen and groin (a condition called renal colic). Renal colic can be associated with nausea and vomiting. 
There can be blood in the urine, visible with the naked eye or under the microscope (macroscopic or microscopic 
hematuria) due to damage to the lining of the urinary tract. 


There are several types of kidney stones based on the type of crystals of which they consist. The majority are 
calcium oxalate stones, followed by calcium phosphate stones. More rarely, struvite stones are produced by urea 
-Splitting bacteria in people with urinary tract infections, and people with certain metabolic abnormalities may 
produce uric acid stones or cystine stones. 





The diagnosis of a kidney stone can be confirmed by radiological studies and or ultrasound examination; urine 
tests and blood tests are also commonly performed. When a stone causes no symptoms, watchful waiting is a 
valid option. In other cases, pain control is the first measure, using for example non-steroidal anti-inflammatory 
drugs or opioids. Using soundwaves, some stones can be shattered into smaller fragments (this is called extra

urethra, bladder and ureter (ureteroscopy), or a keyhole or open surgical approach from the kidney's side. 
Sometimes, a tube may be left in the ureter (a ureteric stent) to prevent the recurrence of pain. Preventive 
and structive measures are often advised such as drinking sufficient amounts of water, milk and coffee, al- 
though the effect of many dietary interventions has not been rigorously studied. 


Signs and symptoms: 
Symptoms of kidney stones include
