& | 
i! 





Localization of kidney stone pain 


e Colicky pain: “loin to groin". Often described as "the worst pain [...] ever experienced". This can also 
occur in the lower back 





e Nausea/vomiting: embryological link with intestine— stimulates the vomiting center. 

e Hematuria: blood in the urine, due to minor damage to inside wall of kidney, ureter and/or urethra. 

e Pyuria: pus in the urine. 

e Dysuria: burning on urination when passing stones (rare). More typical of infection. 

e Oliguria: reduced urinary volume caused by obstruction of the bladder or urethra by stone, or extremely 
rarely, Simultaneous obstruction of both ureters by a stone. 

e Postrenal azotemia: the blockage of urine flow through a ureter. 

e Hydronephrosis: the distension and dilation of the renal pelvis and calyces. 

Causes: 


Kidney stones or calcium oxalate crystals in kidney can be due to underlying metabolic conditions, such as 
renal tubular acidosis, Dent's disease, hyperparathyroidism, primary hyperoxaluria and medullary sponge 
kidney. Kidney stones are also more common in patients with Crohn's disease. Patients with recurrent kidney 
stones should be screened for these disorders. This is typically done with a 24 hour urine collection that Is 
chemically analyzed for deficiencies and excesses that promote stone formation. 


There has been some evidence that water fluoridation may increase the risk of kidney stone formation. In 
one study, patients with symptoms of skeletal fluorosis were 4.6 times as likely to develop kidney stones. 


A 1998 paper in the Archives of Internal Medicine examined the sources of a widely-held belief in the medi- 
cal community that vitamin C can cause kidney stones, and found it to be based on several circular refer- 
ences, ultimately attributing the belief to a wider pattern of skepticism regarding efficacy of vitamin supple- 
ments. A more recent study suggested a causal relationship may exist, but it was not conclusive.

Calcium oxalate stones: 


The most common type of kidney stone is composed of calcium oxalate crystals, occurring in about 80% of 
cases, and the factors that promote the precipitation of crystals in the urine are associated with the devel- 
opment of these stones. 


Common sense has long held that consumption of too much calcium could promote the development of cal- 
cium kidney stones. However, current evidence suggests that the consumption of low-calcium diets is actu- 
ally associated with a higher overall risk for the development of kidney stones. This is perhaps related 

to the role of calcium in binding ingested oxalate in the gastrointestinal tract. As the amount of calcium in- 
take decreases, the amount of oxalate available for absorption into the bloodstream increases; this oxalate is 
then excreted in greater amounts into the urine by the kidneys. In the urine, oxalate is a very strong pro- 
moter of calcium oxalate precipitation, about 15 times stronger than calcium. 


Uric acid (urate): 


About 5-10% of all stones are formed from uric acid. Uric acid stones form in association with conditions 
that cause hyper uricosuria with or without high blood serum uric acid levels (hyperuricemia); and with acid/ 
base metabolism disorders where the urine Is excessively acidic (low pH) resulting in uric acid precipitation. 
A diagnosis of uric acid nephrolithiasis is supported if there is a radiolucent stone, a persistent undue urine 
acidity, and uric acid crystals in fresh urine samples. 


Other types: 


Other types of kidney stones are composed of struvite (magnesium, ammonium and phosphate); calcium 
phosphate; and cystine. Struvite stones are also known as infection stones, urease or triple-phosphate 
stones. About 10-15% of urinary calculi consist of struvite stones. The formation of struvite stones Is asso- 
ciated with the presence of urea-splitting bacteria, most commonly Proteus mirabilis. These organisms are 
capable of splitting urea into ammonia, decreasing the acidity of the urine and resulting in favorable condi- 
tions for the formation of struvite stones. Struvite stones are always associated with urinary tract infections. 


The formation of calcium phosphate stones is associated with conditions such as hyperparathyroidism and 
renal tubular acidosis. Formation of cystine stones is uniquely associated with people suffering from cystinu- 
ria, who accumulate cystine in their urine. Cystinuria can be caused by Fanconi's syndrome. Urolithiasis has 
also been noted to occur in the setting of therapeutic drug use, with crystals of drug forming within the re- 
nal tract in some patients currently being treated with Indinavir, Sulfadiazine or Triamterene. Initially ho- 
meopathic remedies are good before going to Laser/Key hole treatments. 


Diagnosis: 
Clinical diagnosis is usually made on the basis of the location and severity of the pain, which Is typically col- 
icky in nature (comes and goes in spasmodic waves). Pain in the back occurs when calculi produce an ob- 


struction in the kidney. 


Imaging is used to confirm the diagnosis and a number of other tests can be undertaken to help establish 
both the possible cause and consequences of the stone.

Computed tomography: CT Scan 


Computed tomography without contrast is considered the gold standard diagnostic test for the detection of 
kidney stones. All stones are detectable by CT except very rare stones composed of certain drug residues in 
the urine. If positive for stones, a single standard X-ray (digital) of the abdomen (KUB Kidney Ureter Blad- 
der) is recommended. This gives a clearer idea of the exact size and shape of the stone as well as its surgi- 
cal orientation. Further, it makes it simple to follow the progress of the stone by doing another X-ray in the 
future. 


Ultrasound: 


Ultrasound imaging Is useful as it gives details about the presence of hydronephrosis (swelling of the kid- 
ney—suggesting the stone Is blocking the outflow of urine). It can also be used to detect stones during 
pregnancy when x-rays or CT are discouraged. Radiolucent stones may show up on ultrasound however they 
are also typically seen on CT scans. Some recommend that US be used as the primary diagnostic technique 
with CT being reserved for those with negative US result and continued suspicion of a kidney stone. This is 
due to its lesser cost and avoidance of radiation.

Prevention: 


Preventive strategies include dietary modifications and sometimes also taking drugs with the goal of reduc- 

ing excretory load on the kidneys: 

@ Drinking enough water to make 2 to 2.5 liters of urine per day. 

¢ A diet low in protein, nitrogen and sodium intake 

¢ Restriction of oxalate-rich foods, such as chocolate, nuts, soybeans, rhubarb and spinach, plus mainte- 
nance of an adequate intake of dietary calcium. There is equivocal evidence that calcium supplements 
increase the risk of stone formation, though calcium citrate appears to carry the lowest, If any, risk. 

¢ Taking drugs such as thiazides, potassium citrate, magnesium citrate and allopurinol, depending on the 
cause of stone formation. 


¢ Some fruit juices, such as orange, blackcurrant, and cranberry, may be useful for lowering the risk

(3) 11" cusp co-rulers are Saturn, Rahu and Saturn as Sign lord, Star lord and Sublord respectively. 
(a) Saturn is in Venus sign Libra. 
(b) Rahu ts in the sign of Venus (Taurus). 


Thus all the co-rulers of 1%, 5 & 11" cusps are interlinked with each other as explained above of Saturn, 
Mars & Venus. Therefore it leads me to suspect the conduct and character of the boy. 


(B) As per K.P., if the sub lord or the lord of the constellation in which the 7‘ cusp sub lord is situated in a 
dual sign or happens to be a dual planet, then the second marriage is promised. (KP Reader IV, page 181) 
(i) The Sublord of the 7™ cusp Saturn is in the constellation of Jupiter who is placed in a dual sign 
(Sagittarius). (ii) the sub lord of the 7™ cusp is also a significator of 7 & 11". (ii) The Sub lord of 2" cusp 
Venus also signifies 7“ by lordship. So it is an indication of more than one marriage to this native. That 
means, my friend’s daughter may have to die, or to be divorced. This indicates that this boy is promised to 
marry another girl as his wife as per Hindu Law. So | do not like it. 


(C) If the Sub lords of 7° cusp and 6" cusp are the same, this is an indication of more than one marriage. 
(Advanced Theory of K.P. - 4 Step Theory written by Prof. Sunil Gondhalekar ji- page 38). In the boy’s natal 
chart, 7‘° & 6" cuspal sub lords are the same Saturn. This is also another indication for second marriage to 
this boy. 


(D) In K.P. if the sub lords of the two cusps are the same then they are deemed to be connected. For 
example, in a horoscope if the 5" & 7" cuspal sub lords happen to be the same planet, it gives strong ten- 
dencies of a love marriage. (K.P. & Astrology Year Book 2002, page 45, by Shri T. Rajendra Kumar) As per 
this rule both 7 & 6" CSL is happen to be the same planet, i.e. Saturn. So both marriage and divorce are 
indicated. 


(E) Saturn in 7 is Badhaka lord for this lagna. So he may not be able to do well with respect to the 7" 
house matters although in K.P. Badhaka is for health and longevity only. 


(F) At present Rahu Dasa, Mercury Bhukthi is running to this boy from 18-11-2009 to 06-06-2012. 
Rahu+ the Dasanatha at 1 Is in the constellation of Sun (8, 5). But regarding the nodes we have to follow 
the following rule in order of preference. 


Rule: - A Node gives firstly the results of the planet or planets with which it is conjoined, secondly the re- 
sults of the planet or planets aspecting it, thirdly the results of the lord of the constellation in which it is de- 
posited and lastly the owner of the sign in which it is deposited. 


As per the above rule, Rahu+ is conjoined with Moon. So he has to give the results of Moon firstly. Moon 
(1, 4) is in her own star and in her own sub. So through Moon, Rahu+ has to give the results of 1 and 4. 
These two houses are not good for leading a pleasant marital life. Moreover, Rahu Is in the sub of J upiter 
who signifies 9 and 12 which are also not helpful for happy married life. 


Next let us see what Bhuktinatha Mercury indicates: Mercury (8, 3-6) is in the star of Ketu (7, 9-12) in the 
sub of Rahu. Rahu is already explained above. 


By taking in to consideration of the above mentioned (A) to (F) points, | have come to a conclusion that this 
girl should not be married to this boy.

House Suitability_A KP appraisal 


senior Manager, C-DOT 
Electronic City, Phase-1 
Hosur Road, Bangalore — 560 100 (Off), 26587463 (Res), 0-9845039153 





This case is a recent one when a native approached me on 17-07-2010 evening to ask me whether the house 
where he has recently shifted suits him for his safety etc. 


The matter was taken up for scrutiny at 20:15:16 Hrs on 17-07-2010. | obtained horary number 202 from the 
native with a specific question being “Is the house safe for me?” 


The Horary chart is on next page. 

Co-ordinates of judgment: 

In a query relating to the premises and its suitability to the native actually revolves around the 4" cusp/house. 
In order that the house/property is suitable in general, the 4‘ cusp should be favorably disposed to the lagna 


and linked to 11°" house. 


In case, if the 4" cusp links to the adverse houses from lagna, the native would get the trouble related to those 
adverse houses. 


The Query: 


Fundamentally, in any prashna, the lagna indicates the subject matter of the query, while the Moon indicates the 
status of mind and the matter on which the querist dwells about. 


Look to the lagna Sbl-Venus, which Is placed in the sub-sub of Mars (sub-sub lord taken as Star and Sub lord Is 
same as the planet Venus itself) which is 4" lord placed in 8" house. This indicates that there is something un- 
known and troublesome related to the house. 


Moon itself gets placed in 8H indicating a sense of choking, frustration and sense of unknown fear. Moon falls in 
the sub of Venus, which validates the indications as above, as seen from the lagna. 


Thus, the query Is taken as well indicated in the prashna chart and it was comfortable to proceed further. 
Analysis : 

Examine the 4" cusp. 

4‘. cuspal sub-lord is Mars which is the 4" lord as well indicating the premises where the native has shifted. Mars 
is a strong planet as there is no planet in its star and its placement in 8" house would be dominantly giving the 


native a severe nightmare and the native would get scared to live in the premises. 


Looking from the stellar angle, Mars falls in the star of 8" lord Sun placed in 6" house. Mars is in the sub of 
Mars placed in 8" house. 


This gave a definite clue that not only the native would be scared to live in the house (8H), she would fall sick 
(6H) because of the scare. 


Examine the 11™ cusp. 


11™ cuspal sub-lord is Rahu which gets placed in the star of Venus placed in 7" house having its sub-lord Moon 
placed in 8°" house. 


Rahu also disposes Jupiter and Venus. Jupiter falls in the star of Saturn placed in 8th 
house. Other dispositor is Venus itself. As we discussed initially, Venus does not support 
the suitability of the premises to the native. 


This confirms that there is a serious issue in the premises and the premises do not suit the 
native for a peaceful living.

Look to the 12" cusp 


12" cuspal sub-lord is Jupiter which is 3 and 12 lord. Jupiter falls in the star of 2"° lord Saturn placed in 8" 
house. Jupiter is in the sub of 5" lord Venus placed in 7 house. Jupiter being the lord of 12 house, being in 
the star of 2" lord Saturn and being placed in the sub of 5" lord Venus, Jupiter is all set to cause financial loss. 
This was sufficient to conclude that there would be loss of finance after the native moved in the premises. 


Look to Fortuna 


Fortuna falls in the 10" house and falls in the Star and Sub of Saturn. Since Saturn is placed in the 8" house, 
the native is not expected to draw any luck from the occupied premises. 


Conclusion

QUESTIONS & ANSWERS 


Question- 1 


What are the cusps and planets to be seen for a girl to attain Puberty. Inspite of 15 years, a girl has not attained 
puberty stage. Parents are worried. 


Answer- 1 


1. As per Sri K.M. Subramaniam, in the article ‘On Attaining Puberty’, Astrology & Athrishta 


August 1980 (also in Astrosecrets & K.P . Part III, edited by K. Subramaniam, Krishman & Co., 2002, 
page 49 point 16): 


A) In attaining puberty, the 5" (getting mental status and understanding full matters connected to sexual 
organs) cusp sub-lord should be the significator of the 5" or 8°" (sex organs and their function) or both: 
and Mars also should be well connected to 5" or 8" in any manner since Mars represents blood in the 
body. 


B) For fructification consider the conjoined period of the significators of 2 (getting status in the family mem- 
bers as an adult), 5 and 11" (fulfillment of desire) houses, together with Mars, which should have some 
connections in any manner. 


C) Saturn is a delaying planet but not to deny, if other significations are fruitful. 


2. According to Prof. B. Suryanarain Rao, in ‘Strijataka or Female Horoscopy’, Raman Publications, 1964, the 
astrological writers in Sanskrit have attached the great importance of the first menses in a girl or puberty which 
is called Ruthu in Sanskrit . When Chandra is not in upachayas, viz. 3,6,10 and 11 and when the Lagna is power- 
fully aspected by Kuja the appearance of first menses should be predicted. 

Question- 2 

From which house is a girlfriend seen in astrology? Is it 5th or 7°"? 

Answer-2 

1. In fact, the lover is more accurately ascertained from the 11th house rather than from the 7th. This is is so, 
as the 11th house stands for lasting friendship and intimacy that may end in marriage. 

-KP Reader II , page 220, last para 

2. boy friends/girl friends- 7" 


-Rex Bills: the rulership book, pp 15, 56 
- Umang Taneja: Dictionary of Significators pp 21, 81

Case History 
1. One of the most remarkable horoscopes that come into view under marriage and death indications is that a 
male, who died at the age of 35 on the eve of marriage. This horoscope is included in the "Thousand and One 


Notable Nativities" by Alan Leo or "A Thousand and One Notable Nativities" by Anonymous and analyzed by 
Sepharial in his "Astrology and Marriage" book. 


2. The attached horoscope of the above native is calculated to the nearest positions of the Ascendent, Mid- 
heaven and planets as originally given and then converted into a KP chart by using the Placidus house system, 
KPNA and mean Nodes. 


Longevity 


3. 1st cuspal sub lord (CSL) is Ma+(6,11 Badhaka); no planet is in the stars of Ma which is CSL of 1,9 & 11 
houses. Ma is in the star of Su(2,3) and sub of Mo+(2,1-2). Maraka, Badhaka and 6th signification of 1st CSL 
indicates short longevity up to 33 years of age. 

The native had lived up to 35 years due to 1,9 signification. 


Promise of Marriage 


4. 7th CSL is Ra+(6) aspected by opposite Me(1,4-12) & Ju(1,6-10) and sign lord Is Sa(2, 7-8-9). Ra is in the star 
of Su(2,3) and sub of Ve+(12,5) aspected by opposite Mat+(6,11). As long as 7th CSL signifies 2,7,11, marriage 
IS promised despite strong signification of detrimental to marriage 1,4,6,8,10,12 houses, indicating serious ob- 
Stacles in getting married. 


Dasa Analysis 


5. Dasa lord Mo+(2,1-2) is in star of Ke(12) con} Me(1,4-12) & Ju(1,6-10), aspected by Ma+(6,11 Badhaka) and 
in sub of Ma+(6,11 Badhaka) opposite Ve(12,5). It signifies 2,11 houses for marriage, along with 1,4,6,10,12 
houses against marriage, and death inflicting 2, 11, 12 (Maraka, Badhaka, Moksha) and 6 (disease), 4 (end of 
life) & 10 (retirement from this world) houses. Marriage is not possible due to strong signification of negative 
houses to marriage and possible death is indicated without a strong live saving signification of 1,5. 


6. Bhukti lord Sa(2,7-8-9) is in star of Ke(12) con} Me(1,4-12) & Ju(1,6-10), aspected by Ma+(6,11 Badhaka) 
and sub of Ra+(6), sign lord Sa(2, 7-8-9), no planet Is in the stars of Ra, which is CSL of 3,7 houses. Saturn sig- 
nifies 2,7,11 houses for marriage, along with 1,4,6,10,12 houses against marriage, and death causing 2,/7,11 
(Maraka, Badhaka), 4,8,12 (terminal/ trigonal houses) and also 6,10 unfavorable houses in case of death. So 
Bhukti lord Saturn cannot give marriage which is not allowed by Dasa lord Moon but it has to go along with Dasa 
lord for death. 


Punarphoo and Venus-Mars Opposition 


7. Punarphoo formed by closed conjunction of Moon & Saturn in Leo is supposed to be a cause of delay for mar- 
riage. When the native was to have been married at the age of 35, the running dasa period lords are Mo-Sa 
Dasa-Bhukti, which are generally found in the cases of Punarphoo for the event to happen. Saturn usually gives 
what has to give by itself in it's dasa or sub period without allowing other planets to give the result in it's place. 


8. Venus, the ruler of love affairs in the 27" degree of Gemini is opposed to Mars in the 27° degree of Sagitta- 


rius. Such configuration of Venus in 12" house and Mars in 6" house may be regarded as a doubt for the mar- 
riage ever taking place.

Inguinal hernia: 


An inguinal hernia is a protrusion of abdominal-cavity contents through the inguinal canal. They are very com- 
mon (lifetime risk 27% for men, 3% for women, and their repair is one of the most frequently performed surgi- 
cal operations. 

There are two types of inguinal hernia, direct and indirect, which are defined by their relationship to the inferior 
epigastric vessels. Direct inguinal hernias occur medial to the inferior epigastric vessels when abdominal con- 
tents herniate through the external inguinal ring. Indirect inguinal hernias occur when abdominal contents pro- 
trude through the deep inguinal ring, lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels; this may be caused by failure of 
embryonic closure of the processus vaginalis.

Inguinal hernias, in turn, belongs to groin hernias, which also includes femoral hernias. A femoral hernia is not 
via the inguinal canal, but via the femoral canal, which normally allows passage of the common femoral artery 
and vein from the pelvis to the leg. 

In Amyand's hernia, the content of the hernial sac is the vermiform appendix. 

In Littre's hernia, the content of the hernial sac contains a Meckel's Diverticulum. 

Hernias present as bulges in the groin area that can become more prominent when coughing, straining, or 
standing up. They are rarely painful, and the bulge commonly disappears on lying down. The inability to 
"reduce", or place the bulge back into the abdomen usually means the hernia Is ‘incarcerated’ which is a surgical 
emergency. 

Significant pain Is suggestive of strangulated bowel (an incarcerated indirect inguinal hernia). 





As the hernia progresses, contents of the abdominal cavity, such as the intestines, can descend into the hernia 
and run the risk of being pinched within the hernia, causing an intestinal obstruction. If the blood supply of the 
portion of the intestine caught in the hernia is compromised, the hernia is deemed "strangulated," and gut ische- 
mia and gangrene can result, with potentially fatal consequences. The timing of complications is not predictable. 
Some hernias remain static for years, others progress rapidly from the time of onset. Provided there are no seri-

Ous co-existing medical problems, patients are advised to get the hernia repaired surgically at the earliest 
convenience after a diagnosis is made. Emergency surgery for complications such as incarceration and 
strangulation carry much higher risk than planned, "elective" procedures. 


In men, indirect hernias follow the same route as the descending testes, which migrate from the abdomen 
into the scrotum during the development of the urinary and reproductive organs. The larger size of their 
inguinal canal, which transmitted the testicle and accommodates the structures of the spermatic cord, might 
be one reason why men are 25 times more likely to have an inguinal hernia than women. Although several 
mechanisms such as strength of the posterior wall of the inguinal canal and shutter mechanisms compensat- 
ing for raised intra-abdominal pressure prevent hernia formation in normal individuals, the exact importance 
of each factor Is still under debate. 


The hernia truss is intended to contain a reducible inguinal hernia within the abdomen. This device fell out 
of favour with the advent of hernia surgery. It is not considered to provide a cure, and if the pads are hard 
and intrude into the hernia aperture they may cause scarring and enlargement of the aperture. In addition, 
most trusses with older designs are not able effectively to contain the hernia at all times, because their pads 
do not remain permanently in contact with the hernia. The more modern variety of truss (medicine) is made 
with non-intrusive flat pads and comes with a guarantee to hold the hernia securely during all activities. Al- 
though there Is as yet no proof that such devices can prevent an inguinal hernia from progressing, they 
have been described by users as providing greater confidence and comfort when carrying out physically de- 
manding tasks Their popularity is likely to increase, as many individuals with small, painless hernias are now 
delaying hernia surgery due to recently published reports on the incidence of Post Herniorrhaphy Pain Syn- 
drome. 


Surgical correction of inguinal hernias, called a herniorrhaphy or hernioplasty, is now often performed as 
outpatient surgery. There are various surgical strategies which may be considered in the planning of inguinal 
hernia repair. These include the consideration of mesh use, type of open repair, use of laparoscopy, type of 
anesthesia, appropriateness of bilateral repair, etc. During surgery conducted under local anaesthesia, the 
patient will be asked to cough and strain during the procedure to help in demonstrating that the repair is 
"tension free" and sound.

contracting. Later signs include rectal bleeding, often with ‘red currant jelly’ stool (stool mixed with blood

Medical Astrology 


Hernia is classed as a Sa, Ma, Vir & Sco disease, alSo a Ve disease when Ve is afflicted by Sa; 
afflictions in Vi or Sc, and especially when these signs occupy the 6" house; Sa in Vir or Sco 
in the 6" house; Ve in Vir or Sco and afflicted by Sa; Sa’s adverse aspect on the Asc. are also 
an indication of hernia problem. (H.L. Cornell: Encyclopaedia of Medical Astrology; Rex Bills: 
Rulership Book) 


Generally the KP disease finder 6° Cuspal Sub Lord’s connection with these hernia rulers Sa, 
Ma & Ve and 8th (house of surgery), 12th (house of hospitalization) are to be taken into 
consideration. The stars representing Hernia are Chitra Anuradha, UttaraBhadhra.

This case is a recent one when one of my relative’s son came home as guest who had to appear for the selec- 
tion process interview at Service Selection Board for army. 


Out of sudden curiosity, | wanted to find out If the native would be selected in the said interview process. | took 
horary number 13 myself and rotated the chart to 11 house for the guest in question. The matter was taken up 
for scrutiny at 10:59:13 Hrs on 04-08-2010 at Bangalore. 

The rotated horary chart is as follows: 

Co-ordinates of judgment: 

In a query relating to the interview and the results thereof, the 3™ and 9" houses get most pertinent. The 3 
house indicates the performance from the native and 9° house indicates what is asked for from the interview 
panel. If these houses signify the 11™ house, the native gets successful in the interview process. 


The Query: 


Fundamentally, in any prashna, the lagna indicates the subject matter of the query, while the Moon indicates the 
Status of mind and the matter on which the querist dwells about. 


Look to the lagna Sbl-Rahu, which is placed in the star of 9°" lord Venus placed in 7" house, weak rasi sign for 
Venus. This was exactly in consonance to my worries, as the interview process at Service Selection board is nor- 
mally tough. This indicated that there is something to worry. Moon itself gets placed in 3H indicating a scene of 
interview to be faced. 

Thus, the query is well indicated in the prashna chart and it was comfortable to proceed further. 

Analysis : 


Examine the 3™ cusp. 


3" cuspal sub-lord is Mars which is a strong planet as there is no planet in its star. Note that 10™ lord Mars gets 
placed in 7" house close to the 8" cusp, making the scene of professional success a difficult game. 


At the stellar level, Mars falls in the star of Sun placed in 6" house which seemed OK but is in the sub of weak 
Venus in 7" house. In this situation, the ball was in the court of the examining party, though the native was des- 
tined to try his best. 


Examine the 9™ cusp. 

9‘ cuspal sub-lord is Venus which is the strong 9™ lord showing that the examining party was strong. Venus falls 
in the star of Sun placed in 6" house which again seemed OK but the sub of Saturn in which Venus was placed 
was the strong 12™ lord placed in 7 house. This did point out the fact that there could be a situation for the 
native to suffer loss (rejection - 12 house) by the examining party and was a matter of worry. 


Look to Fortuna 


Fortuna falls in the 7‘" house, in the star of Venus and sub of Saturn. As observed in the analysis of the query, 
Venus and Saturn do not support the success. 


Examine the 10" cusp 
10°" cusp indicates the job in question for which the interview is attempted. 10" cuspal sub-lord is J upiter which 
is retro in motion, thus the job was understood to be non-available. 


At the stellar level, it is noticed that J upiter falls in Saturn’s star which does not promote success because of Sat- 
urn lording the 12" house strongly. Venus, sub-lord of J upiter, is weak by rasi position and placed in 7‘" house

Election example: 2 
Tuvalu election on 16 September 2010 


Expect intense family rivalry in the Tuvalu election between a cabinet minister and his Prime Minister on the 
road to the September 16 elections. Both Prime Minister Apisai |elemia and Communications Minister Taukelina 
Finikaso are standing in the Vaitupu constituency. Minister Finikaso, ISLANDS BUSINESS was told, had lodged a 
complaint against |elemia with the Tuvalu Police. It is alleged that lelemia had distributed registration forms in 
their constituency before the registration date. The Tuvalu police are investigating the case.Finikaso Is also a 
close relative of lelemia. The nature of Tuvalu’s politics also tends to be fought on a more personal basis involv- 
ing family ties and clans. Vaitupu constituency, is the largest in Tuvalu, which has 1200 voters, making the level 
of indoor lobbying quite intense. Without party politics, Tuvalu’s campaign trail takes potential candidates 
Straight into the homes of their small constituencies to seek votes. It’s every man for himself during elections 
and Government is formed by those who actually make it into parliament.Expect some close-kept secrets to 
come out in the open as the battle lines have been drawn quite thinly in this contest. Already some of these se- 
crets are making their way into the public domain. |elemia declined an interview when he arrived in Suva for the 
Engaging Pacific Communities talks last month.Finikaso also declined to speak about the issue with the Prime 
Minister, but said he would tell his constituents about the government’s struggle to keep its economy afloat dur- 
ing the global economic cash crisis.While it may not be obvious that tensions are running high between the fami- 
lies, sources on the island say Finikaso stands a good chance of winning his seat.

GUINEA - 
Article published the Wednesday 21 July 2010 - Latest update : Wednesday 21 July 2010 


Guinea presidential elections pit Diallo against Condé in round two 

The Supreme Court in Guinea gave the go-ahead for the second round of presidential elections late Tuesday 
night at a press conference. The landmark elections, seen as Guinea's first free election since its independ- 
ence from France In 1958, will see former Prime Minister Cellou Dalein Diallo battle it out against his main op- 
ponent Alpha Condé. The court's ruling confirmed the provisional results of the 27 J une first round of voting, 
which had been challenged by several of the eliminated candidates who had alleged fraud. No date was given 
for the run-off which was first due on 18 July but postponed following the fraud allegations. The court's final 
version of the first-round results credited Diallo with 43.69 per cent of the vote and Conde 18.25 per cent. 
Sidya Toure, a former prime minister, came in third with 13.62 per cent. His supporters were adamant that 
ballot-box stuffing in favour of Condé had robbed him of second place. On Wednesday, Barack Obama con- 
gratulated the people of Guinea following the first round of "historic" elections. In a written statement the US 
president urged all parties to "continue to choose the rule of law and peaceful political participation over eth- 
nic division and violence. They can continue to count on the support of the United States as they move for- 
Maid. . 





A presidential election was held in Guinea on 27 June, with a second round to be held on 19 September 
(delayed from 18 July 2010).This election is Guinea's first general multi-party presidential election since inde- 
pendence from France. It followed months of tension and unrest after a coup and an attempted assassination 
of the junta leader.

alae elections will be held In Latvia on 2 October 2010. 





After surviving a vote of no confidence in early February, PM Ivars Godmanis resigned on 20 February 2009 
after the two largest parties (People's Party and the Union of Greens and Farmers) called for his dismissal. It 
is likely that an interim government will be formed, followed by emergency elections. President Zatlers stated 
on 23 February 2009 that early elections might be necessary. On 31 March 2009, Zatlers announced he would 
not dissolve parliament. The Saeima was to consider constitutional amendments as early as 9 April 2009.In 
the run-up to the election, three right-wing parties (New Era Party, Civic Union and Society for Other Politics) 
established an alliance called Unity on 6 March 2010. Furthermore, most of the parties constituting the Har- 
mony Centre alliance (National Harmony Party, New Centre and Social Democratic Party - but not the Socialist 
Party of Latvia and the Daugavpils City Party) had merged into the Social Democratic Party "Harmony" on 10 
February 2010. On 22 April 2010, the People's Party and the Latvia's First Party/Latvian Way formed an elec- 
toral alliance called For a Good Latvia.So far, there are five major electoral alliances running: 

Unity: comprising the New Era Party, Civic Union and Society for Other Politics 

Harmony Centre: formed by the Social Democratic Party "Harmony", Socialist Party of Latvia and the Dau- 
gavpils City Party 

For a Good Latvia: of the People's Party, Latvia's First Party/Latvian Way and For a Good Latvia 

Union of Greens and Farmers: consisting of the Latvian Farmers' Union and the Green Party of Latvia 

National Alliance: of For Fatherland and Freedom/LNNK and All For Latvia

4.4%.

Presidential election Cote d'lvoire - Cote d'lvoire will hold the much-awaited presidential election 31 Oct, Prime 
Minister Guillaume Soro announced Thursday. The date was chosen following the recommendation of the Inde- 
pendent Electoral Commission (CEI). On Wednesday, the CEI published a statement indicating the month of Oc- 
tober ‘as a favorable period’ for to the organization of the presidential election. The election, which was due in 
2005 when the tenure of President Laurent Gbagbo expired, has been postponed several times. It is widely ex- 
pected that the election will help consolidate the restoration of peace to the West African nation, which was 
rocked by a political crisis in Sept 2002 that almost led to the break-up of the country. 


Soro, aS Prime Minister, is barred from standing as a candidate by the peace agreement. Describing himself as 
an “arbiter of the electoral process", Soro said in a March 2008 interview with Jeune Afrique that the New Forces 
would not back any candidate and its members could vote for whomever they wished. Rumors have suggested 
that Soro and Gbagbo have secretly agreed on an arrangement whereby Soro would support Gbagbo and, in 
exchange, Gbagbo would back Soro in the subsequent presidential election; Soro derided these rumors as 
"gossip".

Survey: Rousseff Headed for First-Round Victory in Brazil Elections 

BRASILIA - The candidate of the governing Workers’ party, Dilma Rousseff, has increased her advantage over 
opposition hopeful Jose Serra by 17 percentage points and Is poised to win October’s presidential election in 
Brazil in the first round of voting, according to a survey released Saturday. The poll taken by the Datafolha 
company indicates that Rousseff, who has the support of popular outgoing President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, 
has a voter preference of 47 percent compared with 30 percent for Serra, presidential candidate of the center- 
right Brazilian Social Democracy Party. In a poll taken by the same firm last month, the governing-party candi- 
date had 41 percent and Serra had 33 percent of voter preference. The survey released Saturday shows that 
taking only valid voters into account, which means excluding those who say they would leave their ballots 
blank, Rousseff would get 54 percent, with the result that next Oct. 3 she would become the first woman to 
be elected president of Brazil.

Question- 1: 


Rule: - If the 7 cuspal sub lord (CSL) is a significator of 2, 7 or 11, then only the marriage is promised to the 
native. 

As per this rule, for a Girl’s chart (born on 23 July 1980, 10:55 PM IST, 17N27, 78E30, Asc. Pi 20:45:36, KPNA 
23:29:44, by KPAstro 3.5) the 7 cuspal sub lord Venus (in 3, lord of 3 & 8) is in the star of Mars (in 6, lord of 2 
& 9) and in the sub of J upiter (in 6, lord of 1 & 10). Star wise, 2" is indicated as a significator; hence the mar- 
riage IS promised to this native. OK. 

Nevertheless the sub lord of the 7" CSL J upiter is not at all signifying 2, 7 or 11. In K.P. star lord of a planet 
indicates the matter only and the sub lord is the deciding factor. So, the marriage may not be promised to this 
native. Could you give your opinion. 

Answer-1: 


As long as 2,7 or 11 house is signified at any level of planet or star or sub of the 7" CSL, marriage is found to be 
promised in many charts regardless of no positive signification of 2,7 or 11 or negative signification of 1,6 or 10 
in the sub level. 

But promise is not a guarantee for marriage, which can be materialized only during the DBAS of 2,7,11 fruitful 
significators. In judging the signification of dasa lords for marriage, the positive or negative signification in the 
sub level of dasa lord planet should be taken into consideration very cautiously. For instance, the current run- 
ning Dasa for the girl is Venus (29 Apr 2004 to 29 Apr 2024). Dasa lord Ve(3,3-8) is in the star of Ma(6,2-9) and 
sub of J u(6,1-10). Hence Venus Dasa would not be capable to give marriage by mere signification of 2 in the 
star level because of sub level signification of 1,6,10, which are detrimental or 12" to 2,7,11. 


Question-2: 


Generally speaking, connection of Sun with the Punarphoo causing planets (Saturn and Moon) results in cancel- 
lation of Punarphoo. Precisely speaking, cancellation takes place due to following conditions: - 
Sat or Moon or both in association with Sun in one sign (could involve even two houses); 
Sat or Moon in the star of Sun; Or Sun ts in the star of either Moon or Saturn; 
Sun Is in a Star, lord of which is near either Moon or Saturn; 
Any planet near the Moon or Saturn, but is posited in the star of Sun; 
Sat or Moon is in the sub-sub of Sun. 
Does cancellation take place in my horoscope or not? Will this harm in future? 
My details:- D.O.B---21/08/1975, TIME---01:45AM, PLACE—BALLIA (U.P) 
Answer-2: 


As any of the above mentioned Dr. Kar’s Punarphoo cancellation conditions is not fulfilled, the cancellation of 
Punarphoo (formed by opposition of Saturn in Cancer & Moon in Capricorn) does not take place in your horo- 
scope. 

Dr. Kar's cancellation theory is to destroy the evil effects of Punarphoo by burning Sat or Moon by Sun's ray 
(combustion). But in KP Reader VI it is said that the planets in combustion do not fail to give their results. So 
Punarphoo cancellation theory appears not working In many cases. 

Saturn-Moon connection Is only part of the equation which can give very different results depending on their 
Significations and relation with other planets. This connection is not benefic or malefic by itself and inferring the 
conclusion other than ‘delay effect’ by just relying on the mere Saturn-Moon connection would be baseless. Such 
conclusions are not yet proven by systematic approach or research and so it is not to worry about Punarphoo. 
There are plenty of spiritual leaders with Punarphoo like Sri Krishna, Sri Gautama Buddha, Sri Jesus Christ, 
Prophet Mahamud , Pope John Paul ||, Swami Vivekananda, Sri Yogananda, political leaders such as Napoleon 
Bonaparte, Queen Victoria, Abraham Lincoln, Franklin Delamo Roosevelt, Dwight D Eisenhower, Jimmy Carter, 
Indira Gandhi, Rajiv Gandhi, astrologers like Michael De Nostradamus, Dr. BV Raman, K. Subramaniam, Sandy 
Crowther, Visti Larsen, successful celebrities such as Elvis Presley, Marilyn Monroe, Raj Kapoor, Sophia Loren, 
Angelina Jolie and others like Karl Max, Jiddu Krishnamurti, Sir Jagdish Ch. Bose, R.P. Goenka.

Introduction 


1. The earliest manifestation of debate on Polar region charts occurs in Alan Leo's Thousand and One 
Notable Nativities, first published in the early years of the 20th century (page 33 regarding remarkable 
chart no. 909, same in A thousand and One Notable Nativities by Anonymous). Discussion concerned 
the chart of Marie Ahnighito Peary, daughter of the well-known Polar explorer Robert Edwin Peary. 
She was probably the first child of white parents born within Arctic Circle, and known world-wide as 
“Snow Baby”. For her birth details of 6:45 p.m., 12 Sept 1893, Lat. 77.44N, Long. 76W, according to 
Regiomontanous house system the order of the houses is reversed compared to the usual order, e.g. in 
Sayana (Tropical) 1“ house begins with its cusp at Pi 26 %4 and covers the zodiac to Aq 26 at which 
point 2" house has its cusp. As per Campanus house system, it is also in reverse way assuming that the 
cusps of 12,11,10,9,8 must be above horizon; Cusp 10" = Cn 3 4, 11= Ge 26 %, 12"= Ge 14, 1“= Pi 
26 %, 2™= Cp 21, 3™= Cp 9 %. But H.S. Green and other astrologers around him could not agree and 
would call the cusps as given those of 4,3,,2,1,12,11 instead of 10,11,12,1,2,3 as given by these house 
systems. "A symposium of astrologers" had been then invited by Alan Leo to settle the matter but its 
conclusions were not to hand at the time when his book went to press. 


2. According to Michael Wackford’s study (see reference no. 6), any agreement was ever achieved 
seems unlikely since both sides are correct according to their own point of view. While the trigonome- 
try of Campanus or Regiomontanus demands that the northerly degree be presented as an MC, astro- 
nomical principle suggests the southerly, even though this degree is below the horizon. 


3. The nature of Polar region charts, the problems faced by houses systems and proposals for improve- 
ment can be studied in the given references. This article is only a case study of Marie’s chart how dif- 
ferent house systems and KP rules work for her life events. 


Marie’s Basic Chart 


4. Marie Peary, 12 September 1893, 18:45 p.m. LMT, 4:34:12 (4.57) West of GMT, Anniversary 
Lodge, South shore of Bowdoin Bay (McCommick Bay), Inglefield Gulf, Greenland, 77 N 40, 68 W 
30, Asc. Pi 03:56:02, KPNA 22:16:59, Mars Dasa balance 3y, 4m, 6d, by KPAstro 3.5 

5. Source note is as follows: The house where Marie was born served as headquarter for Peary’s 1893- 
1895 Polar Expedition. Peary named the house “Anniversary Lodge” because he and Josephine had 
spent their first wedding anniversary at this location, which was given by Peary at 77.40' N Latitude, 
for instance in ‘Robert Edwin Peary: Northward over the great ice: a narrative of life and work 
along .... Volume 2, page 206, F.A. Stokes Company, 1898’. According to the map of Peary’s Polar 
Expeditions in ‘Katherine Kirkpatric: Snow baby: The Arctic childhood of Admiral Robert E. Peary's 
daring daughter, Holiday House, 2007, page v’, the nearest longitude position of “Anniversary Lodge” 


is 68 W 30. — http://www.astro.com/astro-databank/Peary%2C_ Marie 


Marie’s Chart by Different House Systems 


6. The Marie’s chart by different house systems of Campanus, Regiomontanus, Topocentric which 
provide the reverse order of houses and Alcabitus, Equal, Koch, Placidus, Prophyry which give the 
usual order of houses are attached. Since the chart by Koch, Placidus and Prophyry are exactly the 
same, only the Placidus chart is attached.

Q. How is baby’s health for now? 

A. 1' CSL Mo signifies 6 (disease) along with 1(self existence), 10 (12 from 11" -badhaka) and 5 (vitality). The 
6'" CSL Ve signifies 1°‘ of native-the baby himself. For about three years, J u will play the role of the running 
Dasa lord. Here J u is lord of 6 (disease) and posited at the favourable house of 5 (immunity). However, J u’s 
Sublord Me once again negates the health cause by being placed at 11 (badhaka) and lord of 12 
(hospitalization). As we know, the sublord is the deciding factor. 


Consequently, after assessing these three (1° CSL, 6°" CSL & Dasa lord) aspects, the conclusion is that the 
baby would remain in poor health and any serious health related problem may rise to the baby. 


Q. What about his longevity? 
A. 1° CSL Mo signifies favourable 1, 5 and 10 (12" to 11-badhaka) to be healthy along with unfavourable 6, 2 
(maraka), 7 (maraka). Note that all the nine planets signify either 6 or 8 or 12 or maraka-badhaka. 


So, medium longevity up to 66 years of age would be there for the baby. 


Q. How would be his education? 

A. Nowadays children are starting their nursery educations at their age of about 2 1/2 to 3 years. Surprisingly, 
Ju dasa will come to an end at his age of 3 and then Sa dasa will start. For magnificent education, 4" CSL and 
relevant dasa lords should signify either 4 or 9 or 11. Here 4‘ CSL Me is good for education by signification of 
3,4,11 along with 5,12 (not good for serious study). The Dasa lord signifies 4 along with 5,12 and absence of 11 
(fulfilment of studying desire), indicating average (not so brilliant) education. 


Consequently, the student would be average at his school plot and after school he can pass out with a 
Bachelor degree. 


Q. Would he do further higher study? 
A. 9" CSL Mo does not signify either 4 or 9 or 11, as discussed at the beginning of this article. 


So, further higher study is not found astrologically 


Q. Being star-son, would he go to film industry or somewhere else? 
A. |f the question is for art or films, the 5‘° cusp must be judged for its influence. The word “pleasurable pur- 
suits” is well said by sages for 5" cusp. If the native’s 1* & 10" CSLs and the relevant dasa periods should have 
the signification of 5" cusp. We have discussed above 1°' CSL Su, 10° CSL Me and also relevant dasa lord Me at 
age of 22-39 years signify 5,11. 

Yes, the native may go to film industry. 


Q. How would be his pre-marriage and married life? 

A. Here his 5"" CSL Ra does not signify 7 or 11 and so the native can’t expect pleasurable love-life. Surprisingly, 
Ra is also 7 CSL but it has Ve & Ke in its star and cannot be a strong significator of 7. Now for married life once 
again we have to scrutinize Ra. Readers may note that Ra Is not at all connected with 2, 7 or 11 for marriage. 
But it is not proper to conclude that marriage Is not promised as Ra’s star and sub lord Ve Is closely conjoined 
with Ma, lord of 2,7. 


As per thorough judgement, the native may not have enjoyable pre-marriage and married life. 


Q. What would be his success magnitude? 

A. First of all, assessment of 1° cusp by Ascendant lord and 1*' CSL should be scrutinized. 

1. The Ascendant lord Ve has placed at 1° and its star lord Ra at 3 bhava, so it is good. 

2. 1° CSL Mo has a good magnitude of desirable signification of houses 2, 5, 6, 10 without 8. 
3. Here neither 1° cusp signifies 11" (fulfilment of desire) nor 11" cusp signifies 1°.

1. This article is an attempt to find the astrological indicators of throat cancer, which was diagnosed only at the 
4'" stage even in the case of the Hollywood super star Michael Douglas. Also it is to try to find the clue why doc- 
tors were unable to see the reality of his health and the cause of his discomfort. 


Theoretical Rulership of Throat Cancer 


2. The nature of cancer is uncontrolled growth of cells. Such a process Is connected to J upiter, the planet of ac- 
celerated cell growth and tumor formation. Moreover Saturn Is a planet for obstruction and malignant type of 
disease like cancer. Rahu is the planet responsible for malignant tumor or growth. Mars can trigger changes in 
the evolvement of the disease. Since cancer involves the mutation of cells that happen in an underground fash- 
ion, the Planet Pluto and the sign Scorpio may be prominent in the cancer chart. A cancer that commenced with 
a Mars connection may be cured, but one starting with a Saturn connection is more serious, and one commenc- 
ing with a Pluto connection is likely to be fatal. 


3. Sign Taurus governorship and planet Venus rulership of the throat are undisputed. But 

house rulership of the throat is taken 2" or 3 of different views. As per theory of relationship between sign and 
house meanings, it seems always to have existed in anatomical matters, such that the lst house and Aries both 
relate to the head, the 2nd house and Taurus to the throat and so on. 


4. The ruling or responsible signs, planets and houses for throat cancer should be 

studied whether they are connected with houses 6 (disease), 8 (Serious disease, surgery) and 12 
(hospitalization). The disease finder 6" cuspal sublord connection to these signs, planets and houses would play 
a crucial role. Also the sign lord and star lord of 6" cuspal sublord may be checked in addition to the 6"" cuspal 
sublord, its star lord and sub lord. 


5. Moreover the influence of Maraka (2,7), Badhaka (11 for movable, 9 for fixed and 7 for common sign Asc.) 
and Moksha (12) would be studied, since cancer is frequently a fatal disease. An additional indicators may be 
connection to trigonal or terminal houses of 4,8,12 or detrimental houses to cure or untreatable 12,4,10 (12™ to 
1,5,11). House 10 is also retirement from this world. 


6. There are, of course, other things to be studied on case by case basis since something as varied as cancer Is 
hard to pin down tn the horoscope, because it strikes very differently in people's charts.

i ntroduction 


1. This article is an attempt to find the astrological indicators of throat cancer, which was diagnosed only at the 
4'" stage even in the case of the Hollywood super star Michael Douglas. Also it is to try to find the clue why doc- 
tors were unable to see the reality of his health and the cause of his discomfort. 


Theoretical Rulership of Throat Cancer 


2. The nature of cancer is uncontrolled growth of cells. Such a process Is connected to J upiter, the planet of ac- 
celerated cell growth and tumor formation. Moreover Saturn Is a planet for obstruction and malignant type of 
disease like cancer. Rahu is the planet responsible for malignant tumor or growth. Mars can trigger changes in 
the evolvement of the disease. Since cancer involves the mutation of cells that happen in an underground fash- 
ion, the Planet Pluto and the sign Scorpio may be prominent in the cancer chart. A cancer that commenced with 
a Mars connection may be cured, but one starting with a Saturn connection is more serious, and one commenc- 
ing with a Pluto connection is likely to be fatal. 


3. Sign Taurus governorship and planet Venus rulership of the throat are undisputed. But 

house rulership of the throat is taken 2" or 3 of different views. As per theory of relationship between sign and 
house meanings, it seems always to have existed in anatomical matters, such that the lst house and Aries both 
relate to the head, the 2nd house and Taurus to the throat and so on. 


4. The ruling or responsible signs, planets and houses for throat cancer should be 

studied whether they are connected with houses 6 (disease), 8 (Serious disease, surgery) and 12 
(hospitalization). The disease finder 6" cuspal sublord connection to these signs, planets and houses would play 
a crucial role. Also the sign lord and star lord of 6" cuspal sublord may be checked in addition to the 6"" cuspal 
sublord, its star lord and sub lord. 


5. Moreover the influence of Maraka (2,7), Badhaka (11 for movable, 9 for fixed and 7 for common sign Asc.) 
and Moksha (12) would be studied, since cancer is frequently a fatal disease. An additional indicators may be 
connection to trigonal or terminal houses of 4,8,12 or detrimental houses to cure or untreatable 12,4,10 (12™ to 
1,5,11). House 10 is also retirement from this world. 


6. There are, of course, other things to be studied on case by case basis since something as varied as cancer Is 
hard to pin down tn the horoscope, because it strikes very differently in people's charts.

A boy of Panchkula (Haryana), who has recently completed his MBA from a reputed institute after passing 
B.Tech. , got campus selection in Noida ( New Delhi) for foreign country with a good package under the condi- 
tion that he will serve MNC for at least 2 years and before joining it he will have to execute a 2 year bond with 
MNC. 


His parents were divided in sending him abroad and filling of bond. The boy along with his parents approached 
me to check astrologically whether he will go abroad on job basis or he will do job in India. | asked the boy di- 
rectly to give me a number between 1 to 249. Accordingly he gave me number 11. | made the horary calcula- 
tion on date 16-06-2010 at 6:28pm at Chandigarh. 


At the time of query Moon was in the 4" house, lord 4 & 5 houses. Moon was in the star of Mercury in house 2, 
lord of 3 & 6, and its sub lord Rahu was in 9. Rahu was aspected by Jupiter lord of 12. So the question relates to 
the foreign going and prospect of job in abroad or India and | proceeded further to solve the problem. 


As per Horary Astrology 6" Reader page 300 by Sh. K.S. Krishnamurti: 


Going to foreign country implies that one has to leave the present permanent place, shown by 3” house ( 12"" to 
4". ) make a long journey, indicated by 9" house, and stay for a short time or settling down in foreign, denoted 
by 12'" house of new environment and surroundings. 


For foreign going it is to check 12'" cusp sub lord whether it is retrograde or deposited in a constellation whose 
lord is retrograde, if either is retrograde, one cannot go abroad in horary analysis. If the sub lord and lord of con- 
stellation in which the sub lord is situated are in direct motion and if the 12" cusp sub lord is also a significator of 
either 3° or 9" or 12" house, one can go abroad. 


Here is the case where 12" cusp sub lord is Saturn, significator of 6 by occupation and 10,11 by lordship and in 
star lord of Sun, significator of 2 by occupation, In addition Saturn is in his own sub Saturn to be strong in giving 
his signification. 


Here in this case 12'" cusp sub lord, its star lord and sub lord are not a significator of either 3 or 9 or 12 for for- 
eign going. So | told him frankly that he would not proceed to foreign country as if then. 


Further | checked whether he would! get a job in India. Here 6'" sub lord is also Saturn and as discussed above 
Saturn signifies 2,6,10,11, all houses required to get a job. | therefore told him that he would get a job in India. 
Further to check is whether his desire will be fulfilled on the basis of 11" cusp sub lord as under: 


11'" cusp sub lord is also Saturn, signifying 2,6,10,11, as discussed above. So | told him that there might be 
some delay in fulfillment of his desire of getting job due to the delaying nature of Saturn, although he certainly 
would get a job.

To check war from horary chart | was trying to fix some rules but that rule fails badly, and this time | have used 
my modified rule for war. 


Rule-1 

Is there any war? When? 

If 3" (relations with neighboring country) CSL signifies 4° (concern of national security), 9" (foreign relation), 
7 (International disputes), there will be a war during DBAS of 4,9,7. 

Rule-2 

Who will win in War? 


If 10" (national reputation) CSL signifies 4 (outcome of anything), 10 (national reputation, the end of war), 2

Question: 
Which Time Zone, IST or LMT, is to be used in calculation of India Independence Chart, Aug 15, 1947, 0:0:0 AM, 
77E14', 28N40' (Delhi)? 


Answer: 
1. As far as my reading and web search go, only IST of August 15, 1947, 00:00:00 AM, Delhi has been used in astro- 
logical circles of both Western and Indian, as shown in the references at the end of this answer. 


2. The rationale is that the already introduced IST since Jan Ist 1906 was operating at Deli at the time of India Inde- 
pendence. 


http://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Indian_ Standard Time 


3. Any LMT used chart has not been come across, except the one proposed by someone in a letter to an astrological 
magazine, saying that Mr. Kanak Bosmia had used the ‘wrong’ IST time of the Indian Independence chart in his article 
of “Railway Accidents in India’ (KPE-zine Jan 2009). 


4. For India Independence data, Aug 15, 1947, 00:00:00 AM, 77E14', 28N40' (Delhi): 

1) as per commonly used 00:00:00 AM (IST: 5:30 East), Ascendant is Taurus 7:52:25 (KP New Ayanamsa 
23:02:08) and Saturn Dasa balance at birth 1s 17Y,11M,12D; 

2) as per not found using in astrological circles 00:00:00 AM (LMT: 5:08:56 East), Ascendant is Taurus 13:32:54 
(KP New Ayanamsa 23:02:08) and Saturn Dasa balance at birth is 17Y,7M,19D. (in the above mentioned pro- 
posed chart Ascendant is Taurus 13:27:34 due to Geocentric latitude adjustment.) 

3) As the time difference of 21m:4s between IST and LMT is significant, the first chart as per IST, second chart as 
per LMT and third chart as proposed using LMT and Geocentric latitude adjustment are attached to see the 
differences in the sub lords and dasa periods. 


5. In the following references, the IST based chart is indicated by Ascendant Gemini of around 00:54 min in the West- 
ern tropical (sayana) charts and Ascendant Tarus of around 8 deg in the Indian charts.

One person approached me on 23-5-2010 when | was on tour to Delhi and was staying in Gurgaon. He was 
searching a shop on rent for starting a business. 


He had put up a simple question, When will | get a shop for starting my business? | prepared a time chart at 
19:26:37 Hrs on 23-05-2010 at Gurgaon. 


The time chart for the query Is as follows: 

Co-ordinates of judgment: 

In a query relating for obtaining the shop or premises, the 10" house is important, as the 10" house is the 4" 
house (property) of the opponent (7" house). In case, the native is to obtain the premises on rent from the op- 
ponent, the 4°" cuspal sub-lord must signify the 10" house (premises), 12'° house (expenses on security and 


rent) and 11°" house (for realization of the ambition). 


On the other hand, the opponent (7 house) gets the money (2-6 house) yet retaining the premises in his 
name (4 house). 


The Query: 


Fundamentally, in any prashna, the lagna indicates the subject matter of the query, while the Moon indicates the 
Status of mind and the matter on which the querist dwells about. 


Look to the lagna SbL-Rahu, which is placed in the star of 7" lord Venus located in 7 house, indicating the sub- 
ject matter of business in view. Look to the Moon which is placed in the 10 house, pointing to the profession. 


Thus, the query is well indicated in the prashna chart and it was comfortable to proceed further. 

Analysis 

Examine the 10" cusp. 

10°" cuspal sub-lord is Saturn which is the lord of 3 house and 4" house and represents the shop to rent. Retro 
Saturn shows a stubborn, unrelenting old man as the owner of the shop. Saturn falls in the star of Sun as 10" 
lord placed in 6" house. This shows the owner owning the shop (also 4 house from 7") who may be renting it 
out for the financial gains (6 house). Saturn being in its own sub placed in 10" house affirms the availability of 


the property for native’s work. 


Note that Saturn has the sub-lordship of 3"? and 4" cusps also, thus directly linking these cusps. The signification 
of Saturn for 3-4-6-10 houses affirms the high availability of the shop. 


Since the 4" sub-lord is also Saturn, the shop to be obtained was to be old one without cleaning and even not

Friends asked me to predict whether Sara Scazzi was coming back home.

(Kanak Bosmia In KPE-zine) and started looking at the following chart.

Introduction 


1. As suggested by an elderly KP astrologer, sunrise times used in the KP supported astrological softwares and 
the computer generated Ascendant have been reviewed itn this article for information of the KPE-zine readers. 


Different Views 
2. Generally four different views or formulas have been found in calculating sunrise and sunset times by com- 
puter softwares as furnished below, in order of earlier time to later time, based on the sunrise and sunset times 
on January 1, 2010, 10:00 am IST, 5:30 East of UT, for Chennai, India, 13N04, 80E17: 
1. when Sun’s upper tip/disc/limb/edge/ray Is visible on the eastern horizon, taking the atmospheric condi- 
tions into account (This is default setting of KPAstro 3.5 and 3 option of J Hora 7.4 referring “The tip of 
Sun's disk appears to be on the eastern horizon”.) under “Sunrise and sunset definition” options; 
Sunrise 6:31:14 am, Sunset 5:53:24 pm 
2. when Sun's disc center is considered (This is an option of KPAstro 3.5, namely “Consider Disc Center” 
under “Rising/Setting Options” and 4th option of J Hora 7.4 referring “The center of Sun’s disk appears 
to be on the eastern horizon”.);

before the sight of the semi disc (half) of the rising Sun and a similar duration following the Sun set are called

| mpact of Sunrise Time Definition on Calculation of Ascendant 


26. The sunrise time has nothing to do with the Ascendant calculation by current softwares or modern manual 
calculation method as the sunrise time is not used in this process. The Ascendant remains exactly the same, 
e.g. Aquarius 10:23:56 (KPNA 23:54:23) by KPAstro 3.5 for January 1, 2010, 10:00 am IST, 5:30 East of UT, 
Chennai, India, 13N04, 80E17, irrespective of using any sunrise time definition (1 to 4 or any other). 
http://www.trans4mind.com/personal_development/astrology/Calculations/calcAsc.htm 
http://www.chrismitchell. bristolastrology.net/ascendant_calculation. html 


27. Only in the Hindu traditional method of Ascendant calculation where the sunrise time is used, the Ascendant 
changes depending on the sunrise time used. 
http://www.vedicastro.com/astronomy6.asp 


http://www.astrojyoti.com/LagnaCalculationBasics.htm

Other I mpacts of Sunrise Times Definition 
28. Different sunrise definition has impact on calculation of Vedic parameters of special lagnas like Bhava, 
Hora, Ghati, Vighati and upagrahas like Gulika, Mandi, Kaala, Mrityu, Arthaprahaara, Yamaghantaka, and Rahu 


Kalam etc, which are related with sunrise and sunset times. 


29. When birth time Is stated in ghatikas and vighatikas after sunrise (or sunset as the case may be) in a local- 
ity, sunrise definition impacts conversion to hours and minutes. 


30. In the marginal cases, the Hindu day lord, from sunrise to sunrise, can change. 
Conclusion 


31. The sunrise time definition does not impact the computer software generating Ascendant and it can be 
found practically by switching the sunrise time definitions or options. 


32. In the rare marginal cases, the sunrise time definition can change the Hindu day lord, which is used in the 
KP ruling planets and the KPDP matching calculation. 


33. There is only a single reference to Gulika in the KP literature, I.e. KP Reader II] page 215 (Original Edition 
Practical Part page 58) (same in original Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2 of 1965 Sagar Publications page 109), 
although approximate Gulikakalam, Rahukalam and Yamagandam are shown in KP ephemeris. 


34. The bottom line is not to worry ourselves with the so-called delicate correct time of sunrise since the differ- 
ence of around 3 to 3 % minutes Is not a big deal with compared to the accuracy of birth time and different 
values of ayanamsas. One can use whichever sunrise definition he or she prefers.

Background In Brief 


Marilyn Monroe was an all-American success story. She rose from the ranks of orphan to onscreen sex idol. She 
was married to a sports legend, a literary giant, and was supposed to have affairs with both John and Bobby 
Kennedy. She had everything, yet according to her friends, scared for her life. Her fear was well founded. 





On August 5th 1962, the world learned of Marilyn Monroe’s death. She was discovered by her housekeeper in 
her bedroom, nude and facedown, on her bed. She died from an overdose of Nembutal and chloral hydrate and 
her death was ruled a suicide. Whether these substances were self-administered or not, still to this day, is one 
of debates.

Suspicious Points on Murder or Suicide 


Many interesting, non-explained phenomena surround Marilyn’s death are too many to list. Below, however, are 
some of the most intriguing points to ponder. 


e There was no suicide note ever recovered. 

e How could Marilyn swallow Nembutal tablets when no water glass was found on her nightstand and 
the plumbing system in the adjacent bathroom was turned off? 

e Why did it take four hours after the discovery of her death to inform police and why are there so 
many discrepancies as to what happened during that time by so many people? 

e Her autopsy results showed no trace or residue of any tablet in her stomach or small intestines. Also 
toxicology studies on these organs were never done. 

e She had a fresh bruise on her back that couldn’t be ruled out as an act of violence. 

e The autopsy showed a purple discoloration of the large intestine, suggesting that drugs may have 
been introduced here rather than being swallowed. This discoloration, as noted by one of the medical 
examiners present, was inconsistent and non-characteristic of oral barbiturate overdose death. 

e Peter Lawford, the Kennedy’s brother-in-law stated, "Marilyn took her last big enema’. 

e Marilyn’s psychiatrist, in response to a reporter’s question concerning her death stated, " | can’t ex- 
plain myself or defend myself without revealing things that | don’t want to reveal.... because | can’t 
tell the whole story. Listen.... talk to Bobby Kennedy." 

e The sealing of her file by the government, the destruction and loss of the many records during that 
time and the death of many of the people involved.

Arthiritis: 





external resources 


Hands affected by rheumatoid arthritis, an autoimmune form of arthritis 


Arthritis (from Greek arthro-, joint + -itis, inflammation; plural: arthritides) is a group of conditions involving 
damage to the joints of the body. There are over 100 different forms of arthritis. The most common 
form, osteoarthritis (degenerative joint disease) is a result of trauma to the joint, infection of the joint, or age. 
Other arthritis forms are rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, and related autoimmune diseases. Septic arthri- 
tis Is caused by joint infection. 


The major complaint by individuals who have arthritis is joint pain. Pain is often a constant and may be localized 
to the joint affected. The pain from arthritis occurs due to inflammation that occurs around the joint, damage to 
the joint from disease, daily wear and tear of joint, muscle strains caused by forceful movements against stiff, 
painful joints and fatigue. 

Classification 

Primary forms of arthritis: 

Osteoarthritis 

Rheumatoid arthritis 


Septic arthritis 
Gout and pseudo-gout 
|uvenile idiopathic arthritis 


Still's disease 
Ankylosing spondylitis 


Osteoarthritis: Osteoarthritis is the most common form of arthritis. It can affect both the larger and the 
smaller joints of the body, including the hands, feet, back, hip or knee. The disease is essentially one acquired 
from daily wear and tear of the joint. Osteoarthritis begins in the cartilage and eventually leads to the two op- 
posing bones eroding into each other. Initially, the condition starts with minor pain while walking but soon the 
pain can be continuous and even occur at night. The pain can be debilitating and prevent one from doing any 
type of activity. Osteoarthritis typically affects the weight bearing joints like the back, spine and pelvis. Unlike 
rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis is a disease of the elderly. More than 30 percent of females have some de-

Osteoarthritis, like rheumatoid arthritis, cannot be cured but one can prevent the condition from worsening. 
Weight loss Is the key to improving symptoms and preventing progression. Physical therapy to strengthen mus- 
cles and joints is very helpful. Pain medications are widely required by individuals with osteoarthritis. When the 
disease is far advanced and the pain is continuous, surgery may be an option. Unlike rheumatoid arthritis, joint 
replacement does help many individuals with osteoarthritis. 


Rheumatoid arthritis: Rheumatoid arthritis is a disorder in which, for some unknown reason, the body's own 
immune system starts to attack body tissues. The attack is not only directed at the joint but to many other parts 
of the body. In rheumatoid arthritis, most damage occurs to the joint lining and cartilage which eventually re- 
sults in erosion of two opposing bones. Rheumatoid arthritis affects joints in the fingers, wrists, knees and el- 
bows. The disease is symmetrical and can lead to severe deformity in a few years if not treated. Rheumatoid 
arthritis occurs mostly in people aged 20 and above. In children, the disorder can present with a skin rash, fe- 
ver, pain, disability, and limitations in daily activities. No one knows why rheumatoid arthritis occurs and all 
treatments are focused on easing the symptoms. With earlier diagnosis and aggressive treatment, many indi- 
viduals can lead a decent quality of life. The drugs to treat rheumatoid arthritis range 
from corticosteroids to monoclonal antibodies given intravenously. The latest drugs like Remicade can signifi- 
cantly improve quality of life in the short term. In rare cases, surgery may be required to replace joints but there 
is no cure for the illness. 





Rheumatic fever has now seen resurgence in America primarily because of mass immigration of people from de- 
veloping countries. The disorder can present with a migratory nature of arthritis with many other features 
like heart problems, skin rash, gait abnormality and skin nodules. 


Lupus: This is a common collagen vascular disorder that can be present with severe arthritis. Other features 
of lupus include a skin rash, extreme photosensitivity, hair loss, kidney problems, emotional lability, lung fibrosis 
and constant joint pain. 


Gout: Gout is caused by deposition of uric acid crystals in the joint, causing inflammation. There is also an un- 
common form of gouty arthritis caused by the formation of rhomboid crystals of calcium pyrophosphate known 
as pseudogout. In the early stages, the gouty arthritis usually occur in one joint, but with time, it can occur in 
many joints and be quite crippling. The joints in gout can often become swollen and lose function. 


Other: |nfectious arthritis is another severe form of arthritis. It presents with sudden onset of chills, fever and 
joint pain. The condition is caused by bacteria elsewhere in the body. Infectious arthritis must be rapidly diag- 
nosed and treated promptly to prevent irreversible and permanent joint damage. Psoriasis is another type of 
arthritis. With psoriasis, most individuals develop the skin problem first and then the arthritis. The typical fea- 
tures are of continuous joint pains, stiffness and swelling. The disease does recur with periods of remission but 
there is no cure for the disorder. A small percentage develop a severe painful and destructive form of arthritis 
which destroys the small joint in the hands and can lead to permanent disability and loss of hand func- 
tion (Courtesy: Dr. Bhadmidipati Satyanarayana, MD)

The Moon afflicted in Capricorn gives a tendency to articular rheumatism, lack of synovial fluid, eruptions of 
the skin troubles.

and other eruptive or inflammatory skin diseases; 

Mercury afflicted in Capricorn gives a tendency to rheumatism, especially in the knees; pains in the back, 
Skin diseases, melancholy; 

J upiter afflicted in Capricom gives a tendency to various skin diseases. 

Venus afflicted in Capricorn gives a tendency to gout in the limbs. 

Saturn in Capricorn gives a tendency to articular rheumatism, eczema, erysipelas, and other diseases of the 
Skin;

In Medical Astrology, the significators for arthritis and rheumatism are Saturn, Mars, Moon, J upiter and Mer- 
cury and also Sagittarius/9th house and Capricorn/10th from Ascendant. Mars usually leads to short periods of 
intense pain, while Saturn mostly means long periods of ache. (Encyclopaedia of Medical Astrology by H.L. Cor- 
nell) The stars representing the disease are Moola, Purvashada, Uttarashada and Sravanam. 


Generally the 6th, 8th and 12th houses or lords of the above houses are relevant to this disease as the 6th de- 
notes disease besides the house of location of disease. 8th house is the house of surgery, while the 12th Is 
house of hospitalization, surgical treatment besides the location of disease, the houses 12, 8, 6 have to be 
taken into account from Lagna.

This case is a recent case of my relative’s son who came home as guest and had to appear for the selection 
process interview as pilot in national airways. 


Out of sudden curiosity, | wanted to find out If the native would be selected in the said interview process. | took 
horary number 70 myself directly targeting the native and did not find the need of rotating the chart. The ques- 
tion was “Will the native gets selected in national airways?” The matter was taken up for scrutiny at 23:03:49 
Hrs on 11-08-2010 at Bangalore. 

Co-ordinates of judgment: 

In a query relating to the interview and the results thereof, the 3™ and 9°" houses get most pertinent. The 3 
house indicates the performance from the native and 9°" house indicate what is asked for from the interview 
panel. If these houses signify the 11" house, the native gets successful in the interview process. The securing a 
job is through 10" house as it governs the fructification of karmas. 


Finally, the dasha sequence plays finally decisive role and for the positive results, the dasha planets should be 
well disposed towards fructification with favorable transits. 


The Query: 


Fundamentally, in any prashna, the lagna indicates the subject matter of the query, while the Moon indicates the 
Status of mind and the matter on which the querist dwells about. 


Look to the lagna SbL-Sun, which is placed in the star of 3-12" lord Mercury placed in 2"? house. This was ex- 
actly in consonance to my worries, as the interview process at airlines service selection board Is normally tough. 
This indicated that there is something to worry. 


Moon itself gets placed in 2™ house. Moon falls in the star of 11" lord Venus indicating high hopes, the native 
had in securing the job. Moon was the lagna lord that indicated the high self esteem. 


Thus, the query Is well indicated in the prashna chart and it was comfortable to proceed further. 
Analysis : 
Examine the 3 and 9™ cusp. 


3™ and 9" cuspal sub-lord is Venus which is in the star and sub of Lagna lord Moon placed in 2" House. 
This indicates high confidence level, the native had in facing the interview process (lagna signified). 


However, in the placement of Moon in Lagna did not show fructification of success, as it negates the 2" 
house of acquisition. 


Look to Fortuna 
Fortuna falls in the 5" house which indicates which negates the job promise (6" House). 
Fortuna falls in the star of 3 and 12thy lord Mercury and being in the sub of 6" and 9th lord J upiter placed 
in 9° house. This gave sufficient hopes with hurdles. 


Examine the 10" cusp 


10" cusp indicates the job in question for which the interview was attempted. 10°" cuspal sub-lord is 8" lord 
Saturn placed in 2" house and very close to the 3 cusp, thereby generating sufficient hopes. 


At the stellar level, it is noticed that Saturn falls in the star of Sun placed in lagna. Saturn falls in the sub of 
11" lord Venus placed in the 3™ house. This gave sufficient hopes towards securing a job till then.

Examine the 11" cusp. 
By the examination of the various cusps, the 3 cusp of interview performance by the native and Fortuna 
seemed restricted though 10" cusp did indicate positive promise. The 11° cusp would now decide the over- 
all fructification of the result. 


11" cuspal sub-lord is Mars which is a strong planet as it does not have any planet in its star. Positionally, 
Mars is placed in 3 house, a progressive house, which seemed positive to start with. 


At the stellar level, Mars falls in the star of Moon which is placed in the 2"? house of job acquisition. Mars is 
placed in the sub of retro-] upiter which is a strong planet as there is no planet in its star. J upiter placed in 
9'" house gives the toss in the hand of the interview board (9" house). 
Note that J upiter is positionally very strong and its placement in 9° house (own house) throws away all the 
promises of securing the job. This is because of the fact that the 9"° house negates 10" house of profession 
in principle and secondly by way of the retrogression of J upiter as sub-lord of the 11™ cuspal sub-lord Mars. 
Both these points negate the fructification of the 11" cusp. 
Thus, the securing of the said job was not thought to be possible. 

Examine Dasha sequence 
At the time of query, the dasha of Ven-Mars-Mercury was operating. 
Briefly examining the pratyantara dasha of Mercury, it was noticed that Mercury was placed in the sub of 
retro-] upiter, and as said for the retro-J upiter in the preceding para, the positive fructification of securing 
the job was not possible. 


Conclusion 


Looking to all logistics of analysis as above, it was concluded that the native would not be finally selected 
and it would be a frustrating experience to the native though he might fare decently.

Native was not selected, was rejected in the last round of selection process and was sent back home.

Introduction 


1. Heart attacks are the leading cause of death all over the world. According to the figures, released on J une 19, 
2009, by the Delhi Government’s Economic Survey, heart disease is the single biggest killer in the National Capi- 
tal, followed by diabetes, I.e. the survey, released on Friday, heart attacks killing approximately 15,442 people in 
2007, in comparison to diabetes killing 3,920 people. 


2. Heart attack is defined as a case of coronary thrombosis. This happens when the heart is unable to pump 
blood efficiently to all parts of the body. 


http://www. whereincity.com/medical/topic/heart/diseases/heart-attack-54.htm 


http: //en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Myocardial infarction 





Chief Rulers of the Heart 


3. Sun is the undisputed ‘ruling planet’ of the heart, and consequently sign Leo owned by Sun becomes the 
‘ruling sign’ of the heart. As Leo is 5" sign in the zodiac, the 5" house from the Ascendant is the ‘ruling house’ of 
the heart, consistently with the theory of relationship between sign and house meanings. These three chief rul- 
ers of the heart are accepted in the Vedic astrology where the 4"" house is considered as a ruling house of heart. 
(Essentials of Medical Astrology by Dr. K.S. Charak, 2002, pp 163-164; Medical Astrology by Dr. Shanker Adawal, 
2008, p 164) 


4. Since there are many kinds of heart diseases and major heart attack risk factors, other rulers of the heart like 
Moon, Jupiter, Aquarius etc are also to be studied on case by case basis. In this paper only the chief rulers of 
the heart have been observed on the basis of twelve charts.
