Question & Answer 


Q-1: | would like to know whether a person born in Alaska , North America will have the same 12 Bhavas as 
a person born in India or Malaysia ? 


A-1: It may not be the same for a person born in the higher latitude over 60° N since Alaska is located in 
the arrange of latitude 51°20'N to 71°50'N. For those living in the higher latitudes in places such as Alaska, 
Norway, Finland and Greenland, the astrological house systems have failed to provide a bhava chart similar 
for a person born in India or Malaysia. This is the case where the astrology has been under criticism for it's 
limited perspective and so some astrologers are trying to improve the existing house systems with modifica- 
tions for the proper calculation of horoscopes of those people living in the higher latitudes. (PI see the refer- 
ences given in the last month article on "A Case Study of Polar Region Chart") 


Q-2: | have followed the tutorials on KP System published in the KPE-zine. No doubt they are very useful for 
the astrology circles. But | have few doubts on timing of the event for horary chart and deciding the fruitful 
Significators and so | need additional guidance in this regard. 


A-2: Timing of event is the most difficult task for an astrologer of any level. In selecting the fruitful signifi- 
cators, the following priority order of significators may be changed up to one's preference: 


1. Significators of planets without having any planet in their stars, which are strongest to give the re- 
sults of the houses by being the sub lord to them. 
(Golden Rule: Take the planets which are posited in the sub of the significators 
whose constellations are not tenanted.) 

2. Significators which are posited in the stars of the cuspal sub lords of required houses for a matter 
under consideration, e.g. 2,7,11 for marriage, 

3. Significtors which are common with the ruling planets and significators appearing many times 
amongst the ruling planets and siginificators themselves; 

4, Significators which are the cuspal sub lords of the required houses. 


In the timing of horary for short term prediction, it starts usually with analysis of the current running Dasa 
and Bhukti by checking whether their lords are signifying the required houses for an event under consid- 
eration and also whether they in the RPs. If the current Bhukti lord is not a fruitful significators or in choos- 
ing the fruitful dasa period lords such as Antra lords, the above four priorities will have to play the role, tak-

This is a case from my file of records. One person asked me by mail that his son is looking for a decent position 
in a competitive exam for admission in medical displine. Though he was very confident for his son to get admis- 
sion in a professional college on merit, yet he wanted my opinion. 


| analyzed the query by drawing a time chart at 27-02-2009 at 09-52-52 Hrs IST at Bangalore. The chart was 
rotated to 5" house to represent the native in question. 


The horary chart is as follows: 
Co-ordinates of judgment: 


In a query relating to the higher education, the 4° and 9" houses get important. 4°" house represents the basic 
fabric of education, which also supports the higher education. Thus, 4°" and 9'" houses need be supportive to 
give scope of higher education. If these houses signify the 11" house, the native get successful in the selection 
process. The securing of a seat through competitive exams is seen by the 6" house if favorably linked to the 11" 
house. 


Finally, the dasha sequence plays decisive role and for the positive results, the dasha planets should be well dis- 
posed towards fructification with favorable transits. 


The Query: 


Fundamentally, in any prashna, the lagna indicates the subject matter of the query, while the Moon indicates the 
Status of mind and the matter on which the querist dwells about. 


Look to the lagna SbL-Sun, which is placed in the star of Rahu placed in 6" house meaning the subject matter to 
signify the competitive scenario. 


Moon itself gets placed in 8" house. Moon falls in the star of retro Saturn placed in lagna indicating the self- 
prestige at stake with invisible fear of failure. 


Thus, the query was well indicated in the prashna chart and it was comfortable to proceed further. 

Analysis 

1. Examine the 4" cusp. 
Moon is the 4" cuspal sub-lord, which is placed in the star of Retro Saturn in Lagna. Moon falls in the sub of 
Venus placed in 8" house. This did not portend the educational activities to take off but actually indicates a 
break in education. 

2. Examine 9" cusp 
Mercury is the 9°" cuspal sub-lord, which falls in the star of Moon placed in 8" house that did not show the 
domain of higher education to progress. Mercury falls in the sub of Venus placed in 8" house, thus sealing 
the option for the educational success of professional studies. 


3. Examine 6" cusp 


6‘ cusp indicates competition. 6" cuspal sub-lord is Saturn, which by way of retrogression does not funda- 
mentally indicate success in competitive exams. 


Saturn at the stellar level falls in the star of Venus placed in the 8°" house whereas its sub lord as 11" lord 
Mercury is placed in the 6" house.

Let us now analyze the swearing-in chart of Sri Nitish Kumar government, which is forming the 32° government

Saturn is in 6" house owning the 11" and 12™ house. Saturn therefore, represents the Badhaka house. Moon’s

ANSWER 
Punarphoo 


1. The whole idea of Punarphoo is condensed by Guruji KSK in one paragraph as follows: "Whenever Saturn 
has got any connection what-so-ever with Moon, there will be some obstacle or impediment, not only during 
negotiation but also at the time of fixation and even at the time of celebration of the marriage. This connec- 
tion between Moon and Saturn causes delay, though ultimately both of them do much more good with a 
better partner." (KP Reader IV page 74) 


2. Saturn's aspect on Moon is one of any connection of Saturn with Moon to form Punarphoo. The detailed 
definition of Punarphoo by Dr. Kar based on the KP Readers and also mentioned in the Punarphoo book can 
be found in the article on KP Marriage and Childbirth, under part 6 Punarphoo, in the KPE-zine J uly 2007 
issue. 


3. In the above article and also in the book review on Punarphoo in the KPEzine April 2010 issue and ques- 
tion & answer section of the KPEzine September! 2010 issue, it has been explained not to worry about 
Punarphoo other than its possible delay effect. 


4. The article and a short note on the KPDP Rules for Matching Marriage are available in the KPE-zine March 
2007 Issue and July 2007 Issue (KP Marriage and Childbirth, under part 7 KPDP) respectively. It can be 
found that the KPDP matching does not have any relation with Punarphoo. 


5. Similarly no validity of Mars Dosha in KP had been investigated empirically in the article on Analysis of 


Mars Dosha as per KP in the KPE-zine August 2007issue, 
and theoretically in the article on Mars Dosha in KP in the KPE-zine December 2008 issue.

Fortuna 


6. Fortuna is only a mathematical point in the chart, calculated in KP by the formula: 

Fortuna = Moon + Lagna - Sun (in longitude) (KP Reader |, p 98) 

Generally fortuna is supposed to improve the matters indicated by the house occupied by it. It may give 
fortune to one in the conjoined dasa period and sub period of the star lord and sub lord in which it Is pos- 
ited. (KP Reader III pp 178, 191/ Original Edition Practical Part pp 24, 36) Fortuna is not related to the 
KPDP matching. 


7. AS per the original Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol 1 pp 472-474 of Sagar Publication, 1966, the positive 
results of favorably placed fortuna in the various houses are as shown below:

Karaka 


8. In KP the signification of relevant house grouping is a deciding factor for an event to be promised and 
happen, and the Karaka can play only a supportive role, as demonstrated by the article, Imprisonment: A 
Study of 100 Prisoner Charts in the KPE- zine March 2009 issue. 


Consideration of Lagna Alone 


9. Moreover the limited use of Karaka in KP is for matters only, not for houses, which are set according to 
the Placidus house system. That is why there is no problem of whether a karaka is placed in the house for 
which it is the Karaka. The Karaka e.g. J upiter alone can't give the result of childbirth unless it signifies the 
required houses of 2 , 5 or 11 by occupation and lordship at planet, it's star and sub levels. 


10. In KP the Placidus houses are always to be counted from the Lagnat alone, never ever from the Moon, 
as only the house cusps, including the Lagna, vary in twin births in consideration of whether the house mat- 
ter will prosper or suffer. (KP Reader II| 243-4, 432-3/ Original Edition Practical Part p 85, 259; Astrose- 
crets & Krishnamurti Padhdhati Part Il, 2003, p 190; 30-6-69 dated Forward on Krishnamurti Padhdhati by 
Jyotish Marthand Shri K.S. Krishnamurti in the Astrological Tables for All by R. Eshwara Manu)
